title: Commercial Contracts Associate (NDA)
descriptionHtml:
About Norm

Norm builds AI-native professional services firms and the technology that powers them. Our mission is to help expert professionals deliver better work at greater scale.

Developing the technology and the firms together lets us rethink how work gets done, how teams operate and what clients can expect. Professional judgment and experience guide what we build, while advances in the technology expand what our firms can deliver. Our shared agentic platform connects that progress across teams and services.

Founded in 2023, Norm brings together experts across engineering, research, product, design and professional practice. Our legal and compliance platform serves institutions representing more than $35 trillion in combined assets under management.

Norm also powers Norm Law, LLP, an affiliated AI-native law firm whose attorneys advise leading institutions on complex corporate matters.

AI Fluency:
Norm prefers all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day-to-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end-to-end.

Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands-on experience, not theoretical familiarity.

This Role

As a Commercial Contracts Associate (NDA), you will work on a high impact team that provides important services to Norm Law’s clients, while using AI agents to streamline the drafting, review, and execution process in providing non-disclosure agreement review for clients. You’ll collaborate closely with partners, clients, and technology teams to deliver efficient, precise, and data-driven legal services for in-house legal teams of leading asset managers.

Our practice embraces the use of AI to reduce burden and increase your ability to focus on strategic legal judgment and client engagement.

What You'll Do

  • Document Drafting, Review, and Negotiation: Leverage AI agents to generate, compare, negotiate, and redline NDAs tailored to client guidelines

  • Incorporating Legal Context: Advise clients on their NDA playbooks and market standards, including ensuring AI agents understand each client's specific context and comparing client’s actual practices with playbook positions in order to guide updates.

  • NDA Execution: Integrate AI agents into workflow management, execution, negotiation, and coordination with counterparties for any NDAs.

  • Client Advisory: Partner with clients to demonstrate how AI-assisted workflows improve accuracy, transparency, and velocity.

  • Collaboration with Tech: Work closely with the technology teams to continue to make the NDA review process even more efficient using AI.

  • Managing high volumes of requests: Maintain a tracker, manage multiple high priority requests simultaneously and communicate timing expectations to clients and consistently and proactively follow up and move negotiations forward.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Our new product is a business loan for established UK SMEs, with fixed monthly repayments over 3 to 6 years. Most of the businesses we will be speaking to already know us, so the job is to reach the right people, understand what they need and take good applications from first conversation through to a funded loan.

You will be the person who owns that journey day to day: calling and emailing existing customers, running outreach campaigns, collecting the information we need to underwrite, and keeping the pipeline accurate so the team can see what is working. title: Consumer PR - Business Director
descriptionHtml:
About Ogilvy  

Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports & entertainment, PR & social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy was named Network of the Year at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and ranks as the #1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. For more information, visit Ogilvy.com, and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

Consumer PR - Business Director

Department: Consumer PR & Influence
Location: London
Contract Type: Fixed-Term 12-Months
Full Time/Part time: Full Time
Reporting into: Managing Partner 

The Role: 

As Business Director you will lead client partnership, strategic counsel and integrated delivery across the portfolio, designed to provide the client with fully focused, senior leadership on some of the world’s most iconic FMCG brands. 

The role sits at the intersection of earned-first thinking, culture-led marketing, and integrated agency delivery, ensuring that PR, social, influence and advertising work together to create impact at scale across diverse markets. 
 
This pivotal role places you at the heart of our operations for large FMCG portfolio, one of the world's most iconic and dynamic brands.  

Your remit will span from the initial spark of ideation – identifying trends and innovative opportunities that drive cultural relevance – through the meticulous development of cutting-edge strategies tailored to diverse market nuances and brand objectives. You will lead the charge on defining compelling creative narratives and content frameworks, ensuring brand consistency and breakthrough engagement. Subsequently, you will oversee flawless execution, transforming strategy into impactful activations across various platforms and geographies.  

This role demands a holistic leader capable of driving innovation, navigating complex client relationships, and delivering measurable results within a dynamic, multi-market agency environment. 
 

Key Responsibilities: 

Client leadership & stakeholder management 

  • Act as the senior day-to-day client lead for European and Global teams, building trusted, long-term partnerships
  • Provide strategic counsel across brand, reputation, partnerships and cultural activation
  • Lead complex, multi-market stakeholder management across global, regional and local teams
  • Ensure the FMCG Brand has consistent, senior-level leadership fully embedded in the brand business 

Global & European strategy development 

  • Lead the creation of global and European communications toolkits, frameworks and playbooks that balance global brand consistency with local market nuance
  • Embed earned-first thinking into all toolkits
  • Partner closely with creative and strategy leads to shape culturally relevant, insight-led ideas 

Market management & intelligence 

  • Oversee market engagement across Europe and priority global territories, acting as a central connector between the brands global teams and local markets
  • Ensure clients are consistently informed on market trends, cultural shifts, competitor activity and emerging opportunities
  • Champion local market insight, ensuring work is adaptable, relevant and executable across diverse regions 

Global events & partnerships 

  • Lead the communications strategy and delivery for global brand moments and events, ensuring alignment across markets
  • Play a central role in developing and activating brand partnerships, embedding them seamlessly into toolkits and campaign narratives
  • Work with market and agency leads to bring partnerships to life in locally relevant, culturally resonant ways 

Team leadership & integration 

  • Directly manage a London-based team, working alongside creative and strategy leadership
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performance team culture grounded in integration and shared ownership 

What makes this role different: 

  • 100% dedicated to the FMCG portfolio, allowing for deep brand immersion and long-term strategic thinking
  • Operates at true global scale, balancing global brand stewardship with local market realities
  • Deeply partnership-led, with collaborations embedded into brand strategy
  • Strong emphasis on earned-first, culture-first marketing, influencing how integrated campaigns are built from the ground up
  • Sits within a fully integrated agency model, requiring constant collaboration across discipline 

Key Leadership Competencies: 

  • Proven experience in global and/or European leadership roles, ideally within FMCG or large-scale consumer brands 
  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills — this role is heavily relationship-driven and requires confidence navigating complexity 
  • Strong understanding of how global brands operate across markets, with sensitivity to cultural and market nuance 
  • Demonstrated experience working in integrated agency environments across PR, advertising, social and influence 
  • A passion for culture-led, earned-first marketing and its role in driving brand relevance and business impact 
  • Commercially astute, strategically minded and comfortable operating at senior client level 
  • A genuine interest in — and affinity for — the drinks brands and the wider FMCG landscape 
  • Communication & Collaboration: Defines and communicates the overarching vision for the Influence practice. Develops communication strategies that align the department with agency leadership and fosters a culture of open dialogue and mentorship for senior leaders. 
  • Organisation & Resource Management: Architects the department's operational structure to support profitability and growth. Oversees P&L, leads resource forecasting, and ensures the practice is structured to handle complex, large-scale business needs. 
  • Responsibility & Accountability: Holds ultimate accountability for the entire department's commercial and creative performance. Empowers directors to lead their teams while maintaining transparent, high-level communication with executive leadership on business progress and challenges. 
  • Problem Solving & Decision Making: Acts as the final point of authority on the most critical business issues. Makes high-stakes decisions that protect the agency's commercial interests and mentors directors in strategic problem-solving. 
  • Growth & Development: Champions and funds a departmental learning culture. Defines the long-term talent strategy, creates career pathways for all levels, and builds a best-in-class team through senior hiring and mentorship. 
  • Ogilvy Values & Behaviours: Acts as the ultimate custodian of the agency's values within the department. Embeds these values into the practice's core processes, from recruitment and client management to performance recognition. 
      

Skills for Your Growth to Client Partner: 
To support your progression, you will be expected to develop capabilities in the following areas: 

  • C-Suite Partnership & Business Acumen: Transition from a practice leader to a C-suite strategic advisor. Develop a deep, holistic understanding of the client's entire business model, competitive landscape, and financial drivers to become an indispensable partner to their most senior leaders. 
  • Integrated Solution Leadership: Evolve from leading a single capability to orchestrating the agency's full suite of services. Master the art of integrating diverse crafts—from brand advertising and PR to consulting and data—to solve the client's most complex business problems. 
  • Enterprise Commercial Strategy: Shift focus from departmental P&L management to owning the entire client commercial relationship. Drive enterprise-level growth by identifying strategic opportunities across the client's organization and negotiating large-scale, multi-year partnerships. 
  • Relationship as the Core Product: Move from a role where the craft is the primary product to one where the strategic client relationship itself is the core deliverable. Your success will be measured by your ability to build unwavering trust and long-term loyalty at the highest levels. 
     

Personal Qualities: 

  • Extensive and proven experience in a senior leadership role (e.g., Senior Account Director or Business Director) within a top-tier agency.
  • Strategic yet pragmatic
  • Culturally curious and globally minded
  • Confident, collaborative and calm under pressure
  • Energised by complexity, scale and partnership-driven work
  • Demonstrated track record of P&L ownership and delivering significant, year-on-year business growth.
  • Proven success in leading and winning multi-million-pound new business pitches.
  • Exceptional leadership skills with experience in shaping departmental culture and developing senior talent.
  • Strategic visionary with the ability to anticipate market trends and define a clear, forward-looking path for the business.
  • Outstanding commercial acumen and sophisticated negotiation skills. 

How we help you Thrive: 

  • 25 days annual leave + 1 Volunteer Day 
  • Bupa Healthcare 
  • Enhanced Maternity, Adoption and Shared Parental Leave 
  • Flexible Working Model with core working hours: 10am – 4pm 
  • A 1.5:1 Matching Pension Structure 
  • Wellbeing and Health: Up to £25.00 per month towards physical or online exercise class membership, Unmind membership, LifeWorks tool and annual eye tests. 
  • Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work Scheme 
  • Life Assurance 
  • Our ambition is to attract the very best diverse talent to Ogilvy, and to be the employer of choice in the UK. We want everyone to feel welcome when they join us, and once they’re here, for them to want to stay with us, grow their career, and to feel they belong with us.   

At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self-expression. 

We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality. 

Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve.  This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.

Ogilvy is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

descriptionHtml:

ALMMA, c'est la rencontre de deux pépites de l'agroalimentaire français : Foo Seng (spécialiste des snacks asiatiques) et Varachaux (expert des produits élaborés viande & végétal). Notre ADN ! L'énergie d'une start-up, la solidité d'un outil industriel. Pas de contradiction ici : on avance à la vitesse d'une équipe qui construit, avec la rigueur d'un groupe qui pilote des volumes, des flux et des échéances réelles.

Le poste

Au sein d'une équipe finance nouvellement créée et en plein déploiement, vous êtes le/la partenaire privilégié(e) de nos usines. C'est une création de poste clé, conçue pour un profil qui aime faire parler la donnée au cœur des ateliers de fabrication ! Rattaché(e) directement au CFO Groupe

En clair : une feuille blanche, un vrai mandat de builder. Vous ne reprenez pas un système existant, vous le créez, vous le modernisez, vous le simplifiez.

Vos missions

Envie de faire parler la donnée sur le terrain ALMMA !

Véritable chef d'orchestre de la performance industrielle, vous co-construisez nos indicateurs et accompagnez nos équipes de production pour maximiser la création de valeur :

Vos Missions :

  1. Calcul & Analyse Fine des Coûts de Revient :

  • Analyser au quotidien et à la semaine les écarts de fabrication : rendements matières, freintes, taux de rebuts/pertes et surconsommations.

  1. Gestion & Valorisation des Stocks :
  • Garantir la justesse et la valeur des stocks (matières, emballages, produits finis et en-cours).

Vos compétences

  • Bac+5 (grande école de commerce, école d'ingénieurs, Master CCA ou Contrôle de gestion)
  • 3 à 6 ans d'expérience en contrôle de gestion industriel, idéalement en agroalimentaire ou industrie manufacturière
  • Maîtrise de la comptabilité analytique, des méthodes de calcul de coûts de revient et des ERP industriels ;

✅ Esprit builder, passion du terrain, rigueur, culture produit et énergie positive

descriptionHtml:
Dich begeistern Creatives, die nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern skalieren? Wer wir sind

Content ist bei uns der Motor: Wir bauen unsere Inhouse-Creative-Produktion konsequent aus – mit echten Shootings, einem Creator-Netzwerk und KI-gestützten Workflows. Unser Grafikteam wächst, und wir suchen jemanden, der das gesamte visuelle Spektrum abdeckt.

Warum diese Rolle

  • Alles aus einer Hand: Video-Creatives, Statics, Social-Content, Shop-Banner, Produktbilder – du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für alles Visuelle und siehst deine Arbeit überall: in Ads, im Feed, im Shop.

  • KI als Werkzeug, nicht als Ersatz: Du nutzt KI-Tools, um schneller zu Varianten und Ideen zu kommen – und entscheidest als Designer:in, was davon gut ist.

Aufgaben

Performance Creatives

  • Du schneidest Video-Creatives für Meta, TikTok und weitere Paid-Kanäle – vom Rohmaterial aus Shootings und Creator-Content bis zum fertigen Ad, inklusive Hook-Varianten, Untertiteln und Sound.

  • Du setzt Briefings aus dem Performance-Team um und bringst eigene Ideen für Formate, Hooks und Varianten ein.

Social Media & Organic Content

  • Du produzierst Grafiken, Reels-Schnitte, Story-Formate und Carousels für unsere organischen Kanäle – konsistent im Look, angepasst an jede Plattform.

Shop, Amazon & Brand

Produktion & Workflow

  • Du integrierst KI-Tools in deinen Workflow – für Ideation, Bildvarianten, Freisteller, Übersetzungen oder Schnitt-Unterstützung – und teilst mit dem Team, was funktioniert.

title: Creative Lead
descriptionHtml:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

The Role

We're hiring a Creative Lead to help shape how tem shows up in the world. This is a senior, hands-on creative role sitting within our Brand & Credibility team, working closely with Product and Growth to turn strategy into work that's bold, sharp, and unmistakably tem. You'll report into the Senior Brand Lead and work closely together to build strong brand foundations and multi-channel campaigns that compound on each other for outsized impact. You won't just be setting direction from the sidelines. You'll be in the work daily, building alongside our existing creative team, low ego, high craft, always moving fast without dropping the bar.

In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Establish a clear creative system for tem's brand, from visual identity to campaign storytelling, that makes our work instantly recognisable.

  • Ship standout creative across a major launch or campaign that builds real emotional connection with a specific audience.

  • Take ownership of our tem self-serve creative AI tool, driving adoption across the larger organisation to reduce rote work without sacrificing quality.

  • Set up metric tracking and reporting for the studio, establishing a baseline for speed of execution and reporting progress against it.

  • Define what "fast and high quality" looks like for the studio, and put the systems in place to make it repeatable.

  • Identify and close a skills gap on the team through collaboration, hands-on coaching or targeted training.

Responsibilities

  • Shape the creative system: Translate our strategy and positioning into a distinctive visual identity, storytelling, and campaigns that make tem culturally relevant and instantly recognisable.

  • Build with impact: Deliver standout creative across launches, campaigns, web, and product moments that captures attention and builds emotional connection with specific audiences.

  • Lead an AI-first practice: Use modern AI tools and workflows to accelerate concepting, iteration, and production, and take ownership of our internal self-serve creative AI tool.

  • Lead without dictating: Put the systems and standards in place that everyone works to, and remove the blockers that get in the way of great work. You won't be across every project or act as gatekeeper - leadership here means levelling people up, not creative dictatorship.

  • Maintain high standards: Establish strong creative standards and help everyone produce work that feels bold, coherent, and world-class.

  • Balance pace and quality: Move fast without sacrificing craft, and bring the same energy to a scrappy project as to a major activation.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with Brand, Product, and Growth to make sure creative work drives real business outcomes, from brand awareness to product adoption.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • In-house experience shaping or evolving a strong brand, having played a key role in building a brand identity, campaign platform, or creative system that meaningfully changed how a company was perceived.

  • Practical, proactive experience bringing AI-driven tools into a business, with a track record of accelerating concepting, design, storytelling, or production.

  • A portfolio demonstrating exceptional creative craft, with bold, memorable work across brand, campaigns, and digital experiences.

  • Startup or scale-up experience, shipping quickly in a fast-moving environment while holding a high bar for quality.

  • Experience working across channels and with a range of budgets, from scrappy to significant, with equal commitment to both.

  • Leadership experience, paired with a genuine willingness to stay hands-on and do the work rather than only direct it.

Desirable

  • Experience in energy, fintech, or another highly regulated industry.

  • Experience working in a remote-first organisation.

  • Motion design experience.

Benefits & Perks

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,200 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to GBP150 or EUR150 per month for wellbeing.

Interview Process

  • First call with our Talent Team (30 mins).

  • Behaviour Interview with the Hiring Manager (30 mins).

  • Practical Interview with the Team (45 mins).

  • Bar Raiser Interview with a Business Leader (45 mins).

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

title: Customer Service Advisor – Peak 2026
descriptionHtml:
About the Role:

With two store launches landing just as we head into Black Friday and our busiest season of the year, it’s an exciting time to join.

We’re looking for a Customer Service Advisor to join our growing team on a fixed-term contract from November 2026 to January 2027, supporting us through Black Friday and our seasonal peak. The role is 37.5 hours a week, reports to the Customer Service Manager, and is hybrid between home and our office.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Provide the highest standard of service across live chat, WhatsApp, email, Instagram DMs and social media comments, using TALA’s brand tone of voice.

  • Prioritise live channels and manage several conversations at once, aiming for high first-time resolution with informative, caring replies.

  • Help customers with order tracking and delivery queries, including delays and parcels marked as delivered but not received, working with our fulfilment partner and couriers.

  • Support returns, refunds and exchanges: guide customers through our returns portal, process returns accurately and keep customers updated on their status.

  • Handle faulty, missing, incorrect and damaged item claims: gather evidence, follow agreed processes and escalate using our escalation matrix.

  • Give confident product, sizing and fit advice so customers buy the right size first time, and answer stock, restock and promotion questions during Black Friday and the Winter Sale.

  • Process order changes, cancellations and address updates within agreed timeframes.

  • Respond to customer feedback and product reviews, both positive and negative, and pass on any action or feedback needed.

  • Liaise with the brand and social media teams so replies follow our brand guidelines, and stay up to date on planned launches and social activity.

  • Act as the voice of the customer: share product feedback, recurring issues and ideas to improve our FAQs and help centre, so customers can self-serve 24/7.

  • Use and help maintain macros and template replies, tagging tickets accurately so our reporting stays reliable.

  • Work towards daily productivity targets, handling queues in the agreed priority order.

  • As part of the wider Customer Service team, support other tasks during busy periods when needed.

What we’re looking for:

  • Our customer service team operates 7 days a week between 08:00 and 20:00, so you’ll work a rota that includes weekends, some bank holidays and selected dates over Christmas and New Year. During launches and peak periods we occasionally work outside normal business hours.

  • Experience using Gorgias, Shopify, our SWAP returns, Monday.com and Slack is ideal, though not essential as training will be provided.

  • Previous customer service experience, focused on written communication (email, chat and social media)

  • Experience responding to and moderating social media channels.

  • Strong IT skills and confidence learning multiple platforms, some of them bespoke.

  • Fast, accurate typing and clear, friendly written English, with strong attention to detail.

  • The ability to stay calm and kind with challenging customers while sticking to policy.

  • Problem-solving skills, thinking quickly and creatively to find solutions for our customers.

  • Strong time and task management, and the ability to juggle several conversations at pace.

  • A personality that thrives in a fast-moving, quickly changing environment, with the willingness to try new things and take initiative, using good judgement to resolve issues or escalate for support.

  • A passion for great customer experiences, keeping the customer at the heart of everything you do.

  • This is an exciting opportunity for someone looking for their next challenge in a well-funded, fast-paced and high-growth ecommerce start-up

What we can offer:

25 days holiday a year plus bank holidays

Very generous employee discount after probation period

title: Customer Success Account Manager, Mid-Market
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types, from field services and utilities to long-haul transportation and school buses.
  • Manage a portfolio of 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to accelerate your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.
  • Lead the ROI and value conversation into the renewal, negotiate favorable terms, and close renewals that are a win for both the customer and Samsara while minimizing financial attrition.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience and to engage the right cross-functional partners to drive resolution.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to maximize the value of their Samsara products.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product to strategically solve problems and optimize customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in French (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years in a customer-facing, quota-carrying role (renewals, customer success, account management or sales), ideally in SaaS, technology or logistics.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication and presentation skills, and the ability to build trust with executives, users and internal teams.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Gong or similar GTM tools.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • A bachelor's degree from a 4-year institution, or equivalent practical experience.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • A strong bias towards action, big-picture thinking and high standards.
  • An AI-first approach: you use AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
  • Technical depth across a suite of products, with a bonus for hardware-software integration.
  • Industry Knowledge: Experience with routing, navigation, commercial trucking fleets, and logistics.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. title: Customer Success Manager (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Lumiform ist eine spezialisierte Software, mit der Frontline-Teams Inspektionen, Audits und Checklisten skalierbar über viele Standorte hinweg durchführen. Gegründet 2019 in Berlin, hauptsächlich für europäische Unternehmen gebaut. Unternehmen wie EDEKA, AmRest, Virgin Media und Nordsee sowie Prüf-, Inspektions- und Zertifizierungsgesellschaften setzen auf Lumiform (4,6 von 5 auf G2).

Jährlich laufen über unsere Plattform Millionen von Prüfungen. Jede einzelne macht einen Arbeitsplatz sicherer, einen Prozess effizienter oder ein Produkt oder einen Service besser. Wenn du mit deiner Arbeit einen Unterschied in der Gesellschaft machen möchtest, dann arbeitest du hier an einem Produkt, das genau das jeden Tag tut.

Über die Rolle

Das ist eine Rolle für jemanden, der den nächsten Schritt gehen will. Du bringst bereits 1 bis 2 Jahre Customer Success mit und willst jetzt echte Verantwortung: dein eigenes Portfolio aus namhaften Enterprise-Kunden, das dir gehört und das du weiterentwickelst.

Deine zentrale Kennzahl ist die Net Revenue Retention deines Portfolios. Das heißt, du denkst kommerziell und erkennst Wachstumspotenziale, kannst aber genauso souverän deeskalieren, kritische Situationen drehen und Churn verhindern, bevor er entsteht. Du bekommst kein „Startpaket" aus kalten Leads, sondern ein starkes Bestandsportfolio mit starken Marken, das nur darauf wartet, ausgebaut zu werden.

Aufgaben

  • Ownership deines Portfolios: Du verantwortest ein eigenes Book of Business aus namhaften Enterprise-Kunden, treibst es proaktiv statt auf Anfragen oder schlechte Health-Scores zu warten, und entwickelst es strategisch weiter.

  • Net Revenue Retention steigern: Du treibst Renewals, erkennst Expansion-Potenziale (zusätzliche Use Cases, Standorte, neue Buying Center) und machst aus zufriedenen Kunden wachsende Accounts.

  • Strategischer Sparringspartner auf Entscheider-Ebene: Du erarbeitest dir Zugang zu den relevanten Stakeholdern, führst strategische Account-Reviews und wirst zum Trusted Advisor deiner Kunden.

  • Deeskalation und Churn-Prävention: Du erkennst Risiken früh, führst kritische Gespräche souverän und drehst gefährdete Accounts, bevor sie kippen.

  • Onboarding, Aktivierung und Schulungen: Du führst neue Teams erfolgreich ein, leitest Workshops und sorgst dafür, dass deine Kunden das volle Potenzial der Software ausschöpfen.

  • Produkt und Zusammenarbeit: Du bündelst Kundenfeedback strukturiert fürs Produktteam und arbeitest eng mit Sales, Marketing und Produkt zusammen.

Qualifikation

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Du bringst 1 bis 2 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Customer-Success, Account Management oder Vertrieb mit, idealerweise im SaaS-Umfeld, und willst jetzt den nächsten Schritt mit mehr Verantwortung gehen.

  • Du hast ein kommerzielles Gespür: Du erkennst Expansions- und Wachstumschancen in deinem Portfolio und gehst aktiv auf sie zu.

  • Du kannst deeskalieren: Auch in kritischen Situationen bleibst du souverän, findest Lösungen und hältst Kunden.Kommunikation ist eine deiner Stärken. Du gehst selbstständig in Gespräche, auch auf Entscheider-Ebene, und bleibst dran, bis der Termin steht.

  • Du verstehst technische Konzepte und kannst sie verständlich erklären.

  • Du denkst strategisch, planst vorausschauend und arbeitest gerne im Team.

Benefits

  • Ein eigenes Bestandsportfolio aus etablierten Kunden, das du eigenverantwortlich weiterentwickelst, mit klarem Weg zu größeren und strategischeren Accounts.

  • Neben deinem Fixgehalt eine variable Komponente mit Umsatzbeteiligung, wenn du dein Portfolio in neue Buying Center hinein ausbaust (horizontale Expansion).

  • Eine internationale Kundenbasis und die Chance, mit starken Brands auf Enterprise-Niveau zu arbeiten.

  • Ein Produkt mit echtem Purpose: Millionen von Prüfungen pro Jahr, die Arbeitsplätze sicherer und effizienter und Produkte und Services besser machen.

  • Modernes Büro im Herzen von Berlin-Mitte (Chausseestraße).

  • Investition in deine Zukunft mit einem jährlichen Lernbudget von 500 €.

  • Zusätzliche finanzielle Anreize: monatlicher Sachbezug von 50 € oder Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft.

  • Kostenlose Verpflegung: jederzeit guter Kaffee, Tee, Schorlen, frisches Obst sowie Bier oder Wein.

  • Flexibilität und Balance mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Home-Office-Möglichkeiten.

  • Ein internationales Team mit flachen Hierarchien und offenem Feedback, in dem du viel Verantwortung übernehmen kannst.

Wenn das nach dir klingt, dann lass uns sprechen. Wenn du bereit bist, mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen, dein eigenes Portfolio starker Kunden aufzubauen und an einem Produkt zu arbeiten, das täglich einen echten Unterschied macht, freuen wir uns auf dich.

Lebenslauf oder LinkedIn-Profil genügt, ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht.

Unser Hiring-Prozess:

  1. Interview mit HR (30 Minuten)

  2. Interview mit unserem Head of Customer Success (30 Minuten)

  3. Challenge (wird dir vorab zugesendet, damit du dich in Ruhe vorbereiten kannst)

  4. Referenzgespräch (als letzten Schritt sprechen wir mit einer Referenz von dir)

descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En tant que Customer Success Manager Key Accounts (CSM KA), tu accompagnes un portefeuille de cabinets partenaires grands comptes (7 à 10 comptes, Top 150) qui déploient Pennylane auprès de leurs équipes et de leurs clients.   • CSAT sur ton portefeuille.

  • Qualité de la gouvernance et autonomie des relais locaux.

  • Réduction des risques et amélioration de la rétention.

  

Profil recherché

    • en Customer Success SaaS avec de bonnes bases comptables (ou motivé(e) à monter en compétences à ce sujet

title: Customer Success Team Leader
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description

As Customer Success Team Lead, you’ll lead a team of approximately five Customer Success Executives. Together, you’ll help qualified SME prospects move through their onboarding journey, converting leads into open, funded and actively used Allica business current accounts.

You’ll coach your team to have confident, consultative conversations with business owners and decision-makers—understanding their existing banking challenges, explaining Allica’s value proposition and supporting them as they switch to Allica.

You’ll be accountable for team performance across the full onboarding journey, while ensuring every prospective customer receives a consistently excellent experience and a strong first impression of Allica Bank.

This is a highly collaborative role. You’ll work closely with Relationship Management, Product, Marketing, Growth, Data, Customer Due Diligence and Operations to improve the onboarding experience, remove friction and create better outcomes for customers.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Working closely with the Sales Managers of Customer Success, The Customer Success Team Leader will provide line management, capacity planning, pipeline management, coaching and development to support a team of Customer Success Executives.

  • Coach team members to engage SME decision-makers confidently by telephone and email, using a consultative approach to understand their needs and banking pain points.

  • Through close collaboration with our Customer Due Diligence, operations leaders and product teams, the Customer Success Team Leader will work to support reducing friction and improving the experience in the customer onboarding journey.

  • Understanding our onboarding process and requirements and supporting customers and prospects through this process to open current accounts and deliver a great customer experience.

  • Gaining feedback from customers and prospects on potential future features they need and want from their bank and bank account and feeding these into the Product teams.

  • Working with our Growth, Marketing and Data teams to feedback your learnings from customer interactions, helping us to drive ever better customer outcomes, targeting, segmentation and messaging.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • You will have managed and led a team either in person or remotely to successfully achieve KPIs relating to customer and colleague experience.

  • You should have a general understanding of SME financial products (eg payments, lending, accounting, CRM), and ideally specific expertise in business current accounts.

  • You will have a proven track record in telephone-based lead generation with established SMEs (typically 5-250 employee firms), including business development from cold prospects.

  • You will have excellent interpersonal and communication skills, together with evidence of outperformance in similar roles through earning customer and colleague trust.

  • You will demonstrate the ability to work collaboratively with specialist colleagues such as Relationship Managers, Operations, KYCB and underwriters, to deliver a positive outcome for our customers.

  • You’ll have a proven track record of exceeding targets, providing excellent customer service generating new income opportunities and always considering risk and reputation.

  • Experience working collaboratively with specialist teams such as Relationship Managers, Operations, KYC/CDD teams and underwriters.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Data Center Architect
descriptionHtml:
Role Profile

Job Title: Data Centre Architect

Reports to: Head of Data Centre Development

Location: UK hybrid

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we’re building this organisation from the ground up. We’re looking for people who’d rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of team you’ve previously managed.

This is a senior individual contributor role with authority to sign off technical schedules, working with cluster and network architects, NVIDIA and other OEM engineers, colocation provider engineering and sales teams, and the internal Procurement, Legal, Finance and Site Operations teams.

What You’ll Do

You will be the single technical authority between our GPU-as-a-service business and the colocation providers that host our NVIDIA clusters. You turn cluster architecture and OEM requirements into a precise, contractable statement of work (SOW) for the data centre white space, then hold the provider to it through design, installation and acceptance.

We are growing from tens of megawatts to hundreds, on rack-scale liquid-cooled platforms at 130 kW per rack and rising to 200 kW and beyond. Mistakes in power, cooling or fibre specification show up as stranded capacity, delayed cluster delivery and disputes, so the role carries real commercial weight.

Key Responsibilities

Technical negotiation with colocation providers

  • Lead technical due diligence on candidate sites: power availability and energisation dates, redundancy topology, liquid-cooling capability, floor loading, rack logistics, fibre and meet-me access.

  • Negotiate the technical schedules of the colocation agreement with commercial and legal: capacity and density commitments, power and cooling SLAs, temperature and flow envelopes, metering, expansion rights, change control and remedies.

  • Challenge provider claims with evidence: single-line diagrams, P&IDs, load-bank and commissioning records, reference customers.

Specification & SOW

  • Work with cluster architects and OEMs (NVIDIA first) to capture rack, power, cooling, network and layout requirements, and keep them current across product generations.

  • Write and own the technical SOW for white-space fitout: containment and cooling interfaces, power distribution to rack, structured cabling and pathways, rack and POD layout, security zoning, labelling and records.

  • Define clear scope boundaries and responsibilities between us, the colocation provider, OEMs and installation contractors, with no gaps and no overlaps.

  • Maintain a requirements baseline with traceability from OEM document, to SOW clause, to acceptance test.

Design, installation & acceptance

  • Review provider and contractor designs, shop drawings and method statements against the SOW; run design reviews and close findings.

  • Define acceptance: factory and site tests, liquid flush and cleanliness, power quality, thermal performance at full load, fibre loss, burn-in, and the evidence pack needed for each gate.

  • Attend key witness tests and sign off, or reject, completion of each phase before hardware is energised.

  • Manage technical change requests and variations, and advise on cost and schedule impact.

Knowledge & standards

  • Build reusable reference designs, SOW templates and a site-scoring framework so each new deployment starts from a proven baseline.

  • Track the roadmap: higher rack densities, 800 VDC distribution, new cooling classes and optics, and tell the business early what it means for sites already contracted.

Deliverables You Own:

  • Site technical assessment: Scored, evidence-based report per candidate site, comparable across providers, with risks and mitigations.

  • Technical schedules to the colocation agreement: Measurable commitments, tested in acceptance, with remedies agreed by legal.

  • Cluster white-space SOW: Complete enough that a contractor can price and build without asking us questions; traceable to OEM requirements.

  • Reference designs and layouts: Rack, row and POD layouts, power and cooling single-line and P&ID level interfaces, fibre pathways and densities.

  • Acceptance test plan and evidence pack: Pass and fail criteria set before work starts; signed results per gate.

  • Requirements baseline and change log: One current version of the truth, with every variation recorded and costed.

  • Risk and issues register: Technical risks to schedule and capacity, with owners and dates.

Working Relationships:

  • Cluster and network architects: You translate their cluster design into facility requirements, and they rely on you to say what a site can and cannot carry.

  • OEMs, mainly NVIDIA: You are the facility-side counterpart; you obtain, interpret and challenge site-requirement documents.

  • Colocation providers: Day-to-day technical counterpart through negotiation, build and acceptance.

  • Procurement, legal and finance: You provide the technical substance of commercial terms and the impact of variations.

  • Site operations and deployment teams: You hand over a clean specification and acceptance evidence, and take back lessons learned.

What You Bring:

  • 8 or more years in data centre design, delivery or technical consulting, including at least 3 years on high-density (50 kW per rack or more) or liquid-cooled deployments.

  • Direct experience writing or reviewing technical specifications and SOWs for white-space fitout, and managing contractors against them to acceptance.

  • Strong working knowledge of data centre power: MV and LV distribution, UPS and generator topologies, redundancy models (N+1, 2N, distributed), busway and rack power, metering and power quality.

  • Strong working knowledge of cooling: direct-to-chip liquid cooling, CDUs, facility and technology loops, warm-water and dry-cooler designs, fluid quality and flushing, leak detection and containment.

  • Working knowledge of structured cabling and pathways for large GPU fabrics (single-mode optics, high fibre counts, InfiniBand and Ethernet physical layers), and of rack and POD layouts.

  • Familiarity with NVIDIA rack-scale platforms (GB200 or GB300 class, or later) and their facility requirements, and the ability to read OEM site-requirement documents critically.

  • Proven ability to run technical negotiations with colocation or construction counterparties, and to explain trade-offs to commercial, legal and executive audiences.

  • Command of standards such as EN 50600 and the Uptime Tier framework, ASHRAE TC 9.9 liquid-cooling guidance, and commissioning practice (levels 1 to 5).

  • Excellent written communication: you produce clear, unambiguous contract-grade documents.

Preferred Skills (Nice to Have):

  • Experience at a hyperscaler, neocloud or colocation provider on the operator or customer side.

  • Experience with 800 VDC or other DC distribution, large battery storage, or power smoothing for AI load swings.

  • Chartered engineer status or equivalent; recognised data centre credentials (for example CDCP, CDFOM, Uptime ATD or AOS).

  • Familiarity with BIM, digital-twin tools and requirements-management tools.

  • Willingness to travel up to 30% to sites in the UK, Europe and the US.

Success Measures:

  • First 90 days: Audit current colocation contracts and SOWs and list technical gaps; publish a requirements baseline for the current NVIDIA platform; take over technical lead on one live negotiation; agree the site-scoring framework with the cluster architects.

  • 6 months: One complete SOW issued and priced with no material scope disputes; acceptance plan agreed with the provider before build starts; reusable SOW template adopted by the team.

  • 12 months: Every new site contracted on the template with traceable requirements; clusters accepted on schedule with no facility-caused performance issues; fewer late variations and a measurable cut in time from site shortlist to signed technical schedule.

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up.

  • Inspire the change: There’s no blueprint for the future. You’ll embrace challenges and change.

  • You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same.

  • Get stuck in: You’d rather be building than overseeing. Our strategy will keep evolving, and so will you — attitude and adaptability matter more to us than a fixed playbook or a big team behind you.

Package & Process:

  • Employment type: Full-time, permanent.

  • Travel: Up to 30%.

  • Interview process:

    Talent Screening >Hiring Manager Screen > Technical Interview > Final with the Head of Data Centre Development.

title: Data & Insights Analyst
descriptionHtml:

Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. title: Data Operations & Labeling Specialist (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Data Operations team at Stark builds and maintains the core data pipelines, sensor logging, and annotation workflows that feed our AI and perception models. Operating at the intersection of hardware testing, flight logs, and machine learning, the team ensures high-throughput, high-fidelity data availability. We work closely with ML Engineers, perception experts, and external labeling partners to scale training data for autonomous defence systems.

YOUR MISSION

You are the crucial bridge between our raw field data, our external labeling partners, and our internal Machine Learning teams. Your mission is to ensure our AI models are trained on the highest quality data possible. You will own the day-to-day operations of the data labeling lifecycle: curating raw data, preparing annotation batches, managing vendor communication, and rigorously assessing the quality of incoming labels. If you are highly organized, detail-oriented, and interested in the intersection of data operations and Computer Vision, this is the perfect place to start your career in AI.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Own the day-to-day data labeling lifecycle: curate raw field data, create annotation batches, and prepare deliveries for external labeling companies.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for external data annotation vendors, clarifying edge cases and providing feedback on labeling guidelines.
  • Conduct rigorous Quality Assurance (QA) assessments on incoming label deliveries, track error rates, and create performance reports.
  • Support data curation efforts, filtering and selecting the most valuable sensor data (images, video, lidar) for model training.
  • Work closely with ML Engineers to understand their data needs, edge cases, and specific Computer Vision requirements.
  • Help maintain the data catalog by ensuring incoming datasets are properly tagged and logged.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented: you can manage multiple data batches, vendor deliveries, and QA processes simultaneously without dropping the ball.
  • Strong communication skills: you are comfortable coordinating with external vendors and writing clear, unambiguous instructions/guidelines.
  • Basic understanding of Computer Vision and Machine Learning concepts (e.g., bounding boxes, segmentation masks, object tracking).
  • Comfortable with basic scripting (Python) and data querying (SQL) to automate small tasks or filter data batches.
  • Pragmatic problem-solver who enjoys bringing order to chaotic data deliveries.
  • Fluent in English.

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

descriptionHtml:
Orcrist is building a next generation data intelligence platform using cutting-edge technologies. We're handling petabyte-scale data with sub-second queries. Our product is a Kubernetes‑based platform delivered as B2B SaaS or as a self‑hosted on‑prem solution, including air‑gapped deployments. We enable customers across defense, law enforcement, and enterprise to turn mission-critical data into actionable intelligence.

Role

As Data Protection & Quality Management Officer at Orcrist Technologies, you own our data protection framework and build and operate our ISO 9001 quality management system. You act as our appointed Data Protection Officer under GDPR and lead the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of our QMS.

Both are independent staff functions reporting directly to the C-Level Management. You advise, monitor, audit, and document; the business remains responsible for operational decisions and implementation.

We build AI platforms for customers in the defence and government sector. Data protection and quality management are essential to our business and customer trust. As the company grows, you will build these structures hands-on, working closely with engineering, product, people, IT, and our Information Security Officer.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain our data protection management system, including policies, processes, and documentation.
  • Act as our appointed DPO under Art. 37–39 GDPR and § 38 BDSG, advising management and teams on GDPR, BDSG, and TDDDG requirements.
  • Monitor compliance, including records of processing activities, processor agreements, TOMs, data protection impact assessments, and data subject requests.
  • Advise on privacy by design, international data transfers, retention, and personal data breaches.
  • Build and maintain our ISO 9001 QMS, including process documentation, quality objectives, risk-based thinking, and continual improvement.
  • Own the internal audit programme, track nonconformities and corrective actions, and coordinate certification and surveillance audits.
  • Prepare the annual management review and report on data protection risks, audit findings, and improvement priorities.
  • Train teams on data protection and quality management requirements.
  • Work closely with the ISB to align overlapping requirements while maintaining clear responsibilities and independence.
  • Travel occasionally to our offices in Berlin, Dresden, and Hamburg, as well as to other workshop locations across Germany, to facilitate workshops, training sessions, and audits.
  • On-site presence is expected to be more frequent during the initial implementation phase and primarily driven by audits and specific business needs thereafter.

About you

  • Certified DPO training (GDD, TÜV, DEKRA, or equivalent) and at least 3 years of hands-on GDPR experience.
  • At least 2 years of practical ISO 9001 experience and an internal auditor qualification based on ISO 19011.
  • Experience building and maintaining data protection management systems and QMS documentation.
  • The independence to challenge management, the judgement to prioritise risks, and a pragmatic approach to implementation.
  • Hands-on mindset and confidence working with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally within Germany and work in a hybrid setup, combining remote work with on-site activities.
  • German and English at C1 level or above.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience in a software, SaaS, or AI company.
  • Familiarity with ISO/IEC 27001.
  • Familiarity with AQAP-Standards.
  • CIPP/E or comparable certification.
  • Experience leading a first ISO 9001 certification.
  • Experience with GRC platforms or document control systems.

What we offer

  • Remote-first, Germany-wide: Work from wherever you do your best work, with regular team gatherings in Berlin and other off-site locations.

title: Data Scientist - Measurement, Experimentation & Causal Inference
descriptionHtml:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Role Overview:

As a Data Scientist, you will help measure the impact of PlayStation's products, features and commercial initiatives through experimentation, causal inference and applied data science.

Working at the intersection of data science, machine learning, product and commercial strategy, you will apply robust analytical techniques to solve complex business problems, generate actionable insights and support evidence-based decision-making across PlayStation.

This role goes beyond traditional A/B testing. You will apply modern causal inference, statistical modelling and machine learning techniques to evaluate initiatives where controlled experiments are difficult or impossible, collaborating closely with product, engineering, analytics and business teams to deliver high-quality measurement and insights.

This is an opportunity to work on high-impact initiatives affecting millions of PlayStation players while developing your expertise in experimentation, causal inference and applied data science.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Apply measurement methodologies across experimentation, causal inference and advanced analytics to evaluate product and commercial initiatives.
  • Design and execute robust measurement approaches across randomised experiments, quasi-experimental methods and observational causal inference where controlled experimentation is impractical.
  • Apply statistical, machine learning and AI techniques to solve complex measurement challenges and generate actionable business insights.
  • Apply advanced data science and machine learning techniques where appropriate to complement experimentation and support complex business decisions.
  • Contribute to the development and adoption of best practices for experiment design, statistical analysis and causal measurement.
  • Partner closely with product managers, engineers, analysts and business stakeholders to identify high-impact measurement opportunities and ensure product and commercial decisions are supported by rigorous evidence.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams by providing feedback on experimentation and measurement capabilities to improve tooling and workflows.
  • Develop reusable analytical solutions, dashboards and code that improve the quality, consistency and efficiency of measurement.
  • Communicate analytical findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Stay current with emerging developments in statistics, machine learning and AI, identifying opportunities to improve measurement capabilities and analytical workflows.
  • Contribute to a culture of evidence-based decision-making by sharing knowledge, collaborating across teams and promoting analytical best practices.

What We're Looking For:

Required:

  • Master's degree (or equivalent industry experience) in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science or another quantitative discipline. PhD preferred.
  • 3+ years of industry experience applying experimentation, causal inference, statistical modelling, machine learning or related analytical techniques to solve business problems.
  • Good understanding of experimental design, A/B testing and modern causal inference methods, including quasi-experimental approaches.
  • Experience applying data science, machine learning and statistical modelling techniques to analyse complex datasets and generate actionable insights.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for analytical workflows.
  • Experience developing robust analytical solutions using sound statistical principles and software engineering best practices.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Curiosity, creativity and a pragmatic approach to solving ambiguous business problems.
  • A collaborative mindset with a passion for continuous learning and improving analytical capabilities.

Preferred:

  • Experience working in gaming, digital products, consumer technology, e-commerce or subscription businesses.
  • Familiarity with modern data engineering and analytics tooling such as Databricks, Snowflake, Git and Airflow.
  • Experience with modern business intelligence and data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Domo or Power BI.
  • Experience applying AI tools, including large language models (LLMs), to improve data science workflows and analytical productivity.
  • Experience developing reusable analytical frameworks, libraries or internal tooling.
  • Experience presenting analytical findings and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders.

What You'll Influence:

  • Measurement for PlayStation's product and commercial initiatives.
  • High-quality experimentation and causal inference across product and business teams.
  • Product and commercial decisions through rigorous analytical evidence.
  • The continued evolution of PlayStation's measurement and experimentation capabilities.

Why You'll Love This Role:

  • Help shape how PlayStation measures product and commercial success across a global business.
  • Work on challenging real-world problems using experimentation, causal inference and machine learning.
  • Collaborate with talented scientists, engineers and product teams on high-impact initiatives.
  • Learn from experienced data scientists while developing your expertise in modern measurement and experimentation.
  • Contribute to the adoption of evidence-based decision-making across PlayStation.
  • Continue growing your technical and business skills in a collaborative, supportive environment.

descriptionHtml:

At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurers have been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure; it’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

We don’t take on traditional “transformations” (we have brilliant partners for that) – we specialise in handling only the most difficult and interesting problems our customers face, where only a combination of technical depth, market expertise and hx knowledge will do.

The Delivery Engineering team are the experts' experts of the hx platform, knowing it top-to-bottom, inside-out – both breadth and depth. You’ll learn its limits and which can be pushed.
