title: Enterprise Account Executive III - Netherlands
descriptionHtml:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionaryin 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to build Camunda’s Dutch Government market. This is a territory-building role for a disciplined, consultative seller who can create demand, shape strategic opportunities, and guide complex buying groups through to executive-level decisions. You will own the full sales cycle across a focused set of government accounts, from account strategy and first conversation through business case, procurement, negotiation, close, and expansion.

You will combine commercial ownership with public-sector credibility. The successful candidate will be comfortable engaging senior civil servants, CIO and transformation leaders, procurement, security, architecture, and business stakeholders. You will translate government priorities into a compelling value case for process orchestration, automation, and agentic workflows, while navigating formal procurement processes and the governance expectations of public-sector customers.

What you will own

  • Own the Dutch Government territory and create a clear account and coverage strategy across priority national and public-sector organizations.

  • Build and maintain a healthy, self-generated pipeline, targeting at least 2.5x pipeline coverage through focused outbound activity, executive engagement, partner collaboration, and market development.

  • Develop relationships across complex buying groups, including CIOs, CTOs, transformation leaders, enterprise architects, process owners, procurement, security, legal, and executive sponsors.

  • Lead the full enterprise sales cycle: discovery, qualification, value engineering, technical evaluation, business case, procurement, commercial negotiation, and close.

  • Apply MEDDICC consistently to create deal clarity, strengthen qualification, identify gaps early, and improve forecast reliability.

  • Build business cases connected to public-sector outcomes such as service quality, operational efficiency, transparency, resilience, compliance, and cost control.

  • Coordinate account teams across Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Professional Services, Marketing, Product, Legal, Finance, and leadership.

  • Developa partner-first motion with relevant global system integrators, regional partners, and public-sector specialists.

  • Expand successful customer relationships by identifying adjacent processes, departments, agencies, and use cases after the initial land.

  • Maintain accurate account, contact, opportunity, and forecast data in Salesforce as the single source of truth.

  • Share market intelligence on government priorities, procurement dynamics, competitors, partners, and customer needs to improve Camunda’s Dutch public-sector go-to-market strategy.

What success looks like

First 30 days

  • Build a working understanding of Camunda’s platform, value proposition, sales methodology, customer evidence, pricing approach, and public-sector references.

  • Align with internal stakeholders on territory priorities, account ownership, partner coverage, and available sales resources.

  • Produce an initial account segmentation and stakeholder-mapping plan for the Dutch Government territory.

  • Establish a repeatable operating cadence for pipeline creation, deal inspection, forecasting, and cross-functional account-team collaboration.

First 90 days

  • Complete strategic account plans for the highest-priority government accounts, including business priorities, buying groups, whitespace, partners, competition, and next actions.

  • Create qualified pipeline through a balanced mix of net-new opportunities, partner-sourced activity, executive introductions, and expansion plays.

  • Develop a strong network of relevant government and ecosystem stakeholders, with clear relationship and meeting objectives.

  • Demonstrate consistent MEDDICC qualification and accurate Salesforce hygiene across active opportunities.

  • Identify the most relevant public-sector use cases and value narratives for Camunda’s Dutch market development.

First 180 days and beyond

  • Establish a credible, repeatable pipeline engine for the Dutch Government market.

  • Progress strategic opportunities through well-defined qualification, value validation, technical evaluation, procurement, and commercial stages.

  • Win new government logos and create expansion paths into additional departments, agencies, or processes.

  • Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors and public-sector ecosystem partners.

  • Contribute actionable market insight that improves Camunda’s positioning, messaging, partner strategy, and investment decisions in the Netherlands.

  • Deliver against quota while protecting long-term customer value, adoption, and expansion potential.

What you will bring

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of success in a quota-carrying enterprise software or SaaS Account Executive role, owning complex deals end to end.

  • Demonstrated experience selling into the Dutch Government or another highly regulated public-sector environment, with a clear understanding of formal procurement, security, legal, and governance requirements.

  • A track record of creating pipeline through proactive outbound activity and converting multi-stakeholder opportunities into material, preferably multi-year, contracts.

  • Strong command of MEDDICC or a comparable enterprise sales methodology, with the discipline to qualify rigorously, manage mutual action plans, and forecast accurately.

  • Executive presence and communication skills in Dutch and English, with the ability to connect operational problems to strategic, financial, and citizen-impact outcomes.

  • A collaborative, customer-focused, and resilient approach aligned with Camunda’s FAITH values and global-first way of working.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience selling process automation, workflow, orchestration, integration, business transformation, or adjacent enterprise technology.

  • Existing relationships across Dutch ministries, executive agencies, municipalities, provinces, public-service organizations, or government-focused partners.

  • Experience working with global system integrators, regional implementation partners, or public-sector framework agreements.

  • Familiarity with Camunda, BPMN, DMN, process orchestration, cloud platforms, or agentic automation.

  • Experience creating quantified value cases for service modernization, compliance, operational resilience, or cost reduction.

Why this role matters now

Dutch public-sector organizations are under pressure to modernize services, improve efficiency, operate securely, and coordinate increasingly complex technology and regulatory environments. Process orchestration gives them a way to make that complexity visible and manageable while connecting people, systems, and automation.

This role is an opportunity to shape a market rather than inherit a mature patch. You will have the ownership and visibility to define where Camunda can create the greatest public value, build the ecosystem around those opportunities, and establish a durable foundation for growth in the Netherlands.

You will join a global, distributed team that values initiative, transparency, customer impact, and practical collaboration. The role offers the chance to work at the intersection of public-sector transformation, enterprise technology, process orchestration, and the next generation of agentic automation.

This role is an existing vacancy

#LI-AG1 #LI-Remote

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

  • United States: $281,300.00 to $453,500.00

  • United Kingdom: £176,600.00 to £290,500.00

  • Singapore: S$349,400.00 to S$524,000.00

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices.

⭐️ The Enterprise Account Executive job

We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for a ‘full-stack’ Enterprise Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that mostly focuses on large companies from Tech, Syntec, HCR, and B2B services, interacting with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.

Why is this segment interesting?

  • Diverse workforce: Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

  • Critical challenges: Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers (creating multiple potential blockers), long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

  • Company profiles: Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

  • HR priorities: Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

  • Critical business characteristics: This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise AEs.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

What will you do with us?

You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. In our Enterprise Sales team, you will deal with companies with more than 300 employees, including all CAC40 companies.

At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.

We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.

Take a look at this testimonial from Emilie Quellec and watch Julien Plessis, both part of the Enterprise Sales team 👀


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Enterprise team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 8 years of experience in Sales, including at least 2 years managing the whole Enterprise Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing.

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

title: Enterprise Architect - Salesforce Marketing Cloud
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore. 

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on  LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

Do you thrive on shaping the strategic technological future of the world’s leading brands? Are you a visionary architect who can orchestrate complex MarTech ecosystems to deliver hyper-personalised customer experiences at scale? Can you translate ambitious business objectives into scalable, compliant, and future-proof enterprise architectures? 

If you are a strategic technology leader with a consultancy mindset, strong stakeholder management skills, and a passion for driving innovation across enterprise MarTech landscapes, then you might be the Enterprise Architect we’re looking for. 

What will your day look like? 

As an Enterprise Architect, you will be the strategic technical leader responsible for defining, evolving, and governing enterprise-wide MarTech architecture for our clients. You will operate at the intersection of business, technology, data, and innovation, translating business strategies into scalable architectural roadmaps that drive measurable business outcomes. 

You will act as a trusted advisor to both clients and internal stakeholders, ensuring that enterprise marketing ecosystems align with long-term business objectives while supporting innovation, operational excellence, scalability, and profitability. 

You will also act as an ambassador of VML MAP values, principles, and ways of working, contributing to the growth and evolution of the wider Tech & Data practice. 

More specifically, your responsibilities will include: 

Strategic Vision & Enterprise Roadmaps 

  • Define and maintain enterprise MarTech architectural roadmaps aligned to both short-term and long-term business goals. 
  • Translate complex business strategies into scalable technical visions and actionable transformation plans. 
  • Align enterprise architecture with broader business and marketing objectives to support growth and customer-centricity. 
  • Support clients in defining future-state architecture and transformation strategies. 

Enterprise Architecture & MarTech Orchestration 

  • Design and orchestrate complex enterprise MarTech ecosystems involving multiple platforms, marketing clouds, vendors, integrations, and data sources. 
  • Define scalable architectural blueprints and integration patterns across disparate systems and cloud environments. 
  • Ensure interoperability, scalability, performance, reliability, and operational efficiency across the wider technology landscape. 
  • Simplify and optimise enterprise ecosystems while maintaining alignment with strategic business goals 

Data, Governance, Privacy & Security 

  • Define enterprise-wide data architecture strategies, governance principles, and integration standards. 
  • Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA through Privacy by Design principles. 
  • Establish architectural governance frameworks, standards, and best practices. 
  • Ensure enterprise solutions maintain strong security, scalability, and data quality standards. 

Innovation & Emerging Technologies 

  • Drive innovation initiatives and continuously evaluate emerging MarTech, AI, and cloud technologies. 
  • Identify opportunities to improve client ecosystems, operational maturity, and customer experiences through modern technology adoption. 
  • Stay up to date with evolving industry trends, enterprise architecture patterns, and best practices 
  • Champion AI adoption and innovation initiatives where relevant. 

Consultancy, Client Leadership & Business Growth 

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, including CMOs, Enterprise Architects, and business leadership teams. 
  • Influence strategic decision-making by connecting business needs with enterprise technology opportunities 
  • Support pre-sales, strategic consulting, innovation initiatives, and transformation programs. 
  • Partner with Account, Strategy, and Solution Consulting teams to identify growth opportunities and shape enterprise solution approaches. 
  • Balance technical excellence with commercial pragmatism to drive both client value and sustainable delivery outcomes. 

Cross-Capability Collaboration & Technical Leadership 

  • Operate across cross-functional and cross-capability teams, including Tech & Data, Experience, Strategy, Paid Media, Marketing Operations, Solution Consulting, and Account capabilities. 
  • Provide technical leadership across large-scale and complex client engagements. 
  • Mentor and support Solutions Architects, Technical Architects, Developers, and other technical specialists. 
  • Drive alignment across global teams, portfolios, and capabilities to promote reusable enterprise patterns and best practices. 
  • Contribute to communities, guilds, knowledge-sharing initiatives, and capability growth across VML MAP. 

Operationalisation & Continuous Improvement 

  • Support the stabilisation, optimisation, and operationalisation of enterprise MarTech ecosystems. 
  • Ensure enterprise solutions deliver measurable business outcomes and long-term operational success. 
  • Oversee KPIs, performance metrics, and ROI expectations across enterprise platforms. 
  • Participate in resolving complex technical and operational challenges across client ecosystems. 

Who are you going to work with? 

You will operate at the intersection of business and technology, engaging with a broad spectrum of stakeholders internally and externally. 

You will work closely with: 

  • C-suite stakeholders, including CMOs and enterprise leadership teams. 
  • Client architects, technical teams, and external vendors. 
  • Internal Account, Strategy, Experience, Paid Media, Marketing Operations, and Solution Consulting teams. 
  • Technical Architects, Solutions Architects, Developers, Data Engineers, TPMs, and other Tech & Data specialists. 
  • Communities, Guilds, and innovation initiatives across the wider VML MAP organisation. 

At VML MAP, we value diversity, collaboration, innovation, and continuous growth. We empower our leaders to bring both strategic thinking and personal leadership into their day-to-day work while helping others grow and succeed. 

What do you bring to the table? 

As a person, you are a strategic and influential technology leader with strong emotional intelligence and consultancy capabilities. You can navigate ambiguity, influence senior stakeholders, and connect business strategy with enterprise technology direction. 

You are highly collaborative, self-driven, innovative, and commercially aware, with a passion for mentoring others and contributing to the wider growth of the organisation. 

You are comfortable operating across both strategic transformation discussions and complex enterprise technology challenges. 

In addition, you have: 

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in technical architecture, with extensive experience operating in Enterprise Architect roles within MarTech ecosystems 
  • Deep expertise across Salesforce Marketing Cloud and broader enterprise MarTech platforms such as Data Cloud, CDPs, CRM, Analytics, CMS, AdTech, and cloud ecosystems. 
  • Proven experience designing and governing enterprise-wide marketing technology landscapes across multiple vendors and cloud environments. 
  • Strong understanding of enterprise architecture principles, integration patterns, API strategies, cloud solutions, scalability, reliability, and performance optimisation. 
  • Experience defining enterprise data architecture, governance models, and privacy-by-design frameworks. 
  • Demonstrated experience influencing business outcomes through enterprise technology strategy and consultancy. 
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, including experience engaging with executive leadership and senior client stakeholders. 
  • Experience supporting pre-sales, innovation initiatives, strategic consulting, and business development activities. 
  • Passion for mentoring, knowledge sharing, and growing technical communities. 
  • Strong understanding of the digital agency landscape and consultancy-driven client delivery models. 
  • Experience working across global teams and cross-functional organisations. 
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF and their practical application within MarTech ecosystems. 

A leader in personalised customer experiences 

VML MAP is a world-leading Centre of Excellence that helps businesses humanise the relationship between brands and customers through hyper-personalisation at scale, marketing automation, CRM, and data-driven experiences. 

With the brain of a consultancy, the heart of an agency, and the power of technology and data, we work with some of the world’s most admired brands to help them become truly customer-centric organisations. 

As an Enterprise Architect, you will play a critical role in shaping and evolving enterprise MarTech landscapes, driving innovation, solving complex integration challenges, and aligning technology ecosystems with strategic business outcomes. 

Together, we are 1000+ technology specialists, data scientists, strategic thinkers, consultants, operations experts, and creative minds from 55+ nationalities. 

A global network 

We are part of the global VML network that encompasses more than 30,000 employees across 150+ offices in 60+ markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences. 

#LI-EMEA 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. 

When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to VML. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

title: Enterprise Core Account Executive, UK
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Are you a high-achieving sales professional ready to digitally transform the physical operations that power our planet? Samsara is seeking a driven Enterprise (Core) Account Executive to introduce our cutting-edge Connected Operations® Platform to Enterprise-sized customers across the UK. This is a unique opportunity to sell a much-needed product into a historically underserved market, working directly with leaders to drive real-world impact and unlock significant career progression. As a Strategic AE you will be helping large mid-market and enterprise sized customers consolidate outdated technologies, digitize workflows, and unlock game-changing data insights that will transform their businesses. We are helping the companies that literally keep our lights on, put food on our tables, and build our communities to become safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. Typical sales will be $100k to $500k, and typically involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
  • Proven expertise winning new business logos through a repeatable sales motion
  • Demonstrable expertise in strategic outbound prospecting, particularly via inside sales
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in Enterprise level accounts, winning multiple $100k+ ARR transactions
  • Experience handling enterprise deal sizes with multiple stakeholders at C-Level
  • Value based selling approach
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with demonstrated ability thriving in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  • Working remotely in UK, however comfortable traveling to meet customers as needed

An ideal candidate also has:

  • SaaS sales experience
  • Experience working with line of business stakeholders (Operations, Finance, IT)
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, customer facing environment
  • MEDDIC experience or similar (Sandler Pain Funnel, etc)
  • Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Highly collaborative with a growth mindset.
  • Awards for top achievement (President's club, Winner's circle, Top 10%)
  • Passion for the world of operations!

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

title: Enterprise Sales Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

Solution Consulting sits at the center of how Omnea wins - deals are complex, cycles are competitive, and multiple stakeholders (finance, procurement, legal, risk) all need to be convinced simultaneously. You are the person who takes a messy, high-stakes, multi-threaded sales process and makes the future state obvious and credible, working strategically with the world's largest logos. You'll be sitting across the table from C-suite executives at companies going through massive transformation projects, at the center of decisions that reshape how they operate.

Solution Consulting is not an established playbook you're stepping into. You're building it. You'll decide how we sell, what our demos look like, how we structure technical validation, and how the function scales as the team grows. You won't be stepping into someone else's playbook. You'll be shaping the entire GTM motion for our most important market.

You'll own & define the technical and business case throughout the sales cycles - from discovery through demo(s), supporting RFPs, and defining the solution approach. That means translating a prospect's current-state, disconnected tools, broken workflows, poor adoption, into a compelling, specific vision of what Omnea makes possible, and building tailored demos across an expanding product surface spanning orchestration, risk, compliance, legal, sourcing, and AP. You'll partner directly with our GTM team to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder multi-country deal - and act as the voice of the market back into product and GTM: what's working, what's not, and what needs to change.

What You'll Do

  • Own the technical strategy on our largest, highest-stakes enterprise deals: lead deep discovery across Heads of Procurement, IT, Security, and Finance, and translate what you uncover into a technical narrative compelling enough to justify a strategic investment, not just a tool purchase.

  • Multi-thread every stakeholder in the deal, from operational users to economic buyers, and navigate the political dynamics between teams that have never had to agree on a system before.

  • Scope, design, and own proof-of-concept projects end to end, combining a prospect's current state and processes within the Omnea platform to validate what that specific buying committee needs to see - not only a demo can run smoothly.

  • Present the outcome of a PoV and the roadmap to full implementation directly to executives up to C-level, framing the conversation around measurable ROI rather than a features checklist.

  • Build the reusable collateral, solution patterns, and demo frameworks that outlast your own deals: what you create should make every SE who joins after you productive faster than you were.

  • Mentor teammates on customer engagement and technical strategy, and help define what a great Solution Consultant at Omnea actually looks like, since the function itself is still being built.

  • Work hand in hand with Product: Bring competitive intelligence and prospect insight back from the field, and work with Product to shape what we build and how we position it.

What's Different About This Role

  • This is a career-defining chance to help build Omnea's GTM and Solution Consulting function from the ground up in the U.S., at a company that's still writing its playbook rather than handing you one.

  • You'll own complex enterprise deals end to end, working directly with AEs and senior customer stakeholders, which means you'll influence not just how individual deals get won but how the entire Solution Consulting function operates as it scales.

  • We're a flat, high-bar team where senior hires are expected to be self-directed from day one: you won't be eased in with a slow ramp or a junior support structure, you'll be trusted with real ownership immediately.

  • The company is on an incredibly strong growth trajectory with enterprise momentum behind it, which means the scope for you to create visible, immediate impact is significant rather than incremental.

  • Expect a genuinely meritocratic culture, one with high standards and direct feedback, where performance is recognized quickly and equity upside reflects the level of ownership and impact you actually have.

About you

Someone who thrives in this role is highly ambitious, genuinely energized by ambiguity and wants to influence how this function works from the ground up. They're also an exceptional individual contributor first: whatever they've been trusted with before, they've delivered on it.

  • 5-7+ years in enterprise sales engineering, solutions engineering, or senior technical consulting, ideally in B2B SaaS

  • A track record supporting high-contract-value enterprise deals - you know that winning one takes strategic positioning and deep discovery.

  • Comfortable working across large organizations with stakeholders at every level

  • Experience owning strategic accounts, mentoring others, or shaping solution strategy in a high-growth environment

  • An excellent communicator who can explain the same system to a procurement analyst and a CTO, and be credible to both

  • Proven as a top-performing individual contributor, with the ambition to go further: helping shape how the Solution Consulting function operates, not just working inside it.

  • Able to work from our New York office at least three days per week

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

title: Event Manager
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

As Event Manager, you will be Proxima Fusion in Munich, you will plan and deliver events ranging from investor dinners and international conferences to community engagement, exhibitions and team retreats. Your will translate strategic briefs into effective event formats and independently manage delivery, from planning and budgets, to on-site production and follow-up.

This is a hands-on role combining creative judgment,meticulous project management and team spirit. You will bring event expertise to the table, advise internal stakeholders on what will work and take responsibility for turning plans into successful experiences.

descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:

The 2027 plan, the account list and strong product marketing, DevRel and ecosystem teams are already in place. You’ll be one of the first hires on the growth team that brings it to life.

As a Field and ABM Manager, your role will include:

  • Account-Based Marketing: You will run ABM by tier. For our highest-priority European accounts, you’ll build 1:1 plans with AEs that include an executive sponsor, a custom business case, personalized pages, direct mail and invite-only dinners. For the next tier, such as sovereign EU clouds, NVIDIA Cloud Partners and telcos, you’ll run 1:few campaigns and adapt each quarterly campaign kit to European languages, regulations and buying processes.

  • The Sovereign AI Cloud Story: You will own the regional program for our Q3 sovereign AI campaign, built around RAISE Summit Paris. You’ll run roundtables and briefings on data residency and tenant isolation at the infrastructure layer for the buyers who care most about them.

  • Field Marketing & Events: You will plan and run executive dinners, roadshows, workshops and co-hosted events with NVIDIA, OEMs and ecosystem partners. You’ll turn KubeCon Europe, MWC Barcelona and ISC Hamburg into Tier 1 meetings and VIP dinners, and you’ll measure every program by how it moves accounts forward.

  • Buying Groups & Thought Leadership: You will reach the economic buyer, technical decision maker, champion, product owner and gatekeeper in every account, each with a message built for their role and market. You’ll put our executives, engineers and customers in front of European buyers through panels, roundtables and local media. You’ll also work with Content and Product Marketing to adapt assets for European audiences.

  • Sales Partnership & Measurement: You will agree on target accounts with European AEs and SDRs every quarter. Every touch gets a named follow-up owner and an SLA, and every high-intent event signal reaches an AE within two business days. You’ll track account progression weekly and program ROI quarterly, then scale what works and stop what doesn’t.

  • Early Impact: In your first 30 days, you’ll lock Tier 1 account plans with Sales and map the European field calendar for the first half of 2027. Within two quarters, every Tier 1 account in Europe will have an engaged buying group of 3+ roles and your field events will hold a 50%+ show rate. By the end of 2027, RAISE Paris and the sovereign campaign will have produced named Tier 1 and Tier 2 meetings and opportunities.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • ABM & Field Experience: 7+ years in B2B field marketing, ABM or demand generation across European markets, including at least 3 years running ABM against a named account list. You’ve run field programs that sourced or advanced pipeline in complex enterprise deals with many stakeholders.

  • Technical Buyer Fluency: Experience marketing to technical buyers in cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, HPC, data centers, telco or developer platforms.

  • European Market Depth: You know how European buyers evaluate vendors, including GDPR, data residency and sovereign cloud requirements.

  • Executive Presence: Comfort hosting senior executives and running events across several countries.

  • GTM Tooling: Hands-on experience with Salesforce, HubSpot and ABM or intent tools such as 6sense, Demandbase or Clay.

  • Builder’s Mentality: A bias for action and the ability to build programs from scratch on an early-stage team. You’re fluent in English, have the right to work in Europe and are open to travel up to 40%.

Bonus points for:

  • Languages: German or French.

  • Regional Network: Existing relationships with sovereign AI clouds, regional cloud providers or telcos in Europe.

  • Partner Co-Marketing: Experience co-marketing with NVIDIA, OEMs or European cloud and data center partners.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

  • Flexible Working Schedule:  You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility:  We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

A deep, hands-on understanding of modern AI architectures (LLMs, RAG, deep learning pipelines) and modern analytics data systems (Iceberg, Delta Lake, Trino, Spark) is mandatory. You will not only evangelize MinIO’s capabilities but also act as a trusted advisor, helping organizations architect their data infrastructure to support next-generation workloads. 

What You Will Do

  • Executive Advisory & Evangelism: Act as a trusted technical advisor to C-level executives at Fortune 500 companies. Articulate the strategic value of high-performance object storage in the context of AI readiness and data democratization.
  • Architectural Leadership: Design and validate complex, large-scale architectures for enterprise customers. Guide them in integrating MinIO seamlessly into their AI/ML pipelines and modern data lakehouse ecosystems.
  • Industry Thought Leadership: Represent MinIO at major industry conferences, webinars, and meetups. Write technical whitepapers, reference architectures, and blog posts focusing on the intersection of object storage, generative AI, and modern analytics.
  • Pre-Sales & Post-Sales Strategic Support: Partner closely with enterprise sales and customer success teams on high-stakes deals. Unblock technical objections and provide strategic guidance during Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and large-scale deployments.
  • Product Strategy Feedback Loop: Serve as the "voice of the customer" to MinIO’s product and engineering teams. Distill market trends, customer pain points, and emerging AI/Analytics patterns into actionable product requirements.

Your Skills and Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in technical leadership roles (e.g., Enterprise Architect, Chief Architect, VP of Engineering, or previous Field CTO).
  • Demonstrated experience in a customer-facing or evangelist capacity, successfully presenting to both highly technical audiences and C-level business executives.

AI & Machine Learning Architectures:

  • Deep architectural understanding of Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows and vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone).
  • Strong knowledge of AI/ML data pipelines and frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Ray, Hugging Face).
  • Understanding of hardware bottlenecks in AI, specifically the challenge of feeding data to GPUs (GPU data starvation) and how high-throughput storage solves this.

Modern Analytics & Data Systems:

  • Expertise in Open Table Formats (Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi, Delta Lake) and their integration with object storage.
  • Proficiency with modern query engines and compute frameworks (Trino, Presto, Apache Spark, Flink, StarRocks).
  • Solid grasp of the evolution from traditional data warehouses to modern Data Lakehouse architectures.

Infrastructure & Cloud-Native Tech:

  • Strong command of Kubernetes, containerization, and cloud-native orchestration.
  • Deep understanding of the AWS S3 API, RESTful APIs, and distributed systems design.

title: Finance
descriptionHtml:
About Nomos

Europe pays more than twice as much for electricity as the US or Asia. To reach competitive price levels, Europe has to lean on solar and deliver the flexibility that makes this feasible. Nomos is building a full-stack power company to unlock that flexibility by connecting millions of homes to Europe’s energy markets.

At Nomos, we care about our craft and take full responsibility for what we build. We hire for spikes, not an absence of weaknesses, and look for exceptional ability backed by a record of achievement. This has brought together IMO and IOI medalists, former founders and Olympic athletes in a team whose individual strengths reinforce one another.

 

What you’ll do

Nomos operates at the intersection of energy and finance. You will build and run our finance function, taking responsibility for the liquidity we need and the capital entrusted to us.

  • Plan and manage liquidity across electricity trading, household payments, and company operations.

  • Define and enforce how money moves: spending, approvals, and financial controls.

  • Run accounting, payroll, and the month-end close, with reliable reporting for the founders and investors.

 

Exciting challenges

  • Build the function from scratch. Decide what we run ourselves, where we need external expertise, and what we can automate. Work with engineering to build processes that stay accurate as transaction volumes grow.

  • Put our capital to work carefully. Understand what we can commit, anticipate future funding needs, and challenge spending that does not justify itself. As Nomos grows, explore where financial products could strengthen our energy offering.

 

Who you are

  • You treat our capital as your own. You’ve run finance before or can show the depth and judgement to build the function. You trace numbers back to their source and challenge the assumptions behind them. Before a new product launches or a partnership grows, you’ve worked through what it means for our finances.

  • You are allergic to loose ends. A number that almost reconciles is a number that is wrong. You find the discrepancy before anyone asks. You’re keen to use automation and AI to make the work more reliable.

  • German and English, both fluent. Accounting, payroll, and tax all happen in German here.

 

References

Anne Roellgen

 

Why join us?

As an early member of Nomos, you’ll help shape the company and share in its financial upside. Backed by Index Ventures, we’re building a European category leader in one of the world’s largest industries, making electricity affordable and Europe more competitive.

Building a power company from scratch brings complex, rewarding challenges and the chance to solve Europe’s energy crisis for the long term. You’ll learn from people with exceptional depth in their fields, challenge each other’s thinking and take responsibility from the start.

THE KEY BITS

  • Location: We can currently only accept applications from candidates that are located and have long-term working rights in the UK.

  • Flexibility: We have office hubs in London and Boston, as well as no-office hubs in several European countries. We operate a choice-first work approach that lets you work fully remotely from Day One even if you’re near an office hub.

  • Salary: We benchmarked £45,000 + equity at IC2 in our progression framework for someone based in the UK. Let us know in your application if you like the look of the role but the salary doesn’t match what you’re looking for.

  • Interviews: 2 stages totalling around 2.5 hours over 2 weeks, plus some prep for a task.

  • Start date: As soon as you can start.

  • Reporting to: Ryan, Interim Finance Director (while Eimear, Finance Director, is on leave)

  • More info: The FAQ below, juro.com/careers, our handbook or ask ----- style="min-height:1.5em">

    HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER

    Juro has big ambitions: to make it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts. And we'll need help doing it.

    Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.

    Juro bills customers and pays suppliers across UK and US entities, and the volume keeps growing. We’re looking for someone who carries the day-to-day weight of finance operations together with the team.

    Roughly 60% of your week goes on AP/AR, and the rest is month-end and reporting support: reconciliations, revenue review, and pulling together what’s needed for statutory accounts, audit requests and VAT returns.

    You won’t be doing this alone: you’ll work closely with Charlotte, our Financial Controller, who owns the close, and Ryan, our Interim Finance Director (stepping in for Eimear), who leads the Finance function.

    Your mission is to:

    Own invoicing, payables and collections end-to-end so Juro gets paid efficiently, accurately and with strong control of cash, and support month-end so leadership can trust the numbers.

    Success looks like:

    1. Invoices done right first time: Contracts are turned into accurate invoices with minimal rework or back-and-forth with Sales and Customer Success.

    2. Money moving smoothly: Customers pay on time and suppliers are paid accurately across our UK and US entities. You keep an up-to-date view of what’s owed in and out, and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) comes down over time.

    3. Reliable month-end support: Your reconciliations are accurate and on time, you flag escalations early, and you contribute to month-end, revenue review and statutory reporting.

    4. Solid, scalable ops: Processes are well controlled (from supplier onboarding and bank detail checks to payment run approvals), audit-ready, and increasingly automated inside Rillet (our ERP) and Ramp (our spend management system). You improve the process notes rather than just following them.

title: Financial Control, Accountant
descriptionHtml:
About Us

ClearBank is a technology-enabled bank transforming banking infrastructure through innovative technology and a full banking licence. We provide cloud-based banking and payment solutions to a growing range of clients and are committed to delivering reliable, scalable financial services while maintaining the highest standards of financial control, governance and regulatory compliance.

The Financial Control team is responsible for ensuring ClearBank’s general ledgers are controlled, maintained and reconciled to support timely and accurate reporting across the organisation and externally to regulators and tax authorities. As ClearBank continues to grow, the team plays a critical role in building scalable, efficient and well-controlled finance processes that support the Bank’s strategic ambitions.

Role Purpose

The Financial Control Lead owns allocated month-end activities within a small, hands-on team, supporting accurate, timely and well-controlled financial information.

Reporting to the Financial Control Manager, you will complete month-end tasks, investigate balances and variances, and prepare accounting entries and reconciliations to keep the general ledger accurate and fully supported.

The role will also be expected to stay close to all key aspects of the Financial Control team’s remit, including journals, reconciliations, reporting inputs, controls, audit support, process documentation and stakeholder queries. As ClearBank continues to grow, the Financial Control Lead will be at the forefront of identifying, driving and implementing scalable, efficient and well-controlled processes, helping the team reduce manual effort while maintaining strong financial control standards.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Control & Reporting

  • Own allocated month-end close activities and ensure they are delivered accurately and on time.

  • Prepare, review and approve general ledger journals as required, ensuring postings are technically accurate, appropriately supported and comply with internal control requirements.

  • Own revenue and expense analysis for the relevant areas, ensuring variances are investigated, understood and appropriately communicated to stakeholders.

  • Own the monthly capitalisation and amortisation process for intangible assets, ensuring entries are accurate, supported and appropriately controlled.

  • Partner with Financial Planning & Analysis to ensure accruals and accounting adjustments are identified, calculated and recorded accurately.

  • Prepare, review and approve bank reconciliations as required, ensuring reconciling items are investigated and resolved promptly.

  • Own monthly balance sheet reconciliations for the relevant areas, including preparing and reviewing reconciliations where required, ensuring all balances are fully supported and outstanding issues are appropriately managed.

  • Take ownership of non-automated accounting entries, ensuring they are accurate, appropriately supported, controlled and clearly documented, with clear audit trails maintained.

  • Build and implement scalable, efficient processes while remaining hands-on in day-to-day delivery where needed.

  • Support the preparation of management, regulatory, statutory and tax reporting requirements as required.

  • Ensure compliance with accounting policies, financial reporting standards and internal control frameworks

Systems, Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Help drive and implement automation and process improvements across finance processes, controls and reporting activities, helping to reduce manual effort and improve scalability.

  • Lead initiatives to automate the capture and posting of accounting entries from ClearBank’s core banking and operational systems into the general ledger.

  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability and data quality across Financial Control processes.

  • Drive the adoption of AI-enabled tools and technologies to reduce manual effort, improve accuracy and enhance team productivity.

  • Ensure process changes are documented appropriately and supported by effective control frameworks.

Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong working relationships across Finance and the wider business to support accurate financial reporting and operational effectiveness.

  • Work collaboratively with Accounts Payable, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Regulatory Reporting and external auditors to ensure reporting requirements are met.

  • Support audit activities by coordinating information requests and providing timely, accurate responses.

  • Contribute to cross-functional projects requiring accounting, control or process expertise.

What success looks like in the role:

  • Month-end reporting processes are delivered accurately, on time and in line with agreed timetables.

  • The general ledger remains well-controlled, supported and reconciled, with minimal audit findings or control weaknesses.

  • Complex accounting areas, including share-based payments, are supported with accurate analysis, appropriate documentation and clear escalation where technical judgement is required.

  • Practical capex accounting experience is applied to ensure capitalisation and amortisation are accurate, well-supported and appropriately controlled as part of the wider Financial Control remit.

  • Financial control processes become increasingly automated, scalable and efficient as ClearBank grows.

  • AI-enabled tools are successfully adopted to improve productivity, insight and operational effectiveness.

  • Stakeholders receive accurate, timely and reliable financial information that supports decision-making and reporting obligations.

  • The role works effectively with colleagues across Finance and the wider business to deliver high-quality outcomes.

  • Financial Control contributes to a strong control environment while continuously improving efficiency and reducing operational risk.

  • The role demonstrates excellence in both what is delivered and how it is delivered through strong collaboration, ownership, continuous improvement and leadership behaviours.

Skills & Experience (must-have)

  • Fully qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA).

  • Strong financial accounting and financial control experience within a regulated financial services environment.

  • Experience managing month-end close activities, balance sheet reconciliations and general ledger controls.

  • Experience managing the monthly capitalisation and amortisation of intangible assets, including accurate accounting entries, supporting documentation and financial controls.

  • Strong technical accounting knowledge, including experience interpreting and applying accounting standards.

  • Experience supporting complex accounting areas, including preparing analysis and documentation to support technical accounting judgements.

  • Strong understanding of financial controls, governance and audit requirements.

  • Proven ability to identify, lead and implement process improvement initiatives.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong financial analysis capability.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

  • High attention to detail combined with a pragmatic and solutions-focused mindset.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!  

Equal Opportunities

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. 

As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. 

The legal bit

By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. You are also allowing us to communicate with you by email and telephone for recruitment purposes.
