title: Key Account Manager 🇫🇷
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Key Account Management Team


Our Account Management team’s purpose is to make our key accounts stay and grow with Alan. We created the team in 2020 and we are now 30+.
We are looking for amazing people to help us take care of our growing pipe, especially with our medium-touch segment and large accounts.
Being a Key Account Manager at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate experts, with different backgrounds.
We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?


As a Key Account Manager, you will:

  • Handle a portfolio of strategic accounts and flagships companies

  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships with key stakeholders and display a customer-centric approach to identify the main needs and allow our clients to achieve their goals through Alan

  • Proactively identify potential signals of dissatisfaction and implement solutions to answer them

  • Ensure successful onboarding of new accounts and promote Alan health partner positioning to generate massive adoption by employees and admins

  • Analyze and present consumption reports to customers through business reviews

  • Identify and execute out-of-the-box initiatives to engage our existing customers

  • Be in charge of cross-selling/upselling our portfolio to answer customer needs and pain points

  • Renegotiate contracts to guarantee both great value for money to our customers and sustainable profitability

  • Participate in the evolution of our products and services, acting as the voice of our customers when discussing with Product teams

You would be a great fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

  • You have at least 6 years of experience in a customer-facing role including frequent interactions with C-Levels

  • You are fluent both in French and English

  • You are experienced in dealing with companies of more than 300 employees

  • You have the tact and empathy that make great negotiators

  • You are an expert in positive lobbying with key stakeholders and create long-term relationship based on trust and transparency

  • You are analytical and love to solve problems in order to delight our members

  • You have great active listening skills ans are a master in the art of crafting the right follow-up message

  • You have a growth mindset: you are able to adapt to new trends and to develop an in-depth understanding of the health insurance market

  • You are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon or Annecy.


It is nice to have a previous experience in Insurance or any industry linked to benefits (but definitely not a must-have !)


For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the B1-D level range.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon or Annecy.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your  time as you  wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly  flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk -it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

title: Kfz-Prüfingenieur mit Betrauung (m/w/d) – mit Perspektive zum Abteilungsleiter
descriptionHtml:
Beschreibung

Sie sind betrauter Kfz-Prüfingenieur und möchten nicht nur prüfen, sondern mittelfristig Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann bieten wir Ihnen einen Weg, auf dem Sie in Ruhe in eine Führungsrolle hineinwachsen.

Wir sind die von Hebel Fahrzeugtechnik GmbH. Wir betreiben eigene GTÜ-Prüfstellen in Lüneburg, Lauenburg/Elbe und Hamburg und führen als Partner der GTÜ Gesellschaft für Technische Überwachung mbH amtliche Fahrzeuguntersuchungen durch.

Gut zu wissen: Wir arbeiten eng mit dem von Hebel Ingenieurbüro zusammen – einem etablierten Kfz-Sachverständigenbüro, das professionelle Unfall- und Haftpflichtgutachten für Privat- und Geschäftskunden erstellt. Für Sie bedeutet das: ein breites fachliches Umfeld über die Prüftätigkeit hinaus.

Warum wir jetzt suchen: Wir planen langfristig. Die Leitung unserer Prüfstellen und des ca. zehnköpfigen Teams soll in einigen Jahren in neue Hände übergehen – und wir möchten die Person dafür frühzeitig an Bord holen. Sie steigen zunächst als Prüfingenieur ein, lernen unser Team, unsere Standorte und Abläufe kennen und übernehmen dann Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung. Für die Einarbeitung nehmen wir uns bewusst Zeit.

Ihr Einsatzgebiet: Unsere Standorte Lüneburg, Lauenburg/Elbe und Hamburg.

Ihr Weg in die Führungsposition

Kein Sprung ins kalte Wasser, sondern ein geplanter Übergang in Ihrem Tempo:

  • Ankommen: Prüftätigkeit an unseren Standorten, Kennenlernen von Team, Kunden, Abläufen und der Zusammenarbeit mit der GTÜ
  • Verantwortung übernehmen: erste Aufgaben der fachlichen und organisatorischen Leitung, z. B. Qualitätssicherung, Einarbeitung neuer Kolleginnen und Kollegen, fachliche Ansprechperson im Team
  • Übergabe: Stellvertretung der jetzigen Führungskraft und anschließend vollständige Übernahme der Position

Zuständigkeiten / Hauptaufgaben

Von Beginn an:

  • Durchführung von Untersuchungen der periodischen Fahrzeugüberwachung (HU/SP)

title: Laboratory technician
descriptionHtml:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them - and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The company is growing fast, and we are now seeking the best talents to come and join our exciting and ambitious team in the fight against cancer - join us!

Position overview

Orakl Oncology works on a large cohort of patient-derived organoids (PDO) to predict clinical outcomes of patients and derisk clinical trials. We are looking for a dynamic and motivated Lab Technician to help us execute large-scale drug screening assays on our semi-automated platform, either for internal or external projects. In this position, you will:

  • Actively participate in our commercial contracts: you will take care of numerous PDOs of interest and perform drug screening assays to generate high-quality, robust datasets. These results will be leveraged by our data science and computational biology teams to deliver actionable insights and decision-support data to our partners.

  • Work on the expansion of the Orakl biobank: you will work on patient specimens and organoid cell lines to increase the amount of data collected, thus improving our understanding of cancer.

  • Contribute to the optimisation procedures at Orakl: you will bring new ideas and approaches to improve automation and accelerate workflows in both 3D cell culture and drug screening experiments.

  • Ensure smooth laboratory operations: you will play a key role in laboratory maintenance, documentation, and traceability of activities, while proactively anticipating the needs for consumables and reagents.

Required qualifications

  • BSc (or equivalent degree such as BTS, BUT, Licence) in cellular biology, biotechnology or any related discipline.

  • Hands-on experience in mammalian cell culture, 3D cell culture and preferably organoid culture.

  • Hands-on experience in drug screening assays or viability assessment assay.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and organisational rigour.

  • Flexibility, and a taste for overcoming operational challenges.

  • A genuine enthusiasm and passion for teamwork and learning.

  • As part of an international team, ability to communicate clearly in English

  • Genuine curiosity for cancer biology.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills to interact in an interdisciplinary setting with biologists, ML engineers and researchers.

  • Previous experience working in cancer biology

  • Fluent in English

Recruitment process

  • HR Call (15 minutes call) – An initial discussion to better understand your background, experiences, and motivations.

  • Technical Interview (45 minutes call) – A deep dive into your technical skills and expertise relevant to the role.

  • Lab Case (Around 90 minutes) - You will be directly manipulating in our labs to demonstrate your ability to follow a specific protocol and to work under aseptic conditions.

  • Founder Interview: As final step of our recruitment process, you will meet the CTO of Orakl Oncology in person at our office. This meeting is an opportunity for the founders to assess cultural fit and ensure alignment with our company values.

title: Langfuse - Senior Cloud Infra Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why Cloud Infrastructure at Langfuse

Your work will keep Langfuse running — everywhere.

Langfuse processes over a billion trace events per month. When a Fortune 50 company relies on Langfuse in production, they're relying on the infrastructure you operate. You'll own uptime, performance, and cost efficiency across our entire cloud footprint — and you'll make sure every self-hosted deployment runs just as smoothly.

You'll operate Langfuse Cloud on AWS ECS Fargate and ClickHouse Cloud, with Datadog as the observability backbone. You'll also own our public self-hosted infrastructure — including our Helm chart, Docker Compose setup, and everything in between — so that teams from startups to enterprises can run Langfuse on their own terms.

This isn't a "maintain what exists" role. We're scaling fast, and you'll be the person who makes sure the infrastructure grows ahead of demand — not behind it.

Langfuse is now part of ClickHouse, which means the team behind the database at the core of our stack is one channel away. Few infrastructure roles give you that kind of direct access to the people who build your most critical dependency.

 

You will grow at Langfuse by

Own Langfuse Cloud operations: You'll run our production environments on AWS ECS Fargate and ClickHouse Cloud. You'll manage deployments, autoscaling, capacity planning, and cost optimization — making sure we stay fast and affordable as traffic scales.

Build world-class observability: You'll own our Datadog setup end to end — dashboards, alerts, and SLOs. When something degrades, you'll ensure we know before our customers do. You'll build the monitoring culture that lets the whole team ship with confidence.

Make self-hosting effortless: Thousands of teams run Langfuse on their own infrastructure. You'll own and evolve our Helm chart, Docker Compose configuration, and deployment documentation. You'll turn "works on my machine" into "works on every machine" — from a single-node setup to a multi-region enterprise deployment.

Automate everything: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, automated scaling, zero-downtime deployments. You'll replace manual processes with automation that makes the team faster and the platform more reliable.

Scale for what's next: We're growing fast and new product directions — like complex long-running agent observability and real-time evaluation — push the infrastructure in new ways. You'll be thinking ahead about what breaks at 10x scale and building the foundation before we get there. 10x is always just one quarter away here at Langfuse.

Harden security and compliance: As more enterprises adopt Langfuse, you'll help ensure our cloud and self-hosted deployments meet the security and compliance bar that large organizations require.

 

What we're looking for

  • Strong infrastructure or SRE engineer who gets excited about running systems at scale and making them better every day

  • Experience operating production workloads on AWS (ECS/Fargate, networking, IAM, S3, etc.) or on comparable hyperscale vendors.

  • You organize yourself. You have strong opinions about reliability, automation, and how to ship infrastructure changes safely

  • Interest in open source software and genuine enjoyment helping users debug their self-hosted deployments

  • Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters

  • CS or quantitative degree preferred

Bonus points:

As the AI technical lead for your domain, you will drive architecture decisions, engineering excellence, and AI adoption across teams and stakeholders. Examples of domains include: Sales, GTM and Marketing or Finance & Legal

 This range is provided for transparency purposes and reflects our internal compensation grid for this role level. The final offer will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities involved.

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to transform cutting-edge AI technologies into reliable, scalable, and measurable products used by leading enterprises worldwide.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.

  • Review designs and mentor engineers
  • Raise the quality bar across initiatives

  • Share knowledge and reusable components
  • Build AI expertise within your organization

Success Metrics

  • Business impact delivered by AI initiatives
  • Adoption within the domain
  • Technical quality and reliability
  • Team capability growth

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL
  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models
  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases
  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 7+ years in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, or Applied AI
  • Strong experience with LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, evaluation, and production systems
  • Ability to influence Product and Business decisions
  • Proven leadership on complex cross-functional initiatives

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

title: Senior Business Development Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über unseren Kunden

Wahrscheinlich hast du heute schon ein Produkt unseres Kunden benutzt, ohne es zu merken. Das Unternehmen ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter intelligenter Zugangslösungen: Tor- und Türautomation, die Gebäude, Grundstücke und Garagen sicher und smart macht. Mehrere tausend Mitarbeitende arbeiten weltweit für den Konzern, hinter dem ein renommierter internationaler Investor steht. Zum Portfolio gehören starke Marken für den professionellen B2B-Markt und den DIY-Bereich sowie ein App-basiertes Smart-Access-Ökosystem, das Zugangsprodukte vernetzt.

Das Europa-Geschäft mit Zentrale in Deutschland wächst und verändert sich gerade. Ziel ist es, Marktanteile zu gewinnen und den Vertrieb noch professioneller aufzustellen. Dafür sucht das Unternehmen eine Person, die nicht nur selbst Neukunden gewinnt, sondern das BDM-Team mitzieht.

Deine Mission

In den nächsten 12 bis 24 Monaten gewinnst du messbar mehr Neukunden, vor allem große OEMs. In deinem Kerngebiet Nordeuropa (Skandinavien und Benelux) baust du eine starke Pipeline auf. In Deutschland (DACH) holst du wichtige Zielkunden an Bord. Gleichzeitig setzt du für das BDM-Team den Standard im Neugeschäft.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Neukunden gewinnen: Du verantwortest dein eigenes Kerngebiet Nordeuropa (Skandinavien und Benelux) und konzentrierst dich auf große OEMs. Außerdem bist du dafür verantwortlich, wichtige Zielkunden in Deutschland (DACH) zu gewinnen. Dabei hilft dir idealerweise dein eigenes Netzwerk.

  • Abschlüsse in ganz Europa unterstützen: Mit den BDMs in Benelux und Nordeuropa besuchst du Kunden gemeinsam und hilfst, neue Accounts zu gewinnen.

  • Vorbild und Coach sein: Du prägst mit, wie das Team (ca. 5 BDMs) Neukunden anspricht, Kundentermine gestaltet, das CRM nutzt und die Pipeline steuert. Wenn du schon erste Führungserfahrung hast, ist das ein Plus.

  • Vertrieb steuern und Forecasts verantworten: Du berichtest KPIs in HubSpot, verantwortest deine Forecast-Zahlen und legst Maßnahmen fest, wenn erwartete Aufträge ausbleiben.

  • Den Markt entwickeln: Du beobachtest Markt und Wettbewerb und bringst Ideen ein, wie das Unternehmen Kunden vom Wettbewerb gewinnt.

Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung Europa.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im operativen B2B-Vertrieb oder Business Development und kannst nachweisen, dass du Neukunden gewinnst.

  • Du hast große Accounts, idealerweise OEMs, in mehreren europäischen Märkten gewonnen und weiterentwickelt.

  • Du arbeitest diszipliniert: Ein CRM (z. B. HubSpot), sauberes Pipeline-Tracking, KPI-Reporting und verlässliche Forecasts gehören für dich zum Alltag.

  • Du lieferst Ergebnisse, statt nur darüber zu reden. Du gehst proaktiv auf Kunden zu, setzt dich durch, denkst in Zahlen und hältst ein, was du zusagst.

  • Du betreust gern eigene Kunden und unterstützt dabei deine Kolleg:innen. Profitabilität behältst du im Blick, neue Ideen bringst du aktiv ein.

  • Du wohnst in Deutschland und bist bereit, etwa 60-70 % zu reisen (v. a. Skandinavien, Benelux, DACH und weitere Länder in Europa)

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

Ein Plus ist, wenn du:

  • Erfahrung mit Tür-, Tor-, Zutritts- oder Sicherheitslösungen mitbringst oder aus einer verwandten Branche kommst, etwa Bau, Gebäudetechnik oder Elektro. Das ist keine Pflicht, solange du dich schnell ins Geschäft einarbeitest.

  • schon Vertriebskolleg:innen gecoacht oder ein Vertriebsteam fachlich geführt hast

  • ein Netzwerk zu OEMs und Großkunden in Nordeuropa, Benelux und DACH hast.

  • weitere Sprachen sprichst, vor allem Französisch, Niederländisch oder eine skandinavische Sprache.

Deine Benefits

  • Home-based arbeiten: Du musst nicht regelmäßig in der Europazentrale sein

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit bei einem globalen Marktführer

  • Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Das Europa-Geschäft wächst, und du hast direkten Einfluss darauf, wie der Vertrieb sich entwickelt

  • Internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit Kund:innen und Kolleg:innen in ganz Europa

  • Kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung Europa und schnelle Entscheidungen

  • Attraktives Gehaltspaket + Car Allowance

title: Lead Commercial Sales
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

We want you as a talented Lead Commercial Sales & Business Development professional to help us in our mission by driving commercial B2B success across our key technologies, Nyx, and future programmes, while supporting our Chief Commercial Officer in expanding our government business outside Europe.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as a Lead Commercial Sales & Business Development professional, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include B2B sales responsibilities:

  • Owning the sales pipeline for key technologies e.g. Additive Manufacturing, Thermal Protection, and Propulsion technologies offered through the "Space Store" as well as supporting the commercialization and expansion plan for European Astrotech (EAL) propulsion services.

  • Identifying, qualifying, and developing customers across satellite operators, launch providers, defense and prime contractors

  • Building technical and commercial proposals with our engineering teams and negotiating contract terms

  • Defining the Space Store go-to-market approach, including positioning, pricing, and sales enablement

  • Leading commercial sales for Nyx cargo and crew services, including commercial station (CLD) and payload opportunities.

  • Developing commercial strategies for future programs, including lunar and launcher offerings

  • Developing a qualified pipeline of future clients for future programs to support bid and fundraising efforts.

  • Managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting and bid preparation to contract signature and handover to programme teams

  • Supporting the Chief Commercial Officer in developing and executing the sales strategy for government customers outside Europe.

  • Supporting the European and USA Government teams where needed.

  • Preparing responses, capability presentations, and pitch materials

  • Representing the company at trade shows, conferences, and customer meetings

What we would love to see from you

In the role of Lead Commercial Sales & Business Development professional, ideally, you will have the following:

  • 8+ years of B2B sales or business development experience, ideally in aerospace, space, defence, or other high-technology industries

  • A proven track record of closing complex, high-value commercial B2B deals and technical sales, such as hardware, engineering services, or systems

  • Experience selling to government agencies or prime contractors, including international government markets

  • An understanding of technical products such as additive manufacturing, thermal protection, propulsion, or spacecraft systems, and the ability to translate them into customer value

  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and proposal-writing skills

  • Fluency in English; additional fluency in German, French, or Italian is a strong advantage, depending on your location

  • Experience in a fast-growing startup or scale-up environment (preferred

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. Job Overview

We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery.

Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate.

While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.
  • Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.
  • Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.
  • Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.
  • Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.
  • Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.
  • High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans.
  • Monitoring: A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics.
  • Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies).
  • Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts.
  • Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking.
  • PostgreSQL & Hybrid Estates: Advanced administration of PostgreSQL, alongside experience managing database workloads across a hybrid environment (e.g., combining on-premise architecture with AWS).
  • OLAP & Data Warehousing (Apache Druid / Snowflake): Familiarity with columnar databases and cloud data platforms, particularly Apache Druid and Snowflake. Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments.
  • Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation.

Growth & Innovation:

    • Openness to learn the required technologies.
    • An interest in development, new technologies and innovation.
    • Supporting development teams into the refactoring of technical debt.

At Partnerize, we recognise it is unrealistic for a candidate to fulfil 100% of the criteria in this job description. We encourage you to apply if you feel you meet the majority of the requirements above. We know that skills evolve over time, so if you have a keen appetite to learn and evolve alongside us over time, come join our team!

US Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
  • Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay)
  • Regular company events and activities
  • Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
  • 401k Plan – 4% employee match
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

Privacy and data protection. The data collected as part of this application will be used for the recruitment process and any subsequent employment. You can find further information in Partnerize privacy policy here: https://partnerize.com/privacy-policy/

Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies: To protect the interests of all parties, Partnerize will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate or an approved vendor that has a written and signed agreement in place with Partnerize. Please do not contact or forward resumes to our company employees or locations. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Partnerize property. Partnerize is not responsible for any charges or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Lead Java Software Engineer (v/m/x)
locations: Capelle aan den IJssel, Zuid-Holland, Nederland
descriptionHtml:
Bouw mee aan de digitale toekomst van de openbare ruimte

Bij Progresity ontwikkelen we software die gemeenten helpt om de openbare ruimte slimmer, veiliger en duurzamer te beheren. Onze applicatie BinnenBeter verbindt inwoners en gemeenten: via de BuitenBeter app kunnen inwoners eenvoudig meldingen doen van problemen in de openbare ruimte, van kapotte straatverlichting tot zwerfafval of een losliggende stoeptegel. Gemeenten ontvangen deze meldingen in BinnenBeter en kunnen ze efficiënt opvolgen, zodat elke melding leidt tot een zichtbare verbetering in de leefomgeving. Zo zorgen we samen voor schonere, veiligere en beter onderhouden steden voor miljoenen inwoners in Nederland.

We staan aan de vooravond van een belangrijke volgende stap. Niet alleen ontwikkelen we onze software verder, ook professionaliseren we de manier waarop we software bouwen. We willen groeien naar een moderne engineeringorganisatie waarin eigenaarschap, kwaliteit, automatisering en continu verbeteren centraal staan.

Daarom zoeken we een Lead Software Engineer (Java) die niet alleen technisch sterk is, maar ook energie krijgt van het verder brengen van een engineeringteam. Iemand die verder kijkt dan de code van vandaag, een duidelijke technische visie kan ontwikkelen en anderen weet mee te nemen in verandering. Die begrijpt dat goede software niet alleen draait om technologie, maar ook om samenwerking, vakmanschap en het maken van de juiste keuzes.

Jouw rol

Als Lead Software Engineer (Java) combineer je hands-on software engineering met technisch leiderschap. Je werkt binnen een multidisciplinair productteam aan de verdere ontwikkeling van BinnenBeter en neemt het voortouw in de technische richting en professionalisering van Engineering.

Je bent eigenaar van de technische visie en architectuur van het product. Je bepaalt samen met je collega's hoe we onze software toekomstbestendig houden en vertaalt technische ambities naar concrete verbeteringen. Daarbij kijk je verder dan nieuwe functionaliteiten: ook onderhoudbaarheid, schaalbaarheid, security, betrouwbaarheid en technische schuld krijgen structureel aandacht.

Tegelijkertijd ben je een belangrijke kartrekker in het verbeteren van onze manier van werken. Hoe kunnen we sneller en betrouwbaarder releasen? Hoe maken we geautomatiseerd testen en CI/CD vanzelfsprekend? Hoe zorgen we dat engineers verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor hun software, ook nadat deze in productie staat?

Je hoeft deze uitdagingen niet alleen op te lossen. Je coacht Software Engineers, stimuleert eigenaarschap en zorgt dat technische kennis en verantwoordelijkheden niet bij één persoon blijven liggen.

Je gaat onder andere aan de slag met:

  • Het ontwikkelen, uitdragen en bewaken van de technische visie en softwarearchitectuur van BinnenBeter.

  • Het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van robuuste, onderhoudbare en schaalbare software met Java en Spring Boot.

  • Het richting geven aan belangrijke technische keuzes en het ontwikkelen en borgen van engineeringstandaarden en architectuurprincipes.

  • Het vertalen van relevante wet- en regelgeving en beveiligingseisen naar concrete technische richtlijnen.

  • Het verbeteren van onze engineeringpraktijken, waaronder CI/CD, testautomatisering, observability en DevOps.

  • Het inzichtelijk maken en structureel aanpakken van technische schuld, kwetsbaarheden en andere technische risico's.

  • Het ontwikkelen en realiseren van een technische verbeteragenda, samen met het engineeringteam.

  • Het coachen van Software Engineers en stimuleren van zelfstandigheid, kennisdeling en technisch eigenaarschap.

  • Het versterken van de samenwerking tussen Engineering, Product, UX, Quality en Cloud/Platform.

  • Het onderzoeken van nieuwe technologieën en werkwijzen, waaronder AI, die onze software of manier van ontwikkelen daadwerkelijk beter maken.


Wat neem je mee?

We zoeken een ervaren Software Engineer die inhoudelijk sterk is, maar ook begrijpt dat technisch leiderschap meer vraagt dan het maken van goede technische keuzes.

Je kunt complexe vraagstukken analyseren en een duidelijke richting bepalen. Tegelijkertijd weet je anderen daarin mee te nemen, sta je open voor andere perspectieven en haal je voldoening uit het ontwikkelen van collega's.

Wat we belangrijk vinden:

  • Ruime ervaring met Java en Spring Boot en een sterke achtergrond in professionele software engineering.

  • Ervaring met softwarearchitectuur, REST API's en het ontwerpen van onderhoudbare en schaalbare applicaties.

  • Je kunt complexe technische vraagstukken doorgronden, alternatieven afwegen en onderbouwde technische keuzes maken.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het ontwikkelen of verbeteren van technische standaarden, architectuurprincipes en engineeringpraktijken.

  • Je hebt kennis van moderne softwareontwikkeling, waaronder CI/CD, geautomatiseerd testen, security en observability.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het begeleiden of coachen van andere Software Engineers en vindt het leuk om collega's technisch verder te helpen.

  • Je communiceert helder, kunt technische onderwerpen begrijpelijk uitleggen en weet verschillende disciplines met elkaar te verbinden.

  • Je neemt initiatief, durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en weet ideeën om te zetten in concrete verbeteringen.

  • Je bent pragmatisch en kunt een goede balans vinden tussen technische kwaliteit, ontwikkelsnelheid en klantwaarde.

  • Je bent beschikbaar voor 32, 36 of 40 uur per week.

Mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste:

  • Ervaring met Angular en TypeScript.

  • Ervaring met WildFly, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes of vergelijkbare technologieën.

  • Ervaring met het begeleiden van technische veranderingen of het professionaliseren van een engineeringteam.

  • Ervaring met cloud-native architecturen, DevOps en het beheren van software in productie.

Je hoeft niet eerder de functietitel Lead Software Engineer te hebben gehad. Misschien ben je nu Senior Software Engineer of Software Architect en merk je dat je steeds vaker technische richting geeft, collega's begeleidt en verbeteringen initieert. Als je klaar bent om daarin een volgende stap te zetten, gaan we graag met je in gesprek.

Dan bieden wij jou

  • Een salaris tussen €4.500,- en €6.690,- bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van jouw ervaring.

  • Een rol waarin je daadwerkelijk invloed hebt op de technische richting van onze software en de ontwikkeling van Engineering.

  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, technische verbeteringen en het toepassen van nieuwe technologieën.

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden en een modern kantoor in Capelle aan den IJssel.

  • Werken in een team waar jouw ideeën daadwerkelijk worden gehoord.

  • 8% vakantiegeld.

  • 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen bij te kopen.

  • Laptop van de zaak.

  • Goede pensioenregeling en collectieve bonus.

  • Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.

  • Een rol waarin jouw werk iedere dag maatschappelijke impact heeft.

Over Progresity

Progresity is onderdeel van de Conxillium Group. Samen ontwikkelen we slimme software voor gemeenten. Onze producten ondersteunen gemeenten bij het beheren van de openbare ruimte: van bomen en groenvoorzieningen tot wegen, verlichting en meldingen van inwoners.

We bevinden ons in een interessante fase. We groeien van een traditionele softwareorganisatie naar productgerichte teams waarin eigenaarschap, samenwerking en continu verbeteren centraal staan. Dat betekent dat developers bij ons niet alleen meedenken over hoe we software bouwen, maar ook over waarom we iets bouwen en welke waarde dat oplevert voor onze gebruikers.

Je komt terecht in een hecht team waarin vakmanschap, nieuwsgierigheid en elkaar helpen belangrijker zijn dan hiërarchie. We geloven dat de beste ideeën ontstaan wanneer mensen verantwoordelijkheid krijgen en samen blijven leren.

Lees meer over onze organisatie op: www.progresity.com.

Sollicitatieproces

Ons sollicitatieproces bestaat meestal uit drie gesprekken. We vinden het belangrijk dat we elkaar goed leren kennen. Naast jouw technische kennis zijn we vooral benieuwd hoe jij samenwerkt, hoe je naar softwareontwikkeling kijkt en hoe jij jezelf én een team verder helpt groeien.

Enthousiast?

Wil jij bijdragen aan slimmere, veiligere en duurzamere software voor gemeenten én meebouwen aan de volgende stap van onze engineeringorganisatie? Reageer dan via de sollicitatiebutton of neem contact op met onze recruiter Steven Kruis via 06 57 43 92 61 of

title: Lead Legal Counsel, Regulatory and Financial Services
descriptionHtml:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

We are currently operating approximately 30k business accounts under a BaaS model with Swan.

The role of Financial Services in our strategy is set to grow, both in terms of revenue and product contribution, to serve our 800k current customer base.

As such, we are initiating a process to get licensed as Etablissement de paiement et Société de financement. Our ambition is to start onboarding new customers by mid 2027 before starting migrating existing customers.

To meet this ambition, we are starting to hire our Tech, Product, Compliance, Legal and Ops leaders.

We are looking for a Lead Legal Counsel to drive the legal function of our Financial Services activity and build our regulatory legal team.

From the day you join until we are fully licensed, you will structure and execute the legal path to authorization: interpret requirements, translate them into an internal plan, and ensure deliverables are complete, consistent, and aligned across teams. You will help define the target operating model (intra-group and outsourced) and ensure it is legally defensible and well documented for the application.

After licensing, you will shift from “building the file” to running and scaling the legal function of the regulated entity: ensuring ongoing compliance with ACPR expectations, enabling product growth safely, and keeping the operating model (including outsourcing) continuously audit-ready. You will own the legal oversight of day-to-day legal and corporate matters (policies, governance, reporting support, inspections), lead the legal work for launching new regulated products and entering new partnerships, and manage the legal aspects of onboarding and migrating customers to the licensed subsidiary (terms, communications, complaints/conduct risk).

This is a greenfield project with high autonomy and responsibility, and the opportunity to shape the legal culture of a fast-growing fintech while managing and mentoring an experienced Legal Counsel, with the ambition to scale the team further as the business grows.

Organisation & Reporting

You will be part of the core Legal Department. Your reporting line will be Stanislas, our General Counsel.

You will manage a seasoned Legal Counsel and will be responsible for planning the future growth of the Financial Services Legal team. You will also partner closely with our Financial Services Chief Compliance and Risk Officer, Chief Operational Officer and the contract team.

Mission & Objectives

Team Leadership & Structuring

  • You manage, mentor, and develop your team member(s), fostering a high-performance, autonomous, and pragmatic legal culture.

  • You structure the team’s workload and roadmap, delegating effectively while remaining deeply hands-on.

  • You anticipate future hiring needs and actively participate in scaling the regulatory legal team.

Corporate and governance You design, document and run the legal aspects of corporate governance: delegation of powers, board/committee charters, conflicts management, inter-company arrangements on payment services outsourcing, governance narrative for the ACPR reports, and ongoing legal compliance cadence once authorized.

Products, contracts and customer legal architecture

  • You own the legal design of the FS product perimeter (payments services, account services, credit/financing products as applicable).

  • You work with the contractual team (Roland) on the associated contractual framework: customer terms, disclosures, pricing documentation, complaint handling language, and operational/legal flows (including KYC/AML handoffs, incident handling and customer communications).

Outsourcing / BaaS transition & vendor contracting You own legal matters relating to critical outsourcing and third-party reliance (including existing BaaS arrangements): contract negotiation, regulatory outsourcing clauses, audit/access rights, sub-outsourcing controls, exit plans, SLAs, data protection allocation, operational resilience expectations, and documentation suitable for ACPR scrutiny.

Migration readiness In close collaboration with the operation team (Maxime), you lead the legal plan for migrating customers from Swan (sequencing, consent/novation approaches, customer communications from a legal standpoint, continuity of mandates, handling of incidents/complaints, and safeguards to minimise conduct risk).

Privacy and Security In close coordination with our DPO (Léa) and security stakeholders, you ensure that our Financial Services operating model address data processing roles, cross-border flows (if any), retention, incident response, recordkeeping, and contractual protections with key providers.

Regulatory engagement support & internal enablement

  • Until we are fully licenced, you help prepare ACPR interactions (Q&A packs, position papers, meeting preparation).

  • Once authorized, you own the relationship with ACPR from a legal perspective, supporting the CCRO with legal opinions, advisory etc.

  • You train internal stakeholders on the legal/regulatory constraints that shape product and operations, and build a “legal-by-design” approach for Financial Services.

Culture, Training & Advisory You will be expected to operate as an owner, not a “support function,” and to produce pragmatic, regulator-ready outcomes.

About you

  • You have 8+ years of relevant experience, including in-house legal experience at a regulated entity (payments, EMI/PI, bank, lending/consumer credit, factoring, etc.), fintech, or BaaS.

  • You have a proven track record or a strong aptitude for managing, mentoring, and developing team members in a fast-paced environment.

  • You have substantial experience in regulated financial services legal work, and you are comfortable owning cross-functional programmes.

  • Senior legal expert in a French ACPR-regulated entity (établissement de paiement, établissement de crédit, société de financement or similar).

  • Hands on contract experience and knowledge about our regulatory environment (arrêté du 3 novembre 2014, PSD2, DORA, EBA Guidelines, etc).

Skills & mindset

Technical strengths You can credibly lead on :

  • ACPR/European regulatory frameworks for payments and/or lending/financing;

  • Outsourcing and third-party risk legal frameworks in regulated environments;

  • Governance and regulated-entity corporate law basics.

Soft skills

  • Player-coach mentality: capable of executing complex individual contributions while guiding and empowering your team.

  • You can work fast without losing rigour.

  • Strong pedagogy: able to explain complex regulatory legal topics to product managers, engineers and founders in simple, actionable terms.

  • Pragmatic, impact-driven approach, capable of operating under strong regulatory constraints without blocking innovation.

  • Very strong written and oral communication skills in both French and English.

Languages, presence and location

  • Fluent French and English are mandatory.

  • Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

  • Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role.

Recruitment Process

1. Interview with Lucie (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter

2. Interview with Stanislas (1h), Head of Legal, Risk & Compliance

3. Case Study with Stanislas & Maxime (1h)

4. Last round with Laurent and Felix (45 min)

 

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains ----- or ----- style="min-height:1.5em">We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

 

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. title: Lead Software Engineer - CDI Paris - Theodo
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.

Ton équipe :
Tu rejoindras une communauté tech de plus de 350 Theodoers : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes, avec lesquels tu pourras échanger, apprendre et progresser au quotidien.

Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs.

Les métiers du Software Engineering évoluent avec l’IA : viens apprendre à devenir un Tech Lead AI Native.

Tes futures missions :
Nous recrutons un·e Tech Lead pour concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs.

En tant que Tech Lead, tu es garant du rythme et de la qualité de delivery de ton projet. Tu mobilises ton équipe, fais les choix techniques adaptés au contexte et accompagnes les Software Engineers dans leur progression, avec l’objectif de faire grandir à la fois le produit et les personnes qui le construisent.

  • Garantir le delivery et la qualité du projet
Tu vises un niveau de qualité radicalement supérieur, en structurant le delivery autour de standards :
    • Concevoir des architectures évolutives et résilientes (diagrammes d’architecture clairs et partagés)
    • Rédiger des spécifications précises pour permettre le développement sans bugs de fonctionnalités
    • Mettre en place une stratégie de qualité basée sur : le Clean Code, les tests automatisés, les code reviews
    • Assurer un environnement de travail structuré avec les principes 5S (organisation, clarté, efficacité)
    • Accélérer la vitesse de développement grâce au déploiement des agents IA
  • Être le partenaire technique du client
    • Participer aux routines projet (backlog refinement, daily, cérémonies) et veiller à la satisfaction continue du client
    • Expliquer et défendre les choix techniques pour créer de la confiance et aligner toutes les parties prenantes
  • Créer les conditions de performance de l’équipe
    • Mettre en place un environnement de travail efficace et structuré pour l’équipe projet
    • Mettre en place des boucles de résolution des problèmes via le Daily Problem Solving
    • Créer les conditions pour que l’équipe exploite les LLM et gagne en productivité dans son quotidien
  • Faire progresser les Software Engineers de ton équipe
    • Analyser de manière appronfondie les défauts à la source dans le but d’améliorer les connaissance des équipes (Dantotsu)
    • Former et accompagner l’équipe (pair programming, code reviews, formation)

Les problématiques sont très différentes d'un projet à l'autre, voici quelques exemples :
  • Health Hero : On a aidé HealthHero à scaler une plateforme de télémédecine critique à l’échelle européenne, avec un focus fort sur la qualité et la fiabilité. Résultat : un produit robuste, qui tient la charge et supporte des millions d’utilisateurs sans compromis sur l’expérience.
  • LCL : Développement de la nouvelle néobanque du LCL (L by LCL), une plateforme digitale permettant aux professionnels d’ouvrir et gérer leur compte bancaire en ligne.
Tes perspectives d'évolution :
2 axes d’évolutions s’offrent à toi:
  • Architecte senior : développer une expertise technique
  • Solution Architect : participer à le vente de projets complexes en définissant les solutions techniques les plus ingénieuses pour nous permettre de gagner
  • Managériale : Engineering Manager
Une méthodologie basée sur l'apprentissage continu :
Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits.

Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.

Profil recherché :

  • 4 à 8 ans d’expérience en développement
  • Solide maîtrise des architectures web (front, back, BDD, infra, déploiement) et des pratiques DevOps (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Capacité à concevoir des architectures scalables, faire des choix techniques pertinents et garantir un haut niveau de qualité de code.
  • Expérience dans le coaching et l’accompagnement de développeurs, en restant connecté·e à la tech (veille, code, pair programming).
  • Orientation création de valeur et compréhension des enjeux métier du client.
Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 De l’épargne salariale avec un mécanisme d’intéressement en partenariat avec Epsor 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: Lead Solution & Enterprise Architect
descriptionHtml:
Lead Solution & Enterprise Architect

Location: London (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

Lead transformative architecture to redefine the future of financial services.

The Role

At Capco, you will play a pivotal role in delivering some of our clients’ most complex and high-profile transformation programmes, drawing on your expertise in enterprise and solution architecture.

You will move between hands-on solution design, collaborating closely with engineers, and articulating compelling enterprise visions to senior stakeholders. Your work will influence key technology decisions and business outcomes, leveraging approved AI-enabled tools and workflows where appropriate to enhance architectural insight, design quality and delivery efficiency.

You will oversee architecture across business, data, application and technology domains, guide cross-functional teams and support the development of colleagues. You will also contribute to the growth of our Technology & Engineering Practice through community leadership, delivery excellence and business development, while championing responsible AI adoption, appropriate governance and human oversight in architecture decisions.

What You’ll Do

  • Shape enterprise technology strategies, architecture roadmaps and governance frameworks that align technology investments with business priorities.

  • Design complex, scalable and resilient solutions across legacy and cloud environments, applying modern distributed architecture patterns and engineering principles.

  • Lead cross-functional architecture and engineering teams, promoting collaboration, delivery excellence, continuous learning and the development of colleagues.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, communicate enterprise architecture visions and influence strategic decisions while contributing to business development and commercial opportunities.

  • Explore and apply approved AI tools, automation and AI-enabled workflows to improve architecture analysis, design documentation and delivery efficiency, maintaining human review, appropriate governance and clear escalation pathways.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience leading enterprise architecture initiatives, shaping technology strategies, roadmaps and governance across complex organisations.

  • Strong solution architecture expertise across legacy and cloud environments, including at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure).

  • Experience applying modern distributed architecture patterns, including microservices, event-driven, containerised, serverless and zero-trust architectures.

  • Ability to build trusted senior stakeholder relationships, guide cross-functional technical teams and deliver through agile and DevOps practices, supported by recognised architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, Zachman, Domain-driven Design or NIST.

  • Curiosity about AI-enabled ways of working, with an understanding of how approved AI tools can support architecture activities while preserving professional judgement, security, responsible AI principles and appropriate human oversight.

Bonus Points For

  • Senior-level consulting experience, ideally within financial services or other regulated industries with complex compliance, risk and security requirements.

  • Experience leading pre-sales activities, proposals or bids, including commercial ownership and client engagement.

  • Experience designing greenfield architectures, cloud-first enterprises or establishing and maturing enterprise architecture functions within agile delivery environments.

  • Awareness of emerging AI capabilities, including Generative AI and Agentic AI, and their potential application to enterprise architecture, engineering productivity and responsible technology transformation.

  • Relevant professional certifications in architecture frameworks, cloud technologies or related disciplines, such as TOGAF or cloud provider certifications.

Why Join Capco

  • Deliver high-impact technology solutions for Tier 1 financial institutions.

  • Work in a collaborative, flat and entrepreneurial consulting culture.

  • Access continuous learning, training and industry certifications.

  • Be part of a team shaping the future of digital financial services.

  • Help shape the future of digital transformation across financial services and energy.

Benefits

We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package designed to support every aspect of your life:

  • Core Benefits: Discretionary bonus, competitive pension, health insurance, life insurance and critical illness cover.

  • Mental Health: Easy access to CareFirst, Unmind, Aviva consultations and in-house first aiders.

  • Family-Friendly: Maternity, adoption and shared parental leave, plus paid leave for sickness, pregnancy loss, fertility treatment, menopause and bereavement.

  • Family Care: 8 complimentary backup care sessions for emergency childcare or elder care.

  • Holiday Flexibility: 5 weeks of annual leave with the option to buy or sell holiday days based on your needs.

  • Continuous Learning: Your growth, your way – a minimum of 40 hours of training annually. Take your pick from workshops, certifications and e-learning. You'll also be assigned a Business Coach from Day One, offering one-on-one guidance to support your goals and accelerate your development.

  • Healthcare Access: Convenient online GP services.

  • Extra Perks: Gympass (Wellhub), travel insurance, Tastecard, season ticket loans, Cycle to Work and dental insurance.

Inclusion at Capco

We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know – we’ll be happy to help. We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration – a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

#LI-DNI

title: Lead Supply Chain Coördinator
descriptionHtml:
Bij Crisp hebben we een missie: eten met meer smaak bereikbaar maken voor iedereen, waarbij we onze kracht van de kortste keten van boer tot bord inzetten op een manier waar je trots op kunt zijn. Als Lead Supply Chain Coördinator geef jij leiding aan het team dat iedere dag opnieuw zorgt dat de korte keten tussen leverancier en ons Warehouse zo goed mogelijk loopt. Zo kunnen we onze knetterverse producten altijd op tijd bij onze klanten bezorgen.

Je staat zelf midden in de operatie, maar kijkt ook verder: je maakt de supply chain elke dag een stukje slimmer, bouwt aan de processen en manier van werken binnen je team, en zorgt voor een sterke samenwerking met ons warehouse. Zo bouw je mee aan een Supply Chain-afdeling waarmee we kunnen blijven groeien.

Wat je gaat doen

Als Lead Inbound Supply Chain Coördinator zorg jij er samen met je team voor dat onze leveranciers de juiste producten, op het goede moment, in de juiste hoeveelheid leveren. Hierdoor krijgen onze klanten hun producten vers bezorgd en kunnen we op ons Warehouse de voorraad zo laag mogelijk houden. Dat is een ingewikkelde puzzel die we elke dag een stukje slimmer willen oplossen. Jij geeft het team daarin richting, houdt de dagelijkse operatie scherp en verbetert tegelijk structureel. Je hebt veel contact met externe partijen zoals leveranciers, en met andere teams binnen Crisp zoals ons warehouse en het commerciële team.

Een aantal van jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

  • Je bent leidinggevende van het Inbound Supply Chain-team. Je coacht en ontwikkelt je teamleden, voert de gesprekken die daarbij horen en zorgt dat iedereen weet wat je van hem of haar verwacht.

  • Je bewaakt samen met het team de dagelijkse supply chain performance en bent eindverantwoordelijk voor het oplossen van verstoringen. Waar nodig spring je zelf bij om bestellingen scherp te monitoren en snel te schakelen met leveranciers en interne teams.

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de continuous improvement van onze dagelijkse supply chain. Je analyseert waar het schuurt, zet verbeteringen op de agenda en zorgt dat ze ook echt landen in de operatie.

  • Je bent eigenaar van de teamprocessen en de way-of-working. Je zorgt voor heldere afspraken, duidelijke rolverdeling en werkwijzen die meegroeien met Crisp.

  • Je zorgt voor een goede samenwerking met ons warehouse team. Je stemt structureel af, lost knelpunten samen op en bouwt aan een relatie waarin beide teams elkaar sterker maken.

Dit ben jij

  • Je hebt een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding op zak.

  • Je hebt minimaal 3-5 jaar ervaring binnen Supply Chain, Logistiek of Operations.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands.

  • Je bent een natuurlijke leider. Je geeft richting, coacht je team en haalt het beste uit mensen.

  • Je bent een verbeteraar. Je ziet snel waar processen beter kunnen en voert verbeteringen ook echt door.

  • Je bent nog steeds een echte doener. Je vindt het leuk om mee te draaien in de operatie.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk. Je bent een teamplayer, bouwt makkelijk relaties op en schakelt met gemak met veel verschillende partijen tegelijk.

  • Je hebt talent voor planning en structuur. Je werkt planmatig en gestructureerd en bent altijd voorbereid.

Wat wij bieden

  • Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem.

  • 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden.

  • Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen.

  • Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp.

  • Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL.

  • Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University.

  • Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven.

  • Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor.
