title: Operations Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du steuerst die Invasion. Wir bringen Marken in Kioske, Mini-Märkte und Tankstellenshops. Jede Marke braucht einen Plan, eine Tour und einen Report. Du sorgst dafür, dass alle drei stehen.

Über uns

Impuls Invasion ist eine FMCG-Handelsagentur aus Hamburg, gegründet 2026. Wir arbeiten für Hersteller und Marken im Impulskanal. Unser Außendienst ist in Hamburg und Berlin unterwegs. Jede Marke sieht Besuche, Distribution und Platzierungen in unserem Live-Tool.

Nach 12 Monaten

Du leitest die Projekte mehrerer Marken selbst. Jeder Monatsreport geht pünktlich raus. Du hast ein neues Projekt vom Angebot bis zum Start gebracht und weißt, welche Tour sich rechnet.

Dein Job

  • Kundenprojekte leiten. Du bist Ansprechperson für mehrere Marken. Du planst Maßnahmen, hältst Termine und lieferst Ergebnisse.

  • Außendienst steuern. Du planst Touren mit unserem Team in Hamburg und Berlin und koordinierst unsere Handelsvertretungen. Ab und zu fährst du selbst mit.

  • Auswertungen ziehen. Du holst Besuche, Distribution und Platzierungen aus unserem Live-Tool. Daraus baust du Reports und Entscheidungsvorlagen.

  • Neue Projekte aufbauen. Du rechnest Angebote mit, setzt Piloten auf und bringst neue Marken in bestehende Touren.

Woran wir dich messen

  • Jede Marke hat ihren Monatsreport, bevor sie danach fragt.

  • Geplante Besuche finden statt. Abweichungen kennst du vor der Marke.

  • Jedes neue Projekt startet mit Kalkulation, Tourplan und KPI-Set.

Das brauchst du

  • Erste Erfahrung in Vertrieb, Handel, Gastro oder Agentur. Job, Ausbildung und Werkstudium zählen.

  • Kundenkontakt, am Telefon oder vor Ort.

  • Auswertungen in Excel oder Google Sheets, aus Job, Studium oder Projekt.

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift.

Ein Plus

  • Du hast schon etwas selbst verantwortet: ein Projekt, ein Team, eine Schicht oder einen Verein.

  • Türkisch oder Arabisch.

Du bekommst

  • Fixum plus Bonus auf deine Ziele. Die Gehaltsspanne steht in unserer ersten Antwort.

  • Vollzeit oder Teilzeit. Du sagst uns, wie viele Stunden du arbeiten willst.

  • Homeoffice jederzeit. Hamburg ist unsere Basis.

  • Du studierst berufsbegleitend? Wir planen deine Woche um die Vorlesungen.

  • Laptop und Zugang zum Live-Tool ab Tag eins.

Deine ersten 90 Tage

  • Woche 1 und 2: Touren mitfahren, Live-Tool lernen.

  • Monat 1: Reports der ersten Marken übernehmen.

  • Monat 3: Dein erstes Projekt leiten.

title: Operations Manager, Offer Operations
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

🦾 Our Offer Operations team

Joko helps millions of users earn cashback automatically, whether they shop online through affiliate links, activate coupons, or pay in-store with their linked bank card. Behind each of these experiences, there's an operational engine that needs to work flawlessly: transactions must be tracked, cashback must be caught, offers must be reliable, and merchants must perform as expected. When this engine breaks, users don't get paid — and trust erodes fast.

Offer Operations owns that engine. The team's mission is to guarantee the reliability and continuous improvement of Joko's core monetization mechanics — across affiliate tracking, coupons, card-linked bank integrations, gift cards, and merchant performance. It's a technical, data-heavy, high-stakes scope that sits right at the heart of what makes Joko's product work.

🎯 What you will do

As an Operations Manager, your main mission is to own one of the processes that decides whether millions of Joko users actually get the cashback they're owed. You'll report to David Le Pahun, our Offer Operations Lead. The role blends four things: analysing data, designing how the process should work, solving problems with AI, technologies or in the last resort outsourcing, and managing projects.

  • Analyse data. You'll build the dashboards that tell you — and everyone else — whether your part of the system is healthy: how many transactions are being correctly tracked and rewarded, what's silently breaking down, whether user experience is suffering.

  • Design the process. You decide how merchants get set up on our platform: their cashback rate, which purchases qualify, how we connect to their systems. A lot of this doesn't have a playbook yet — you'll be writing a good chunk of it as you go.

  • Solve problems with technology. A merchant might be showing users a coupon that doesn't actually pay out. A batch of card purchases might not match cleanly to any merchant we track. You'll dig into why, then fix it choosing the right solution for it: automating it with AI, improving one of our internal tools (built on Retool) and if a human is required, you'll build the right playbook to outsource it.

  • Manage outsourced resources. You'll manage the outsourced team members who help you operate at scale — briefing them, training them, checking their work is actually good — while juggling several of these issues at once and deciding what matters most.

  • Partner cross-functionally. With Product & Engineering when the fix is structural, and with the commercial team when it's really about a merchant relationship.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: around 2–5 years of experience, ideally with exposure to Operations, Product, or a technical/data-driven environment.

  • AI-native: you genuinely believe in what AI can do, and you already use it as part of how you work — not as a buzzword, but as a real way to automate the repetitive parts of your job and move faster on the rest.

  • Ops mindset: you think in systems — monitoring → detection → investigation → resolution → prevention. You instinctively look for what can break and build safeguards so it doesn't happen again.

  • Tech acumen: you're comfortable in a technical environment — tracking, APIs, integrations — and can hold your own in a conversation with Engineering.

  • Analytical skills: you're data-driven and comfortable navigating dashboards, investigating anomalies, and making decisions based on metrics.

  • Attention to detail: the devil is in the details, and you have a talent for spotting flaws where others don't.

  • Communication: clear written and verbal communication skills; you're not afraid to defend your decisions with demanding stakeholders (including merchants and the outsourced teams you'll be directing).

  • Education: Top-tier engineering or business school background. International experience and a double degree are a clear plus.

  • Languages: fluent in written and spoken English. Mastering French is not required.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €41.2K – €79.8K • Offers Equity

descriptionHtml:

You will own the end-to-end solution design for Xstore Point of Service and Xstore Office, so each market is designed on the global template with minimal, well-governed customisation, completing design for 3 to 4 work packages a year.

You will be measured on low design-related defects, template conformance and on-time design delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Fit-gap and Adopt-vs-Adapt assessments per market, with documented standard vs. custom recommendations
  • Solution designs and FSDs for POS flows: sales, returns, exchanges, clienteling, payments, tax and receipts

  • Integration designs between Xstore and payments, tax, order management, CRM, ERP, e-commerce and SIOCS

  • Are able to say no to overcommitment and unnecessary customisation with a clear rationale

  • Have excellent interpersonal skills and strong written and verbal communication skills in English (C2 proficiency); French is a strong advantage; willingness to travel regularly to boutiques, regional PODs and client sites. Location: France (preferred, Paris)

  • Oracle Retail and cloud integration patterns; fiscal and tax requirements across Europe, APAC and the Americas
  • 15+ years in retail technology and 8+ years designing Oracle Xstore solutions (Senior Principal: 18+ years, several global rollouts as lead architect)
  • Lead or chief architect on a multi-country POS rollout, ideally 10+ countries
  • Strong luxury, fashion or premium retail background: clienteling, high-touch boutique processes, multi-brand and multi-currency
  • Experience governing a standard-first template and working across multiple vendors; Oracle Retail or Xstore certification is a plus

Given that this is just a short snapshot of the role we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the requirements listed above. We are looking for team members who strive to make an impact and are eager to learn. If this sounds like you and you feel you have the skills and experience required, then please apply now.

Benefits

Our CRL (Consumer Goods, retail & Logistics) practice helps some of the largest global firms and most recognizable local brands solve their biggest challenges in today’s age of constant disruption. With diverse services spanning growth strategy and new product innovation, to omni-channel customer experience, supply chain resiliency and AI-driven new business models, we help clients shape and achieve their growth agenda for a sustainable future. Be part of a globally renowned management consulting firm on the front-line of industry disruption and at the cutting edge of technology. We work with market leading brands across sectors. Our culture is inclusive and entrepreneurial. Being a mid-size consultancy within the scale of Infosys gives us the global reach to partner with our clients throughout their transformation journey.

Our core values, IC-LIFE, form a common code that helps us move forward. IC-LIFE stands for Inclusion, Equity and Diversity, Client, Leadership, Integrity, Fairness, and Excellence. To learn more about Infosys Consulting and our values, please visit our .

Furthermore, Infosys has been recognized by the Top Employers Institute, a global certification company, for its exceptional standards in employee conditions across Europe for five years in a row.

descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 350 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !



Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez nous ?

Les intégrateurs historiques disposent souvent d’une expertise métier reconnue, d’équipes commerciales et de conseil, ainsi que d’un parc de clients à accompagner. Ils peuvent contribuer fortement à la croissance de Pennylane, à la fois par la vente de nouvelles solutions et par le développement de leur parc existant.

Pour transformer ce potentiel en résultats, il faut installer une dynamique commerciale durable : aligner les dirigeants et les équipes terrain, faire émerger des opportunités, améliorer la maîtrise du produit et faciliter la collaboration avec les équipes Pennylane. Tu aideras les partenaires à passer d’une relation de distribution ou de prescription à une collaboration active, structurée et créatrice de valeur.

 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

Tu piloteras le développement d’un portefeuille de partenaires intégrateurs, de la stratégie de compte jusqu’à l’exécution des plans d’action :

  1. Développer les comptes partenaires, en alignant les dirigeants, responsables commerciaux et équipes opérationnelles autour d’objectifs communs.

  2. Accélérer le business Resell et Cosell, en animant les opportunités, en améliorant leur qualité et en aidant les partenaires à faire progresser leurs cycles de vente.

  3. Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence, grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret.

  4. Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant, en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs.

  5. Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain, en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes.

 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenaires

  • Comprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur.

  • Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes.

  • Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes.

  • Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles.

  • Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu.

2. Animer le business Resell et Cosell

  • Créer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire.

  • Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable.

  • Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane.

  • Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés.

  • Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion.

3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateurs

  • Identifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires.

  • Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe.

  • Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau.

  • Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation.

  • Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats.

4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomes

  • Maîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes.

  • Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités.

  • Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs.

  • Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux.

  • Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire.

5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relation

  • Assurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales.

  • Préparer et animer des revues de partenariat qui débouchent sur des décisions, des responsables et des prochaines étapes claires.

  • Entretenir un réseau de contacts au-delà de l’interlocuteur principal afin de sécuriser la continuité du partenariat.

  • Identifier tôt les signaux de risque, les irritants et les sujets nécessitant un arbitrage.

  • Représenter Pennylane auprès des partenaires avec exigence, réactivité et transparence.

6. Collaborer en interne et contribuer à la stratégie Partnerships

  • Coordonner les plans partenaires avec les équipes AE, Marketing, Ops, Produit et les équipes d’accompagnement concernées.

  • Faire remonter des retours terrain précis sur les besoins des intégrateurs, les objections, les évolutions de marché et les opportunités commerciales.

  • Proposer des initiatives marketing, commerciales ou produit pour accélérer la croissance des partenaires.

  • Partager les bonnes pratiques et les succès avec l’équipe afin de contribuer à la performance collective.

  • Maintenir des informations fiables dans le CRM et respecter les processus de vente et de suivi partenaires.

     

Profil recherché :

Compétences incontournables :

  • Tu as une expérience confirmée en vente indirecte B2B, gestion de comptes partenaires ou développement de réseaux de revendeurs et d’intégrateurs;

  • Tu as idéalement au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans un environnement logiciel ou SaaS B2B ; une expérience plus senior sera appréciée pour gérer des partenaires stratégiques et des cycles complexes;

title: People Data Analyst
descriptionHtml:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot,based on 60,000 reviews. Our cultureputs customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 byAlexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.


Join us as a People Data Analyst to help Qonto’s People team turn HR data into clear insights and better-informed decisions.

Reporting to Mélodie Moulin, you will work closely with your People Systems teammates, HRBPs, and partners across People and Finance. You’ll combine hands-on analysis with an understanding of HR topics to answer practical questions, improve dashboards and reporting, and help stakeholders make better use of People data.

➡️ What you’ll do

  • Turn People data into actionable insights. Explore topics such as turnover, absenteeism, and performance, investigate trends, and communicate findings through clear analyses and concise recommendations.

  • Build and improve dashboards and reporting. Create reliable, easy-to-use reports, maintain consistent metric definitions, and help stakeholders understand what the data tells them. Keep People data reliable and usable. Validate data, document calculations, and contribute to mandatory reporting while following established access, confidentiality, and GDPR requirements.

  • Support HRBPs in their day-to-day decisions. Translate their questions into relevant analyses, discuss which KPIs are most useful, and help them become more autonomous through documentation and practical guidance.

  • Contribute to workforce and talent analyses. Prepare datasets, reports, and analytical inputs for topics such as headcount planning, compensation reviews, and talent reviews, in collaboration with the team.

  • Use AI to improve how you work. Apply AI to relevant analytical and reporting tasks, test practical ways to save time, and check the accuracy and reliability of outputs.

➡️ What we’re looking for

  • Relevant experience in People Analytics, HR reporting, or a data analytics role with substantial exposure to HR topics, ideally within a tech company or scale-up. A solid understanding of HR processes. Compensation reviews, talent reviews, and HRBP activities are familiar territory. You understand the questions behind a reporting request and can discuss whether a metric addresses them.

  • Hands-on analytical skills. You’re comfortable using SQL, Excel, and BI tools to combine datasets, check calculations, investigate trends, and build clear dashboards. Experience with HRIS reporting, particularly Workday, is a plus.

  • Clear communication and sound judgment. You can explain findings to non-technical stakeholders, ask useful questions, and distinguish what the data supports from what still needs investigating. Reliable delivery and collaborative working habits. You can progress independently on defined analyses, keep stakeholders informed, and flag blockers or competing priorities early.

  • Practical experience using AI. You already use AI in your work and can explain where it improves your efficiency or output quality, how you verify results, and how you protect sensitive information.

  • Professional fluency in English. French is a strong plus.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • Meaningful analytical work that helps the People team understand workforce trends and make better-informed decisions.

  • Varied HR topics, from performance and attrition to compensation, workforce planning, and reporting.

  • Close collaboration within a growing team, with opportunities to deepen both your analytical skills and your understanding of People topics.

  • Room to improve how work gets done, through clearer dashboards, reusable analyses, better documentation, and practical applications of AI.

➡️ Your future manager

You’ll report to Mélodie Moulin, Head of People Systems at Qonto.

  • Their path? Mélodie has 10+ years in HR systems and people operations, including leading large-scale HR transformation programs at Doctolib and Pernod Ricard, notably a global Workday deployment across 80+ locations. She joined Qonto to build a People Systems team from the ground up, using data and AI to help HR operate at scale.

  • What do they bring to the team? Mélodie values autonomy, thoughtful problem-solving, and proactive collaboration. She brings a practical, solutions-focused approach, with clear expectations and space to develop your expertise while contributing to shared team priorities.


[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here

[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

title: People Ops Intern
descriptionHtml:
About The Role

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We're growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we're looking for an HR Intern to be Taktile's ambassador to our future employees.

You will collaborate closely with our People team to ensure the efficient management of the employee lifecycle, from onboarding to ongoing feedback and support. You will play a crucial role in maintaining our HR systems, keeping employee data accurate, and supporting the administrative tasks that keep our people operations running smoothly. By handling these essential tasks, you will contribute significantly to shaping the company's growth and ensuring we maintain a high standard of employee satisfaction and performance. You will work closely with colleagues across all departments to manage various HR activities.

What You'll Do as an HR Intern

  • Database and Profile Management: Maintain and update HR-related content on our internal databases and manage employee profiles in our HRIS (HiBob), ensuring all data is accurate and up-to-date. This is crucial for consistency and compliance with company policies.

  • Administrative Support: Prepare documents for various processes (internal transfers, mobility, etc.).

About You

  • Strong time management and multitasking abilities.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English (German is a plus).

  • Excited to learn about new concepts, tools, and processes and eager to challenge the status quo.

Ideal Qualifications (but not required)

We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

Our Stance

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

About Us

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com.

title: Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d, Vollzeit)
descriptionHtml:
Du steuerst bezahlte Kampagnen nicht nach Gefühl, sondern nach Zahlen, und weißt aus eigener Erfahrung, was einen guten Lead von einem teuren unterscheidet? Dann passt du zu uns.

Als Performance Marketing Manager setzt du unsere bezahlten Kampagnen auf, steuerst und wertest sie aus, damit qualifizierte Leads bei unserem Vertrieb ankommen. Du bist der Filter zwischen Anzeige und Beratungsgespräch und verantwortest deine Kampagnen vom ersten Tag an eigenständig.

Die Take Care Immobilien GmbH entwickelt Senioren- und Pflegeimmobilien und bietet sie Kapitalanlegern als langfristige und nachhaltige Investition an. Damit schaffen wir ein Zuhause für Menschen, die Unterstützung brauchen, und eine Antwort auf den demografischen Wandel.

Bei uns triffst du auf kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien, getragen von erfahrenen Gesellschaftern. Du arbeitest eng mit Marketingleitung und Vertrieb zusammen und siehst direkt, welchen Beitrag deine Kampagnen zum Geschäftserfolg leisten.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du baust Kampagnen in Meta, Google und LinkedIn auf und steuerst sie im Rahmen eines festen Quartalsbudgets.

  • Du baust Google Ads als eigenen Schwerpunkt aus: Search und Display, Keywords, negative Keywords und Suchintentionen.

  • Du richtest ein sauberes Tracking ein, inklusive UTM-Parametern, und verknüpfst die Kampagnen mit HubSpot.

  • Du optimierst laufende Kampagnen kontinuierlich über Zielgruppen, Gebote, Creatives und A/B-Tests.

  • Du entwickelst Wording und Framing für Objekt- und Rabattaktionen in Abstimmung mit der Marketingleitung.

  • Du briefst Bild-Creatives bei unserem Digital Designer und Videos bei unserem Video Editor und prüfst sie vor dem Go-live auf Briefing und Plattformformate.

  • Du wertest deine Kampagnen aus: Kosten pro Lead, Anteil qualifizierter Leads, Terminquote und Kosten pro Abschluss.

  • Du pflegst das Marketing-Dashboard in HubSpot auf Kampagnenebene und lieferst die Kennzahlen für das monatliche Reporting an die Marketingleitung.

  • Du prüfst und qualifizierst eingehende Leads vor, bevor sie in ein Beratungsgespräch gehen, und spielst die Rückmeldungen zur Lead-Qualität in Kampagnen und Framing zurück.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Performance Marketing, in der du Kampagnen eigenverantwortlich aufgesetzt, gesteuert und ausgewertet hast.

  • Nachweisbare Praxis mit Meta Ads und Google Ads (Search und Display); Erfahrung mit LinkedIn Ads ist ein Plus.

  • Erfahrung in der Leadgenerierung mit klarem Fokus auf Lead-Qualität und Kosten pro Abschluss, nicht nur auf Lead-Menge, idealerweise bei erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten wie Immobilien, Kapitalanlagen oder Finanzdienstleistungen.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Tracking, UTM-Parametern und Conversion-Messung sowie mit Analyse- und Reporting-Tools.

  • Erfahrung mit HubSpot oder einem vergleichbaren Marketing-Automation-Tool sowie mit einem CRM.

  • Verantwortung für feste Werbebudgets und die Fähigkeit, Budgets zielgerichtet einzusetzen und einzuhalten.

  • Ein analytisches, zahlengetriebenes Denken und gleichzeitig ein gutes Gespür für Botschaften, die Zielgruppen überzeugen.

  • Eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du brauchst keine lange Einarbeitung, sondern legst nach kurzer Einführung in unsere Prozesse direkt los.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit KI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude oder Microsoft Copilot und Lust, KI im Arbeitsalltag gezielt einzusetzen.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

title: Ph.D. Position in Computer Science (Wearable Intelligence & Data Fusion)
descriptionHtml:
Constructor University in collaboration with Constructor Knowledge Labs and Constructor Technology

About the Position

The research group of Dr. Sari Sadiya at Constructor Knowledge Labs (CKL), in collaboration with Constructor University (CU) and Constructor Technology (CT), invites applicants for Ph.D. student positions in Computer Science with a focus on wearable intelligence, multimodal data fusion, and edge AI.

The project investigates how wearable data streams can be transformed into structured knowledge and integrated into a knowledge-grounded digital avatar that supports bi-directional collaboration in education and research.

Ph.D. students will work in a highly interdisciplinary environment, combining AI/ML, edge computing, cognitive science, and human–computer interaction. In close collaboration with academia and industry, they will contribute to building privacy-preserving, real-time personalization frameworks while pursuing their doctoral dissertation.

About the Program

The PhD program is research-centered, emphasizing original contributions in:

  • Wearable data analytics and fusion methods
  • Biomedical data analytics
  • On-device processing and performance modeling
  • Personalization and adaptive reasoning systems
  • AI for Education

Doctoral students will also have access to specialized courses in:

  • Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Edge Computing
  • Advanced Computational Methods and Data Science
  • Cognitive Science and Human-Centered Computing

As part of the program, students will collaborate with Constructor Technology to gain first-hand industrial experience, contributing to real-world testbeds and prototypes.

Research Focus

This PhD position is part of the Wearable Intelligence Project, with two main research directions:

  • Data fusion of heterogeneous temporal streams
    • Designing algorithms to unify multimodal signals (physiological, cognitive, contextual, scheduling, and learning data).
    • Developing pipelines that produce structured insights powering the Agentic Personalization Engine (APE).
  • On-device data processing & performance modeling
    • Developing models balancing computation, energy, and data flows across wearable, edge, and cloud environments.
    • Exploring feasibility of running compact micro-LLMs directly on wearables.

The overarching goal is to create scalable, ethical, and transparent personalization systems that support education and research.

Funding

The appointment provides full financial coverage through a dedicated fellowship, comprising:

  • Monthly stipend of €1,650
  • Monthly research-cost allowance of €100 (Forschungskostenpauschale)
  • Health-insurance subsidy of €100 per month
  • Supplementary €603 mini-job allowance to support parallel part-time employment (optional)

Constructor Knowledge Labs actively supports candidates in preparing applications for external funding — doctoral scholarships, foundations, or international mobility grants — and can provide institutional support and references

Applicant Profile

Mandatory requirements:

  • MSc degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, Cognitive Science, or related disciplines.
  • Strong background in AI/ML, signal processing, or edge computing.
  • Hands-on experience with wearable or multimodal data (e.g., heart rate, EEG, activity, sleep, GPS).
  • Solid mathematical and computational modeling skills.
  • Proficiency in academic English writing (e.g., reports, papers, theses).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with LLMs, multimodal data fusion, or agent-based AI systems.
  • Familiarity with privacy-preserving ML, dynamic consent, and GDPR-compliant frameworks.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct independent research and collaborate across disciplines.
  • Interest in teaching, mentoring, and applied industrial research.

Application Details

  • Deadline: August 31, 2026

Required documents:

  • Curriculum Vitae (CV);
  • Academic transcripts;
  • Letter of motivation outlining research interests and career goals;
  • 2 recommendation letters.

Applications to be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to interviews.

title: Photonics Packaging & Cryogenic Integration R&D Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry.
Its offerings include a very energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers.
Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components.
Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.
Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Description of the Team/Project

We are looking for a Photonics Packaging & Cryogenic Integration Engineer to contribute to the development and industrialization of our photonic quantum systems.

You will work on the integration of single-photon sources, photonic integrated circuits and optical/electromechanical assemblies, with a strong focus on miniaturization, automation and operation under cryogenic conditions.

This is a highly hands-on role at the intersection of photonics, electronics, mechanics, automation and experimental physics.

You will contribute across the full development cycle: design, prototyping, assembly, testing, optimization and transfer toward industrial-scale production.

Your Key Responsibilities:

    • Design and develop packaging and integration solutions for photonic and quantum devices.
    • Integrate single-photon sources, photonic integrated circuits and optical components into complete systems.
    • Develop and optimize optical coupling strategies, including fiber coupling and direct chip-to-chip integration.
    • Design, build and assemble precision positioning and alignment systems, including nano-positioning stages and multi-axis platforms.
    • Develop experimental setups operating under cryogenic conditions, typically in the 2–4 K range.
    • Design mechanical parts and assemblies using CAD tools.
    • Contribute to electronics development, including PCB design, instrumentation and control systems.
    • Automate alignment, test and characterization processes using Python, C++, Rust or similar programming languages.
    • Work with microcontrollers, FPGA-based systems or other hardware-control architectures when relevant.
    • Build, test and iterate rapidly on prototypes, including using 3D printing and other rapid prototyping techniques.
    • Perform test and measurement activities to characterize system performance and identify failure modes.
    • Contribute feedback to the design of photonic chips and single-photon sources based on integration and testing results.
    • Support the transition from laboratory prototypes to repeatable and scalable manufacturing processes.
    • Document designs, experiments, procedures and lessons learned, and actively share knowledge within the team.

Requirements

What we're looking for:

You should ideally bring:

  • A PhD in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, applied physics, condensed matter physics, solid-state physics, optics, photonics or a related field.
  • Strong hands-on experience building and testing scientific or high-precision equipment.
  • Experience with photonics, optomechanics, semiconductor devices, cryogenics or precision engineering.
  • Familiarity with optical alignment, fiber coupling and/or photonic packaging.
  • Experience with mechanical design and CAD tools.
  • Good understanding of electronics, instrumentation and test equipment.
  • Programming skills in Python, C++, Rust or similar languages for automation and hardware control.
  • Experience working with multidisciplinary systems combining optics, mechanics, electronics and software.
  • Strong experimental problem-solving skills and the ability to iterate quickly from concept to prototype.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to produce clear technical documentation and collaborate in an international environment.

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be particularly valuable:

  • Cryogenic systems and experiments at very low temperatures.
  • Photonic or optoelectronic packaging.
  • Chip bonding, indium bump bonding or related micro-assembly techniques.
  • Pick-and-place systems or automated precision assembly.
  • Nano-positioning and multi-axis motion control systems.
  • Robotics or computer vision.
  • FPGA or microcontroller development.
  • PCB design using KiCad or similar tools.
  • Finite-element simulation using tools such as ANSYS or COMSOL.
  • Semiconductor or quantum photonics environments.

More than a specific academic background, we are looking for someone who enjoys building complex scientific systems and solving problems directly at the hardware level.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)

  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3-4 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris or 1 to 2 days remotely)
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

title: Principal AI Security Specialist, UK&I
descriptionHtml:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

About the Role

The AI revolution is here, and enterprises are racing to adopt GenAI - but they cannot deploy what they cannot secure. Zscaler is seeking an experienced Principal AI Security Specialist to bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI innovation and robust enterprise security.

In this highly strategic, field-facing role, you will combine the elite consultative strengths of a Solutions Engineer with deep expertise in LLMs, RAG architectures, and data protection. As our premier technical authority, you will partner with Fortune 500 executives and architects, serving as a trusted advisor to help them confidently unlock the power of AI without compromising their data or infrastructure. If you are a builder, an educator, and a master storyteller who thrives in a fast-evolving market, this is your chance to lead the industry's most critical conversation.

What You’ll Do 

  • Architect the AI Technical Strategy: Partner with enterprise account teams to own and execute the technical sales strategy, driving complex, high-value AI security opportunities from discovery to close.
  • Deliver Compelling, High-Impact Demos & POVs: Configure and present tailored, outcome-driven demonstrations of Zscaler’s AI security platform that resonate with both deep-tech practitioners and C-level executives.  When needed, take customers through successful demos and POVs to validate Zscaler’s ability to securely enable enterprise AI.  
  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert: Act as the field authority on modern AI patterns (such as RAG, agents, and prompt workflows), advising clients on how to prevent sensitive data exposure and unsanctioned AI usage.
  • Scale the Field Motion: Collaborate with Product and Engineering to inject real-world customer feedback into the product roadmap, while building reusable demo assets and enablement playbooks to upscale our global sales force.
  • Enable Those Around You: Develop reusable demos, technical assets, competitive positioning, and enablement content to help scale Zscaler’s AI field motion while sharing best practices and training with enterprise account teams

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. You adapt to what’s needed, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are customer-obsessed. You build deep empathy for the customer—both internal and external—and anchor your decisions in solving their real-world problems. You champion their needs from start to finish, knowing their success is our success.
  • You are driven by innovation. You have a deep curiosity for how things work and are energized by solving complex technical challenges. You believe in the power of technology to accelerate transformation and are always looking for a better, more secure, and scalable way.

What We’re Looking For 

  • Deep Fluency in AI/GenAI: Strong foundational knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), MCP (Model Context Protocol) orchestration patterns, and the inherent security risks associated with them.
  • 10+ Years of Solutions Engineering Mastery: A proven track record in a customer-facing technical role (Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Technical Advisory) navigating complex, enterprise-level sales cycles.
  • Enterprise Security Foundations: Solid grasp of cybersecurity principles, including Zero Trust architecture, data loss prevention (DLP), cloud-native security platforms, and API integrations.
  • Elite Executive Communication: Exceptional presentation and storytelling skills, with a demonstrated ability to seamlessly translate complex AI architectures into tangible business value and security outcomes.
  • Collaborate and Co-elevate: Successfully work cross-functionally with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other go-to-market teams in a hyper-growth, rapidly evolving market.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Demonstrate strong AI fluency by leveraging coding assistants, LLMs, and Generative AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, solution design, automation, and customer problem-solving, while applying sound technical judgment to validate outputs.
  • Hands-on AI Prototyping: Interacting with LLM APIs, scripting, creating agentic automation routines, and building lightweight AI applications.
  • Advanced AI Risk Expertise: Direct experience helping enterprises deploy production AI technologies while navigating data leakage, model governance, compliance frameworks, and shadow AI usage.
  • Scale & Enablement Focus: A history of creating high-impact field assets, technical workshops, and competitive positioning content that helps broader go-to-market teams win.

title: Principal Hardware Engineer I
descriptionHtml:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.
We are looking to add a Principal Hardware Engineer I to our team. If you are great at what you do, enjoy working in a startup environment, and are passionate about developing leading-edge electronics for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. At the Principal level, you will be tasked with full-stack hardware development for complex modules and hardware systems. You will have the opportunity to start at concept development and progress through detailed design, analysis, layout, build, test, and delivery, doing hands-on work at each phase. The Principal level also includes technical leadership opportunities, gaining responsibility for critical designs and teams of engineers developing new products and systems. At a small company and a startup, your work will make direct contributions to the success of the business. The work is challenging and impactful, requiring both breadth and depth of technical knowledge. Our products are made for high-reliability space and airborne applications, so designs require high levels of technical rigor while maintaining the agility of a startup environment. The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.
JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Own end-to-end design of complex electronics modules and systems, from concept and architecture through schematic, layout, test, and production. Products may include high-speed digital, power electronics, and/or RF.
  • Lead teams of hardware engineers to develop new products with multiple electronics modules.
  • Provide subject matter expertise in support of hardware development across the company.
  • Develop hardware architecture and write hardware requirements for systems of high complexity.
  • Perform detailed and complete schematic design for complex boards, ranging from key components to supporting passives.
  • Perform detailed PCB layout in Altium Designer for complex boards, often working with a PCB Drafter.
  • Complete analysis such as worst-case circuit analysis, signal integrity analysis, and power integrity analysis. Guide analysis methodology.
  • Develop bring-up plans and design verification plans for new hardware and complex systems.
  • Perform bring-up and key verification testing of modules and complex integrated systems, often working with a team to complete validation.
  • Release modules and assemblies to production, working with the Manufacturing and Test Engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior and senior engineers to build technical understanding and professional development.
  • Use strong working knowledge of adjacent fields, such as software and mechanical, to streamline development of complex hardware systems.

    • JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor of Science (BS) degree or higher in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university.
  • Minimum of 9 years of industry or university research experience in board-level electronics design, analysis, and test.
  • Direct experience designing high-reliability electronics and small systems for space or defense applications, including part derating, worst-case analysis, and thermal constraints.
  • Experience owning the design phase of complex board-level electronics and small hardware systems, including architecture design, trade studies, key part selection, and detailed design.
  • Multiple experiences delivering hardware products through production and deployment.
  • Expertise in PCB layout and manufacturing, including high-density interconnect (HDI) stackup design, IPC standards, and industry best practices.
  • Expertise derisking designs with board-level signal integrity and/or power integrity simulation tools such as Ansys SIwave, ADS SIPro, or Mentor Hyperlynx.
  • Strong understanding of adjacent fields, such as software and mechanical, that contributes to judicious design of hardware system architectures.
  • Expert-level proficiency in electronics design tools such as Altium.
  • Extensive lab experience for bring-up and verification of new hardware, based on in-depth understanding of specialized lab equipment.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills.

    • PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
  • Experience leading teams of hardware engineers to develop multi-module assemblies, including hardware architecture, requirements, and interconnects.
  • Design for space radiation environments.

title: Principal, Product Analytics
descriptionHtml:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

We're looking for a Principal, Product Analytics who loves getting to the bottom of things. You'll do the deep investigative and technical work that explains why users and customers behave the way they do, and turn it into decisions that change the product and the business.

We're building a more proactive data function, and this role is its deep-investigation engine. You'll take ambiguous, high-stakes questions about user behaviour and customer experience and follow them wherever the data leads, across acquisition, activation, usage and the wider customer journey.

You'll work hands-on and independently, partnering with Product Managers, engineering managers and commercial teams, and working alongside a VP of Growth who will set the function's direction and build the team. Your findings will inform experiments, the roadmap and company strategy.

 

What you'll do

  • Go looking for what nobody asked about. This is the heart of the role. You'll notice when something looks off in a funnel, a cohort or a metric, disappear into it, and come back with a product issue, a cost leak or an opportunity nobody was looking for. You set much of your own agenda, and you don't wait for a request to start digging.

  • Lead deep investigations into user behaviour and customer experience across product and non-product touchpoints, including support, customer success and sales.

  • Find where activation breaks. Identify failure points in the user journey, including those that could become productised capabilities.

  • Understand acquisition and intent. Dig into acquisition channels, user use cases and what people are actually trying to achieve.

  • Do rigorous causal and statistical work. Go beyond correlation with regression, causal analysis and well-designed experiments, and be clear about what the evidence does and doesn't support.

  • Build models that drive action. Apply data science to real business problems, such as churn modelling that can trigger real-time product action, and explain clearly how models are applied and what impact they have.

  • Analyse unstructured and AI-specific data. Work with agent-user conversations, context layers and evaluation systems alongside structured product data.

  • Size opportunities. Produce market opportunity sizing that helps the business prioritise.

  • Measure how we build. Partner with engineering managers on organisational productivity metrics.

  • Communicate for impact. Translate findings into clear recommendations for product teams, management and executives.

What we're looking for

 

Must-haves

  • Deep product analytics experience across growth and broader product areas, with a record of investigations that changed decisions.

  • Data science and modelling experience, and the ability to explain how you applied it and what business impact it had.

  • Strong grounding in correlation, regression and causal analysis.

  • A proactive approach. You surface insights and shape the agenda rather than working to a brief.

  • Genuine curiosity. You notice what looks off and dig until you understand why.

  • Clear communication with management and executives about business impact, simplifying complex analysis into actionable recommendations.

Preferred

  • Experience with unstructured data.

  • Experience at an AI-native company, or with the added data complexity AI products bring.

  • Understanding of subscription businesses.

  • Understanding of the PLG motions in a B2B space.

Bonus points if you've…

  • Worked on multi-product platforms where upsells, cross-sells and bundling were a key revenue driver.

  • Worked alongside qualitative research, connecting the what (data) with the why (qual).

  • Done pricing and packaging work: willingness-to-pay, price testing, bundle performance.

How we work

We optimise for responsibility and freedom.

  • No ticket conveyor belt. We run on ownership and a small number of high-impact projects.

  • Close collaboration with Product, Engineering, Growth and commercial teams to ship real outcomes.

  • A bias toward pragmatic solutions that get used, measured and improved.

Why join

  • Do the hardest, most interesting analytical work in the company, with direct line of sight to product and strategy decisions.

  • Work across structured and unstructured data, customer conversations and AI evaluation, at the intersection of product usage, AI and revenue.

  • Independence and impact at principal level, without the management overhead.

title: Principal / Senior Consultant EU Transport & Mobility (Project Delivery & Excellence)
descriptionHtml:
Panteia | Transport & Mobility | EU Policy & Research


About Panteia

Panteia is one of the Netherlands’ leading research and consultancy firms in the fields of transport, mobility and public policy. Headquartered in Zoetermeer, Panteia employs around 70 professionals and works for national governments, the European Commission, EU agencies (CoR, CINEA), international institutions (e.g. EIB, World Bank, etc) and branch organisations. Panteia is part of the PanMuc group, together with Revnext (digitalisation, cybersecurity, technology and innovation). Together, they form a growing European consultancy ecosystem operating at the intersection of transport, sustainability, economics and policy. Panteia also collaborates closely with partner consultancies across all 27 EU Member States.

Within the Transport & Mobility (T&M) unit, Panteia has built a strong and trusted position in EU projects, including policy studies, corridor studies, market studies, evaluations and impact assessments.

As Panteia’s EU transport and mobility portfolio continues to grow in scale and complexity, this role is created to anchor delivery quality and long-term excellence.

The role

To further strengthen delivery quality and execution excellence, Panteia is looking for a Principal Consultant EU – Project Delivery & Excellence.

This is a senior leadership role focused on the co-ordination, execution and quality assurance of complex EU-funded transport and mobility projects (research and consultancy). The role is designed for an experienced EU consultant who excels in structuring delivery, steering teams, managing risk, and ensuring that projects meet the highest professional standards. A job for a policy-driven expert who wants impact and autonomy.

The Principal Consultant EU transport and mobility holds end-responsibility for delivery performance across a portfolio of EU projects and acts as a senior point of contact for clients and consortium partners.

Key responsibilities

Project delivery & leadership

  • Lead and oversee the execution of EU transport and mobility projects, including corridor studies, evaluations, impact assessments and policy research.

  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope and budget, and in line with contractual and quality requirements.

  • Act as senior escalation point for delivery issues, client questions and consortium coordination.

  • Maintain strong working relationships with the European Commission, EU agencies and international partners.

Team & quality leadership

  • Steer and coach multidisciplinary project teams (internal consultants and external partners).

  • Safeguard consistency, methodological soundness and professional quality across deliverables.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal workflows, delivery standards and quality assurance processes.

Role in acquisition & transition

The Principal Consultant plays a key strategic role in shaping delivery approaches during tenders and proposals:

  • Shaping delivery concepts, work plans and governance structures in EU proposals.

  • Identifying delivery risks and mitigation strategies at proposal stage.

  • Ensuring a smooth and effective handover from acquisition to project execution.

Position in the organisation

  • Reports to: Team manager.

  • Team: Works closely with an international EU team of approx. 10–15 consultants, plus external consortium partners.

  • Leadership role: Senior delivery lead across multiple EU-funded projects, with high autonomy and responsibility.

Practicalities

  • Location: Zoetermeer (NL), hybrid model
    – Regular presence at HQ expected (approx. 3 days/week)
    – Occasional travel to Brussels and other EU locations.

  • Languages: English required; additional EU languages are an asset.

  • Start date: As soon as possible.

  • Package: Competitive salary, aligned with Dutch consultancy benchmarks.

Why join Panteia?

  • Work at the forefront of EU transport and mobility policy – from social aspects of transport, to transport infrastructure resilience.

  • Combine analytical depth with real policy impact.

  • Focus on delivery excellence rather than sales targets.

  • Work in a compact, expert-driven team.

  • Enjoy autonomy to shape how EU projects are delivered.

  • Join a respected, collaborative team with strong EU credentials.

  • Be part of a growing European consultancy ecosystem within PanMuc.


What Panteia is looking for:

  • 10+ years of experience managing EU-funded projects in transport, sustainability or policy consulting.

  • Proven track record in complex project execution within a multi-stakeholder environment.

  • Experience with policy studies, corridor studies, impact evaluations, stakeholder consultation, and socio-economic analysis.

  • Excellent team leadership and co-ordination skills.

  • Familiarity with DG MOVE, DG CLIMA or similar EU institutions and processes.

  • Strong communicator in English (spoken and written). Dutch or any additional EU language is a plus.

  • MSc or PhD in Transport Economics, Civil Engineering, Spatial Planning, Public Policy or related field.

  • Willingness to travel to Brussels and other EU locations when needed.

title: Principal Technical Program Manager
descriptionHtml:

The work:

We're seeking a dedicated, passionate, and eager Principal Technical Program Manager to join our team responsible for leading large cross-functional programs linked to our Products. This role reports to the Head of TPM within Ripple Core. This is a challenging and technical role, requiring the expertise to synthesize business and technical requirements and the foresight to ensure we are solving for Ripple's current and future customer needs. You will bring a strong understanding of traditional finance and trading markets, and use it to help bridge the needs of financial institutions with the capabilities of digital asset infrastructure. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams to design robust and scalable systems, lead product schedules, remove roadblocks, and ensure high development velocity. Ideal candidates have a track record of seeing around the corner and providing technical leadership to deliver for customers. You will be responsible for high-level strategy, but also know when to get hands-on to push an initiative forward. You must be passionate about enabling teams to invent and deliver customer-focused solutions to bold and ambiguous challenges.

What you'll do:

  • Develop department-level priorities and strategy across strategic financial product initiatives by deeply understanding our institutional clients, the financial markets they operate in, and the technology that serves them.
  • Reduce ambiguity and risk by proactively identifying and eliminating bottlenecks and obstacles, raising issues strategically, and making sound data-driven decisions that deliver for our customers based on associated trade-offs.
  • Communicate with purpose and clarity, bringing together cross-functional teams to achieve program objectives.
  • Be a role model and an inspiring leader for other TPMs.
  • Create technical frameworks that can be used by engineering teams for decision-making.
  • Improve the efficiency of Operational Excellence processes across the organization.
  • Partner with product, engineering, and business leaders to align development priorities with the needs of financial institutions and market participants, driving alignment across internal teams and external partners such as banks, custodians, and market infrastructure providers.
  • Drive Ripple’s strategic initiatives that bring institutional financial products to market end to end, partnering with executive leadership to set direction, align business units, and translate company goals into executable multi-year programs.
  • Own outcomes across a portfolio of large programs serving financial institutions, anticipating cross-program dependencies and regulatory, operational, and market risks, making trade-off calls at the leadership level, and ensuring delivery translates into measurable client and business impact.

What you'll bring:

  • 12+ years of technical program management experience leading large-scale, cross-functional programs in complex financial services or financial technology environments, with a track record of delivering strategic initiatives across multiple organizations and external partners.
  • Deep experience in traditional finance (TradFi), such as banking, asset management, broker-dealers, custodians, or financial market infrastructure, with a strong understanding of the financial services landscape, its key players, and its regulatory environment.
  • Working knowledge of crypto or traditional trading markets, including market structure, liquidity, and the full trade lifecycle from order management and execution through clearing and settlement.
  • Ability to use data and analytics to identify trends and manage the health of programs and systems.
  • Shown understanding and working knowledge of software development and modern project management standard processes, such as Agile, Scrum, Six Sigma, etc.
  • Ability to coordinate multi-functionally, build consensus, and deliver across teams. Able to influence without authority, negotiate, and encourage others in a matrixed environment.
  • Experience with project planning tools such as Jira and Confluence, and proficiency in Google Sheets.
  • Experience crafting or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems.
  • Experience in Payments, Custody, Stablecoin, Prime Brokerage, Tokenization, and/or Blockchain ecosystems.

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.  A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
  • In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in. 
  • Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
  • We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

  • Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
  • Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
  • Employee giving match

Take Care of Yourself

  • R&R days so you can rest and recharge
  • Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
  • Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
  • Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
  • Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.

title: Principal Software Engineer - Product, Platform, Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Help us build the future of public administration!

Ayunis is a Munich-based GovTech company trusted by more than 1000 cities, municipalities and districts across the DACH region.

With Ayunis Core, we are building an open-source AI platform that automates repetitive administrative work. We use cutting-edge AI and engineering tools to build cutting-edge agentic technology—both for our customers and for our own development workflows.

Tasks

Your role

As Principal Engineer, you will provide hands-on technical leadership across our product, integration platform and production infrastructure.

Working closely with the CTO and engineering team, you will set technical direction, make critical architectural decisions and help other engineers deliver independently. You will remain close to code and production without becoming the bottleneck for every difficult problem.

Your responsibilities

  • Evolve the architecture of Ayunis Core across frontend, backend, agent runtime, identity, permissions and extension interfaces.

  • Own the technical direction of our infrastructure, including deployments, reliability, observability, security and incident readiness.

  • Build stable APIs, SDKs and reusable integration patterns for external systems such as document management systems and identity providers.

  • Make pragmatic trade-offs between delivery speed, simplicity and long-term maintainability.

  • Work with Product and customer-facing teams to turn recurring needs into reusable product capabilities.

  • Collaborate with open-source contributors, software vendors and integration partners.

Requirements

What you bring

  • Experience operating at Staff, Principal or a comparable level in a production software environment.

  • Strong backend and systems architecture skills, ideally with TypeScript and Node.js.

  • Hands-on experience with agent runtimes like LangChain, OpenAI Agent SDK, Mastra or similar.

  • Hands-on experience with sovereign infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, scaling, observability and security.

  • Experience designing APIs and integrations, such as OAuth/OIDC, webhooks, synchronization or event-driven systems.

  • The ability to move between high-level architecture and hands-on implementation and debugging.

  • A pragmatic product mindset: you judge technical decisions by their effect on reliability, delivery speed and customer value.

  • The ability to set technical direction and lead engineers without relying on formal authority.

  • An interest in using and systematically improving AI-assisted software development.

  • Confident communication in German and English.

Our stack

TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, React, TanStack, PostgreSQL, Redis, S3-compatible storage, Docker Compose, Hetzner, GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry and multiple LLM providers.

No LangChain though – we've built our agent orchestration from the ground up.

Benefits

What we offer

  • A competitive salary

  • €2,000 annual personal development budget

  • 30 days of holiday

  • Significant influence over an open-source product and engineering organization

  • Flexible working hours, hybrid work and EU workations

  • Modern Munich office and equipment

  • Regular team events and off-sites

  • Public transport subsidy and Wellpass

Interested? We look forward to hearing from you.
