title: Privacy & Product Counsel
descriptionHtml:
This role can be office-based in Freiburg, Germany/ San Francisco, USA or remote-first, with a requirement to be in the office one full week per month.

About Black Forest Labs

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.

Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.

Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.


Why This Role

Every FLUX release, API feature and enterprise offering requires legal oversight. Black Forest Labs’ (BFL) frontier technologies raise questions where there is no established precedent – especially as we push further into video, perception and physical AI.

We’re hiring a Privacy & Product Counsel to find solutions and help drive our product teams forward. You’ll sit in our Legal, Policy & Assurance (LPA) team and be embedded with research, product and engineering, shaping how BFL builds and ships.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to build a privacy function at the frontier of AI and robotics.

What You’ll Work On

  • Product counselling. Be the go-to lawyer for product teams on new models, API features and innovative products, from first spec to launch, giving clear, risk-calibrated advice that keeps us shipping.

  • Marketing. Partner with our Growth, Marketing and DevRel teams to review launch announcements, model cards and campaign copy so that our claims about FLUX are accurate. Advise on privacy matters relating to product marketing, analytics, commercial and creator partnerships, and advertising claims.

  • Privacy by design. Own BFL’s GDPR programme across the model lifecycle: training data, fine-tuning, inference, logging and retention. Run point on DPIAs and privacy documentation as required.

  • Customer commitments. Partner with GTM on DPAs, zero-data-retention and no-training terms, security questionnaires and enterprise negotiations – and work with the team to ensure that what we promise matches what we do.

  • International transfers and vendors. Manage EU–US transfer mechanisms (SCCs, the EU–US Data Privacy Framework and TIAs), and run privacy diligence on sub-processors and AI tooling.

  • US privacy. Track and implement obligations under US state privacy laws (CCPA/CPRA and peers) and emerging AI-specific state legislation.

  • Regulatory interface. Prepare BFL for engagement with data protection authorities, and handle data subject requests, complaints and incidents, including breach assessment and notification.

  • Policy and documentation. Draft and maintain privacy notices, internal policies, records of processing and the privacy elements of compliance documentation.

  • Scale the function. Build playbooks, templates and training so the rest of BFL can handle routine privacy questions without you.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5–8 years’ PQE as a qualified lawyer in an EU/EEA jurisdiction or the UK, with a substantial focus on data protection and product counselling

  • Experience at a technology company, in a top-tier law firm’s privacy or tech practice, or both – ideally including time in-house advising product teams directly

  • Deep, practical command of the GDPR (and the German BDSG), the ePrivacy framework and international transfer rules, plus a working knowledge of how other relevant EU regulations, such as the EU AI Act, interact with them

  • Familiarity with US privacy and AI law (CCPA/CPRA, BIPA, and state AI and deepfake statutes)

  • A track record of advising on AI, ML or data-intensive products: you understand training pipelines, inference and feature releases well enough to ask engineers the right questions

  • Comfort giving direct, pragmatic advice under uncertainty – you can turn a novel legal question into a clear recommendation and workable product guidance

  • Strong drafting skills across DPAs, privacy notices, DPIAs and commercial privacy terms

  • Excellent written and spoken English; you can explain complex issues to researchers, executives and regulators alike

  • An ownership mindset and low ego: you’re comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where you build processes, not just follow them

While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience with generative AI, computer vision or media products – particularly involving biometric data, likeness rights or synthetic media

  • Direct experience engaging with data protection authorities or the EU AI Office

  • CIPP/E, CIPT or equivalent certification

  • German language skills

  • An interest in adjacent areas such as security and trust & safety


How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. You’ll be based in Europe or the US and work from your home location, with one week each month spent with us in Freiburg / San Francisco to stay connected with the team.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

Closing

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.


Compensation

EU: €150,000 - €200,000 + equity
US $200,000 - $250,000 USD

Note: We may use AI-assisted tools to help organize applications. All hiring decisions are always made by our team.

title: Product Certification Engineer, Fuel Cell Systems
descriptionHtml:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

descriptionHtml:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

title: Product
descriptionHtml:
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

About the role

We’re looking for a hands-on product expert to collaborate closely with clients and engineers to identify opportunity and figure out what we need to build to accelerate growth and decarbonisation.

What you will be doing

  • Driving product–market fit including in new markets, ensuring customer needs and commercial objectives stay in sync.

  • Championing a customer-first mindset, translating feedback into impactful product solutions.

  • Overseeing end-to-end delivery - from scoping and defining success metrics to launch and iteration.

  • Designing user experiences that are clear, intuitive, and drive measurable impact

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years of product management experience

  • Proven ownership of delivery: you've been responsible for something live in the real world, not only the strategy or concept around it

  • Experience building products that touch the physical world. You respect real-world complexity and design around things going wrong

  • Experience in B2B, B2B2C or data-heavy products, with comfort working across partners and end users

  • User research and discovery: you know how to speak to users and run discovery towards a clear goal

  • You identify pain points and needs, turn them into plans, and ensure delivery.

  • Comfortable with hands-on prototyping and design, at least to the level of high-fidelity concepts

Nice to have

  • Fluency in one or more European languages

What's in it for you

A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary. We operate with a deliberately flat structure. We aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments.

Bupa private healthcare from day one of employment.

Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Take-home exercise

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

title: Product Manager - Core UX
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

📱 Our Product Team

Led by Fabien, our VP Product, Joko's Product team groups the passionate individuals behind our users' delight! From brainstorming to development to launch, the Product team's main mission is to turn ideas into reality by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering, Design, and Business teams.

Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value:

  • Business lines owns the current core value proposition, covering online shopping, in-store experiences, and gift cards, each run as a dedicated team.

  • Scale focuses on growing and amplifying this value through growth, international expansion, and shared core user experiences across the app.

  • Juno builds the next value proposition: an AI shopping assistant that finds the right product at the best price in seconds, backed by a universal catalog of what merchants actually sell.

  • AI Platform helps Joko become a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside, owning the internal agent infrastructure, automation layer, internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security and operational scalability.

🎨 The Core UX task force

Core UX is a task force inside the Scale tribe. It owns the part of Joko that every single user touches, on every platform: navigation, account and login, and the cross-cutting features that make the app work — cash back collection, redeem, favouriting, search, and the map. It also owns the Care experience and, importantly, performance and reliability across the board.

That scope runs across an unusually wide surface area: the mobile app on iOS and Android, the Chrome, Firefox and Safari desktop extensions, the Mobile Safari Extension, and the web app. Every other task force builds on the foundations Core UX lays down. That makes the role high-leverage and demanding in equal measure: a latency regression or a broken login flow here is felt everywhere at once.

The task force is a small, autonomous team: a Product Manager who owns it, a Product Designer, and software engineers.

🎯 What you will do

As Product Manager for the Core UX task force, you own it. That means a slice of Joko's core cross-platform experience end to end, with performance and reliability as a permanent thread. You will report to Damien, who leads the Scale tribe, and work with a Product Designer and software engineers.

  • Core experience ownership: You will own core surfaces — navigation, onboarding and login, cash back collection, search, redeem — from problem framing through spec, delivery, and post-launch monitoring. These are used by millions of people daily, which means small changes carry real weight.

  • Cross-platform trade-offs: Mobile, desktop extensions, Mobile Safari Extension and web app each have their own constraints — iOS restrictions, app store review, browser APIs. You will decide what ships where, what stays consistent, and where platform-specific divergence is worth the cost.

  • Performance & reliability: App latency, silent degradations, and regressions caught too late are a standing part of the mandate. You will define what good looks like, get it monitored, and own reliability as a product feature.

  • Foundations work: A meaningful share of the roadmap is foundational — design systems, codebase consolidation, tooling that makes the whole Product & Engineering org faster. You will make the case for that work in terms of user and business outcomes.

  • Delight & personalization: Core UX also owns whether Joko feels good to use. You will run discovery on the experiences that make people come back, and ship improvements to the moments that matter most.

  • Stakeholder alignment: Because every other task force depends on your surfaces, you will spend real time arbitrating between their needs and the health of the core, and saying no in a way people accept.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products, ideally mobile apps. You have owned a scope end to end and driven your own roadmap.

  • Scale sensibility: You have worked on products with a large user base and you understand what changes when a decision affects millions of people rather than thousands.

  • Craft & UX judgment: You care about how things feel. You can tell a functional experience from a genuinely good one, and you push for the second.

  • Technical fluency: You are comfortable in a technical environment — platform constraints, performance, release mechanics — and you can hold your own with engineers on trade-offs. Coding is not required.

  • Data fluency: You define metrics, instrument them, and use them. You are comfortable digging into numbers yourself to find where an experience is leaking.

  • AI fluency: You are hands-on with AI tools in your own product work. At Joko this is expected daily, across the whole company.

  • Stakeholder leadership: You are good at alignment, prioritization, and making trade-offs explicit when several teams want incompatible things from the same surface.

  • Location: Based in France or Spain.

  • Languages: Fluent in English, both written and spoken. French is a plus, but it is optional.

  • Mindset: You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you love constantly learning and getting better.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €64K – €104K • Offers Equity

title: Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Lupa is building a category defining product the industry has never seen before.

We're the AI-native operating system for veterinary practices and pet parents, replacing the fragmented, clunky systems vets have tolerated for years with a single intelligent platform for scheduling, client communication, clinical documentation, and AI-driven care guidance. Practices run more efficiently, vets get back to doing what they love, and pet parents feel more connected to their animals' health than ever.

The traction speaks for itself: founded in 2023 and already one of Europe's top 100 AI startups, with a team of 50 people, 10x growth in twelve months, the UK market leader, and now charging hard into the US and Europe. We have $25M in funding, 3M+ pets on the platform, and a buzzing HQ in Paddington, London. We've attracted exceptional people from the likes of ElevenLabs, Palantir, Google, DeepMind, BCG, Meta, and AWS and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a rocket ship at exactly the right moment and we're looking for exceptional people to help us fly it.

In this role, you will:

  • Own product areas end-to-end, from zero-to-one discovery through to shipping, measuring, and iterating in production

  • Define and drive the roadmap for your domain, making hard prioritisation calls that balance customer pain, AI capability, and commercial impact

  • Work at the intersection of AI and B2B SaaS. defining how LLM-powered features get embedded into clinical and operational workflows that vets actually use

  • Run tight discovery loops with customers; getting into practices, watching how vets work, and translating messy real-world problems into sharp product decisions

  • Collaborate daily with Engineering and Design to ship fast, without sacrificing quality or coherence

  • Align with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure what you build lands well and drives measurable outcomes

  • Define success metrics for every initiative and hold yourself accountable to them

  • Contribute to how the product team operates, our processes are still forming and you’ll help shape them

Your background looks something like:

  • Solid background as a PM at a SaaS company, ideally one that was building 0–1 products in a fast-moving, resource-constrained environment

  • Experience shipping AI-powered features, you understand what LLMs can and can’t do, and you know how to design around their limitations

  • A track record of owning a roadmap and making difficult trade-offs under real constraints, not just managing a backlog

  • Strong technical fluency, you don’t need to write the code, but you can engage meaningfully in architectural conversations

  • Experience in health-tech, vertical SaaS, or a regulated industry (nice to have)

  • Background at a FAANG company or high-growth VC-backed startup (nice to have)

As a person, you:

  • Get energised by building from scratch, blank-page problems don’t intimidate you, they motivate you

  • Are relentlessly driven by outcomes, not output, shipping a feature means nothing if it doesn’t move the metric

  • Move fast and make decisions with incomplete information, then course-correct quickly when you’re wrong

  • Have a genuine passion for product. you think about it outside of work, and it shows in how you talk about it

  • Are excited to work in-person from our Paddington, London HQ

  • Value working with people who are kind, ambitious, and pragmatic

What does success look like in 6 months?

  • You’ve shipped something meaningful that customers are using and talking about

  • You own your domain with confidence, Engineering, Design, and Go-to-Market trust your judgement and come to you first

  • You’re already influencing the roadmap beyond your immediate area and shaping how the team thinks about AI-native product development

title: Product Manager, Messaging
descriptionHtml:
CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth trusted by more than 1,300 global brands and agencies.

We’re on a mission to make businesses more human, and humans more impactful. We operate by our values — be intentional, pursue excellence every day, embrace the journey together, and be a good human — every day. CreatorIQ has earned the title of best companies to work for in multiple programs, including BuiltIn LA and NY. It’s been named a Fastest-Growing Company in North America on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ for four years, was named a leader in IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Influencer Marketing Platforms for Large Enterprises in 2025, was named a Leader by The Forrester New Wave™: Influencer Marketing Solutions, and has been consistently recognized by G2 as a Leader, and is rated 5 stars on Influencer MarketingHub. We operate in a flexible work model that combines both in-person and remote work to boost collaboration, enhance innovation, and adapt to individual work styles.

We're seeking passionate, innovative minds to join our journey. Be a part of our dynamic team and let's transform the industry together!

Product Manager, Messaging

We’re looking for a Product Manager who wants to own how brands actually talk to creators at scale. This role owns CreatorIQ’s messaging product: the unified inbox and composer that creator marketing teams live in every day, the sending infrastructure underneath it, and the automation and agentic layer we’re building on top. Messaging is where creator relationships are won or lost, and the opportunity is to let AI do the work a manager currently does one message at a time, on infrastructure that can actually carry it.

If you love turning a messy, high-volume communication problem into workflows that marketers trust — and you have the taste to tell when AI-drafted outreach genuinely sounds like the brand versus when it’s impressive-looking slop a creator will ignore — you’ll fit right in. We’re growing fast, building in an evolving AI and agentic landscape, and working with teams around the world who care about doing great work without the ego.

In this role, you'll get to:

  • Take real ownership of the creator messaging experience end to end — inbox, composer, threads, templates — iterating from messy problem to shipped feature. You’ll measure, learn, and do it again.

  • Own the agentic layer of messaging: outreach that drafts itself, sequences that adapt, and automations a marketer can trust to run without watching. You’ll decide what the agent does on its own, what it proposes, and where a human has to sign off.

  • Shape how brand voice and comms style become real product primitives, so automated messaging sounds like the customer instead of like a template — and have the backbone to cut scope when the output isn’t there yet.

  • Partner with engineering on the sending infrastructure all of this rests on: flexible mailbox connectivity (Gmail, Outlook, SMTP, IMAP/POP), isolated per-customer sending environments, dedicated domains and reputation, tracking, and volume throttling.

  • Make deliverability a product feature rather than a support ticket — authentication setup a non-technical user can actually complete, domain warm-up, bounce and unsubscribe handling, and clear in-product answers when a message doesn’t send.

  • Run discovery with real users — creator marketing managers, agency teams, program ops — and turn their workflows, volumes, and frustrations into clear requirements.

  • Look beyond the backlog. Spot opportunities across the messaging and marketing agent roadmap, challenge assumptions, and help shape where the product goes next — including channels past email, like SMS, WhatsApp, and platform DMs.

Who you are and what you'll need for this position:

  • You’ve spent 4+ years in product management (or equivalent technical product ownership) in B2B SaaS — titles matter less than the work.

  • You have a builder’s mindset. You prototype. You’d rather put a rough working thing in front of someone this week than write a document about it for three, and you use AI tools to build that thing yourself.

  • You have genuinely good product taste, specifically for AI output: you can look at generated copy, a prototype, or an agent’s behavior and tell whether it’s good, and you can articulate why.

  • You either understand email deliverability — SPF/DKIM/DMARC, domain and IP reputation, warm-up, bounce and complaint handling — or you’ll go deep on it fast.

  • You’re comfortable with how modern AI features work in practice: prompting, context, evaluation, confidence, human-in-the-loop review, and where an agent should and shouldn’t be allowed to act alone.

  • You’re technical enough to hold your own on infrastructure conversations — APIs, data models, queues, third-party integrations — and to recognize when a “small” request is actually touching something big.

  • You can map workflows fast, write clear requirements, and explain your thinking without needing a meeting to do it.

  • You’re curious, self-driven, low-ego, and allergic to “that’s not my job.”

  • Comfortable working with distributed teams. Most work is async and flexible, but occasionally we’ll ask for a later call.

Nice to have:

  • Experience shipping email or messaging software — marketing automation, sales engagement, CRM, or an ESP.

  • Familiarity with AWS SES or comparable sending infrastructure, and with mailbox integrations (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, SMTP/IMAP).

  • Experience with responsive email HTML, template systems, or WYSIWYG editors.

  • Experience with SMS/MMS, WhatsApp Business, or social DM integrations, including the consent and compliance requirements that come with them.

  • Familiarity with customer-facing APIs, webhooks, or enterprise integrations.

  • Experience with influencer marketing, creator workflows, or martech.

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Have 50% of the criteria? Excited about this opportunity? Passionate about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply! CreatorIQ is a place where everyone can grow.

What you will get from us:
* People: work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do.

  • Guidance: utilize our learning platform to fully get the training and tools you’ll need to become successful here from your first day with us.

  • Surprise meal stipends: work from home can’t stop the enjoyment of someone else making a meal for you!

  • Work/life harmony: 26 days vacation, floating and set holidays, wellness allowance, and paid parental leave.

  • Medical insurance, life insurance, and business travel insurance

  • Stock options as part of our equity-sharing program.

  • Comprehensive perks program providing stipends for cell phone and internet, home office setup, mental wellness, professional development and tuition reimbursement, plus occasional company-funded meal opportunities throughout the year.

Compensation, benefits, and beyond:

We understand that a comprehensive benefits package plays a significant role in your overall compensation. To gain more insight into the various components of our total compensation, we invite you to review our benefits and perks.

AI Transparency Notice

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications and note taking during interviews. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please refer to our Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Product Manager at Harmattan AI, you will be at the heart of company strategy, as you will be in charge of product specification and roadmap based on market and technological analysis, as well as full scale development and industrialization of the product. You will be responsible for managing timelines, resources, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure market fit and successful delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Product Definition: Define product specification based on customer feedback, market analysis and technology; iterate and validate for technical, industrial and commercial feasibility.

  • Project Management: Develop, maintain, and update project timelines, ensuring all deadlines are met during the whole lifecycle of the product.

  • Technical Coordination: Oversee the architecture and the technical development of the system across R&D and industrialization phases, resolving challenges as they arise.

  • Team Leadership: Inspire and manage the project team to maintain a high level of performance and quality.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as the key interface between technical teams, the product team, and other stakeholders (especially customers, sales, marketing and program) to align efforts and ensure tenders and projects success.

  • Resource Allocation: Manage the allocation of engineering and other resources to meet project goals effectively.

Candidate Requirements

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, with at least 8 years of experience in technical roles.

title: Product Owner Data (Technico-Fonctionnel) H/F
descriptionHtml:
Lieu : Nantes sud (44)

Salaire : 50 K€ annuel brut

Rythme : 1 journée de télétravail par semaine

Nous recherchons pour notre client, un Product Owner Data Technico-Fonctionnel (H/F) dans le cadre d'une création de poste en CDI.

VOS MISSIONS :

Rattaché(e) directement à la Direction des Systèmes d’Information, vous intégrez une DSI à taille humaine pour piloter la vision, la roadmap et la gouvernance Data de notre client.

Vos missions sont les suivantes :

Pilotage stratégique et orientation de la roadmap data

  • Piloter la trajectoire produit : Concevoir, ajuster et prioriser la feuille de route des différents actifs et de la plateforme data en fonction de la valeur métier apportée.
  • Gérer le cycle de vie de la plateforme : Animer et séquencer les différents chantiers d'évolution et de structuration de l'écosystème data, incluant son volet gouvernance.
  • Cadrer les besoins métiers : Écouter, qualifier et hiérarchiser les demandes émanant des différentes entités de l'entreprise (réseau, animation, marketing, finance et support).

Centralisation des données et unification des référentiels

  • Orchestrer le DataHub relationnel : Garantir la fiabilité du golden record (conseillers et clients), piloter l'identifiant pivot et centraliser la gestion des flux de leads entrants.
  • Alimenter l'écosystème CRM 360° : Centraliser l'historique des interactions et veiller au respect des niveaux de confidentialité pour les équipes du siège.
  • formaliser les contrats de données : Négocier et rédiger les data contracts avec les équipes en charge des applications et les éditeurs tiers.

Déploiement d'une gouvernance des données robuste

  • Instaurer le catalogue de données : Mettre en œuvre et administrer le référentiel documenté, clarifier les définitions métier et identifier les data owners.
  • Assurer la qualité des données : Définir et surveiller des indicateurs de contrôle stricts (fraîcheur, taux de complétude, déduplication).
  • Veiller à la conformité réglementaire : Travailler main dans la main avec le DPO pour appliquer le RGPD (politiques de rétention, automatisation des purges, tenue du registre).

Conception et mise en valeur des produits data

  • Industrialiser les flux : Concevoir les pipelines de données et superviser l'alimentation continue du datalake.
  • Moderniser la BI : Rationaliser et repenser les outils de reporting existants pour concevoir des tableaux de bord pertinents destinés au siège et au réseau.
  • Piloter la performance : Valider et certifier les indicateurs clés de pilotage, y compris ceux mesurant l'avancement de la trajectoire DSI.
  • Soutenir l'innovation IA : Préparer et structurer les jeux de données nécessaires aux cas d'usage portés par l'équipe IA Factory.

Pilotage du delivery et animation agile

  • Spécifier les besoins : Rédiger les user stories orientées data, formaliser les spécifications techniques de flux et définir les critères de recette.
  • Animer les rituels de livraison : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les data engineers et les intégrateurs, rythmer les cérémonies agiles et valider les mises en production.
  • Favoriser l'appropriation : Assurer la montée en compétences des utilisateurs finaux et encourager l'autonomie à travers des usages en self-service.

ENVIRONNEMENT TECHNIQUE :

Data & Gouvernance : Mise en place d’une plateforme Data moderne, gouvernance, qualité et observabilité des données.

Compétences techniques : SQL | Data : Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, ClickHouse, Metabase, DataHub.

Connaissance du RGPD et de son application aux données personnelles.

VOUS :

De formation supérieure au minimum Bac+5 types ingénieur ou commerce, vous justifiez d’au moins 6 années d’expérience dont 3 ans en tant de Product Owner ou Chef de Projet Data.

Au cours de votre parcours, vous avez déjà contribué activement au déploiement d'une plateforme data moderne ainsi qu'à la mise en place d'une démarche de gouvernance globale (incluant le catalogue, le datahub, la qualité et l'observabilité). Sur le plan technique, vous maîtrisez parfaitement le SQL et comprenez les technologies modernes de la data telles qu'Airflow, dbt, les entrepôts analytiques (Snowflake, ClickHouse), les outils de BI (Metabase) et de catalogage (DataHub).

Nous recherchons une personne rigoureuse et soucieuse de la qualité des livrables, sans jamais perdre de vue l'usage final pour les utilisateurs. Vous faites preuve d'une excellente capacité d'analyse pour traduire des besoins métiers parfois flous en indicateurs clairs, précis et partagés. Doté(e) d'un sens de la pédagogie, vous savez évangéliser et diffuser la culture de la donnée auprès des équipes. Enfin, votre diplomatie vous permet d'aligner facilement plusieurs directions autour d'une vision et d'une définition communes.

PROCESS :

Après un premier échange en visio avec un membre de notre équipe, vous rencontrerez :

  • Le Responsable des Systèmes d’information en visio
  • Puis un entretien final sur site avec la direction

Une décision rapide est prise à l’issue des entretiens.

title: Product Owner Hardware (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
What We're Building Towards

At Omegga, we're on a mission to reinvent how AI and spectroscopy can drive positive change for animals, people and the planet. We started with a clear objective: eliminate chick culling on a global scale through early, non-invasive detection. This outdated practice still impacts billions of lives, and we're here to change that. We're not building for the niche, we're building for the global standard.

Today, our systems are already in use, and the focus is on scaling performance, robustness, and deployment across an international customer base. For us, scaling means more than growth. It means changing an industry for the better.

We are looking for people who take ownership, think in systems, and want to help turn a working product into the industry benchmark. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a Technical Project Manager who runs our hardware development projects end to end and holds the thread between our engineers, our external partners, and our leadership. Our system combines optics, mechanics, electronics, and embedded control with machine learning on top. Most of what you manage is hardware, but every hardware decision touches software and data science, and you make sure those pieces move together.

Development happens in-house, but parts of it are outsourced to production partners and component suppliers. You keep those external work packages aligned with our internal timelines, specifications, and quality standards. Our Sales Engineering team owns the customer relationship; you make sure their requirements turn into delivered systems.

You take ownership end to end, hold yourself to a high standard, and focus on outcomes that matter for the customer. You communicate openly, give honest feedback, and build trust through your actions.

What You'll Build

  • Own the plan for our hardware development projects, from concept and prototypes to release for series production

  • Keep hardware, software, and data science development in sync: interfaces, test campaigns, integration milestones, and releases

  • Prioritize the integration backlog together with our tech leads and align it with customer commitments

  • Manage the outsourced parts of our development with production partners and component suppliers: scope, specifications, timelines, and quality

  • Integrate partner timelines into the overall project plan and resolve conflicts before they become blockers

  • Plan and coordinate system deployments together with Sales Engineering: installation scheduling, spare parts, and incident handling

  • Plan and monitor project budgets, track risks, and initiate corrective measures early

  • Deliver clear, regular reporting on milestones, trial outcomes, and project status to leadership

What You Bring

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in technical project management in a hardware development environment: machinery, medtech, robotics, optics, or comparable

  • Solid understanding of hardware development, from prototyping to release for small series production

  • Experience coordinating outsourced development work with manufacturers or key suppliers

  • Enough understanding of software and data science to spot dependencies to the hardware and plan integration realistically

  • Experience with project budgets and risk tracking

  • Strong communication skills: you naturally become the connective tissue between engineers, partners, and leadership

  • A structured, hands-on working style and an affinity for using AI tools in your daily workflow

  • Fluent English. Fluent German is a strong plus for working with our partners and suppliers

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to our partners

  • Nice to have: experience with embedded systems, optics, or agile product ownership

Not ticking every box? That's okay. If this role excites you and you bring most of what we've described, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Get

Mission & Technical Challenge: At Omegga, you work on problems that are both technically demanding and globally relevant. We build deep-tech solutions with real-world impact, pushing the boundaries of what's currently possible.

Relocation Support: Moving to Munich? We are part of the WERK1 incubation program, which gives us access to apartments in the Werksviertel that never hit the open market. With enough lead time we reserve one for you before you arrive, minutes on foot from the office.

Work Environment: Located in Munich's Werksviertel, we combine a focused, high-performance culture with flexibility. Up to 50% remote work, depending on role and execution needs.

Ownership: VSOPs (Virtual Stock Options) so you share in the value you help create.

Time Off: 28 vacation days per year, plus December 24th and 31st off.

Benefits & Growth

  • Monthly meal budget for whatever keeps you going, from quick lunches to proper team dinners

  • Monthly perks budget to spend where it actually matters to you — fitness, mobility, or the occasional "I earned this" purchase

  • Annual learning budget to invest in your growth, from conferences to deep dives into new domains

  • Free drinks, coffee, and snacks in the office to keep you focused throughout the day

title: Product & Regulatory Counsel
descriptionHtml:
Tired of meeting the product at the terms and conditions stage?

Most product lawyers see the flow once it's built and the launch date is set. Here, you're on the whiteboard at ideation, so compliant by design is the plan, not the clean-up.

And the stakes are real. Taptap Send moves billions of dollars every month across 100 countries, and is now building wallets, cards and broader financial products for diaspora communities.

The job

You'll advise on new licensing and products from first idea to go-live, and own regulator engagement across our markets.

  • Shape products before they're built: review designs, UX, flows and terms against regulatory and customer-outcome rules, Consumer Duty included, while change is still cheap.

  • Turn regulation into decisions: what's mandatory, what's prudent, and the alternative route that still gets it launched.

  • Own the regulator relationship: across our markets, including new ones, and flag what regulatory change means for the roadmap early.

  • Take products to new countries: localise what already works, with country leads and local counsel.

  • Build the playbooks: templates that let Legal scale without adding friction.

Why you'll want it

Spend your time on the hard questions. You're asked to shape our roadmap and launches, and understand how to fit them to the relevant regimes

Be a peer, with room to run. You'll join a flat team of regulatory and commercial lawyers, with real autonomy and a manager who trusts you.

Make launches faster, not slower. Legal in the room from day one is how products here ship sooner. That's the whole point of your seat.

Make sending money home cheaper. Remittances pay for school fees, rent and medical bills, and are worth more than all foreign aid combined. Cheaper, reliable transfers put more of that money in families' hands.

Is this you?

You're a qualified lawyer (UK or equivalent) with 4+ years' PQE in payments, e-money or financial services regulation, at a firm, a regulator or a fintech.

You've advised payments or e-money firms under the FCA or an equivalent regime, dealt with the regulator directly, and helped product teams take live launches over the line.

You give the answer first and the reasoning second. Ambiguity across several jurisdictions doesn't stop you making the call.

If you'd rather be asked first than asked last, apply. Missing a box or two? Send your CV anyway.

title: Project Manager, Media Analytics
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

3524 - Project Manager, Media - UK

Role Summary and Impact

Google via Media Futures Group - A little about us:  

Google has consolidated its media agency partnership into WPP Media, building on the world class digital work that EssenceMediacom has delivered for Google for over 15 years. Media Futures Group (MFG) is a bespoke team that delivers on our commitment to Google for a more strategic, creative and integrated media approach established to drive better  business results.  

The MFG team is made up of best in class digital, offline, and integrated media experts who work together to enhance media’s contribution to Google’s business. MFG is powered by EssenceMediaCom and other constituent parts of GroupM around the world. The MFG team operates in a seamlessly integrated way across strategy, planning, investment, creative, business sciences and analytics, data and technology. The profile of people who work in MFG are world class, committed to establishing a new high water mark in the media industry.  

The convergence of expertise and excellence makes MFG the most progressive and exciting team in advertising and media, globally. The characteristics of successful MFG team members are that they are highly collaborative, intellectually curious and constantly reach for excellence.  

MFG is committed to the growth of our people as a means to unleash the potential of Google’s business. We are invested in whole-person wellbeing, values and behaviors that feeling included and supported. This is a team empowered by limitless possibilities.

About the role

The Analytics Operations Manager focuses on organisational needs and works closely with the leadership team to multiply their impact. This role provides direct support to the Campaign Analytics & Core Solutions teams and is responsible for cross-practice facilitation.

When operating effectively in the role, this individual assists practice leads in decision-making, program management, and initiative implementation. They will develop new processes and optimize areas of existing processes to improve productivity, efficiency, and scalability. All of this is underpinned by accountability of delivery for our clients and the responsibility of ensuring projects and programs are delivered on time.

In addition to program responsibilities, the Manager will intake, understand requirements and scope for new projects if required. 

Some of the things we’d like you to do:

  • Oversee daily operations through collaboration with Analytics leadership across regions
  • Responsible oversight of Analytics Operations including creation and delivery of global client reports
  • Oversees campaign analytics deliverables across product area teams to ensure adherence to stated processes, timelines and delivery requirements necessary meet contractual obligations
  • Understand, communicate, and remove project roadblocks
  • Develop and document new processes to drive efficiency, organization, prioritization and quality and timely delivery (including but not limited to timeline templates and processes for Quality Assurance)
  • Continue to optimize processes based on changing team and client needs
  • Interface heavily with internal stakeholders to assure that processes, timelines and delivery  requirements are understood
  • Partner with Senior Analytics leadership to escalate out of scope requests to ensure timely resolution
  • Coordinate and lead project meetings, internal & client facing as needed
  • Build and develop relationships with our internal team and client stakeholders

A bit about yourself:

  • Experience as a producer or project manager, ideally in a digital media agency or agency environment
  • Excellent and proactive communication & clear articulation of needs/requirements
  • Comfortable overseeing delivery while balancing the needs of the team with client expectations
  • Proactive and skilled at anticipating project stall-points and dependency chains
  • A creative and strategic thinker with an impeccable attention to detail and problem solving skills
  • Ability to handle competing priorities in order to meet competing deadlines
  • Experience documenting requirements

The right candidate can build relationships, show and earn respect, and will contribute to the team culture in an energetic and forward thinking way.

Some nice-to-have qualities:

  • Experience and understanding of digital media including, social, search, app and programmatic
  • Lots of experience with Google’s suite of office management tools (Gmail, Sheets, Slides, Drive, Meet & Chat, etc.)
  • Some program management experience
  • Some media experience
  • Formal PM qualifications e.g. Agile, PMP, Scrum

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.  

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.  Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country. 

Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location

title: Projektingenieur Entwicklung (m/w/x) – Teilprojektleitung Prototypen und Prüftechnik
descriptionHtml:
Die Alveon MedTech GmbH ist ein innovatives Medizintechnik-Startup mit Sitz in Ostfildern bei Stuttgart. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung medizinischer Inhalationssysteme. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2020 haben wir erfolgreich eine patentgeschützte Basistechnologie entwickelt. Aktuell arbeiten wir – im Rahmen einer strategischen Partnerschaft mit einem der größten deutschen Unternehmen im Medizinalcannabis-Markt – an der Entwicklung und Zulassung des ersten dosierfähigen Cannabis-Inhalators für den europäischen Markt.

Jetzt steht die entscheidende Phase an: Prototypen, Versuche, Verifikation und Zulassung. Dafür erweitern wir unsere Prüfkapazitäten in Ostfildern und bei externen Partnern und suchen jemanden, der diesen Bereich verantwortet.

Als Projektingenieur Entwicklung und Prüftechnik übernimmst du abgegrenzte Entwicklungsbereiche mit voller Ergebnisverantwortung — von der Konzeption über Versuch und Prototyp bis zum belastbaren Nachweis. Du bekommst Ziele, keine Arbeitsanweisungen.

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem CTO und Projektleiter zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass zum jeweiligen Meilenstein die richtigen Prototypen bereitstehen — und koordinierst dafür Kolleginnen, Kollegen und externe Partner.

Aufgaben

Eigenverantwortliche Arbeitspakete:

  • Konzeption und Umsetzung abgegrenzter Entwicklungsthemen

  • Festlegung von Vorgehen, Umfang und Abbruchkriterien

  • Abstimmung mit QM/Regulatory und externen Partnern

  • Terminverantwortung für die Bereitstellung von Versuchsaufbauten, Prototypen und Mustern

Schwerpunkt: Versuch, Prüfaufbau und Labor

  • Aufbau, Inbetriebnahme und Weiterentwicklung von Prüfvorrichtungen, Messplätzen und Versuchsständen

  • Planung, Durchführung und Auswertung von Entwicklungs- und Verifikationsversuchen, unter anderem zu Verdampfungsleistung, Dosiergenauigkeit, Temperaturverhalten, Dichtheit und Lebensdauer

  • Aufbau und Betreuung der Messtechnik inklusive Kalibrierung und Prüfmittelverwaltung

  • Vorbereitung, Begleitung und Auswertung von Prüfkampagnen bei externen Laboren und Hochschulen

  • Erstellung von Versuchsplänen, Versuchsprotokollen, Prüf- und Entwicklungsberichten

Ergänzend: Konstruktion und Prototyping

  • Konstruktion von Vorrichtungen, Adaptern und Bauteilen im CAD

  • Prototyping mittels 3D-Druck sowie Aufbau, Kennzeichnung und Rückverfolgbarkeit von Mustern

  • Technische Bewertung von Bauteilen und Werkstoffen aus Keramik, Spritzguss und Silikon

  • Zuarbeit zur technischen Dokumentation gemäß MDR und ISO 13485

Qualifikation

Damit du in dieser Position erfolgreich bist, solltest du Folgendes mitbringen:

  • Abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (z. B. Maschinenbau, Medizintechnik, Verfahrenstechnik, Physik) oder Technikerabschluss mit einschlägiger Erfahrung

  • Mind. 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im technischen Entwicklungsumfeld, davon mehrere Jahre in eigenverantwortlicher Rolle

  • Die Fähigkeit, pragmatisch zu entscheiden, wie weit eine Lösung gehen muss — und das zu begründen

  • Sicheres, repräsentatives Auftreten gegenüber Lieferanten, Prüflaboren und Hochschulen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Messtechnik sowie mit der Auswertung und Darstellung von Versuchsdaten

  • Sorgfältige, nachvollziehbare Dokumentation deiner Arbeit

  • Hohe Eigenmotivation, Selbststrukturierung und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe, analytisches Denken und die Bereitschaft, dich tief in technische und regulatorische Themen einzuarbeiten

  • Bereitschaft zur Arbeit vor Ort in Ostfildern sowie zu gelegentlichen Einsätzen bei Partnern und Prüflaboren

  • Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität: du baust auf, misst und packst selbst an

  • Praktische Erfahrung im CAD, etwa mit SolidWorks, Creo oder Fusion 360

  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher, Englisch sicher in Wort und Schrift

Besonders von Vorteil sind:

  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung medizinischer Geräte unter EU-MDR

  • Kenntnisse der Qualitätsnormen ISO 9001 und ISO 13485

  • Erfahrung mit Aerosolen, Inhalation, Thermodynamik oder Strömungstechnik

  • Kenntnisse in statistischer Versuchsplanung und Auswertung, etwa Python, Minitab oder R

Benefits

Was wir bieten:

  • Ein Produkt, das in den nächsten Jahren durch die Zulassung geht — deine Versuchsergebnisse entscheiden mit darüber, ob es funktioniert

  • Eigene Verantwortungsbereiche mit Entscheidungsspielraum — und die Perspektive, daraus Teilprojektleitung zu machen

  • Arbeiten auf Augenhöhe in einem kleinen, vielseitigen Engineeringteam

  • Schnelle Übernahme von Verantwortung, hoher Gestaltungsspielraum und direkter Einfluss auf den Produkterfolg

  • Kurze Wege: Entwicklung, Labor und Prototypenbau an einem Standort statt verteilter Abstimmungsschleifen

  • Ein Team, das KI-Werkzeuge nicht diskutiert, sondern baut

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 30 Tage Urlaub, unbefristete Vollzeitanstellung

  • Mobiles Arbeiten für Auswerte- und Dokumentationstage nach Absprache

Gestalte mit Alveon MedTech die Zukunft der Medizintechnik im Bereich der Inhalation. Wenn du Lust hast, ein Gerät nicht nur zu rechnen, sondern es zu bauen, zu messen und zum Funktionieren zu bringen, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung — gerne formlos mit Lebenslauf und einem kurzen Wort dazu, warum diese Rolle zu dir passt. Zeugnisse brauchen wir erst später.

title: Propulsion Functional Engineer
descriptionHtml:

    • Contribute to architecture trade-off studies, sensitivity analyses, and risk assessments, as well as component selection and make-or-buy decisions

    • Contribute to the evaluation and optimization of the engine architecture and operating conditions

    • Develop and maintain functional performance models of the propulsion system using simulation frameworks such as EcosimPro and Python

  • Systems Engineering

    • Contribute to the definition and allocation of functional requirements for the engine and its subsystems

    • Contribute to FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) to ensure that the system architecture meets reliability and safety targets

  • Testing & Model Validation

    • Contribute to the definition of demonstrator architectures and operating conditions

    • Analyse test data and use test results to validate and anchor system models


What we would love to see from you

  • Master's Degree or higher (or NZ and AUS "Bachelor with honors") in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related and applicable technical discipline. Alternatively, a bachelor's degree with substantial relevant experience

  • Minimum 2 years of proven experience working with cryogenic propulsion systems

  • Strong knowledge of fluid dynamics and thermodynamics

  • Fluency in English; proficiency in German or French are an asset

  • Basic knowledge of aerospace standards (e.g. ECSS, NASA guidelines)

  • Experience with modelling and simulation tools (e.g. EcosimPro) and/or experience writing scripts in Python

  • (Optional) Hands-on experience developing hardware from concept to working prototypes is an asset

Skills and Behaviors

  • Strong ability to work in close collaboration with others

  • Strong oral and written communication skills

  • Strong analysis and problem-solving skills

  • Strong research skills and ability to infer useful information from partial or even contradictory sources

  • Drive towards excellence coupled with ability to work within time constraints

  • Proficiency in organization and prioritization of tasks

  • Behavior consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork

  • Enthusiasm for space exploration: be ready to have an impact on the future global space industry.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?

title: QA Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the role

At YoungOnes, you make sure our platform delivers on its promise: stable, reliable and free of surprises for the people who use it every day. As a QA Engineer you don't work at the end of the chain, but right in the middle of our development teams. You think along before any code is written, test smartly where it matters, and act as the bridge between development, product and the rest of the company when it comes to quality. You report to the Teamlead Frontend and work daily with the frontend, mobile and backend teams.

What you'll do

  • Think along from the start. You join refinements and help teams see the risks and impact of a feature before they start building;

  • Choose the right test approach. Together with the team, you decide per feature what to test automatically, what to test manually, and why;

  • Build and maintain automated tests. You set up tests for key platform functionality and keep them reliable;

  • Manual and exploratory testing. You go through the app yourself, look for edge cases and find what a script misses;

  • Central point of contact for bugs. Bug reports from across the company come to you. You reproduce them, gather all the information a developer needs to get started, and get them ready in Jira with the right priority;

  • Advise on releases. You map out risks and give clear advice on the quality of a release;

  • Provide insight. You collect test data and show how our software quality is doing;

  • Keep the balance. You help teams weigh fixing bugs against building new features.

What you bring

  • A bachelor's level of working and thinking, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field;

  • At least 2 years of work experience, including at least 1 year as a QA Engineer, Software Tester or Test Automation Engineer;

  • Experience setting up and carrying out a test approach and test plans;

  • Experience with test automation and test frameworks;

  • You're comfortable working with AI tools and use them purposefully: to test faster and better, and to set up automated tests;

  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum team and with a bug tracking system, preferably Jira.

  • You work independently, make decisions in your own work and give advice, whether asked or not;

  • You're critical and analytical, take initiative and work well with developers, product and business.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript and you're comfortable working with code;

  • You look beyond "does it work?": also at accessibility, speed, security and multilingual support.

  • Experience with tests that run automatically on every code change, and you know how to deal with unreliable tests;

  • You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping colleagues test better;

  • Experience testing mobile apps.

We're looking for someone who sees quality as something the whole team owns. You don't just perfect your own testing work; you ask yourself what needs to change structurally so the whole team tests better. Our own values guide the way: Own it, Say it, Make it.

What we offer

  • We prioritize mental well-being in collaboration with our partner OpenUp;

We trade crypto derivatives and spot markets across global venues, 24/7. Our traders don't just watch the systems. They own them end-to-end.

About BlockTech

BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets.

Our traders work side by side with quantitative researchers and engineers. Research, engineering, and trading happen a few meters apart, so the path from a market read to live PnL is short.

What will you do?

You'll own the systems that trade our capital, from day-to-day operation to the strategies that come next. As a senior trader, you'll also use what you've learned elsewhere to shape where the desk goes.

You will:

  • Own the systems. Monitor, operate, and tune our automated trading systems in live markets.

  • Manage the risk. Manage positions and risk, adjusting pricing and parameters as market behaviour shifts.

  • Set new directions. Bring new ideas to the desk, drawing on your previous experience.

  • Build new strategies. Develop and deploy new strategies together with quantitative researchers and engineers.

  • Spot what’s next. Identify and research new business opportunities as markets change.

What we're looking for

You'll need:

  • A strong academic background in a quantitative field such as mathematics, physics, statistics, or computer science.

  • 3+ years of quantitative trading experience.

  • Proficiency in Python, with excellent numerical and algorithmic skills.

  • Focus and sound judgment behind the screen when markets get busy.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience at a proprietary trading firm or hedge fund, particularly with mid-frequency strategies, prediction markets or DeFi.

You don't need: crypto experience. If you've successfully traded derivatives on other asset classes and want to bring that experience to BlockTech, we want to hear from you.

Pay, location, and relocation

  • Compensation: a competitive base salary plus a very attractive performance bonus based on individual and company results.

  • Trading fund: strong performers get the opportunity to buy into the trading fund.

  • Location: On-site on our trading floor in Amsterdam

  • Visa: BlockTech sponsors the Dutch highly skilled migrant visa.

  • Relocation: All-in relocation package and Dutch classes for international hires. Eligible hires may qualify for the 30% ruling.

What else is in it for you

  • Pension plan, company laptop, and home internet reimbursement

  • An extensive in-house training program and an annual learning and development budget

  • An environment that embraces AI, both to speed up your work and to advance our systems

  • Gym reimbursement and sports during working hours: kickboxing, CrossFit, fitness, and soccer

  • Weekly Friday drinks, monthly outings, quarterly sports competitions, and two trips abroad a year

  • Daily breakfast and warm lunch, plus snacks and drinks all day

How we work

We're a team of trading and tech enthusiasts with a flat hierarchy. Have an idea today, and it can ship tomorrow. The best idea wins, whoever it comes from.

This role comes with a high degree of autonomy. You'll own hard problems from concept to production and solve them your way. We promote reverse leadership, give everyone an equal playing field, and invest in personal and professional development.

Our culture

At our core, we are a team of passionate trading and tech enthusiasts committed to revolutionizing trading through automation. Our collaborative approach ensures that everyone contributes to achieving our ambitious goals.

In this role, you will be both challenged and stretched, with ample opportunities for growth and development, both within and beyond your main responsibilities.

We invest in our people by offering competitive compensation and benefits, fostering innovation, and celebrating success. Our commitment to personal development transcends traditional norms; we provide an equal playing field, promote reverse leadership, and offer boundless growth opportunities for all our employees.

Join us to unlock your potential and drive innovation in the exciting world of algorithmic trading.
