title: Quantum Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include a very energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Description of the Project

We are looking for a Quantum Software Engineer to develop the future software stack for controlling utility-scale quantum computers. At the interface of the theory and engineering teams, this ambitious project aims to develop internal tools to streamline the operation of logical quantum circuits on Quandela’s spin-photonic quantum computers.

This position requires a strong understanding of quantum computing protocols on real hardware, strong software engineering skills and proficiency with AI tools.

Your Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop a new compilation stack translating high-level quantum circuits into hardware-aware pulse schedules optimized for our photonic quantum computers.
  • Drive long-term architectural strategy, technical roadmap, and cross-organizational alignment.
  • Contribute to the development of a digital twin, receiving hardware instructions to simulate the behavior of our future QPUs.
  • Stay up to date with the latest developments in quantum software.

How You’ll Grow:

  • 3 months. By the end of the first quarter, you are expected to have a grasp over Quandela’s roadmap and specific approach to quantum computing. You understand how user operations are currently compiled to machine instructions and how that is expected to evolve
  • 6 months. By the end of the first semester, you have a firm understanding of Quandela’s technology and are already a key contributor to the compiler codebase for the near future
  • 12 months. You have a long-term vision over the quantum software’s activities, and are the owner of one or more work packages for strategic projects.

Requirements

What we're looking for:

  • Master’s, or PhD in Quantum related field.
  • 2/4+ years of relevant experience in quantum software, quantum hardware automation, or related topics.

Must-have:

  • A good understanding of photonic-based quantum computing.
  • Strong proficiency in python.
  • Experience working at the interface of software, experimental hardware, and theory teams in the industry or academia.
  • Collaborative mindset, able to serve as a bridge between various teams.

Important, but you can grow here:

  • Proficiency in at least one system language (C++ or Rust)
  • Exposure to the quantum computing frontends and related ecosystem (e.g. cirq, qiskit, openqasm, cuda-q).
  • Hands-on experience with quantum photonic systems.
  • Familiarity with compilation mechanisms such as LLVM or compilation to microcode.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3-4 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris or 1 to 2 days remotely)
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45')
  • Hiring Managers Interview (45')
  • Use Case (a live use case or one to be prepared at home and presented afterward)
  • Meeting with the teams
  • 2 to 3 reference check
  • Offer

(This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles)

At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome.

title: Recruiting Operations Manager, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

The EMEA Recruiting Operations Manager keeps hiring running smoothly across EMEA. You'll take on complex, loosely defined operational work, then turn it into automated processes that the coordination team can run and maintain on their own. You'll also help lead bigger AI implementation projects, partnering with Harvey's analytics and AI teams while doing much of the hands-on work in EMEA yourself.


What You'll Do

  • Execute tier 2 operational work in EMEA: the complex, poorly defined processes that don't fit a standard playbook.

  • Automate that work so it runs on its own, then document it and hand it off to the coordination team to maintain.

  • Work on larger AI implementation projects, partnering with analytics and AI colleagues.

  • Keep the lights on in EMEA, owning day-to-day recruiting operations for the region.


What You Have

  • 4+ years in recruiting operations, people operations, or a similar operational role in a fast-growing company.

  • A track record of taking messy, undefined processes and making them clear, repeatable, and reliable.

  • Hands-on automation experience, including AI or workflow tools, and the discipline to hand work off so others can maintain it.

  • Experience supporting hiring across EMEA markets.

  • Strong cross-functional skills: you can partner with analytics and AI teams and explain trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias for action.

  • Nice to have: experience with an ATS such as Ashby.

title: Referent (w/m/d) Vertriebssteuerung und -strategie
descriptionHtml:
Über die Nord-Ostsee Sparkasse

Wie schön, dass du dich für uns als Arbeitgeber interessierst. Wir sind eine der größten Sparkassen Deutschlands mit 40 Filialen und einer Bilanzsumme von über 8 Mrd. Euro. Als Marktführerin in unserer Region engagieren wir uns für vielfältige gesellschaftliche Projekte und wurden mehrfach als beliebteste Bank ausgezeichnet. Doch was uns vor allem antreibt, sind die Zufriedenheit unserer 270.000 Kundinnen und Kunden und das Wohlbefinden unserer über 800 Mitarbeitenden. Bei uns erwarten dich Teamwork, interessante Jobprofile, vielfältige Entwicklungswege und ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einer der schönsten Regionen Deutschlands. Du hast Lust uns kennenzulernen? Dann bewirb dich jetzt. Wir sind mehr als nur ein Arbeitgeber. Wir sind Sparkasse.


Deine Mission:

Du möchtest nicht nur Zahlen analysieren, sondern daraus konkrete Impulse für den Vertrieb ableiten? Du interessierst dich dafür, wie aus der Unternehmensstrategie konkrete Ziele für Produkte, Kundensegmente und Vertriebseinheiten entstehen?

Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

In dieser verantwortungsvollen Position verbindest du strategisches Denken mit operativer Umsetzung und entwickelst den Vertrieb zukunftsorientiert weiter. Du hast Markt und Kund:innen im Blick, erkennst Chancen frühzeitig und sorgst dafür, dass aus strategischen Ideen konkrete Maßnahmen werden.

Folgende Aufgaben warten auf dich:

Du entwickelst die strategische sowie operative Produkt- und Geschäftsfeldplanung auf Basis der Unternehmensplanung und übersetzt strategische Zielsetzungen in konkrete Ziele.

Du entwickelst Vertriebsstrategien kontinuierlich weiter und setzt neue Impulse – auf Basis der Geschäftsstrategie sowie aktueller und zukünftiger Marktentwicklungen.

Du leitest daraus Zielgruppen-, Produkt- und Kommunikationsstrategien ab und entwickelst passende Ansätze für unsere Marktbearbeitung.

Du übersetzt interne und externe Anforderungen in eine ganzheitliche, omnikanale Vertriebsstrategie und sorgst dafür, dass diese in der Praxis ankommt.

Du hast unsere Vertriebsziele im Blick und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den relevanten Bereichen aussagekräftige KPIs und Messgrößen, mit denen der Vertrieb gezielt gesteuert und weiterentwickelt wird.

Du bringst den Vertrieb operativ weiter und übernimmst die verantwortliche Planung und Umsetzung vertrieblicher Projekte.

Als Schnittstelle zu Verbänden, externen Partnern und weiteren Stakeholdern arbeitest du an zentralen Umsetzungsthemen mit.

Du führst Markt-, Abweichungs- und Ursachenanalysen durch und interpretierst die Ergebnisse und entwickelst konkrete, passgenaue Maßnahmen für das Haus.

Deine Fähigkeiten:

Du zeichnest dich durch eine analytische, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus – vor allem aber hast du Freude daran, komplexe Zusammenhänge zu durchdringen und auf den Punkt zu bringen.

einem erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Studium als Sparkassen-/Bankbetriebswirt/in oder Bachelor mit mehrjähriger Erfahrung im Vertriebsmanagement oder -controlling oder einer vergleichbaren Funktion.

einem sehr guten Verständnis für betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und die Steuerungslogik eines Kreditinstituts.

Erfahrung im Umgang mit Kennzahlen, Datenanalysen und Managementreports.

MS-Excel-Kenntnissen und idealerweise Erfahrung mit BI-, Reporting- oder Dashboard-Lösungen sowie Powerpoint und think-cell.

Erfahrungen in der Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe sowie Kenntnisse von OSPlus und den relevanten Steuerungsinstrumenten sind von Vorteil.

sicherer und adressatengerechter Kommunikation - auf allen Ebenen und agierst als kompetenter interner und externer Ansprechpartner.

title: Référent(e)s de proximité (H/F) – CDI à temps partiel – 25 heures par semaine
descriptionHtml:
Groupe M Service renforce ses équipes et recherche plusieurs Référent(e)s de proximité afin de répondre à ses besoins opérationnels sur différents secteurs d'Île-de-France.

Secteurs géographiques concernés

Nous recherchons des candidats pour intervenir sur les secteurs suivants :

  • Seine-et-Marne (77)

  • Val-de-Marne (94)

  • Paris (75)

Plusieurs postes sont à pourvoir afin de renforcer notre présence sur ces différents secteurs. Chaque référent(e) sera rattaché(e) à un secteur géographique défini en fonction des besoins de l'exploitation.

À propos du poste

Dans le cadre du développement de notre activité, nous recherchons des Référent(e)s de proximité pour accompagner au quotidien nos conducteurs, nos établissements et nos équipes d’exploitation.

Véritables relais opérationnels de terrain, vous veillez au bon déroulement des prestations, au respect des procédures et des consignes de sécurité, ainsi qu’à la qualité du service rendu aux clients et aux usagers.

Vous êtes en lien étroit avec les conducteurs, les établissements, le service exploitation et le référent manager.

Rejoignez GROUPE M SERVICE, une entreprise dévouée au transport de personnes à mobilité réduite, en tant que référent (e) de proximité. Située à Aulnay-sous-Bois, notre société opère dans l'industrie du transport terrestre de passagers et compte entre 201 et 500 employés engagés. Notre mission est d'assurer le transport des personnes en situation de handicap, en apportant une aide précieuse à ceux qui en ont besoin. Nous recherchons des professionnels passionnés par l'assistance aux personnes vulnérables, capables de gérer les défis quotidiens avec compétence et bienveillance. Rejoignez-nous pour faire une différence significative dans la vie de ceux qui comptent sur notre engagement et notre expertise.

Vos missions

1. Suivi opérationnel des prestations

  • Contrôler les véhicules à leur arrivée et à leur départ.

  • Vérifier la bonne mise en place des circuits et la disponibilité du matériel nécessaire.

  • Assurer le suivi des nouveaux clients, des modifications de circuits et de l’intégration des nouveaux usagers ou conducteurs.

  • Veiller à la mise à jour des circuits et à la bonne transmission des informations aux conducteurs.

  • Assurer un suivi régulier des conducteurs et du bon déroulement des prestations.

  • Identifier les difficultés opérationnelles et proposer des actions correctives adaptées.

  • Participer aux rendez-vous clients avec la direction et/ou le référent manager.

2. Gestion et accompagnement des conducteurs

  • Récupérer et contrôler les documents obligatoires des conducteurs.

  • Assurer le suivi des VPM, attestations d’honorabilité et autres documents requis.

  • Participer au recrutement des conducteurs.

  • Accueillir et accompagner les nouveaux conducteurs lors de leur intégration.

  • Assurer leur suivi dans le cadre des formations.

  • Réaliser, lorsque nécessaire, des conduites en doublon dans le cadre des intégrations, contrôles, formations ou accompagnements.

3. Suivi des véhicules

  • Organiser et suivre les rendez-vous liés aux contrôles techniques, révisions, entretiens et réparations.

  • Contrôler régulièrement la propreté et l’état général des véhicules.

  • Identifier et signaler les anomalies ou dysfonctionnements.

  • Assurer le suivi des interventions et des échéances de maintenance.

  • Organiser et contrôler la restitution des véhicules.

4. Gestion du matériel

  • Assurer le suivi du matériel confié aux conducteurs : véhicules, téléphones, clés Dallas et autres équipements.

  • Veiller à la bonne utilisation, à la conservation et à l’entretien du matériel.

  • Organiser et contrôler la restitution du matériel lors des changements d’affectation ou en fin de mise à disposition.

5. Qualité, sécurité et respect des procédures

  • Veiller au respect des procédures internes et du règlement intérieur.

  • S’assurer du respect des consignes de sécurité et des exigences propres à chaque établissement.

  • Contrôler la conformité des pratiques et des équipements nécessaires aux prestations.

  • Être attentif à toute situation pouvant présenter un risque pour les usagers, les conducteurs ou les tiers.

  • Signaler immédiatement tout incident, accident, dysfonctionnement, non-conformité ou situation susceptible d'affecter la sécurité ou la continuité du service.

  • Assurer le suivi des réclamations et incidents relevant de votre périmètre.

6. Reporting et communication

  • Compléter et transmettre le reporting hebdomadaire d’activité.

  • Faire remonter les incidents, difficultés opérationnelles, besoins identifiés et actions mises en œuvre.

  • Assurer une communication régulière avec les conducteurs, les établissements, le service exploitation et le référent manager.

  • Garantir une transmission fiable et rapide des informations.

  • Assurer un rôle d’interface entre les différents interlocuteurs afin de contribuer à la continuité et à la qualité du service.

Vos compétences

Nous recherchons des personnes organisées, réactives et à l’aise dans les échanges avec différents interlocuteurs.

Vous appréciez le travail de terrain et êtes capables de gérer plusieurs sujets opérationnels en parallèle.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

Indie Campers is the leading campervan marketplace, on a mission to make road trips accessible to everyone. As Regional Operations Director, you lead local operations across a group of countries. Each depot has Operations Supervisors on the floor; clusters of depots are led by Operations Managers; the Operations Managers report to you. You report to the EMEA Operations Vice President.

You will own results on fleet availability and quality, Customer satisfaction and public profile, operational efficiency and profitability, ensuring high service standards and consistent execution of the central procedures and SOPs defined for our operating model.

  • Lead, coach and develop the regional team and the Depot Leaders across your locations
  • Oversee day-to-day regional operations and drive the region's results on fleet availability, customer satisfaction and profitability
  • Monitor KPIs daily, follow up on action plans and implement improvements
  • Ensure operating standards and SOPs are followed consistently across all depots
  • Safety, legal compliance and audit readiness at every site, under several sets of national law.

Customer first

  • Customer satisfaction and recurring issues across every country in your district, with corrective plans that actually close

P&L and cost ownership

  • Own the regional P&L from an operational standpoint, including budgeting and cost control
  • Identify and deploy efficiency initiatives
  • Keep resources aligned with activity levels, expanding and contracting cost structure based on seasonality
  • Manage relationships with international suppliers serving the region

Collaboration and growth

  • Work closely with Central Ops, Revenue & Growth, Finance, People & Talent Acquisition, and so that processes are well defined and adapted to your region
  • Lead, coordinate and deliver projects related to operational expansion in the region
  • Travel frequently to support depot teams (up to 75% of the time)

Who We Are Looking For

Must have

  • Degree in Engineering, Business Management or a similar field (higher education)
  • 10 years or more of operational leadership in mobility, logistics, hospitality, rental or multi-site management, including several years running operations in more than one country.
  • You have run a profit and loss account of meaningful size and are comfortable owning a commercial result rather than contributing to one.
  • You manage through managers who themselves manage managers. Your effectiveness depends on your Operations Managers being good, not on you being everywhere.
  • You can diagnose across a portfolio and across borders, telling apart a problem with one depot, one manager, one country, or the way we operate.

  • You make sound people decisions at Supervisor and Manager level in reasonable time, and build a pipeline rather than filling vacancies.

  • You are steady in a crisis and willing to be in the field: every country monthly, a frontline shift monthly, present when it matters.
  • Strong Excel or Sheets. Fluent English and at least one other language used in your district. Full driving licence, category B. Free to travel across your countries without restriction.

  • Opening new markets, integrating an acquisition, or setting up a new operating model rather than inheriting a settled one.
  • A third language used in your region

The Indie Commitment

  • A fast-growing, dynamic environment where you make a real impact
  • Career growth in Field Operations, with potential moves to Lisbon, Mexico City or Manila

title: Director of Global Training
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the Role

As Director of Global Training, you’ll shape UFORCE’s global training capability, enabling customers to operate our uncrewed systems safely, legally and effectively.

Reporting to the VP Military Exercises, you’ll set a consistent standard across markets, working through training schools, regional and technical teams while local delivery and commercial ownership remain with the regions.

What You Will Do

  • Own global operator and maintainer syllabi, assessment and certification, with controlled materials, consistent thresholds and appropriate local adaptation.

  • Develop training for new products and command-and-control systems, including individual and group operation, communications and configuration.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with training-authority processes and international operating permissions.

  • Experience delivering training in multiple languages and adapting it for different cultures.

title: Financemanagement Specialist - Fintech (m/w/d) - Germany
descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1 300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Deine Mission

Du bist die Stimme unserer deutschen Kunden und trägst direkt dazu bei, dass sie mit Pennylane erfolgreich sind. Du hilfst kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen (KMU), ihre Finanzprozesse zu vereinfachen und das volle Potenzial unserer Finanzmanagement-Plattform auszuschöpfen. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du mit uns den Aufbau von Pennylane in Deutschland.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Onboarding mit Wirkung: Du begleitest neue KMU-Kunden und ihre Steuerkanzleien durch den gesamten Onboarding-Prozess. Du sorgst dafür, dass der Einstieg reibungslos gelingt und Unternehmen schnell von den Möglichkeiten unserer Plattform profitieren.

  • Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und weiterentwickeln: Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere bestehenden KMU-Kunden. Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf, erkennst Potenziale für zusätzliche Funktionen und eine erweiterte Nutzung und hilfst deinen Kunden, ihre unternehmerischen und finanziellen Ziele mit Pennylane zu erreichen.

  • Proaktiv beraten: In regelmäßigen Gesprächen prüfst du, wie erfolgreich deine Kunden mit Pennylane arbeiten und wo sie Unterstützung brauchen. Du steigerst ihre Zufriedenheit, optimierst die Nutzung der Plattform und erkennst frühzeitig, wenn eine Abwanderung droht.

  • Gemeinsam den deutschen Markt gestalten: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem deutschen Sales-Team und dem lokalen Leadership-Team zusammen. Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr Abläufe weiter, bündelt Produktfeedback und treibt das Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland voran.

  • Expertise aufbauen und teilen: Du entwickelst dich zur gefragten Ansprechperson für unsere Plattform und die deutsche Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft. Dein Wissen und bewährte Vorgehensweisen gibst du direkt an unsere KMU-Kunden weiter.

Das bringst du mit

  • Relevante Erfahrung: Du hast 8+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, im Finanzmanagement, in Corporate Finance oder in einer vergleichbaren unternehmensinternen Rolle. Idealerweise hast du selbst mit Finanzprozessen, Rechnungsstellung oder Buchhaltungsabläufen gearbeitet. Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld, bei einem Fintech oder in einer Steuerkanzlei ist ein Plus.

  • Fachliche Grundlage: Du hast ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen. Alternativ bringst du eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, eine Weiterbildung als Steuerfachwirt oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Rechnungswesen mit.

  • Verständnis für den deutschen Markt: Du kennst die Anforderungen von KMU an ihr Finanzmanagement und verstehst die zentralen Abläufe rund um Rechnungswesen, Rechnungsstellung und das finanzielle Tagesgeschäft in Deutschland.

  • Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie: Du hörst aufmerksam zu, versetzt dich in deine Kunden hinein und erklärst komplexe finanzielle oder technische Themen einfach und verständlich.

  • Lust, selbst anzupacken: Du möchtest Teil eines Teams sein, das in Deutschland noch am Anfang steht und wächst. Du ergreifst die Initiative, denkst in Lösungen und hast Freude daran, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.

  • Reisebereitschaft: Du freust dich darauf, unser Team beim Onboarding im Pariser Headquarter kennenzulernen, und bist bereit, gelegentlich Kunden in Deutschland zu besuchen – etwa einmal im Monat.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder verhandlungssicherem Niveau (C2) und fließend Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren internationalen Teams.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

 

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

 

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

title: Head of AI Expansion
descriptionHtml:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are seeking a highly driven Head of AI Expansion to lead the global adoption of Tether’s AI ecosystem, with a focus on QVAC and decentralized, privacy-preserving AI infrastructure.

The role will engage leading enterprises, institutions, and governments globally, helping them deploy AI solutions built around local computing, data sovereignty, privacy, and independence from centralized cloud infrastructure.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining exceptional commercial and relationship-building capabilities with deep AI knowledge. You will identify and prioritize opportunities, structure complex projects, close strategic partnerships, monitor success of partnerships and build the team required to scale Tether AI globally.

The ideal candidate can comfortably move between technical discussions with AI and engineering teams and strategic conversations with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, and government leaders and should be used to work in multiple geographies/ cultures.

International travel is required.

Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Drive global adoption of QVAC and Tether AI across enterprises, institutions, and governments.

  • Identify organizations where local, private, decentralized, or sovereign AI provides a strategic advantage.

  • Match use cases with needs of identified organizations and build business cases for the implementation of the use case

  • Nurture existing and build new relationships with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, AI leaders, and government stakeholders.

  • Personally originate, structure, negotiate, and close strategic AI partnerships and deployments.

  • Develop partnerships across the AI ecosystem, including compute, hardware, infrastructure, and technology providers.

  • Monitor performance of partnerships, proactively identify risks and design mitigation plans

Market Strategy & Execution

  • Define and execute Tether AI’s global go-to-market strategy.

  • Identify priority markets, industries, and high-value AI use cases.

  • Co-develop with clients their requirements and translate them into deployable solutions together with product and engineering teams.

  • Build and manage a global pipeline of strategic AI opportunities.

  • Monitor market, competitive, regulatory, and technological developments.

Team Leadership

  • Build and lead the AI Expansion team globally.

  • Recruit expansion managers, partnership leads, solution architects, and other key profiles.

  • Establish KPIs, execution playbooks, and commercial processes.

  • Work closely with Tether’s AI, engineering, product, and regional Expansion teams.

Strategic Representation

  • Position Tether as a strategic partner for organizations seeking AI sovereignty, privacy, resilience, and infrastructure independence.

  • Represent Tether AI in strategic meetings, government engagements, conferences, and industry forums.


You Have

  • 7+ years of experience across AI, enterprise technology, infrastructure, or technology business development.

  • Strong knowledge of AI/ML, LLMs, inference, local/edge computing, data infrastructure, and decentralized architectures.

  • Proven experience personally originating, structuring, and closing large enterprise technology deals and partnerships.

  • Strong relationships with senior decision-makers across enterprises, technology companies, and/or governments.

  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

  • Experience building and managing high-performing teams.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to operate independently in fast-moving environments.

  • Degree in AI, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Head of Engineering, Sales Management Tools
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why the UK

The UK is home to our headquarters where more than 70 team members are based, with team members joining us from companies like Tide, Klarna, Revolut, Capital One, Teya, Wise, Starling, Monzo, and many others! Our London office is located at Sea Containers, just by London Bridge - this is also where a significant number of our most senior leaders sit, which makes it a natural base for a Head of Engineering.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Sales Management Tools, to join us in UK.

About The Role

Sales Management Tools owns MonieCRM, the operating system for Moniepoint's 50,000-strong sales network. This is not a CRM we bought — it is a workforce operations platform built entirely in-house for a multi-level field sales hierarchy, and it is how those teams run their day to day: the portfolio of businesses they manage, their own teams, their goals and performance, the physical and digital resources they need in the field, and an emerging AI-assisted support layer. Sixteen capabilities span onboarding and network management, pipeline and portfolio, performance and goals, compensation, and sales experience and support.

A significant part of the domain moves money. The platform owns wallets, commission calculation and attribution, cashout and welfare funds for a network that drives the overwhelming majority of company revenue — which makes financial correctness, not just availability, a core engineering requirement of the role.

Alongside that, the domain covers partner management, a rewards and retention platform serving tens of millions of users, and our marketing technology stack, including the engineering and customisation of Braze, the platform we use for customer engagement. The mandate is modernisation and reliability: re-architecting systems that have grown very quickly and making them dependable at a scale of more than 20 million users. This is a platform engineering and legacy modernisation challenge first and foremost, and prior CRM or SalesTech experience is genuinely not required.

Who You Are 

  • You have 10–15 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
  • 5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not years spent overseeing teams who write it.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing managers — leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.
  • You have proven platform engineering experience at scale — building and running complex distributed systems, not feature delivery alone.
  • You have navigated legacy migrations and re-architecture projects at 20M+ user scale.
  • You have strong backend engineering skills in high-throughput, data-intensive distributed systems, and are proficient in Java and Spring Boot.
  • You have managed and developed large engineering teams of 20 or more members.
  • Experience building systems where financial correctness matters — commissions, payouts, wallets, ledgers or equivalent — is a strong advantage.
  • A fintech or payments background is strongly preferred. CRM or SalesTech domain experience is nice to have and explicitly not required.
  • Exposure to customer engagement or marketing automation platforms such as Braze is a plus, but not a requirement.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like In The Role

  • Legacy systems modernised and re-architected, with measurable improvement in reliability and performance.
  • Commissions and earnings calculated, attributed and paid accurately and on time, at network scale.
  • A sales and marketing platform that scales with a rapidly growing agent network across multiple markets.
  • Commercial teams able to move faster because the tooling beneath them is dependable.
  • A high-performing engineering team with a strong bench of managers and senior engineers.

Why Join Us

  • Own the platform behind the commercial engine of one of Africa's largest digital banks — the system 50,000 people rely on to do their jobs and to get paid.
  • A genuine platform modernisation mandate with the autonomy and backing to see it through.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company impacting millions of businesses and individuals across Africa and beyond.

  • Software development background: Familiarity with building software using languages such as Python, Ruby, JavaScript, PHP, Go, or Rust.

  • CI/CD, containers & APIs: Hands-on experience or close collaboration with CI/CD workflows, Docker/OCI container technologies, and a clear vision for intuitive API design.

About Deepdesk

Deepdesk, part of AnywhereNow, powers AI Assistants and Virtual Agents for enterprise contact centres, helping brands such as Achmea, Vodafone and DHL boost productivity today while scaling for the future of customer experience. As part of AnywhereNow, a global leader in customer experience technology with 220 colleagues worldwide, we combine the agility of a scale-up with the strength of an established enterprise provider.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced developer to join our small engineering team. The centre of the role is backend development in Python or Go and cloud infrastructure, with some front-end work alongside.

At Deepdesk, we are building “Augmented Intelligence” for the enterprise. Think Gmail Smart Compose for contact centres. We use machine learning to provide agents with real-time recommendations and autocomplete suggestions, supporting them in efficiently assisting customers. Alongside recommendations, we offer fully virtual assistants that can take care of repetitive tasks.

You will work on the services behind this: the Python and Go services and APIs, the data stores and the cloud infrastructure that run our product for enterprise customers, including the services that serve our recommendation models. You will also pick up front-end work where it helps the product, for example in our admin interface and widgets.

We are also building voice agents: AI that talks with customers in real time. Speech is turned into text, a language model works out the answer, and the answer is spoken back, all within a fraction of a second. You will help build and run the services behind this, in Python and Go.

We have a start-up culture, but your code is directly used and proven at scale. Our technology is cutting-edge and continually evolving.


What You’ll Be Doing

• Build and maintain backend services and APIs in Python and Go, with background processing for heavy work.

• Keep our databases fast and reliable.

• Run and improve our infrastructure on Google Cloud: Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines.

• Build and run the real-time voice agent services: speech to text, language model and text to speech, with low latency, in Python and Go.

• Help deploy and run the machine learning services behind our recommendations. Machine learning experience is not required.

• Design and provide complete and accurate end-to-end metrics.

• Write and review well-tested, clean and maintainable code.

• Follow software engineering best practices while staying pragmatic and avoiding over-engineering.

• Contribute to front-end features in TypeScript and React when needed.

Our Stack

• Backend: Python (Django REST framework, FastAPI and Celery) and Go.

• Voice: Go for our real-time voice AI service, with WebSockets, speech to text, language models, text to speech and the OpenAI Realtime API.

• Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse and Elasticsearch.

• Cloud: Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Flux and Cloud Build.

• Front end: TypeScript and React.

• Quality: automated tests (pytest, and BDD integration tests written in Go), code review on every change, and automation to keep our code and delivery practices in shape.

What We’re Looking For

• Strong professional experience building backend services in Python or Go. In Python, Django or FastAPI is a plus.

• Solid knowledge of relational databases, in particular PostgreSQL.

• Hands-on experience with containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD. Google Cloud is a plus.

• Working knowledge of TypeScript and React, enough to build and fix front-end features. It does not need to be your strength.

• A disciplined approach to testing, code review, maintainability and delivery.

• Comfort working with autonomy and taking full ownership in a fast-moving environment.

• Interest in voice and real-time systems, and willingness to also work in the other language. Our voice AI service and our integration tests are written in Go, and most of the backend is in Python.

• A plus: experience with Celery, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, serving machine learning models, or real-time audio.

Why Join Us?

• Based in the Netherlands, with flexibility over how you organise your time. [HR: confirm office and hybrid details]

• A small team working with major enterprise clients.

• Start-up culture combined with enterprise demands and production scale.

• Full autonomy and full ownership of your work.

• High standards, trust and plenty of humour.

• The opportunity to shape real-time AI experiences used in enterprise contact centres.

• Full-time (40 hours), permanent contract.

Information Security Responsibilities

All employees are responsible for supporting and maintaining the organisation’s information security standards. This includes:

• Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures and guidelines at all times.

• Protecting company, customer and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or loss.

• Using company systems, devices and networks in a secure and compliant manner.

• Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team.

• Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required.

• Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in line with company policies and legal requirements.

Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.

title: Senior Netwerk Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Bouw mee aan de netwerken die Nederland draaiende houden

Ben jij een ervaren Network Consultant die complexe netwerkomgevingen weet om te zetten in veilige, stabiele en toekomstbestendige oplossingen? Wil je werken aan uitdagende infrastructuren voor klanten in zowel de publieke als private sector? Dan is dit jouw kans om impact te maken bij Centric.

Wat jij doet

Als Network Consultant binnen Cloud & Dataservices (DC & Network Services) ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, implementeren en beheren van complexe netwerkinfrastructuren. Je werkt met moderne technologieën zoals routers, switches, firewalls, WAF's en load balancers binnen zowel private als public cloudomgevingen.

Samen met een team van gespecialiseerde netwerk consultant zorg je ervoor dat onze diensten veilig, beschikbaar, geautomatiseerd en efficiënt worden geleverd aan onze klanten.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Implementeren en beheren van geavanceerde netwerkomgevingen

  • Configureren en beheren van routers, switches, wireless, firewalls, WAF's en load balancers

  • Vertalen van architectuurontwerpen naar concrete technische implementaties

  • Uitvoeren van patch-, lifecycle- en securitymanagement

  • Monitoren, analyseren en optimaliseren van netwerkprestaties

  • Werken volgens ITIL-processen en bijdragen aan continue verbetering

  • Ontwikkelen van innovatieve netwerkoplossingen voor onze klanten

Dit breng jij mee

Wij zorgen voor een werkomgeving waar jij blij kunt zijn en gewaardeerd wordt. Andersom voeg jij als Netwerk Consultant

waarde toe met jouw:

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau;

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal;

  • Je beschikt over relevante certificeringen, zoals Cisco CCNP, Aruba, Fortinet NSE4/NSE5, Microsoft AZ-700/AZ-900, Citrix Netscaler, F5 en ITIL Foundation, of bent bereid deze te behalen;

  • Kennis van routing- en switching concepten;

  • Kennis van VPN-technologieën, Zero Trust, NAC en MFA-integraties;

  • Ervaring met firewalls, WAF's en load balancers;

  • Je bent communicatief sterk, oplossingsgericht, zelfstandig en klantgericht;

  • Je bent bereid om deel te nemen aan stand-by diensten en incidenteel buiten kantooruren werkzaamheden uit te voeren.

Dit krijg je

Bij Centric vind je veel flexibiliteit en vrijheid om jouw vak als Netwerk Consultant succesvol uit te oefenen. Zo heb je veel ruimte om te bepalen hoe jij jouw werkweek indeelt. Ook kies je (deels) zelf waarvandaan jij werkt: vanaf kantoor, thuis of andere locaties. Verder kun je voor deze functie rekenen op:

  • Een bijdrage aan je pensioen van 7,5% van je pensioengrondslag;

  • Loyaliteitsdagen: des te langer je bij ons werkt des te meer vrije tijd;

  • Een thuiswerkvergoeding tot € 15,00 per maan;

  • Onbeperkte mogelijkheden voor het volgen van opleidingen. Centric helpt jou graag slagen;

  • Een bonus tot € 1.500,00 als jij een nieuwe collega aan ons voorstelt.

Dit zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden op basis van een 40-urige werkweek. Voor een overzicht van alle arbeidsvoorwaarden ga je naar careers.centric.eu/nl/jij-en-centric/arbeidsvoorwaarden

title: Senior Sales Engineer - MENA
descriptionHtml:
Who we are:

Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

Our culture:

  • We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.

  • We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

  • We're a remote-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to - work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport-optional, work-from-anywhere-on-Earth kind of remote - think flexible within your country, not borderless.

Location:

  • Remote MENA - Preference for Dubai

  • Please note: This role will require up to 50% travel.

 

About the role:

Sales Engineering is a team of subject matter experts who serve as the trusted technical advisor to prospective customers. You will lead prospects through the sales process by connecting their needs to Sardine’s value to win new customers and drive revenue growth. You will deliver best in class product demonstrations, fill out RFPs, and win over our prospective customer’s technical teams with your thought leadership and consultative approach. Internally, your insights from the field will help shape our product roadmap and will pave the way for future customers. You will play a key role in our commitment to customer excellence and allow Sardine to stay ahead of market trends.

The SE team is a high visibility and high impact team. At the intersection of our Go-To-Market and Product and Engineering teams, we serve as the link between our customer’s needs and the Sardine’s capabilities, ensuring our platform is always adding value to our customer’s Fraud and Compliance stack. It's a great role for someone who enjoys learning the intricacies of a product to drive value to prospects, and leading through innovative problem-solving to convert prospects into customers. Variety, ambiguity, innovation, and ownership of complex problems are all big components of this role.


What you'll be doing:

  • Support Account Executives in identifying a prospect’s fraud and compliance needs.

  • Prepare and deliver customized demos that showcase the impact of Sardine’s platform.

  • Interface with Security teams to articulate our security posture and successfully complete security reviews.

  • Complete RFPs for competitive opportunities.

  • Create comprehensive Solution Designs that address our prospect’s needs.

  • Collaborate with peers to improve all processes within the Sales Engineering team.

  • Work together with our product and engineering teams to identify areas for improvement in our product suite and help prioritize and design solutions.

 

What you’ll need:

  • 7+ years prior experience as a Sales Engineer, System Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or similar roles

  • Prior experience in similar roles within the Risk, Fraud, or Compliance domain

  • Experience with APIs, a strong understanding of JSON, and proficiency in one or more of the following languages: Python, JavaScript, Ruby, Go, or Java. Bonus points for knowledge of web development principles and/or the ability to build internal tools using one of these languages.

  • Strong analytical skills: you can dig into the technical details of a problem and turn it into a proposed solution

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced remote environment working with global clients

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical and business concepts to technical and non-technical personas.

Benefits we offer:

  • Generous compensation in cash and equity

  • Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested

  • Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture

  • Flexible paid time off and Year-end break

  • Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific

  • 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific

  • MacBook Pro delivered to your door

  • One-time stipend to set up a home office — desk, chair, screen, etc.

  • Monthly meal stipend

  • Monthly social meet-up stipend

  • Annual health and wellness stipend

  • Annual Learning stipend

Join a fast-growing company with world-class professionals from around the world. If you are seeking a meaningful career, you found the right place, and we would love to hear from you.

title: Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: UK. Fully remote, or from our London office next to East Croydon Station

Working pattern: Fully remote working is allowed, and the London office is available to you

Reports to: CTO

About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

You will build the products drivers and car park operators use every day: ANPR camera enforcement, pay-by-web, Autopay, permits, a client console and a motorist account app, across about 160 sites, and the new products we build next. We are a small engineering team, and we form teams around the work from the people we have.

We work in Kotlin on the backend (Spring Boot WebFlux, a domain-driven layering of domain, edge services and repository, Postgres, Axon event sourcing and Pub/Sub) and in TypeScript with Next.js and React on the front end, on GCP and Kubernetes. You do not need to know Kotlin to apply. Our engineers work with AI coding agents day to day, and we are looking for people who use them well and check what they produce.

Every engineer here is product-minded. You will talk to the people who use what you build, decide with product people what is worth building, and find out afterwards whether it worked.

You will report to the CTO and work with a team that reviews each other’s work.

The Mid-level

Mid-level Software Engineer. You own features end to end: you shape them with a product person, build them, test them, release them and look after them once they are live. You work inside an existing architecture with senior review. The work is mostly Kotlin backend plus Next.js and React front end.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the delivery of what you are given, from the first ticket to production, with tests, and be the person who fixes it if it breaks.

  • Talk to the people who use what you build, and use what you learn to shape and cut scope.

  • Write acceptance criteria, and check a feature after release to see whether it was used and whether it worked.

  • Work in our existing codebase and its layering, and keep it consistent for the next engineer.

  • Use AI coding agents as part of how you work, and be accountable for everything you ship, however it was written.

  • Take part in the on-call rota and look after what you ship.

  • Review other engineers’ pull requests, and welcome review of your own.

Who we’re looking for

  • You’re product-minded. In the last 12 months you’ve talked to real users or customers, and what you learned changed or cut the scope of what you built. You write acceptance criteria, you check a feature after release, and you can say whether something you shipped got used.

  • You’ve shipped production code end to end in the last 12 months, in any language. You can say what you personally built, and what happened after it went live.

  • You test as you build. You can describe a bug you shipped and the test that would have caught it.

  • You use AI coding agents in real work today, and you can describe how you check what they produce, including a time one was wrong.

  • You’re willing to be on call, and you take ownership of what you ship. You don’t need to have been on call before.

  • You work well in an existing codebase with a layered or domain-driven structure that you did not design, and you read before you write.

  • You’re comfortable across the stack. You’ve changed a React or Next.js front end, or worked properly against an API contract, even if you lean backend.

  • You review others’ pull requests, finding real problems and saying so well, and you change your own design when review shows you a better way.

You do not need a degree, a particular programming language, or Kotlin. Experience of Axon, Temporal, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, parking or payments is welcome, but none of it is required.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! Your Role

As Senior Product Manager for one of our Revenue Management teams at RoomPriceGenie, you'll own the experience where hoteliers see, trust and act on our AI-powered pricing, both in our app and embedded in our partners' PMSs through Revenue Intelligence. title: Research Engineer / Scientist, Reinforcement Learning
descriptionHtml:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As a Member of Technical Staff, Modeling in Harvey Research, you’ll own how we adapt and improve leading open-weight models for legal work.

We recently post-trained our first model built for legal work, and we’re now building the team to scale up our post-training efforts. You’ll own the post-training recipe across SFT and RL, including reward design and verification for challenging, semi-verifiable legal tasks. You’ll help set the research direction and carry ideas from experiments through training runs to models used by customers. You’ll join a small, high-bar team of hands-on engineers and researchers, where each person owns a large part of the work.

We’re looking for research engineers and scientists who have gotten training runs working at scale, are immersed in RL for language models, and want their work to reach users quickly.

Learn more about our work at harvey.ai/research.

What You'll Do

  • Own and pursue a research agenda to improve model capability on long-horizon legal reasoning and agentic workflows.

  • Design and run post-training experiments across SFT and RL, building on leading open-weight models.

  • Develop reward functions and verifiers for semi-verifiable tasks, including rubrics, learned preference models, and expert preference data, and study where they break.

  • Run and debug training at scale, addressing divergence, reward hacking, and instability.

  • Build and use rigorous evals to track improvements and decide what ships.

  • Design, implement, test, and debug code across our research stack.

What You Have

  • Hands-on experience post-training LLMs with SFT and RL, including preference optimization, and direct ownership of training runs and results.

  • Deep ML fundamentals and experience getting distributed training runs working reliably.

  • Strong engineering skills in Python, with production-quality code and end-to-end system ownership.

  • Research experience in RL for language models or reward modeling, with the ability to move quickly from experiments to shipped improvements. Publications welcome, not required.

We are hiring for this role across multiple levels.

title: Revenue Operations Engineer | AI & Automation (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

As a Revenue Operations Engineeer you anchor the build end of Revenue Operations - our internal product team whose customers are the GTM functions: Sales, CS, Marketing, and Finance. You build the AI, automation, and data foundations that make these teams faster, smarter, and more scalable, owning the end-to-end delivery of internal tools, integrations, and AI-powered workflows - from problem framing and architecture through launch, adoption, and measurable business impact.

Who We Want

Proven GTM Systems Builder.
You bring 3+ years of hands-on experience in RevOps, GTM Engineering, SalesOps, Business Systems, or a comparable B2B SaaS role, and can show production systems you personally built.

AI-Native Builder.
You've integrated LLMs into real workflows or tools through APIs and understand how to move beyond prompting into reliable, production-ready use cases.

Product-Minded Systems Thinker.
You start with the user and business problem, map the relevant process and data dependencies, and choose the simplest scalable solution rather than defaulting to a particular tool.

Integration & Data Fluent.
You're comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication, data models, and the movement of data between multiple systems.

End-to-End Owner.
You can take a project from discovery and architecture through building, testing, rollout, documentation, monitoring, and ongoing improvement.

Pragmatic Production Engineer.
You ship quickly without treating reliability as optional, including appropriate testing, error handling, security, observability, and documentation.

Business-Impact Oriented.
You connect technical work to measurable outcomes such as pipeline, productivity, data quality, speed, cost, or customer experience.

Clear Cross-Functional Communicator.
You can explain technical decisions simply, manage trade-offs, work through ambiguity, and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You are fluent in written and spoken English; German is a plus.

Curious & Self-Directed.
You actively experiment with new technologies, learn through building, and share useful findings without chasing novelty for its own sake.

Who We Don’t Want

Uses tools without hands-on depth.
You've used CRM and AI tools but lack hands-on experience building automations, configuring systems, or solving operational problems end-to-end.

Struggles with cross-functional GTM processes.
You find it hard to understand how operational decisions ripple across the wider GTM motion and the business as a whole.

Weak on the technical fundamentals.
You struggle with APIs, JSON, data models, authentication, debugging, or moving data reliably between systems.

Can't connect the build to the business.
You can't explain technical choices clearly, manage trade-offs, influence stakeholders, or connect a build to its wider business impact.

Uses AI without shipping anything real.
You use ChatGPT or Claude but can't point to an LLM-powered workflow, integration, or tool you've personally built and shipped.

Builds without thinking about what comes after.
You've built isolated automations without considering maintainability, documentation, ownership, failure handling, or how the solution fits into the wider architecture.

Your Day To Day

Building: AI, Automation & Systems (~ 65%)

  • You identify and productionize high-leverage AI use cases across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Finance, including LLM integrations, workflow design, evaluation, guardrails, and monitoring
  • You design and build lightweight internal applications and interfaces that remove recurring manual work, improve decision-making, and are simple for teams to adopt
  • You build end-to-end workflows using Make, n8n, and custom logic, including business rules, system handoffs, error handling, alerts, and ongoing monitoring
  • You create clean, maintainable data flows between HubSpot, the data warehouse, billing, support, and other GTM tools using APIs, webhooks, enrichment pipelines, and data activation
  • You work deeply within HubSpot's objects, properties, workflows, and integration layer to support complex use cases without creating fragile or unnecessarily complicated architecture

Discovery & Solution Design (~ 15%)

  • You translate scoped or ambiguous business problems into clear technical solutions, define success metrics, and choose the simplest approach that can deliver meaningful impact

Deployment, Adoption & Documentation (~ 20%)

  • You test, document, deploy, and iterate on solutions with end users so they remain secure, maintainable, reliable, and useful after launch

Stakeholders

RevOps: Your peers and manager to collaborate on projects and daily initiatives
Engineering team: Coordinate with engineers for projects that may require product know how and integration across the engineering tool stack GTM teams as and when required

Why People Choose Us

  • We believe in the power of in-person collaboration: We genuinely love being together in the Berlin office. That's where the best ideas happen, decisions move faster, and we learn from and grow with each other every day. We do offer some flexibility for remote work, but our default and our energy is being in the room together.
  • We're an international team with diverse cultural backgrounds and languages. Openness, mutual respect, and the exchange of different perspectives shape the way we work together.
  • We value ambition and drive. We're looking for people who take ownership, show initiative, and are excited to grow quickly.
  • We work with a high degree of ownership and a strong learning mindset. Asking questions, staying curious, and continuously improving are part of our everyday culture.
  • We care deeply about humility and teamwork. No egos, open feedback, and a willingness to learn from one another matter more to us than titles.

Benefits & Culture

title: Revenue Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Location

  • Remote – Europe or US (EST only)

  • Hybrid – Paris or New York

 

Role

Morpho's GTM motion has grown faster than the operations behind it. Pipeline visibility, CRM hygiene, forecasting, and tooling are split across people who all have other jobs, and nobody owns the end-to-end picture. This role owns RevOps outright and builds the systems that help the GTM team close more relevant deals, faster, working directly within the Business Operations team, directly under the Head of BizOps.

 

Responsibilities

  • Own GTM dashboards and KPI reporting so the team tracks what matters and trusts the numbers.

  • Run the GTM tech stack, automations, and AI tooling to keep business developers fast and well informed.

  • Keep the CRM minimal and clean, with stages, hygiene, and processes people actually follow.

  • Build business intelligence and forecasting to set targets that are ambitious and credible, and to spot new trends early.

  • Surface signals from markets and media so business developers can chase, upsell, and close at the right moment.

  • Partner with GTM leadership and Finance on comp design, quota setting, and territory assignment.

  • Own the knowledge base and data management so accurate information is easy to find and reuse.

 

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days

  • You are fully up to speed on the Morpho product, protocol, and roadmap, and you understand how the GTM team operates today.

  • You have a prioritized plan for what to build, fix, and delete, and you are already making reps faster.

 

First 3 months

  • You have fixed the biggest gaps and bottlenecks: a cleaner CRM, simpler processes, and the automations, dashboards, and forecasts business developers rely on daily.

  • You are central to productivity assessment, rep attribution, and deal tracking.

 

First 6 months

  • You own the full RevOps stack and bridge GTM and Finance.

  • Leadership has full visibility into the business to make better decisions, and you lead entire projects end to end.

 

Must Have Skills & Experience

  • DeFi native: you use onchain products and understand how protocols and their users behave.

  • Experience as a RevOps, growth engineer, or business analyst at a B2B startup.

  • Tech or software background: comfortable building automations and reasoning about connected systems.

  • Strong with data: cleaning, modeling, analyzing, and reporting it accurately.

  • Finance experience

  • Business mindset with a critical eye: you challenge metrics and simplify by default.

  • Strong ownership and autonomy: doesn't wait to be told.

  • Clear and crisp async communication.

  • Comfort operating in fast-changing, ambiguous contexts.

  • Team-first mindset, low ego.

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

title: Robot Learning Engineer, Human Motion Data (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About EASE

EASE builds active, AI-powered exoskeletons for logistics and manufacturing. As a TUM spin-off, we have just started series production, and paid pilots with well-known logistics companies have led to first purchase orders. Our goal: move every parcel better, manually with an exoskeleton or autonomously with a robot.

The role

Our exoskeletons are deployed in real warehouses and production plants and capture what video-only datasets miss: body pose, joint kinematics, interaction torques, vision, and hand forces from real human work. Your job is to turn that data into skills our humanoid can actually perform, so that human workers and robots can work side by side on the same tasks.

What you'll do

  • Map human motion onto humanoid kinematics and close the embodiment gap

  • Train manipulation and whole-body policies with imitation and reinforcement learning

  • Evaluate in Isaac Lab or MuJoCo and on our in-house humanoid, and measure the value of our data

  • Define what data training needs and help build our training setup, including GPU compute

  • Turn new research on robot foundation models and VLAs into prototypes

What you bring

  • Master's or PhD in robotics, CS, ML or similar, with hands-on experience from industry or research

  • Imitation or reinforcement learning on real robots (e.g. Diffusion Policy, ACT, PPO)

  • Strong Python and PyTorch; C++ is a plus

  • Physics simulation and sim-to-real transfer

  • Solid kinematics, dynamics and control

Nice to have

  • Learning from human data (egocentric video, motion capture, retargeting)

  • Humanoids, legged robots or exoskeletons; publications at CoRL, RSS, ICRA or NeurIPS

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. What you have built matters more than a perfect match.

What we offer

  • Data almost nobody else has, from a product in series deployment

  • Our own humanoid and the chance to build Physical AI at EASE from the ground up

  • Competitive salary plus virtual stock options (VSOP)

  • Flexible hours, hybrid in Munich, mobility benefit

  • Budget for conferences and further training

How to apply

Send your CV with links to GitHub, papers or robot videos.

Martin Fleischer, CEO & Co-Founder
