title: Senior Databasebeheerder (deeltijd 16 uur)
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een ervaren databasespecialist die zijn technische expertise wil inzetten voor complexe vraagstukken en de verdere ontwikkeling van een modern dataplatform? Wil je bijdragen aan veilige, betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige databasediensten binnen een maatschappelijke organisatie, maar zoek je bewust een functie voor 16 uur per week? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou.

Waar jij het verschil maakt

Als Senior Database Specialist versterk je ons team met specialistische kennis van Microsoft SQL Server en PostgreSQL. Je richt je vooral op complexe technische vraagstukken, verbeteringen en vernieuwing. De dagelijkse operatie ligt bij het team; jij helpt juist daar waar extra expertise, verdieping of richting nodig is.

Onze databasediensten vormen een belangrijk onderdeel van de technische infrastructuur van het CBS. Beschikbaarheid, performance, veiligheid en continuïteit zijn daarbij essentieel. Tegelijkertijd ontwikkelen we onze dienstverlening verder door meer te automatiseren, nieuwe databaseservices te onderzoeken en onze infrastructuur verder te moderniseren.

Met jouw ervaring help je het team bij vraagstukken die verder gaan dan het dagelijkse beheer. Je analyseert complexe problemen, adviseert over technische keuzes en helpt structurele verbeteringen te realiseren. Daarbij werk je zowel met onze bestaande MSSQL- en PostgreSQL-omgevingen als aan de ontwikkeling van toekomstige databasediensten.

Omdat je 16 uur per week werkt, ligt de nadruk op werkzaamheden waarvoor jouw senior expertise de meeste waarde toevoegt:

  • analyseren en oplossen van complexe vraagstukken rondom MSSQL en PostgreSQL, waaronder performance, troubleshooting en database-optimalisatie;

  • adviseren over databasearchitectuur, high availability, disaster recovery, lifecycle management en de verwerking van grote hoeveelheden data;

  • initiëren en uitvoeren van structurele technische verbeteringen en bijdragen aan upgrades, migraties en automatisering van databasewerkzaamheden;

  • bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe databasediensten, waaronder Database as a Service en toekomstige technologieën zoals graphdatabases;

  • meedenken over de verdere modernisering van het platform, waaronder containerisatie, Docker, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code en CI/CD;

  • verbeteren van monitoring, logging, capaciteitsbeheer, back-up- en restorevoorzieningen, encryptie, autorisaties en informatiebeveiliging en jouw kennis delen met collega’s en andere technische specialisten.

Je toekomstige collega's

Je komt te werken in Team Data & Webdiensten van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur (IGI). De afdeling bestaat uit ongeveer 30 IT-professionals die werkzaam zijn vanuit Heerlen en Den Haag. Het Team Data & Webdiensten bestaat uit ongeveer 15 collega’s.

Binnen het team werken we Agile in combinatie met ITIL. We gebruiken Azure DevOps om het werk inzichtelijk te maken en werken met stories en epics. Ook nemen we deel aan vaste momenten zoals dagstarts, planningen, reviews en retrospectives.

Met 16 uur per week maak je volwaardig onderdeel uit van het team, maar verwachten we niet dat je iedere operationele taak oppakt. In overleg bepalen we waar jouw expertise het meeste verschil kan maken. Je werkt daardoor nauw samen met de collega’s die dagelijks verantwoordelijk zijn voor de databasediensten en ondersteunt hen bij complexere technische vraagstukken en ontwikkelingen.
We werken met collega’s op verschillende locaties en vanuit verschillende specialismen. Kennisdeling, samenwerking en plezier in het werk vinden we belangrijk.

Dit ben jij

Je bent een ervaren databasespecialist die snel tot de kern van een technisch vraagstuk komt. Je hoeft niet voortdurend bij de dagelijkse operatie betrokken te zijn om te begrijpen wat er speelt en bent in staat om binnen je beschikbare tijd duidelijke prioriteiten te stellen.

Je combineert diepgaande databasekennis met een bredere blik op infrastructuur, automatisering en security. Je denkt niet alleen in tijdelijke oplossingen, maar zoekt naar structurele verbeteringen die ook op langere termijn waarde toevoegen.

Daarnaast kun je jouw technische afwegingen helder uitleggen. Je werkt gemakkelijk samen met andere technische disciplines, deelt je kennis en kunt collega’s adviseren zonder het werk van hen over te nemen.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • hbo-werk- en denkniveau en meerdere jaren relevante ervaring met het ontwerpen, beheren en optimaliseren van databaseomgevingen;

  • aantoonbare en diepgaande ervaring met Microsoft SQL Server en PostgreSQL, waaronder performance tuning, troubleshooting, back-up/restore en high availability;

  • ervaring met Windows- en Linux-serveromgevingen en automatisering met bijvoorbeeld PowerShell, Bash en/of Python;

  • kennis van databasebeveiliging, waaronder encryptie, autorisaties, informatiebeveiliging en compliance;

  • kennis van Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD en DevOps-werkwijzen en bij voorkeur ervaring met Infrastructure as Code, bijvoorbeeld Ansible;

  • kennis van ITIL-processen, sterke analytische en communicatieve vaardigheden en een proactieve houding gericht op kennisdeling en continue verbetering.

Certificeringen op het gebied van Microsoft SQL Server en/of PostgreSQL zijn een pré.

Feitelijk goed geregeld

Voor onze arbeidsvoorwaarden volgen wij de CAO Rijk. Dat betekent dat je onder andere kunt rekenen op het volgende:

  • Een salaris van minimaal € 4132,- en maximaal € 6275,- bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur. Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. Als je bij de start van je functie nog niet over alle benodigde kennis en ervaring beschikt, kan worden gekozen voor tijdelijke inschaling in een lagere salarisschaal. Hierover maak je bij de start van je functie afspraken met je leidinggevende.

  • 8% vakantiegeld en een 13e maand. In totaal is dit 16,5% bovenop je salaris. Dit noemen wij het Individueel Keuze Budget (IKB). Je bepaalt zelf hoe, wanneer en op welke manier je dit budget wilt inzetten.

  • Pensioenopbouw bij het ABP Pensioenfonds.

  • Een laptop (Microsoft of Apple) en mobiele telefoon (Android of iOS).

  • Twee tot drie dagen thuiswerken, de rest ben je aanwezig in ons onlangs gerenoveerde gebouw. In je team maak je daar verder afspraken over.

Kom werken aan de feiten

We sluiten de vacature bij voldoende kandidaten.

title: Senior Designer RTW
descriptionHtml:
Born in 1971, the roots of Mulberry are in Somerset, England. For more than fifty years, Mulberry has been a British lifestyle brand, internationally acclaimed for quality and design capturing the Mulberry Spirit.
Sustainability has been part of the Mulberry ethos since the brand's inception, in recognition of our purpose-driven approach, in 2024 we proudly achieved B Corp Certification.
Today, we are a global brand, but our values remain the same; we are committed to improving our impact on people and the planet. To do this our people are honest, dynamic, and community spirited.
If these are values you share, we would love you to join our team.
The Role: To design the Women’s Ready-to-Wear (RTW) collections, working under the direction of the Design Director and contributing to the development of creative, commercially relevant and distinctive collections that reflect the Mulberry aesthetic. The Senior RTW Designer will take ownership of design projects from initial research and concept development through to sampling, fittings and PPS.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Research

  • Carry out research in line with the creative direction established by the Design Director and Creative Director, proactively identifying opportunities to develop and evolve the collection.
  • Demonstrate resourcefulness across a variety of research techniques, including library, online, archive and market research.
  • Identify inspiring references for silhouette, proportion, fabric, colour, print, texture, garment construction and finishing.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of the luxury fashion landscape, identifying opportunities to introduce fresh perspectives whilst remaining true to the Mulberry brand.
  • Share research, knowledge and inspiration with the wider design team, supporting a collaborative and informed approach to design development.

Design

  • Design and develop the Women’s RTW collections, working under the direction of the Design Director to interpret the seasonal creative direction and translate it into a cohesive, distinctive and commercially relevant product offering.
  • Take ownership of design projects from initial concept through to final product, ensuring consistency of vision and quality throughout the development process.
  • Demonstrate strong creative judgement and the ability to develop original design ideas that balance innovation, wearability and commercial relevance.
  • Experiment with silhouette, proportion, fabrication, garment construction and detailing to create distinctive and varied collections.
  • Demonstrate confidence in developing ideas three-dimensionally through draping, toile development, garment manipulation and collaboration with pattern cutters and technical teams.
  • Apply an in-depth understanding of garment construction, fit, fabric behaviour and finishing to inform and strengthen design decisions.
  • Ensure individual designs proposals work cohesively within the wider collection, contributing to a balanced and considered product offering.
  • Present design concepts and proposals clearly and confidently, articulating the rationale behind creative decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure all designs are communicated effectively through accurate technical drawings, CADs, specifications and construction details, for the atelier and suppliers.
  • Manage workload and prioritise projects effectively, ensuring the critical path is adhered to, and all key deadlines are met.
  • Work collaboratively with the wider design, technical and production teams to ensure design intent is maintained throughout the product development process.
  • Maintain accurate records of design development, sample comments and amendments throughout the season.
  • Support the Junior RTW Designer in prioritising workload, improving technical accuracy and developing confidence and independence in their role.

Prototypes and Fittings

  • Take responsibility for ensuring prototypes and samples are developed and delivered in line with the critical path, working closely with product development
  • Lead or contribute to fit meetings and sample reviews, assessing garment fit, proportion, construction, fabric performance and overall appearance.
  • Provide clear, considered and technically accurate feedback to product development / suppliers, ensuring amendments are communicated efficiently and effectively.
  • Work collaboratively with pattern cutters, garment technicians and suppliers to resolve complex fit and construction issues. Demonstrate strong technical judgement when assessing samples, balancing creative intent with garment functionality and wearability.
  • Refine and improve designs throughout the sampling process, ensuring the final product reflects the original creative vision and meets the required quality standards.

Specifications and Production Handover

  • Work closely with the production development and technical teams to ensure product specifications are accurate, commercially viable and suitable for production handover.
  • Produce and oversee accurate technical sketches and CADs, ensuring all amendments following fittings and sample reviews are incorporated.
  • Ensure garment measurements, construction details, fabrications, trims and finishing specifications are clearly and accurately documented.

Culture:

  • Embrace and demonstrate the Mulberry values and behaviours: honesty, dynamism, and a community-oriented spirit.
  • Support Mulberry to deliver an inclusive culture, through behaving in a way that is open-minded and respectful towards others, and understanding that your views, opinions, and experiences may not always be shared by your colleagues.
  • Act as an ambassador for Mulberry and communicate positively about the brand.

Sustainability:

  • As a certified B Corp, we are committed to using business as a force for good. You’ll be encouraged to incorporate environmentally and socially responsible practices into your work, supporting our Made to Last strategy across Climate, Circularity, and Community.
  • Help foster a culture where diversity is celebrated and every individual feels valued, respected, and included. Champion equity, empathy, and understanding in all interactions - internally and externally.

Skills & Knowledge:

Computer Skills

title: Senior Detection & Response Engineer, Cyber Defense
descriptionHtml:
About Nscale

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you’ll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About the Role

We are hiring Detection & Response Engineers to decide what we detect, command the response when something is real, and automate everything in between, across enterprise, cloud, production, data centre, and operational technology environments.

You will work in a three-person regional rotation. Roughly one week in three, you hold the operational slot: taking escalations, deciding fast, and acting. The other two weeks are engineering. You find where our detection coverage is thin and work with our AI agents to close it, build automation that removes human time from the response path, and make sure we are ready for the next incident. When a serious incident lands, you command it.

If you have spent years closing the same ticket every Tuesday—and knowing exactly how to fix it for good, but never having the mandate—this is the job where that is the mandate.

What you'll be doing

Detection engineering

  • Map our detection coverage against attacker tradecraft and the real estate, and find where we are blind.
  • Turn coverage gaps, incidents, threat research, and recurring escalations into clear detection ideas, and work with our AI agents to build them.
  • Assess and tune the detection ideas and rule logic our agents propose, which run as shadow rules before they go live. Judge what each one catches, what it misses, and what its noise will cost.
  • Make the human call on promotion. You will rarely write a query from scratch, but nothing goes live without your judgement, and you are accountable for whether it is right.
  • Retire or retune live detections that are noisy, stale, or no longer relevant.
  • Identify telemetry gaps and make the business case for closing them.

Automation

  • Remove recurring toil from the response path: enrichment, triage, containment actions, case handling, and reporting.
  • Improve the agents that hold the first tier, so they resolve more on their own and escalate with better context. Every gain here cuts the human time per alert and lets us cover more attack surface.
  • Ship new capabilities in our internal security platform, such as response actions, integrations, and agent tooling, so every engineer and agent on the team gets faster, and prove each one works in production.

Incident command

  • Command security incidents: set objectives, coordinate responders across engineering, infrastructure, and service owners, and keep leadership informed.
  • Make containment calls under time pressure, knowing what you can do immediately, what requires authority, and what could disrupt production if handled incorrectly.
  • Run post-incident reviews that end in engineering work, not just a document.

Incident preparedness

  • Design and run tabletop exercises and recovery tests.
  • Keep playbooks and runbooks honest, and turn the steps that do not need a human into automation.
  • Make sure the evidence, access, knowledge, and authority we need in an incident are in place before we need them.

Your operational week

  • Take escalations from the agents and the managed provider, scope them against real asset and business context, decide, and act.
  • Execute approved containment, including isolating devices, revoking sessions, restricting access, blocking activity, and preserving evidence.
  • Ensure every escalation exits with a solve where one is warranted. Where the solve is a detection or automation, you build it with the agents. Where it is a control change, specify it clearly enough that the owning team can act without a second conversation.
  • Close every case with a security disposition, an owner, the evidence, actions taken, and any required follow-up.
  • Hold the managed provider to our standard for evidence, analysis, routing, and closure quality.

First 90 days

  • Learn the incident command, escalation, evidence, and handover model, and take a rotation slot.
  • Independently own escalations across common classes, with defensible dispositions and evidence that stands up.
  • Ship your first solve: a detection, automation, or control change that permanently retires a recurring alert class.
  • Map coverage for one area of the estate, name its top gaps, and work with the agents to close at least one.
  • Assess, tune, and promote your first agent-proposed detections to live.
  • Add your first feature to the internal security platform.
  • Shadow the incident commander on a real incident or exercise.
  • Name one telemetry gap with a business case behind it. Extra credit if it is in operational technology or building management systems, both of which we currently cannot see.

About You

  • 5+ years in detection engineering, incident response, security operations, threat hunting, security engineering, or related roles.
  • Detection judgement. You can read a rule and say what it catches, what it misses, and how noisy it will be in production. You think in coverage, not in individual alerts.
  • Fluency in modern attacker tradecraft, including credential theft, session abuse, phishing, malware execution, persistence, privilege escalation, lateral movement, command and control, and exfiltration, and in how each shows up in telemetry.
  • Working knowledge of Windows, macOS, and Linux internals, including where attackers persist on each and what each one logs.
  • Incident command experience. You have led, or been central to, a significant incident: running the bridge, setting priorities, and keeping leadership informed without losing the technical thread.
  • Experience building in, and securing, public cloud environments like AWS and GCP
  • You automate what you repeat, using query languages, scripting, APIs, or workflow automation. When you hit the same problem a third time, your instinct is to build—not add another step to a runbook.
  • Hands-on investigation experience across endpoint, identity, cloud, SaaS, network, or production workloads.
  • Sound judgement on containment under time pressure.
  • Willingness to challenge automated conclusions. You will work alongside AI agents every day, and their analysis and detection logic are inputs, not authorities. We expect you to validate them and notice when they are confidently wrong.
  • You write investigations another engineer can follow, escalations a leader can act on in thirty seconds, and case notes that still make sense to someone reading them two years later in an audit.
  • Calm and methodical when facts are incomplete or contradict each other.
  • Ability to work effectively with engineering, infrastructure, and service owners who do not report to you.

Strong pluses

  • Operational technology, industrial control systems, building management systems, or critical facilities experience.
  • Cloud infrastructure, AI infrastructure, data centres, HPC, or other availability-sensitive environments.
  • Detection-as-code, detection testing, adversary emulation, or purple teaming.
  • Building, tuning, or evaluating AI agents or LLM-based security tooling.
  • Response experience involving ransomware, identity compromise, destructive attacks, cloud intrusion, insider threats, or supply-chain incidents.
  • Experience holding a managed monitoring or response provider to a standard while keeping decisions in-house.
  • Experience working as part of a Follow-the-sun rotation.

This role may not be a fit if you:

  • Want a queue to work through all day. You hold it one week in three, and the job is making it smaller.
  • Measure success in tickets closed.
  • Close cases without a security disposition or evidence.
  • Accept a vendor alert or an agent’s conclusion without validating it.
  • Want to spend most of your time hand-writing detection queries. Here the agents draft the logic and you own whether it is right.
  • Would rather not be the person in charge when an incident is live.

What we can offer you

At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core.

  • Highly competitive UK compensation package (base + bonus + equity), with performance reviews every 12 months. 🚀
  • Join one of the fastest-growing AI infrastructure companies — your chance to directly shape how global AI capacity is planned and deployed. ✨
  • Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by leading critical cross-functional initiatives and shaping capital strategy — always with our full support.
  • Human-First Flexibility: We treat you as humans first. 🫶🏽 Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.

Equal Opportunities Statement

We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

The responsibilities outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and are intended to provide a general overview of the position. The employee may be required to perform additional duties, tasks, and responsibilities as assigned by management, consistent with the skills and qualifications required for the role.

title: Senior Director of Engineering - Civil Government and Commercial
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced engineering leader to become our Senior Director of Engineering for Civil Government and Commercial. In this role, you will lead the engineering strategy, execution, and team development for a rapidly growing organization of 70+ engineers spanning multiple global Planet offices. You will oversee the development, scaling, and delivery of our critical existing solutions, including Area Monitoring Service (AMS) for EU Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) compliance, Disaster and Wildfire solutions, Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE), and a portfolio of Derived Data Products. You will also drive our "zero to one" product discovery, partnering closely with Product Management, Design, and Science teams to incubate, architect, and launch new, emerging solutions built on top of Planet’s high-frequency imagery and derived data products. AI is central to how Planet builds solutions, and you will make it a primary way your teams discover, build, and deliver for customers. This position is vital to delivering innovative applications to civil governments and commercial customers worldwide.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem, or Ljubljana office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a global engineering organization of 70+ engineers, managers, and directors across multiple geographies and time zones.
  • Set a high bar for performance and accountability. Define measurable outcomes for every product and team, surface risks early and directly, and make the hard calls on people and priorities when results fall short.
  • Drive the day-to-day engineering execution and delivery for existing flagship products, ensuring reliability and performance for AMS,  Disaster and Wildfire solutions, and the derived data portfolio.
  • Champion and lead "zero to one" engineering discovery, building the technical foundation and prototypes for new emerging commercial and civil government products.
  • Partner on a daily basis with Product Management, Design, and GTM teams to define product direction, prioritize feature development, and align technical strategy with business goals.
  • Ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and secure for government and enterprise use, guiding architectural decisions and engineering best practices.
  • Align your team's daily output with Planet’s mission of using space to help life on earth, directly enabling governments and businesses to make critical, timely decisions.

What You Bring:

  • 10+ years of relevant software engineering work experience, including 8+ years of supervisory or leadership experience managing multiple layers of engineering management.
  • Experience leading and scaling distributed engineering teams of 50+ employees across multiple geographic locations and time zones.
  • Hands-on engagement with AI tools in your own work, and experience leading engineering teams through AI adoption.
  • Track record of "zero to one" product development, including the technical discovery, architecture, and successful launch of new software solutions.
  • Background in building and delivering geospatial platforms, data analytics solutions, or enterprise SaaS products.
  • Experience delivering tailored solutions to individual customers, meeting or exceeding their expectations and integrating new building blocks back into the solution commons.
  • A growth mindset. You experiment, learn quickly, and change course when the evidence says to.
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional partners to translate complex business and user requirements into actionable technical roadmaps.
  • Experience overseeing operational reliability, cloud infrastructure, and software deployment lifecycles for enterprise-grade applications.
  • Ability to drive software delivery metrics, maintain high operational availability/SLAs, and foster rigorous engineering practices.
  • Ability to recruit, mentor, and retain engineering talent at all levels while fostering an inclusive team culture.
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills for engaging with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Success building large scale civil government solutions leveraging forward deployed engineering. 
  • Familiarity with the unique regulatory, compliance, and security requirements of government technology solutions globally.
  • Experience building sovereign systems for governments.

descriptionHtml:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. We're looking for an experienced, hands-on and enthusiastic Senior Director of Global Tax to lead the Global Tax team at Monzo, and our wider finance team.

You’ll be leading our growing Tax team of 10+ individuals, and will be reporting into the Group Financial Controller (with a close partnership with the MBL Chief Financial Officer and wider Executive team).

A large part of the role involves advising on the tax implications of all new business developments, ensuring we’re both set up for compliance and optimised wherever possible and appropriate. Given the stage Monzo is currently at in its growth journey, these will be many and wide ranging, from customer products to treasury strategies, group reorgs to mobility proposals, systems implementations to international expansion.

title: Senior Director of Platform & Data Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Keyloop is a leading automotive retail software business, operating across 100+ markets and backed by Francisco Partners. As we accelerate our transition to a modern, cloud-native SaaS platform, Platform & Data Engineering sits at the heart of our technical strategy. This is a high-impact leadership role reporting directly to the CTO, responsible for setting and executing the platform strategy that enables Keyloop's product engineering teams, powers our data and AI capabilities, and provides the integration fabric for an acquisitive, multi-product business.
Responsibilities:

1. Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and develop a diverse, distributed team of platform and data engineers, providing guidance, mentorship, and clear career pathways to ensure high performance and professional growth.

  • Build and refine the organisational structure of the platform function, including defining team topologies that support product engineering teams as internal customers.

  • Foster a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement, with a strong emphasis on developer productivity and platform reliability.

2. Platform & Technology Strategy

  • Ensure security, stability, and scalability are foundational properties of the platform - not afterthoughts - with clear ownership of reliability targets, security-by-design standards, and the capacity to serve a growing SaaS customer base across 100+ markets.

  • Co-own the multi-year platform engineering roadmap with the Platform Product Leader, translating commercial and product priorities into a coherent engineering delivery plan.

  • Lead the evolution of Keyloop’s shared services, API gateway, integration layer, and internal developer platform (IDP) to serve as the technical foundation across all product lines.

  • Establish API-first as a non-negotiable architectural principle - every platform capability must be accessible via a well-governed, versioned API surface before any other access pattern is considered, enabling both internal product teams and external ecosystem partners to build reliably on top of Keyloop infrastructure.

  • Drive cloud-native architecture decisions, leveraging AWS services and infrastructure-as-code practices (Terraform/Pulumi) to ensure scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency.

  • Champion platform security-by-design, ensuring adherence to enterprise security standards, compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2), and Keyloop's obligations as a custodian of sensitive automotive retail data.

3. Integration & Acquisitive Platform Capability

  • Architect and evolve the integration platform that enables Keyloop to onboard acquired businesses and codebases efficiently, reducing time-to-integration across M&A activity.

  • Define and maintain shared platform capabilities including identity, authentication, multi-tenancy, data residency, and OEM connectivity standards.

  • Ensure the platform acts as the enabling layer across Keyloop’s product portfolio, providing consistent APIs, event streaming, and shared infrastructure rather than duplicating capability across product teams.

  • Design and deliver low-code/no-code integration capabilities that enable rapid, standardised connectivity with third-party systems across the automotive ecosystem, including OEM partners, dealer group platforms, and acquired businesses. Build on modern integration tooling (including n8n) to reduce time-to-integration and enable non-engineering teams to configure and operate integrations where appropriate.

4. Data & AI Platform

  • Lead the design and delivery of Keyloop's data platform, including data lakes, data pipelines, and analytical infrastructure to power BI, reporting, and AI-driven product capabilities.

  • Build and operate the infrastructure layer for AI and ML workloads, including feature stores, model serving infrastructure, MLOps pipelines, and experimentation frameworks.

  • Drive strategic adoption of technologies including Snowflake, Databricks, AWS Athena, EMR, Glue, Snowplow, and Kafka, ensuring robust data governance and quality practices.

  • Partner closely with product and data science teams to ensure the data and AI platform directly enables Keyloop's AI product initiatives, including KARA and AIME.

5. Enabling the Agentic Development Lifecycle

  • Lead Keyloop's transition to an agentic software development lifecycle, defining the strategy, frameworks, and delivery model for AI-augmented engineering at scale.

  • Develop and roll out the methodologies, toolchains, and workflows that enable engineering teams to work with AI coding agents, autonomous test generation, agentic PR review, and AI-assisted architecture decisions.

  • Build and own the internal platform capabilities required to support agentic workloads, including MCP (Model Context Protocol) server infrastructure, LLM gateway services, context management systems, and agent orchestration layers.

  • Drive the skills and capability development agenda across engineering, partnering with engineering directors to upskill teams in prompt engineering, AI-native development patterns, and responsible AI tooling practices.

  • Establish guardrails, security controls, and governance frameworks that allow teams to move fast with AI tooling without introducing risk to code quality, IP, or data security.

  • Drive and report on engineering AI maturity progression using Keyloop’s established AI maturity framework, setting stage-based targets, tracking adoption across teams, closing capability gaps, and accelerating teams from early experimentation to production-grade AI-augmented delivery.

6. Delivery Excellence & Observability

  • Oversee the execution of platform engineering initiatives, ensuring timely delivery, adherence to quality standards, and effective resource utilisation.

  • Define and embed observability standards across the platform (OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, SLO/SLA frameworks), giving engineering teams clear visibility into platform health and performance.

  • Drive FinOps discipline across platform infrastructure, owning cloud cost governance and optimisation in partnership with the infrastructure leadership.

7. Strategic Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with the CTO, engineering directors, architects, and product leadership to align platform capabilities with business priorities and product roadmaps.

  • Act as a strategic partner to the broader engineering organisation, ensuring platform decisions accelerate rather than constrain product delivery teams.

  • Represent platform and data engineering at the executive and board level, communicating strategy, progress, and investment cases clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Required Skills & Experience:

Technical & Architectural

  • Deep experience in cloud-native platform engineering on AWS, including IaC (Terraform or Pulumi), containerisation (Kubernetes/ECS), event streaming (Kafka), and API gateway patterns.

  • Proven track record designing and operating shared platform services - integration layers, identity, multi-tenancy, and developer-facing APIs - in a complex, multi-product enterprise SaaS environment.

  • Hands-on background in data platform engineering: data lake architecture, ELT pipelines, and familiarity with Snowflake, Databricks, and AWS data services (Athena, Glue, EMR).

  • Experience building AI/ML infrastructure: feature stores, model serving, MLOps pipelines, and LLM-enabling platform capabilities such as MCP server infrastructure or LLM gateway services.

  • Strong understanding of platform observability: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, SLO/error budget frameworks, and production reliability engineering.

  • Security-first mindset with hands-on experience in enterprise security practices, compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2), and zero-trust architecture patterns.

Leadership & Delivery

  • Extensive engineering leadership experience, with a proven record of building, scaling, and developing high-performing distributed engineering teams of 60+ people.

  • Experience operating within an acquisitive software business, with the ability to lead M&A technical integration and platform standardisation across acquired codebases and teams.

  • Familiarity with modern delivery frameworks (SAFe, Shape Up, or equivalent) and the ability to adapt methodology to the needs of a platform organisation serving multiple internal customers.

  • Strong FinOps capability, including cloud cost governance, unit economics thinking, and the ability to frame infrastructure investment in commercial terms.

Agentic Engineering & AI Tooling

  • Practical experience adopting and scaling AI-native development tooling (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) across engineering organisations.

  • Understanding of agentic software delivery patterns: autonomous agents, human-in-the-loop workflows, agentic code review, test generation, and AI-assisted architecture.

  • Ability to define governance frameworks that enable AI-augmented development at pace while managing code quality, IP protection, and data security risks.

  • Passion for driving engineering culture change, with the ability to take a sceptical or early-majority engineering team on a credible AI adoption journey.

Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex platform and data engineering decisions into clear narratives for executive, commercial, and board audiences.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience partnering with product, commercial, and finance leadership in a PE-backed, high-growth software environment.

Quantexa is embarking on a significant expansion of its EMEA Public Sector Go-To-Market (GTM) team. Following landmark wins—including our historic 10-year partnership with HMRC —we are looking for a highly motivated leader to direct our UK Public Sector sales activity.

As a Senior Director and Player/Manager for the UK Public Sector, you will spearhead our continued growth in the UK. You will lead, mentor, and expand a high-performing team of Sales Directors while simultaneously acting as an active "player" managing a high-value pipeline, farming existing landmark accounts, and hunting for new strategic opportunities across the UK Government, Security, and Defence sectors.

What you’ll be doing

Your role will be a dynamic blend of team leadership, strategic direction, and active enterprise selling (Player/Manager).

  • Strategic GTM Leadership: Work closely with our VP for Public Sector Sales, EMEA, Regional Vice-President, and Solution Owners to define and execute the UK go-to-market plan and sales strategy.

  • Deal Execution (“Player”): Personally lead complex, strategic, high-value opportunities across UK Central Government, National Security, and Defence.

  • Consultative Selling: Build and nurture a diverse, multi-stage pipeline of opportunities through a consultative, land-and-expand approach.

  • Performance and Accountability: Set a high bar for the team and hold people to it, measuring performance through leading indicators and field observation as well as quota attainment.

  • Coaching and Talent Development: Coach the team hands-on through live deals, spend time in the field giving meaningful feedback, and build a diverse, high-performing team. Help the team learn from both wins and losses.

  • Operating Rhythm: Run a disciplined cadence of forecast calls, pipeline reviews, 1:1s and QBRs, each with a clear purpose. Quickly diagnose and fix forecast accuracy and pipeline coverage gaps.

  • Culture and Leadership: Define high performance in terms of both results and behaviours, create momentum while protecting trust and morale, and act on feedback about your own leadership style.

  • Collaboration and Alignment: Partner closely with Field Engineering, Marketing, Commercial, Product, and Delivery to ensure seamless customer alignment.

  • Ecosystem Expansion: Cultivate relationships and drive joint pipeline with key System Integrators, Cloud platform providers, and Consulting organisations.

  • In office collaboration: In-office collaboration is a core part of how we build and solve problems together, so there will be an expectation to be in the London office or on client site 2-3 days per week.

What you’ll bring

  • UK Public Sector Domain Expertise: Deep, practical knowledge of UK Central Government operational structures, procurement frameworks, and buying processes.

  • Established Networks: Genuine, active, and trusted relationships at senior levels within UK Central Government departments. Security and Defence connections are highly desirable.

  • Proven Player/Manager Track Record: Extensive experience as both an individual enterprise software sales contributor and a leader who has grown, motivated, and managed high-performing sales professionals.

  • Consultative Enterprise Selling: A strong background in complex, high-value solution selling to government stakeholders, such as AI, Big Data, Entity Resolution (connecting and resolving data to reveal relationships and risk), Fraud, or FinCrime solutions.

  • Pipeline Champion: A relentless drive to create and manage an active, multi-stage pipeline, using a storytelling-led approach.

  • Executive Presence: The credibility to challenge targets or decisions respectfully, and the discipline to commit fully once a decision is made.

  • Leadership Self-Awareness: You actively seek out feedback and act on it.

  • Security Clearance: You must either hold current SC clearance or be willing and able to achieve it.

  • Commercial Drive and Resilience: An entrepreneurial spirit with strong commercial and interpersonal skills, comfortable delivering results in complex, fast-paced environments.

Our perks and quirks

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits. We offer:

  • Competitive salary 💰 and performance-driven company bonus.

  • Flexible working hours in a hybrid workplace, with free access to global WeWork locations & events.

  • Pension Scheme with a company contribution of 6% (if you contribute 3%).

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option to buy up to 5 days) + birthday off!

  • Work from Anywhere Scheme: Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period.

  • Family Support: Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Private Healthcare, EAP, Well-being Days, Calm App, and Gym Discounts.

  • Socials: Team's Social Budget & Company-wide Summer & Winter Parties.

  • Tech & Cycle-to-Work Schemes + Volunteer Day off.

  • Dog-friendly Offices.

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

title: Senior Early Talent & G&A Recruiter
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As our Senior Early Talent & G&A Recruiter in EMEA, you will lead Engineering Early Talent (New Grads and Interns) and G&A hiring across multiple businesses. You will partner with regional and global leaders, build sourcing strategies that work, and give every candidate a standout experience.

You should apply if these excite you:

In this role, you will: 

  • Lead G&A hiring across EMEA: partner with a very diverse group of business leaders, plan hiring by function (Finance, People, Legal, IT), and switch context fast to keep every business moving.

  • Build creative sourcing strategies across LinkedIn, referrals and other channels, tailored to each function and market and backed by EMEA market intelligence.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • You have 6+ years of proven full-cycle recruiting experience, preferably in a tech organisation with a very high hiring bar.
  • You have proven experience building Early Talent programs, hiring for Engineering New Grads and Interns in UK (mandatory) and G&A roles (e.g. Finance, People, Legal, IT) in EMEA.
  • You communicate with key partners in a concise, professional and pro-active way.
  • You have exceptional stakeholder management abilities and executive presence, experienced working with a very diverse population of business leaders and switching context rapidly and comfortably.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Deep understanding of EMEA talent market trends, turned into actionable strategies for each function.
  • Proven outbound sourcing for technical and specialist talent in a competitive market.

What's in it for you?

  • The chance to shape and build Samsara’s teams across EMEA.
  • A high-visibility role: build connections and influence with Samsara’s regional & global business leaders.

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. title: Senior Electrical Product Engineer - Maritime Engineering
department: Maritime & Maneuver Dominance : Undersea Dominance - Engineering & Operations : Software Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Role

The Senior Product Engineer is the primary electrical design engineering presence on the production floor, bridging the gap between design intent and production execution. The role sits within Platform Engineering and is based primarily at the production site, dispositioning nonconformances and Material Review Board (MRB) actions for electrical systems and sub-assemblies, resolving design questions in real time, and closing the loop between production and design so that issues get root caused and fixed at the source. To hold that authority credibly, this role also contributes to upstream electrical design - architecture, analysis, schematics, and design reviews - so they have the depth needed to make sound disposition decisions on the floor. This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strong technical judgement in electrical and power systems engineering, the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced production environment, and the credibility to influence both design engineers and production teams. You will be expected to drive systemic improvements, cutting repeat nonconformances through changes to the design and documentation, as well as resolving individual issues.

Key Responsibilities

Production Floor Engineering Support

  • Serve as the primary electrical design engineering point of contact on the production floor for assigned programs and product lines
  • Represent the design authority at Material Review Board (MRB) for electrical systems, working with Quality and Manufacturing to minimise production hold time without compromising product safety and integrity
  • Resolve production process-blockers, design ambiguities, and schematic/drawing interpretation issues in real time, exercising engineering judgement within defined authority boundaries
  • Provide rapid-response engineering support and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to Production, Quality, and Test teams for electrical nonconformance resolution, use-as-is/rework/scrap decisions, and repair dispositions
  • Identify and escalate systemic electrical design issues to core Design Engineering teams with clear problem statements, data, and recommended corrective actions
  • Perform detailed electrical calculations, simulations, and analysis to support MRB dispositions, deviation requests, and use-as-is justifications (e.g. power budgets, thermal derating, circuit analysis, connector/harness assessments)

Electrical Design Contribution

  • Contribute to the design, development and integration of electrical systems and subsystems, maintaining the technical depth needed to hold disposition authority on the production floor
  • Perform detailed electrical calculations, simulations and analysis (circuit analysis, power budgets, thermal derating, EMC/EMI) to support both design decisions and MRB dispositions
  • Participate in design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR) and contribute to system-level trade studies
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with mechanical, software, and systems engineering to integrate electrical systems into the vehicle

Design Intent Translation & Multi-Site Support

  • Support the translation of electrical design intent into production-executable work across multiple product versions, configurations, and manufacturing sites
  • Support the stand-up and ramp of production at new or expanding manufacturing sites, ensuring electrical design engineering knowledge transfers effectively
  • Raise and implement engineering changes to correct production issues that originate in the electrical design, through the Anduril configuration management and change process
  • Feed production observations, failure modes and DFM/DFA opportunities back into Platform Electrical design work through structured feedback, prioritised using data

Design to Production Interface

  • Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering on work instruction (WI) development, tooling validation, and First Article Inspection (FAI) activities for electrical assemblies, communicating the design intent and acceptance criteria
  • Own the resolution of EBOM discrepancies found in production for electrical assemblies, and give engineering input to Configuration Management and Manufacturing Engineering on PLM workflows, BOM reconciliation and work instruction tooling
  • Identify patterns across electrical nonconformances, test failures and build issues, and lead engineering root cause analysis and design corrective action implementation
  • Collaborate on the improvement of key tool and functional interfaces (PLM workflows, digital work instructions, BOM reconciliation) that impact design-to-production efficiency
  • Support the development of scalable frameworks for multi-site production: configuration management alignment, site-specific work instruction adaptation, and cross-site lesson-learned sharing
  • Build repeatable playbooks for standing up production of new product variants, reducing ramp time and first-unit defects at each additional site

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Metrics

  • Maintain strong working relationships with Quality, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering, and Program Management to ensure aligned priorities and rapid issue resolution
  • Collate and drive corrective actions on design-originated production issues, providing data-backed prioritisation to core Design Engineering teams
  • Participate in Production readiness reviews, design reviews (P&DFMEA, DFM/A/T) and engineering change assessments

Key Competencies & Attributes

  • Engineering Judgement: Technical depth in electrical and power systems combined with production pragmatism - able to make sound engineering decisions under time pressure without over-engineering solutions
  • Design Authority Integrity: You protect product safety and integrity under schedule pressure, understand the limits of your delegated authority and escalate when you should
  • Cross-Functional Influence: Credibility with both design engineers and production operators; able to speak both languages and bridge communication gaps
  • Autonomy & Initiative: Comfort with ambiguity and competing priorities in a fast-moving production environment; able to self-direct and prioritise without constant direction
  • Systems Thinking: Thinks beyond individual issue resolution to identify patterns, root causes, and scalable solutions that prevent recurrence across sites and variants
  • Communication: Clear, concise technical communication - written dispositions, engineering reports, and presentations to leadership

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
  • Proven experience in a senior role within defence, tech or any fast-paced environment, driving successful electrical engineering projects from concept to market launch
  • Expertise in electrical engineering principles, techniques, and technologies, with a track record of delivering innovative solutions
  • Proficiency in using industry-standard electrical design and simulation software
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate and mentor junior engineers while fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation
  • Strong time management and organisational abilities, with a demonstrated ability to deliver projects on time and within budget
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to think creatively and adapt to diverse and evolving challenges
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Familiarity with fast paced environment best practices, including agility, adaptability, and the ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a NV2 Australian Government Security Clearance
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience working on or directly supporting a production floor
  • Understanding of Material Review Board (MRB) processes, nonconformance management, and engineering disposition (use-as-is, rework, scrap, return to vendor)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing electrical and power systems for unmanned vehicles
  • Experience in the subsea or maritime domain
  • Experience working on defence programs and familiarity with current Defence standards
  • Previous experience as a Product, Sustaining, Liaison or Production Support Engineer with delegated design or disposition authority
  • Experience with first article inspection (e.g. AS9102) and production test development
  • Familiarity with IPC/WHMA-A-620 and/or IPC-A-610

Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates.     • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to 

 

Data Privacy

title: Senior Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰 £138,000 - £175,000 + Equity + Benefits 

About the Role 

This role is for a Senior Engineering Manager where you’ll be a manager of managers. You will be leading across multiple teams in an org of around 20-30 people. We’re expanding and your role as the Senior EM will be to grow and build new squads as needed. Your direct reports will include Tech Leads, Senior Engineers and 2-3 Engineering Managers.

Senior Engineering Managers at Monzo are part of cross-functional, autonomous teams and groups. Our teams are mission driven, and typically include Product Managers, backend, web and mobile engineers as well as data scientists, designers and subject matter experts relevant to that mission. Teams are organised into groups, and then collectives - we aim to keep our line management structure as shallow as possible, and for teams to directly own decision making relevant to their work.

Senior Engineering Managers are accountable for the technical and delivery outcomes for their area - that means supporting and developing best in class engineering talent, as well as creating an inclusive team environment for people to do their best work. You’ll be responsible for structuring, organising, supporting and challenging your team to deliver on their mission.

You can read more on the expectations of Senior Engineering Managers in our Progression Framework.

Is this role right for you?

While this is not a role which requires hands-on-coding, we are looking for an experienced manager who has a strong technical and delivery background and has worked as a software engineer in previous roles.

We recognise that Senior Engineering Managers lead in different ways, we’re looking for someone who is adept at: 

  • Delivery and Execution: Enjoys taking accountability for delivery across your squad(s), collaborating with the Technical Lead and Product Manager.
  • Engineering and Operational Excellence: Actively fosters a high bar for engineering excellence within your teams. You’re accountable for the technical outcomes your teams deliver alongside individual engineer performance and growth, so holding a high bar (and clearly articulating your expectations) is key.
  • People Leadership: Has experience directly managing at least 2-3 Engineering Managers and leading orgs of around ~20 engineers. You can support, coach and develop them through their career with regular 1:1s and continuous feedback.
  • Technical Influence: Partners with senior engineers to drive technical initiatives that raise the bar for our engineering practices.
  • Stakeholder Relationships: Builds strong stakeholder relationships with other teams, and creates a focus space for engineers to do their best work.
  • Organisational Wide Impact: Collaborates with the wider engineering organisation to contribute to company-wide best managerial and technical practices and standards.

We consider your application across all open EM roles at Monzo independent of which role you've applied for, so if you've recently applied to a similar role at Monzo and have been unsuccessful, please wait 6 months before applying again.

How we work 💻:

Locations & Flexible Working : 

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. 

We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. 

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

The interview process:

After an initial informal recruiter call you go through two main stages

  1. Initial Call (1 hour) You'll meet with one of our Senior Engineering Managers or Engineering Directors. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They’ll ask example based questions (‘Tell me about a time when…’)

  2. Loop Stage (3 hours 30 mins) The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability) and one 30 minute reverse interview (more details below).

The Loop is one stage and the interviews in this stage are:

- Team and Org Management (1 hour)An example based interview with 1-2 of our engineering leaders. They’re interested to hear examples from your previous experience on the teams you’ve led, how you’ve shaped and partnered with product, and the impact you had.

- System Design (1 hour)You'll partner with a Staff or Principal Engineer on a technical whiteboarding exercise.

- Behavioural (1 hour)Similar to Team and Org Management, this is an example based interview with 1-2 Engineering Leaders. This interview focuses on your people leadership style and core behaviours as an Engineering Manager.

- Chat with an Engineering Leader (30 mins)At Monzo, we believe interviews are a two-way street. This will be your opportunity to ask us any questions about Monzo, engineering leadership or our teams – whatever’s on your mind. 

All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process. 

What’s in it for you:

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK  

✅ We can sponsor visas

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. title: Senior Engineering Manager (hands-on) - Alan Clinic
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🤖 Who we are

Alan Clinic. A health companion and a digital clinic for everyone.

We're a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise. The Clinic is two crews building one experience:

  • Mo. An intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care. We kicked off in 2023 and launched Mo to all our French members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe.

  • Clinic Platform. The medical services behind the conversation: chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation, and care programs across primary care, mental health, and physiotherapy.

Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise (through chat, voice, or video) with AI agents working in tandem with real doctors and the health system. That's what we are building 🤖🏥.

🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with

We're building a medical experience that works reliably, safely, and at scale. An AI agent, and the clinic behind it. You'll lead the engineering team and you'll keep building alongside them.

The crews work at the intersection of product engineering, ML engineering, and medical expertise. As their engineering leader, you own:

  • ➕ The architecture for Mo's next chapters. More context, new skills, new countries. You guide the calls on our architecture and agentic framework, and you stay close enough to the code to make them well.

  • 🏥 The platform that turns conversations into care. Chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation at national scale, and the tooling doctors and therapists use every day. You drive alignment with the crews and medical teams on the other side, so members get from words to actions.

If you're excited by the idea of building the future of healthcare, this is the team for you. We're at the start of the journey. If you're curious, here is a paper we published recently.

🔍 What we're looking for

We're looking for an engineering leader who gets excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.

Leadership experience

  • 3+ years leading engineering teams, with a track record of building high performers.

  • You partner with other product functions as a true equal: you shape the roadmap, name trade-offs honestly, and help the team commit to what it can actually deliver.

title: (Senior) Enterprise Engagement Manager (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Stackgini

How do you govern 20,000 applications when nobody in the building still knows which of them do the same thing? How do you get faster to market and leaner at the same time, when business units ship AI prototypes in days and the regulatory load grows every quarter?

Stackgini is the AI operating system for Autonomous Enterprise IT. Our system understands our customers' enterprise tech landscape from the ground up: from technical configuration to application documentation, from a single tech demand to the dependencies across the entire portfolio. With the depth of knowledge of a senior tech expert and the speed of a machine. Some of the largest organizations in the world work with us, including DAX-40 and Fortune-500 customers like Siemens Healthineers and REWE.

We're a small, talent-dense team, building what we believe will change how the world's largest companies operate. We are growing fast, and the people joining now are the ones who set the standard - for the product, the culture, and our category. Stackgini will be the place where you will do the most meaningful work of your career.

About the role

As an Enterprise Engagement Manager, you own what Stackgini actually becomes inside our customers. You take over once the deal closes and guide the organization from the first target-picture discussion to the point where tech demand management runs differently than it did before.

This is advisory work with a product behind it. You sit with CIOs, IT business partners, and enterprise architects, understand how their demand process works today and where it breaks, and design a target picture they can defend internally. You measure what it delivered and turn that into the basis for the next year.

Unlike consulting, you don't walk out after the final presentation. You stay with the accounts you own and see, over years, what became of your work.

Areas of ownership

  • Strategic advisory. You are the trusted advisor to tech leaders in DAX-40, Fortune-500, and ambitious mid-market organizations. You show them what best-practice AI-first demand management looks like and bring an outside view they can't get internally. Out of that you develop the target picture with them, from the end-to-end process concept to how Stackgini fits into the existing IT toolchain.

  • Value realization. You define the KPIs you will be measured against together with the customer, baseline them, and prove the effect. You guide them through portfolio optimization and build the business cases behind it. Realized value is not a story for the QBR here, it is the number the role hangs on.

  • Stakeholder engagement. You make the champions inside the customer's organization successful. You give them the arguments, the evidence, and the backing they need to carry Stackgini into business units, IT governance, architecture, procurement, and information security.

  • Adoption and enablement. You make power users and multipliers capable through trainings, best practices, and workshops, and you feed what you learn back into our methodology.

  • Account growth and expansion. Identify and drive expansion opportunities by developing growth plans across new use cases, teams, and units, and spot risk before it surfaces in a renewal.

  • Build our customer value engine. You work hands-on on daily operations, expand the Stackgini Academy into a best-in-class enablement hub, and develop thought leadership assets: playbooks, point-of-view content, best practice guides.

  • Partner cross-functionally. Bring structured customer insights into Product and Engineering, shape our roadmap with use-case-driven evidence, and support Sales on key strategic deals.

Who you are

  • 2+ years in enterprise tech or consulting. Strategy or management consulting, IT transformation, or an enterprise tech function such as IT governance, architecture, or tech demand management. What matters is that you owned an outcome at a customer, not a workstream.

  • You structure ambiguity. You break down complex problems, shape them into clear options, and build processes that work without you.

  • You hold your own up to C-level. Precise in writing, structured in speech, composed in front of executives. In German and English.

  • AI-native, not AI-curious. You can describe concretely how you use LLMs, agents, or custom workflows in your daily work. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to be credible in a room with one.

  • Ownership over scope. You move things forward without waiting to be assigned, and client-facing work energizes you rather than drains you.

What's a plus

  • A real understanding of how enterprise tech organizations work, ideally with exposure to enterprise architecture, IT governance, software asset management, or IT procurement

  • Experience designing onboarding paths, trainings, and certifications that drive adoption at scale

Your first 90 days

  • You own accounts and know their demand process well enough to challenge it.

  • You have built a target picture and the corresponding value KPIs with at least one customer.

  • You run workshops and trainings on your own, with business and tech in the same room.

  • You have improved one thing about our methodology, because you saw where it didn't hold up at a customer.

Process

Intro call, hiring manager interview, case study, meeting the team.

Compensation Package

The annual salary for this permanent, full-time position is EUR 80,000–110,000 per year and employee stock options.

Benefits

  • Opportunities for professional growth

  • 30 days of vacation and day off on your birthday

  • Modern office space in Berlin

  • Budget for self-improvement, and other perks

  • Gympass

  • Deutschlandticket subscription

  • Dedicated time for learning & innovation

  • Quarterly Get-Together-Events

  • The best popcorn in town

Ready to make an impact? Join us at Stackgini and be part of something extraordinary!
