descriptionHtml:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

As a Senior Flight Dynamics Engineer, you will work in a small team of dedicated engineers responsible for the Flight Dynamics and Mission Planning for Planet’s fleet of satellites. The Flight Dynamics disciplines of this team include mission design, orbit determination, maneuver design and execution (with propulsion and differential-drag), and conjunction assessment & mitigation. Mission Planning is concerned with optimal scheduling of imaging and contacts for Planet’s Dove, SkySat, Pelican, and Tanager constellations. This operations research problem has a direct impact on fulfilling the business needs for the world’s largest heterogeneous constellation of Earth Observation satellites. Your role will involve developing and automating tools to assess mission design trade-offs that will define the future of Planet's constellations.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Research, design, and architect new software solutions for managing Mission Design needs for Planet's increasingly diverse fleets of satellites.
  • Work on complex optimization problems with your knowledge of flight dynamics and software engineering.
  • Develop and automate tools to assess mission design trade-offs that will define the future of Planet's constellations.
  • Collaborate with mission planning, flight dynamics, and ground software teams to improve the operations of existing fleets and enable future missions.
  • Perform first-principles analysis to optimize scheduling of imaging and contacts for Planet's diverse satellite constellations.

What You Bring:

  • 10+ years of relevant work experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, physics or related technical field
  • Expertise in orbital mechanics and space mission operations
  • Deep knowledge in software development, in C++ and Python
  • Experience carrying out first-principles analysis and operationalizing MVP solutions
  • Excellent written and verbal technical communication skills

title: Senior FP&A Expert - Financial Task Design and Evaluation
descriptionHtml:
Lightly AG is a Zurich-based AI company and ETH/HSG spin-off, backed by Y Combinator and top-tier investors. Our machine learning and computer vision technology is trusted by global leaders in autonomous driving, medical imaging, and visual inspection.

We’re looking for experienced Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) professionals with strong financial modeling and analytical backgrounds to support an advanced AI evaluation project. You'll design realistic financial planning and business decision-making tasks, develop reference solutions, and evaluate AI-generated financial outputs for accuracy, completeness, and practical business relevance.

This is a remote, project-based contractor opportunity with flexible working hours.

Compensation: $400 USD per accepted task. Each task is estimated to take approximately 5–6 hours to complete, equivalent to an indicative hourly rate of $67–$80/hour. Actual earnings per hour will vary depending on the time spent completing each task. Compensation is based on successfully completed and accepted tasks, not on hours worked.

Tasks

What you'll be doing

  • Design realistic FP&A tasks and business scenarios that reflect complex, real-world financial planning, forecasting, and decision-making workflows

  • Develop financial models and reference solutions using Excel, including traceable formulas, documented assumptions, scenario analysis, and consistency checks

  • Create tasks involving core FP&A processes, such as annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, variance analysis, headcount planning, and investment decisions

  • Build and evaluate integrated financial analyses, incorporating income statements, balance sheets, cash flow forecasts, working capital, and liquidity considerations

  • Develop scenarios involving multiple sources of financial and business information, including spreadsheets, contracts, emails, and management presentations

  • Evaluate AI-generated financial models, analyses, and recommendations for technical accuracy, financial consistency, completeness, and sound business judgment

  • Identify material errors, unsupported assumptions, inconsistencies, and weaknesses in financial models or conclusions

  • Define clear evaluation criteria and acceptable outcomes, accounting for valid alternative financial approaches and reasonable assumptions

  • Write precise task instructions, reference answers, and concise executive-level explanations that accurately reflect the underlying financial analysis

  • Apply structured evaluation guidelines consistently, providing clear, evidence-based rationales for your assessments

The project focuses on developing and evaluating realistic financial tasks to assess how effectively advanced AI systems can perform complex FP&A workflows. Your role is to bring practical financial expertise to the design of challenging business scenarios and the evaluation of AI-generated outputs against professional standards.

Requirements

You're a strong candidate if you:

  • Have 5+ years of relevant professional experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), corporate finance, finance business partnering, or a closely related field, or equivalent demonstrated expertise

  • Have advanced Excel and financial modeling skills, including building, reviewing, and auditing complex financial models with transparent formulas and well-documented assumptions

  • Have hands-on experience owning or supporting financial planning processes, including operating budgets, rolling forecasts, variance analysis, headcount planning, and investment evaluations

  • Have a strong understanding of financial statements and accounting principles, including the income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, working capital, liquidity, and debt covenants

  • Are comfortable building scenario-based financial models, evaluating different business assumptions, and assessing their impact on financial performance

  • Can independently reconcile complex or conflicting financial information across spreadsheets, contracts, business documents, and management reports

  • Have strong analytical judgment and can identify material financial errors, flawed assumptions, inconsistencies, and unsupported conclusions

  • Can assess the quality and correctness of financial analyses, including recognizing valid alternative methodologies and defining clear acceptance criteria

  • Have excellent written English communication skills and can produce precise instructions, structured financial explanations, and concise executive memos

  • Have strong attention to detail and can consistently apply detailed evaluation guidelines while exercising independent professional judgment

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in software, technology, or SaaS businesses, including ARR, retention, gross margin analysis, and subscription-based financial planning

  • Experience with financial model auditing, quality assurance, or reviewing financial deliverables prepared by others

  • Previous exposure to AI evaluation, benchmark development, or designing structured analytical assessments

  • Experience presenting financial analyses and recommendations to senior management or executive stakeholders

Benefits and Compensation

  • $400 USD per accepted task, with an estimated completion time of 5–6 hours

  • Fully remote and flexible — work from anywhere

  • Part-time contractor role with flexible hours

  • Work on the evaluation of cutting-edge AI systems tackling complex financial and business decision-making tasks

Send us your CV along with a brief note about your FP&A background, financial modeling experience, and areas of expertise. Please highlight your experience with budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and any relevant software or SaaS industry exposure.

If applicable, we'd also love to know about your experience building complex financial models, reviewing financial deliverables, or designing financial assessments and business cases.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | AI & Security
descriptionHtml:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Product & Platform) • Paris Office

  • Location: Paris (75002), 2 days remote per week

  • Company: Escape : Leading AI Cybersecurity

  • Compensation: €75–90k base + 0.05% BSPCE depending on seniority and scope

  • Total Engineering Team at Escape: 21 Engineers, 4 Technical Leads, 4 Squads

About Escape

Escape is offensive security for the teams that are 100x outnumbered. We build AI agents that find and exploit vulnerabilities in modern applications, APIs, and microservices: the way a real attacker would, but at the speed of a CI pipeline.

We're a Y Combinator W23 company. We just closed an $18M Series A in March 2026 led by Balderton Capital (with Uncorrelated Ventures, IRIS, and YC following on). Our customers and partners include Zoom, Schibsted, Wiz, Pandadoc, and a growing list of teams who've stopped pretending annual pen tests are enough. We're 40 people split between Paris and NYC, scaling to 80 in the next 12 months.

The product surface is real: ASM, business-logic-aware DAST, and AI Pentesting GA-ing this year. The competitive thesis is that LLMs collapsed the cost of offensive engineering by 1000x, and the companies that ship that capability into production first will own the next decade of the category. We're betting we're those companies.

About the Role

In AI, context is the moat. At Escape, the data model is the context: and a team of three owns it end to end.

Every Escape product (ASM, DAST, AI Pentesting) is built on top of one data model rich enough to represent an entire attack surface and everything our agents learn about it. That model is our moat, and this team owns it. You'll own the schema at the heart of the company and the last mile that delivers our offensive R&D to customers through the GraphQL API and the product UI. If it ships to a customer, it goes through your team.

This is not a CRUD SaaS role in security clothing. It's the highest-leverage seat in product engineering: small team, central surface, and a direct line from your commits to what a CISO sees. "Senior" here means you set technical direction, not just execute it.

What You'll Do

  • Own the data model that is the moat: Design and evolve the schema representing tens of thousands of assets, millions of findings, multi-identity context, and everything our AI accumulates across engagements. This compounds: get it right and the whole platform gets stronger.

  • Turn R&D into Product for customers: Turn the output of our offensive AI research into something teams actually use: through the Svelte frontend, the GraphQL API, integrations, and real-time data refresh. You're the bridge between technology and value.

  • Push PostgreSQL to its edge: Query optimization, index design, pagination, caching, low-latency search over millions of records. The platform is intensely data-driven and the standard playbook runs out fast. This is most of the job.

  • Build AI-native workflows: Guided triage, assisted remediation, signal extraction from noisy scan data. AI is woven through the product, not bolted on: you build the surfaces where it meets the user.

  • Drive architecture: Data modeling, system design, GraphQL schema. You decide how we build, not just what: with a real, un-gimmicky path to Tech Lead.

Our Tech Stack & Focus

Frontend: Svelte + TypeScript, GraphQL client Backend: Node.js, GraphQL (Yoga + Pothos), Prisma, PostgreSQL, Kafka Infra: AWS, GitLab CI, Grafana Adjacent deep tech: Python (AI/ML), Go (network tooling)

Perks & Benefits

  • 💸 Significant equity (Stock Options/BSPCE) – become a core stakeholder in Escape's journey

  • ❤️‍🩹 Top-tier health insurance with Alan

  • 🍕 Meal vouchers with Swile

  • 💪 EGYM Wellpass sport subscription

  • 📚 Continuous learning: budgets for books and online courses

  • 💻 Premium equipment to support your work

  • 🎁 Dedicated time for open-source projects

  • 🌍 Present at top international conferences (RSAC, BlackHat, DEFCON, BSides, APIDays)

About You

  • 5+ years building production web apps, genuinely strong on both frontend and backend

  • Deep TypeScript knowledge: you use the type system to its full potential, you don't just tolerate it

  • Proven experience designing (not just consuming) GraphQL schemas A real passion for product, craft, and design: you care how it feels, not only whether it works

  • Strong ownership: you fix the problem the moment you spot it Excellent communicator: able to explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineering stakeholders

Nice to have:

  • Svelte expertise Security / DevSecOps background Early-stage startup experience

Ready to own the moat of an AI-native security company? Apply now to join Escape and ship offensive security to the teams that need it most.

title: Senior Hardware Certification Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Hardware Certification Engineer with focus on DO-254, you will be an important part of our Certification and Systems Engineering organization, supporting the development and certification of advanced unmanned aircraft systems.

Your main focus will be the development assurance and certification of airborne electronic hardware. You will work closely with Hardware, Systems Engineering, Safety, Verification & Validation and Certification teams to ensure that hardware development and verification activities fulfil the applicable certification objectives.

You will translate certification and safety requirements into practical engineering activities and help ensure that the required compliance evidence is complete, consistent, traceable and ready for review by certification authorities.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Plan, coordinate and support DO-254 / ED-80 hardware certification activities throughout the hardware development lifecycle.

  • Develop, review and maintain certification artefacts such as the Plan for Hardware Aspects of Certification (PHAC), Hardware Verification Plan (HVP), Hardware Configuration Management Plan (HCMP), Hardware Accomplishment Summary (HAS) and supporting compliance evidence.

  • Define and maintain DO-254 compliance matrices and ensure that applicable objectives are addressed by appropriate engineering evidence.

  • Support determination and justification of the applicable Hardware Design Assurance Level (DAL) together with Systems and Safety Engineering.

  • Ensure bidirectional requirements traceability between system requirements, hardware requirements, design data and verification evidence.

  • Review hardware requirements, conceptual and detailed designs, verification activities and lifecycle data against DO-254 objectives.

  • Define and review hardware verification methods, test cases, procedures, analyses and results, including the required level of independence.

  • Support compliance of FPGA, programmable logic, complex electronic hardware and electronic assemblies, as applicable to the individual programme.

  • Assess COTS, reused or previously developed hardware and define appropriate certification and compliance activities.

  • Support configuration management, problem reporting, change control and lifecycle data management required for certification.

  • Perform compliance reviews, gap analyses and change-impact assessments and track findings through closure.

  • Work closely with Hardware Development, Systems Engineering, Safety, Test & Verification and Configuration Management to integrate certification activities into the engineering lifecycle.

  • Support certification reviews, audits and authority engagements and provide clear technical justification for the selected means of compliance.

  • Continuously improve the organisation's DO-254 processes, templates, tooling and certification methods.


What you bring to the team:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering or a comparable technical discipline.

  • Professional experience in airborne electronic hardware development, hardware verification, aerospace certification or development assurance.

  • Strong practical knowledge of RTCA DO-254 / EUROCAE ED-80 and its application to airborne electronic hardware.

  • Experience with hardware certification planning, requirements management, verification and compliance evidence.

  • Good understanding of FPGA / CPLD or complex electronic hardware development, electronic hardware and PCB development, hardware requirements and design reviews, requirements-based verification, configuration management, change control, requirements traceability, verification independence, and COTS or reused hardware assessment.

  • Experience creating or reviewing DO-254 lifecycle documents such as PHAC, HVP, HCMP and HAS is highly desirable.

  • Familiarity with AC 20-152A or comparable authority guidance for airborne electronic hardware is an advantage.

  • Knowledge of related aerospace development and safety standards such as ARP4754A, ARP4761 / ARP4761A and DO-178C is advantageous.

  • Experience working with aviation certification authorities or within a DOA or military airworthiness environment is advantageous.

  • Structured and analytical working style with a strong focus on traceability, evidence and technical correctness.

  • Ability to communicate complex certification requirements effectively to hardware engineers and other engineering disciplines.

  • Fluent English, written and spoken. German language skills are beneficial.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

title: Senior High-Voltage Electrical Design Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As Senior High-Voltage Electrical Design Engineer (all genders) you will lead the electrical design of the battery packs, power distribution units (PDUs), and junction box of the propulsion battery system for VÆRIDION's CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will own everything electrical on and within these units, from cell interconnections and busbars to protection and safety devices, internal HV and LV wiring, and the HV power and LV communication connector interfaces. Through electrical modelling and analysis, you will close the design before it moves to test and provide the engineering evidence that the propulsion battery system is electrically safe, robust, and certifiable.

Within the Airborne Electronics team, you will collaborate with Electronic Hardware Design and Power Electronics, and work closely with the Electrical Systems Architect and the HV Electrical Systems, Mechanical Design & Integration, Thermal Systems, Cell Technology, Safety, and Certification teams to ensure that the design of each unit is fully aligned with the propulsion battery system and the aircraft electrical system. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION's mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the electrical/electrothermal design of HV equipment for an 800 V class propulsion battery system, covering topology, segregation, protection, isolation, precharge, and safe disconnection within each unit.

  • Align the electrical design of each unit with the propulsion battery system and the aircraft electrical system, working closely with the HV Electrical Systems team and the Electrical Systems Architect.

  • Design cell interconnections and busbars as well as develop the cell connection system together with the Mechanical Design & Integration team.

  • Specify and select protection and safety devices, including contactors, fuses, pyrofuses, precharge components, current sensors, manual service disconnects, and the HV interlock loop, working with Airborne Electronics colleagues where solid-state power controllers (SSPCs) are used.

  • Define the HV power and LV communication connector interfaces of each unit together with the HV Electrical Systems team.

  • Lead or support component specification, selection, and supplier engagement depending on the component, together with the responsible teams.

  • Develop or assist with electrical models of the full battery pack to close the design before testing, and support propulsion battery system modeling of performance and failure cases together with the HV Electrical Systems team.

  • Perform electrical/electrothermal analyses, including short-circuit and fault current, protection coordination, insulation coordination, creepage and clearance, partial discharge at altitude, voltage drop, and Joule losses as input to the Thermal Systems team.

  • Own the grounding, bonding, shielding, and EMC design within each unit.

  • Define the physical layout and routing of electrical components together with the Mechanical Design & Integration team.

  • Perform safety analyses such as FMEA for each unit or support the Safety team in system-level safety assessments.

  • Draft test requirements (TRQs) for electrical verification, independently or together with the respective teams as required.

  • Create and maintain schematics, wiring diagrams, requirements, and interface definitions under configuration control, and contribute to design reviews and certification evidence.

 

Your Profile:

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in HV electrical design, preferably in aerospace or automotive battery systems, or other safety-critical industries.

  • Proven experience in the electrical design of HV battery packs, power distribution units, or junction boxes.

  • Strong understanding of HV DC distribution and protection, including contactors, fuses, pyrofuses, precharge circuits, insulation monitoring, HV interlock, and fault coordination.

  • Experience designing busbars and cell interconnections, including current-carrying capacity, thermal derating, and short-circuit withstand.

  • Experience with insulation coordination, creepage and clearance, and partial discharge, ideally for equipment operating at altitude.

  • Proficiency with electrical modeling and analysis tools such as MATLAB/Simulink, Simscape Electrical, PLECS, or equivalent.

  • Proficiency with ECAD tools such as Zuken E3.series, Siemens Capital, EPLAN, SolidWorks Electrical, or equivalent.

  • Experience with grounding, bonding, shielding, and EMC design.

  • Experience writing requirements and test requirements, and correlating analysis results with test data.

  • Experience with safety analyses such as FMEA, FTA, and FHA is desirable.

  • Experience with electronics or PCB design, including flex PCBs, is beneficial.

  • Working proficiency with 3D CAD, such as CATIA, SolidWorks, or Siemens NX, is beneficial.

  • Familiarity with CS-23, DO-160, DO-311A, DO-254, ARP4754A/B, ARP4761/4761A, and IEC 60664-1 is beneficial.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, technical curiosity, and attention to detail.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. German is a plus.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of flight.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

title: Senior Influencer Manager
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Airbnb Communications team drives earned visibility and cultural relevance for the brand, delivering campaigns that support direct traffic, brand love and positive conversation. Our influencer function sits at the intersection of culture, content and community — leading social-first campaigns that inspire travel on Airbnb and strengthen its long-term reputation.

The Difference You Will Make

We're looking for a Senior Influencer Manager to lead Airbnb's influencer programme in theUK, localising regional priorities and delivering campaigns that connect the brand to culturally relevant conversations.

The role covers our full influencer remit: earned and organic creator partnerships, and influencer work running through paid media. You'll own campaigns end to end — creator sourcing, briefing, contracting, measurement and reporting — and help position influencers as both a commercial lever and a long-term driver of brand health, while collaborating with agency partners.

Sitting in the UK Communications team, you'll build influencer into campaign narratives from inception, and partner with Brand Marketing and Paid Media so creator content is designed for amplification from the outset, with usage rights, whitelisting and dark posting permissions secured up front.

This is a hands-on role for someone who knows how to turn brand objectives into content that is authentic, thumb-stopping and earns attention rather than interrupting it.

A Typical Day

  • Own and scale Airbnb's influencer programme in the UK against local, regional and global priorities — timelines, creative execution and performance
  • Deliver across earned, organic and paid influencer work, partnering with the regional Influencer Lead and the UK Brand Marketing and Paid Media teams on creator selection, briefing for amplification, permissions and asset delivery
  • Build influencer into the core campaign narrative and press strategy from inception, with the UK Communications team
  • Identify, vet and build relationships with creators across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube — emerging talent through to established partners — with inclusive, culturally relevant casting
  • Write clear, strategic briefs covering objectives, key messages and content guidelines, and lead onboarding and content reviews against brand standards
  • Partner with legal and agency teams on contracts: deliverables, usage rights, paid media, exclusivity and payment
  • Stay plugged into culture, consumer and media trends — particularly Gen Z — bringing forward creator ideas and campaign hooks, and moving fast on reactive opportunities
  • Manage logistics for influencer stays and experiences, including vetting, Host coordination and credit approvals
  • Track performance across commercial and brand health metrics using CreatorIQ,Sprinklr and Airtable, optimising with the agency and reporting to the regional team
  • Align plans with local Marketing, Partnerships, Affiliate and Growth teams and the global influencer team to avoid duplicated effort
  • Lead day-to-day communication and program operations with our respective UK Influencer agency partners 
  • Identify opportunities with key opinion formers — policy, cultural and news influencers, and third-party validators — for reputation campaigns

Your Expertise

  • 8+ years in communications, influencer marketing, talent partnerships or social-first content strategy
  • Deep knowledge of the UK creator landscape and strong instincts on what resonates and why, across a diverse audience
  • A communications mindset: a track record of building creator partnerships into integrated campaigns, connected to the earned, social and reputation storytelling around them
  • End-to-end campaign experience across organic and paid environments — sourcing, briefing for amplification, dark posting, usage rights, contracting and performance analysis
  • Confident negotiating with creators and managing external agencies and stakeholders across legal, marketing and comms
  • Strong writing, particularly briefs and content feedback
  • Familiarity with influencer tools (CreatorIQ, Sprinklr or similar tooling platforms) and reporting that quantifies brand health and sentiment, not just reach and engagement
  • Able to run multiple campaigns and creators at once with high attention to detail
  • Belief in influencer as a driver of long-term brand equity, not just short-term performance

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

United Kingdom Annual Pay Range£72,000—£90,000 GBP

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Senior Infrastructure Manager
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Manager who is, first and foremost, a people leader.

In this role, your primary responsibility is the health, performance, and career growth of your engineering team. While you must possess a solid technical background to understand the challenges your team faces, your day-to-day focus will not be hands-on technical work. Instead, you will use your experience to remove blockers, guide decision-making, and ensure your engineers have the environment they need to succeed.

The Team You Will Lead

You will lead the Infrastructure Solutions team within the wider Technical Operations department. Your engineers are responsible for building the environment, delivering projects as requested by Engineering and Product, and ensuring we remain available, scalable, and secure. They are not responsible for the BAU function of the platforms that is managed by another team within Technical Operations. The Infrastructure Solutions team takes a concept or idea and makes that into a reality within the boundaries and constraints of our platforms.

You will be managing a team of engineers who individually possess experience in:

  • On-Premise Linux systems, Container solutions, Debian packaging, Ansible, data streaming and queuing technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
  • Advanced database management knowledge (MySQL, Postgres) in replicated environments.
  • Physical Network management, with an on-prem estate that is Juniper focused.
  • Cloud environments: GCP and AWS
  • Platform engineer focused on building, maintaining and supporting an Internal Developer Platform (CI/CD)

The Operational Reality

It is important to be transparent about the environment you are joining. We operate at high velocity with a broad and complex technology estate. However, we are a lean team, not a giant corporation with endless resources.

  • Context Switching is the Norm
    • You will rarely have the luxury of focusing on a single task for weeks at a time. You will be required to shift focus multiple times a week, and sometimes multiple times a day, as business priorities evolve.
  • Agility over Silos
    • Because we are a lean team, we wear many hats. You must be comfortable pivoting from a strategic discussion to an operational challenge without losing momentum.
  • Focus Management
    • Success in this role requires the ability to maintain high standards while navigating a workload that changes dynamically. This is not a role for those who prefer a slow, singular focus; it is for those who thrive on variety, pace, and solving complex problems in real-time.

As the Senior Infrastructure Manager, You Will:

People Leadership & Talent Development

  • Team Management
    • Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of infrastructure engineers. Conduct weekly 1-2-1s, manage performance reviews, and handle all aspects of people management.
  • Formal Training & Growth
    • Go beyond ad-hoc mentoring to schedule and lead formal training sessions regarding operational improvements. Actively create professional development plans for your direct reports.
  • Recruitment & Retention
    • Own the hiring process for your team, ensuring we attract top talent and maintain a supportive, inclusive culture.
  • Culture of Learning
    • Foster a "Self-Learner" mindset. Create a transparent environment where failures are treated as learning opportunities and documented as such for future reference.

Strategic & Operational Management

  • Budget & Capacity Planning
    • Ability to own your team's budget and lead capacity planning initiatives. You will forecast future infrastructure needs to ensure we remain scalable while managing spend for subscriptions and hardware.
  • Risk & Contingency
    • Proactively identify operational risks and form contingency plans immediately to ensure business continuity.
  • Procedure & Frameworks
    • Ability to define, maintain, and cascade operational procedures (SOPs) and ITIL standards.
  • Prioritisation
    • Shield your team from noise by effectively prioritising workloads (Changes, Problems, and Projects) and managing stakeholder expectations.

Technical Support & Oversight

  • Performance Optimisation
    • Measure and optimise system performance with a focus on improving reliability and time-to-market. You will drive innovation to get ahead of internal customer needs rather than just reacting to them.
  • Visual Documentation
    • Ensure the team produces detailed system design documentation, specifically enforcing the inclusion of visual representations to support understanding. Ability to technologically assess it as a technical editor.
  • Hybrid Estate Management
    • Ability to oversee the management of both On-Premise and Cloud (GCP/AWS), ensuring high availability across all environments.
  • Unblocking Issues
    • Act as the senior escalation point for complex technical issues. Your goal is not to fix the issue yourself, but to coordinate the right resources and provide air cover.

General Duties

On-Call DutiesWillingness to participate in the Management On-Call Rotation to support the department and the business (Current frequency: Once every three weeks). Ad-HocCarry out other strategic or technical duties required to support the Director/VP of Technical Operations.

Essential Knowledge, Skills, and Experience

Leadership & Management Competencies

  • Proven Management Experience
    • Significant experience leading a technical team, with a specific focus on the people management aspect (performance reviews, career growth etc).
  • Project Management
    • Strong project management experience with the ability to delegate effectively to meet tight deadlines. You must be able to multitask and maintain focus in a high-priority environment.
  • Communication
    • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You must be able to liaise effectively with management and other business areas. Engagement may also include interactions with senior technical engineers/leaders within other teams and C-Team members.
  • Goal Oriented
    • You must be highly goal-oriented with strict attention to detail, capable of prioritising workload and demand to ensure targets are met.
  • ITIL Application / Lean Six Sigma
    • Deep knowledge of and experience with ITIL practices, with the ability to apply them to improve team workflows. Demonstrated ability to apply Lean Six Sigma concepts.

Technical Environment & Team Capabilities

Focusing on the technical skills that your engineers possess, it would be ideal if you had a decent working knowledge of each of the areas. Hands-on expertise in every area is not required, but the ability to hold and facilitate discussions, know when to push or hold back and when to ask poignant questions will help you effectively mentor the team and guide architectural decisions.

For reference from above these areas are: on-prem and AWS/GCP solutions; system design from network to application level; resilient database availability strategies; automation and configuration management via Ansible, Docker and CI/CD; programming awareness in Python; Linux administration.

Your willingness to learn what you don't know is required to succeed in this role and we will support you through that journey.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills, and Experience

The following skills or experiences are advantageous but not strictly required. They would be utilised for facilitating tasks rather than for direct, hands-on implementation.

  • Innovation & Debt Management
    • A keen interest in new technologies and innovation, specifically supporting development teams in the refactoring of technical debt.
  • Advanced Containerization
    • Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and container ecosystems.
  • Observability
    • Experience with monitoring systems (e.g., Zabbix, Grafana) and logging stacks (Elasticsearch, Kibana).
  • Data Streaming
    • Experience with data streaming and queuing technologies, specifically Apache Kafka and Druid.
  • Web & Storage
    • Knowledge of Nginx (or other web server technologies) and storage technologies like Gluster.
  • Tooling
    • Proficiency with JIRA and Confluence for project tracking and documentation.
  • Version Control
    • strong understanding of Git and version control best practices.

Why This Role?

If you are an experienced technical leader who finds more satisfaction in growing people and building high-performing teams than in closing tickets yourself, this is the role for you. You will have the autonomy to shape the culture of the Infrastructure function and the strategic backing to make a real impact on the business

This role operates on a hybrid basis and requires attendance in our Newcastle office once a week. While some flexibility may be discussed, applicants should be willing and able to work from the office as part of the role.

UK Benefits & Perks

  • 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year
  • Private Medical Insurance through Vitality
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Cycle to Work scheme
  • Eye Care Vouchers
  • Life Assurance
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program
  • Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

title: Senior Integrated Marketing Manager (Global Campaigns)
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it's a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

We're looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Brand Integrated Marketing to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us take ideas from global strategy through to local activation across markets, delivering integrated campaigns that drive measurable business growth.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Integrated Marketing team. We own the Deliveroo brand globally and lead our biggest campaign moments. Working in a cross-functional squad alongside strategic teams, functional leads, and local markets, we turn big ideas into high-impact campaigns across our markets.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Framework & Playbook Development: Design, scale, and maintain measurement frameworks, playbooks, and systems that enable global and local teams to execute best-in-class brand campaigns.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with cross-functional squads, strategic teams, functional leads, and local market leads to align campaign strategies with core business goals.

  • Stakeholder Management: Influence senior stakeholders across the global organisation without direct authority, ensuring alignment on messaging, execution, and performance metrics.

  • Strategic Optimisation: Balance tactical execution with a longer-term strategic perspective to solve complex marketing briefs and continuously optimize brand performance.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Integrated Brand Leadership: Proven experience leading end-to-end global integrated marketing campaigns from initial strategy through to local market activation.

  • Framework Development: Strong track record in establishing measurement frameworks, campaign playbooks, and operational systems that scale across multiple regions.

  • Stakeholder Influence: Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior cross-functional stakeholders and matrix teams without direct line management authority.

  • Strategic & Tactical Execution: Proven ability to operate independently on complex or ambiguous briefs, balancing day-to-day execution with longer-term brand strategy.

  • Commercial Acumen: Strong expertise in linking brand initiatives and marketing campaigns directly to measurable business growth and commercial impact.

Nice to Have

  • Experience navigating three-sided marketplace dynamics or fast-paced consumer tech environments.

  • Background working across international or multi-market structures.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

About BeReal

At BeReal, we are dedicated to authenticity in social media. By encouraging users to share unfiltered moments, we foster genuine connections and celebrate real life. We are now an international team of 70+ and have 40M+ monthly active users. Backed by Voodoo, our team is fully focused on scaling BeReal into an iconic social network used by hundreds of millions.

Role

We are looking for a talented iOS Engineer to join our Monetization team, where you will focus on building and optimizing revenue-generating features while maintaining the authentic experience that makes BeReal special.

You will be responsible for:

  • Designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable iOS monetization features (ads formats, sponsored content, premium features) in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

  • Contributing to and upholding best practices in code quality, design, and development processes.

  • Continuously innovating and improving the iOS tech stack (Swift, SwiftUI).

You'll work alongside AI tools that amplify your creativity and streamline your day-to-day.

Profile

  • Strong iOS programming skills (5+ years experience).

  • Solid knowledge in Swift, SwiftUI and UIKit.

  • Familiarity with Clean Architecture principles and separation of concerns.

  • Experience building monetization features, ads products, or consumer-facing products is a strong plus.

  • Ability to understand and debug large, complex codebases.

  • Product mindset with a strong passion for clean interfaces, smooth animations, and interactions.

  • Interest for analytics and data-first mindset to measure impact and iterate.

  • Strong understanding of user experience and ability to balance business goals with product quality.

  • You're highly driven, autonomous, and results oriented.

  • Be fluent in English (French is a plus).

Our Stack

Use the following predefined list:

  • iOS: Swift, Combine, SwiftUI, SPM, Swift Concurrency, MVVM

  • Ops: Github.

  • Android: Kotlin, Compose, Coroutines, Room, gRPC.

  • Backend: Go, Node.js (NestJS, Nx, Typescript).

  • Database: Spanner, PostgreSQL, Redis.

  • Infrastructure: GCP, GKE, Firebase.

  • Data: Amplitude, Tableau.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience

  • Swile Lunch voucher

  • Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)

  • Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office

  • Remote days on Fridays

title: Senior Java Engineer - Core/Infra - Elasticsearch
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is the Role

We are on the lookout for a Senior Java Engineer to join our Elasticsearch team and focus on ensuring that the shared platform functionalities of Elasticsearch are easy to use, performant, maintainable and secure.

The team’s mission is to create foundational infrastructure and shared functionality that enables engineers to develop, extend, and support Elasticsearch. The team owns common functionality such as services, settings and scripting, and makes Elasticsearch extensible through plugins or the Painless scripting language. The team also makes Elasticsearch observable by providing logging and telemetry information. We also own the orchestration of Elasticsearch in serverless, the CI/CD workflows and enable Elasticsearch developers to deliver Elasticsearch to customers - serverless, cloud and on-premise alike.

You will be a strong individual contributor on the team but you will also contribute to and lead cross team projects. We need someone who has great design skills, who can work at a low level of abstraction but can equally drive and communicate technical concepts across a variety of collaborators.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Contributing to large, impactful projects that evolve the core infrastructure that underpins Elasticsearch.
  • Making Elasticsearch developers more productive by identifying and developing opportunities for automation, and integrating agentic apps into development workflows.
  • Designing and implementing new horizontally-scalable features and APIs in Elasticsearch.
  • Solving difficult issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.
  • Improving operation and observability of Elasticsearch cloud systems.

title: Senior Lifecycle Manager
descriptionHtml:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

The Role

Synthesia is growing fast, and lifecycle is how we turn that growth into lasting customer relationships, guiding every user from first signup to real value. Every month we send 150+ emails to 1+ million contacts, and as we launch new products and enter new markets, that scale and its impact on revenue will keep rising.

As Senior Lifecycle Manager, you’ll build one of the most exciting lifecycle programmes in Europe. You’ll own the product-led growth motion after signup: the journeys that turn new users into activated, paying and expanding customers. You’ll build automations triggered by what users do in the product and set the standard for how every customer-facing email Synthesia sends works together as one experience. You’ll partner with Product, Product Marketing and Data teams to build a lifecycle engine that grows with the company.

What You'll Do

  • Customer journeys: Design, build and optimise lifecycle journeys that support customers throughout their experience with Synthesia, from activation, adoption and engagement through to expansion, retention and winback.

  • Lifecycle automation: Own the end-to-end implementation of lifecycle programmes, from audience segmentation and behavioural triggers to workflow logic, suppression rules, QA and performance monitoring.

  • Experimentation: Develop and execute structured experiments to continuously improve lifecycle performance. Test messaging, timing, segmentation and journey design, analyse results and turn learnings into actionable improvements.

  • Data-driven personalisation: Leverage product usage, customer attributes and engagement signals to deliver increasingly relevant lifecycle experiences.

  • Lifecycle quality and deliverability: Own campaign QA and testing processes, support email deliverability and sender reputation and help establish best practices for segmentation, frequency management and customer experience.

  • AI-powered lifecycle: Explore and apply AI to make lifecycle marketing more effective and efficient. From content creation and dynamic personalisation to workflow automation, identify opportunities to improve both the customer experience and how we work.

We’d love to hear from you if you have

  • You deliver impact: You understand how lifecycle marketing contributes to activation, adoption, retention and revenue, and you can demonstrate measurable results from programmes you’ve owned

  • You’re analytical and curious: You use data to understand performance, challenge assumptions and continuously improve what you build

  • You think in customer journeys: You look beyond individual emails to understand the customer experience, identify friction and create relevant, connected communications

  • You’re technically excellent: You’re confident building sophisticated automation, managing complex segmentation and working with customer and product data. You care about the details that make programmes effective and reliable

  • You take ownership: You’re comfortable independently leading initiatives from concept through execution, proactively solving problems and making informed decisions

  • You collaborate naturally: You know how to work across functions, build strong relationships and move complex projects forward without direct authority

  • You care about quality: From deliverability and data accuracy to messaging and customer experience, you hold your work to a high standard

  • You’re excited about AI: You actively explore how emerging technologies can improve personalisation, experimentation and the way lifecycle marketing operates

We’d be particularly excited if

  • 6+ years of experience in lifecycle, CRM or email marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or product-led companies

  • Strong hands-on experience with HubSpot, including complex workflows, list building, segmentation and campaign execution

  • Proven experience building and optimising always-on automated programmes, including onboarding, nurture and re-engagement, alongside one-off campaigns

  • Experience owning lifecycle initiatives end to end, from briefing and journey design to implementation, QA, reporting and optimisation

  • Strong analytical skills, with experience using product, CRM and engagement data to build audiences, evaluate performance and run structured experiments

  • Practical experience using AI to improve lifecycle execution, operational efficiency or customer personalisation

  • Working knowledge of email deliverability, including SPF, DKIM and DMARC, and privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA/CPRA

  • Proven ability to manage complex cross-functional projects and influence stakeholders across different teams

Nice to have

  • Experience with customer data platforms

  • Experience with Salesforce, particularly connecting CRM and account data to lifecycle programmes

  • Experience with in-product messaging and multichannel lifecycle journeys

  • SQL skills for self-serve behavioural analysis and insights

Compensation

We offer a competitive salary, equity and benefits. Your offer will reflect your experience, skills and the scope of the role. The range for this position is £70,000 - £90,000 GBP, and we are open to discussing where you land within it, or beyond it, for exceptional experience.

title: Senior Management & Technology Consultant - Manufacturing/Production
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The position of the Senior Management & Technology Consultant (Internal Title: Senior Value Engineer) is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.

The Role:

You are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers. You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Teams and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.

Native-level German proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in German.

The work you’ll do:

Identify & Frame Value

  • Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases
  • Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers 
  • Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executive

Realize Value

  • Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement
  • Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives
  • Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives

Scale Value

  • Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing
  • Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion
  • Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases

The qualifications you need:

Live for Customer Value: Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.

Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP),  experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Knowledge of Python and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams.

Process Improvement & Value Realization: Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures,  being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value

Project Management: Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.

Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Business Domain Expertise: Understanding of the Finance and/or Supply Chain domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)

Industry Expertise: Ideally expertise in one or more industries (e.g. Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer, Retail, Pharmaceuticals, Chemicals) and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities 

Degree: In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program

Native-level or near-native German language skills (written and spoken), with the ability to confidently engage German-speaking customers, facilitate workshops, and present to executive stakeholders.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters.
