title: Senior Manager, AI Architect
descriptionHtml:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Solutions & AI Lab (SAIL) practice are looking for an experienced AI Architect to join the team. 

Our Solutions & AI Labs practice helps clients control their data, turn it into actionable insight, and better leverage it through AI and Machine Learning solutions embedded directly into business processes. We support clients across a range of industries and offer deep expertise in AI/ML, Cloud, Platform Engineering and Managed Solutions. 

We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager to serve as an AI Architect — someone who can design the end-to-end architecture for enterprise AI platforms, lead consultancy engagements, and grow our AI & Solutions Engineering capability. 

The AI Architect role owns the technical blueprint for AI-enabled solutions delivered in and around our clients’ environments, combining deep architectural specialism with the commercial and leadership skills to shape and grow our practice. This is a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of client advisory, AI platform architecture and hands-on delivery leadership — and who has a genuine passion for bringing AI systems to production at scale. 

What you will be doing

As a Senior Manager and AI Architect, you will own and lead the architecture of complex AI programmes end-to-end — from shaping the opportunity and winning the work, through solution design, delivery governance and team leadership. You will bring SME-level depth in enterprise AI architecture and apply it to create real, lasting value for our clients. 

Although we do not expect you to be an expert in every technology listed below simultaneously, our team consists of people who can advise clients as well as bring deep technical knowledge when needed. Key responsibilities span the following areas. 

Engagement & delivery leadership 

  • Own and lead the architecture of complex AI and data transformation engagements, taking accountability for solution design, quality, technical risk and client outcomes. 
  • Lead and resource multi-disciplinary delivery teams — architects, engineers, data scientists and consultants — providing clear direction, technical oversight and people development. 
  • Manage engagement resourcing: forecast team requirements, work with practice leadership to staff engagements, and develop the talent pipeline through mentoring of junior practitioners. 
  • Proactively identify and manage delivery and architectural risks in complex stakeholder environments, escalating appropriately and maintaining client confidence throughout. 
  • Communicate clearly to both technical teams and senior client stakeholders, translating architectural complexity into actionable insight and decisive recommendation. 
  • Conduct rigorous architecture and design reviews and uphold engineering standards across every engagement you lead. 

Stakeholder management & advisory 

  • Act as a trusted advisor to client architects, CTOs, CDAOs and engineering leads, earning trust through depth of knowledge and a demonstrable delivery track record. 
  • Build and maintain strong, senior client relationships, navigating competing priorities across business, technology and risk functions. 
  • Facilitate architecture workshops and decision forums, driving alignment across diverse stakeholder groups and securing buy-in for target-state designs. 
  • Translate business strategy into architectural roadmaps, sequencing investment and change in a way that balances ambition with deliverability. 

Business development & bid support 

  • Play a leading role in business development: identifying new opportunities, shaping propositions, and supporting or leading bids and tender responses for AI and technology engagements. 
  • Contribute to proposal writing, articulating our capabilities and differentiators, including authoring technical and architecture sections of bid responses to client tenders and RFPs. 
  • Support practice-level growth initiatives, including account planning, capability development, and go-to-market positioning for AI architecture and solutions engineering services.  

Technical architecture — what you will design 

You will be the design authority for enterprise AI platforms, able to reason across the full stack and make credible technology selections. We expect expert-level depth in several of the areas below and working knowledge across the rest. 

AI platform & cloud architecture 

  • Architect AI and Data Platforms using a mix of technologies including Databricks, Snowflake, Claude Enterprise and the native services of Azure, AWS and GCP - selecting the right tool for the workload rather than defaulting to a single vendor. 
  • Design for scalability, security, cost efficiency and multi-cloud / hybrid patterns, with a strong grasp of containerisation, infrastructure-as-code, event-driven architectures and CI/CD. 
  • Balance technical excellence with delivery pragmatism and commercial realities, championing the path from prototype to production. 

Enterprise AI ecosystem integration 

  • Bring awareness of the broader enterprise landscape and how AI integrates with core operational systems such as SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow and other systems of record and engagement. 
  • Design integration patterns that let AI capabilities interoperate safely with enterprise data, identity, workflow and process automation platforms – including MCP and A2A and how these capabilities enable an enterprise Agent mesh.  
  • Understand the data, governance and change implications of embedding AI into mission-critical enterprise processes. 

Orchestration & control plane 

  • Architect the orchestration and control-plane layer that governs how AI capabilities are exposed, routed and managed across the enterprise. 
  • Design MCP, AI and LLM gateway layers for secure, observable and policy-controlled access to models and tools. 
  • Design agent and skills registries — including recommending suitable technologies and patterns — to enable discovery, reuse and governance of agentic capabilities. 
  • Define the control plane for routing, rate limiting, cost management, model selection and version control across multiple model providers. 

AI solution design 

  • Design retrieval and reasoning architectures including RAG, corrective RAG (CRAG), and agentic patterns, selecting the right approach for a given business problem. 
  • Architect agent harnesses and their components — planning, memory, tool use, state management and multi-agent coordination. 
  • Design prompt strategies, context management and grounding approaches for reliable, production-grade LLM behaviour. 

Evaluation, guardrails & responsible AI 

  • Design evaluation frameworks and guardrails that make AI systems safe, reliable and measurable — covering accuracy, safety, bias, and task success. 
  • Embed responsible-AI and governance controls aligned to emerging regulation and client risk appetites. 
  • Define human-in-the-loop and fallback strategies for high-stakes use cases. 

Observability & operations 

  • Architect logging, monitoring, tracing and cost-observability across the AI stack, including model, agent and platform telemetry. 
  • Design for drift detection, performance monitoring and continuous evaluation in production (LLMOps / MLOps). 
  • Establish operational patterns for reliability, incident response and lifecycle management of AI systems at scale. 

 
Your skills and experience  

We're seeking a technically credible, commercially aware leader who brings a rare combination of architectural depth, delivery accountability and client advisory skill — someone energised by the complexity of taking AI solutions to production at scale. 

  • 7+ years in technology consulting, architecture or AI/ML engineering, with at least 3 years in a senior leadership or lead-architect role — including accountability for end-to-end solution design, resourcing and commercial outcomes. 
  • Proven ability to architect enterprise AI platforms across a mix of technologies (Databricks, Snowflake, Azure, AWS, GCP) with strong design capability across cloud, data and AI domains. 
  • Working understanding of how AI integrates with major operational systems such as SAP, Salesforce and ServiceNow. 
  • Hands-on knowledge of agentic AI, LLM gateways, MCP, RAG/CRAG, agent harnesses, evaluations and guardrails, and AI observability. 
  • Demonstrable experience designing and leading data & AI transformation programmes, and building high-performing teams in complex stakeholder environments — engaging comfortably at CTO, CDAO or engineering-director level. 
  • Track record of supporting or leading bid and proposal activity, including writing technical and architecture sections of responses to tenders and RFPs. 
  • A clear, confident communicator able to make the complex accessible for technical and non-technical audiences alike. 
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science or a related discipline, or equivalent depth through relevant certifications (e.g. AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Google Professional ML Engineer, Databricks / Azure / GCP architecture credentials). 

Industry experience 

We would particularly like to hear from people who have designed and led data & AI transformation programmes across one or more of the following sectors: 

  • Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) 
  • Retail 
  • Pharmaceuticals & Life Sciences 
  • Manufacturing 
  • Financial Services 
  • Government and Public Services  

Prior experience as an embedded or forward-deployed architect within a client environment, and exposure to regulated industries would be desired. 

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure

title: Senior ML Compiler Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

The Role

We are looking for Senior ML Compiler Engineers with experience in machine learning compilation to work on the compiler stack for our ground-breaking AI accelerators. You can be based in our Bristol office or London.

Fractile isn't another AI startup gluing together frameworks. We are designing a full-stack execution engine: hardware, compiler, runtime, to build the world's largest language models 100 x faster than today's systems. That ambition forces us to rethink everything from first principles.

For compiler engineers, this is a rare moment: the architecture is still being shaped. The IR, the lowering strategy, the optimisation passes, the execution model - you get to define its future.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop the machine learning compiler stack for Fractile’s innovative AI acceleration hardware

  • Enable industry-leading performance of the latest LLMs on Fractile’s accelerators

  • Work with hardware, driver runtime, and ML engineers in a highly collaborative hardware-software co-design methodology

It would be great if you have:

  • Proven experience of the development of machine learning compilers using industry standard technologies such as MLIR or TVM

  • Up-to-date knowledge of machine learning techniques and technologies

  • A good understanding of computer architecture and performance optimisation techniques

  • Excellent C/C++ skills and solid experience of industry standard development tools and technologies

  • An creative and innovative mindset, and a willingness to take ownership and drive results in a fast-paced environment

  • Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Maths, Physics, or related degree and 4+ years of industry experience

You may also have:

  • Previous experience in a startup or small team environment

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

descriptionHtml:
Intermate x SAMY – Shaping the State of Social

Intermate gehört zu den größten Social-Media- und Influencer-Agenturen im DACH-Raum. Mit mehr als 250 Mates in Berlin, Hamburg, Köln und Remote entwickeln wir Social-First-Strategien, produzieren Content in eigenen Studios, arbeiten eng mit Creator:innen zusammen und steuern Kampagnen datengetrieben über unsere eigene Technologie. Unsere Kund:innen sind einige der bekanntesten Marken der Welt – von Lifestyle über FMCG bis hin zu Tech.

Als Teil von SAMY, einem globalen Agenturnetzwerk für Social Media und Creator Marketing, sind wir mit über 970 Expert:innen an 20 Standorten vernetzt. Das eröffnet internationale Perspektiven, Projekte in rund 55 Märkten und die Möglichkeit, dich weit über Ländergrenzen hinweg weiterzuentwickeln.

WAS DU MACHST

  • Du entwickelst und animierst Video-Ads und Social-Formate in After Effects — von der Typo-Animation bis zur komplexen, mehrschichtigen Szene — und bringst sie in Premiere Pro in einen Schnitt, der werblich funktioniert.

  • Du kombinierst gefilmtes Material mit generierten Elementen: Freistellen, Rotoskopieren, Tracken, Keyen, bis der Übergang unsichtbar ist.

title: Senior National Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Practical Detail
Location: Hybrid | Remote

Why this role matters
In your first year, you will deliver an ambitious growth plan for Flora Food Group's largest customer, Bidfood, driving both sales and margin across the full P&L. This role is critical to strengthening Flora's position in the food service market by embedding a joint business plan that aligns Flora's brand priorities with Bidfood's commercial strategy. You will shape how our brands are listed, promoted, and grow within a key account that influences menus and food trends across the UK. Your work will directly impact the availability and innovation of better food in kitchens nationwide.

What you'll do

  • Own the Bidfood P&L, managing pricing, promotions, trade spend, and trade promotion management accruals to achieve sales and margin growth.
  • Lead the joint business plan and negotiate annual trading terms to ensure Flora's brands are well positioned and invested in.
  • Build and maintain relationships across all levels of Bidfood, from senior buyers to depot and logistics teams, to improve service and unlock commercial opportunities.
  • Deliver new product development and innovation launches on time and at the right price, collaborating closely with culinary and new business teams.
  • Champion the push-pull strategy by engaging Bidfood's end users—contract caterers, pubs, hotels, restaurants and Quick Serve Restaurants (QSR) — to grow brand presence and volume.

Performance
You will own the full P&L for the Bidfood account, driving measurable growth in sales and margin while managing trade spend within budget. Your leadership of the joint business plan will ensure alignment between Flora's brand ambitions and Bidfood's commercial goals. Success will be seen in improved brand listings, timely innovation launches, and strong trading terms that support sustainable growth.

Care
You will report directly to Helen Scott and collaborate with internal teams including new business, culinary, supply chain, and demand planning to ensure seamless service delivery. Externally, you will engage with multiple Bidfood functions such as buying, logistics, marketing, and category teams. Your decisions will balance commercial ambition with operational integrity, supporting a lean team environment during a period of organisational change.

Passion
Bidfood is at the heart of food service trends, where culinary culture is shaped. You will connect Flora's innovation pipeline directly to the chefs and kitchens that bring our products to life. Your role will influence how plant-based, indulgent, and culinary food categories evolve in the out-of-home market. Your curiosity about taste, nutrition, and functionality will drive meaningful innovation and brand growth.

About you
You'll bring solid food service experience, ideally managing Bidfood, Brakes, or Booker accounts, with a deep understanding of this route to market. You are commercially rigorous, confident in owning a P&L, and skilled at negotiating assertively while maintaining productive relationships. You sell on brand value, not price, and thrive in a fast-changing, lean environment. Your resilience and solution-oriented mindset help you navigate complex commercial and cultural challenges. You are genuinely interested in food culture and curious about how consumer behaviour and future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition, and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences.

Where this could lead to
This role typically leads to broader commercial leadership opportunities within Flora Food Group, including potential European roles as the business integrates into a larger unit. There is also scope to move into retail or new business functions. With success, you may take on direct reports and progress into senior management positions within 2 to 3 years.

What's next
If this opportunity sounds exciting, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply before: 31-Oct-2026
For questions about the role, please contact:
Richard ----- class="content-conclusion">

title: Senior netwerk infrastructuur engineer
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij, met inzet van moderne technieken, zorg dragen voor het fysieke en virtuele netwerk van het CBS en hiermee de beschikbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid maximaliseren? Heb je daarnaast affiniteit met het automatiseren van beheer en hersteltaken? Dan biedt het CBS jou een unieke kans!

Waar jij het verschil maakt

  • Je levert en ontwikkelt diensten op basis van virtuele netwerktechnieken en beheert en onderhoudt deze;

  • Je zorgt voor de continuïteit van het CBS door het fysieke netwerk te onderhouden, te ontwikkelen en te beheren, zowel in het datacenter als op kantoorlocaties.

  • Je werkt aan de bescherming van onze omgeving middels beheer van firewalls, microsegmentatie, proxy servers en application delivery controllers;

  • Je werkt aan het maximaal automatiseren van beheertaken en het bieden van autonomie aan afnemende teams

  • Je hebt affiniteit met het aanbieden van infrastructuurdiensten als selfservice en door middel van ‘Infrastructure-as-Code’.

Je toekomstige collega's

Je werkt in het Team IaaS van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur (IGI). We opereren middels een Agile methodiek, in combinatie met ITIL. Een actieve bijdrage wordt verwacht in het succes van deze werkmethode, dit uit zich oa in het opstellen van kwalitatief goede story’s en Epics, het actueel houden van jouw story’s op het Azure DevOps bord, actieve en constructieve deelname aan events als dag-starts, planning, review en retrospectives.
De totale omvang van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur is ongeveer 30 experts die werkzaam zijn in Heerlen en Den Haag. Het IaaS Team bestaat uit ca 15 collega’s die in Heerlen en Den Haag werkzaam zijn. Plezier in het werk vinden we belangrijk en dat is dan ook verankerd in onze kernwaarden.

Dit ben jij

Je bent gericht op het continu verbeteren: je signaleert, adviseert, voert uit, reflecteert en pakt de regie en verantwoordelijkheid, zo zien we je graag.

Daarnaast verwachten wij dat je:

  • Aantoonbare ervaring hebt op het gebied van het beheer van complexe netwerken

  • Informatieveiligheid altijd on top of mind hebt,

  • Ruime ervaring hebt met het automatiseren van infrastructuurdienstverlening.

  • Kennis en ervaring hebt met netwerkvirtualisatie ingezet ten behoeve van selfservice.

  • Bedreven bent met het werken op een iteratieve wijze, waarbij producten worden afgestemd op de klantvraag,

  • Je kunt verplaatsen in gebruikers van onze IT-diensten en vanuit dat perspectief probleemoplossend te werk gaan.

  • Ben je ervaren met Terraform/Ansible en DevOps pipelines om infrastructuurdiensten als code beschikbaar te stellen? Dan maken we graag gebruik van die kennis en ervaring.

Feitelijk goed geregeld

Voor onze arbeidsvoorwaarden volgen wij de CAO Rijk. Dat betekent dat je onder andere kunt rekenen op het volgende:

  • Een salaris van minimaal € 4132,- en maximaal € 6275,- bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur. Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. Als je bij de start van je functie nog niet over alle benodigde kennis en ervaring beschikt, kan worden gekozen voor tijdelijke inschaling in een lagere salarisschaal. Hierover maak je bij de start van je functie afspraken met je leidinggevende.

  • 8% vakantiegeld en een 13e maand. In totaal is dit 16,5% bovenop je salaris. Dit noemen wij het Individueel Keuze Budget (IKB). Je bepaalt zelf hoe, wanneer en op welke manier je dit budget wilt inzetten.

  • Pensioenopbouw bij het ABP Pensioenfonds.

  • Een laptop (Microsoft of Apple) en mobiele telefoon (Android of iOS).

  • Twee tot drie dagen thuiswerken, de rest ben je aanwezig in ons onlangs gerenoveerde gebouw. In je team maak je daar verder afspraken over.

Kom werken aan de feiten

We sluiten de vacature bij voldoende kandidaten.

title: Senior Partner Account Executive, UK - Insurance
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role:

We are looking for a strategic and results-driven Senior Partner Account Executive to launch, scale, and optimise partnerships across our ecosystem with a focus on insurance carriers and brokers. Samsara's telematics and dashcam technology already help thousands of customers improve safety and reduce risk - this role will accelerate those benefits by developing high-impact partnerships that drive mutual growth.

You will be the face of Samsara to insurance executives, building scalable programmes that directly influence customer acquisition, retention, and loss cost improvement. If you thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, are motivated by measurable business impact, and enjoy turning ideas into reality, this is your opportunity to make a difference.

Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

In this role you will:

  • Own and grow our relationships with insurance carriers, brokers and MGAs in the UK
  • Design and run partner programmes that drive customer acquisition, retention and loss-cost improvement - and the Samsara revenue that comes with them
  • Map accounts with partners, pick joint targets and bring Samsara sales into the deals
  • Build the playbook: how we qualify, onboard and scale insurance partnerships

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact - helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your partners are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live. Samsara's top employees do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You want to develop the playbook, not just follow one: Our partner ecosystem is young. You'll define how we take partners to value - from first conversation to joint customers - and build the model that lets those partnerships deliver maximum value for Samsara at scale.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your partners and our customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Strong sales, partnerships, or business development experience, ideally within a B2B technology or insurance-related field and a track record of overachievement.
  • A builder mentality - you thrive in ambiguous environments and know how to create structure, process, and scale.
  • Exceptional relationship management skills, with experience engaging stakeholders from the C-suite to front-line sales teams.
  • A strategic and data-driven mindset, using insights to optimise programmes and drive revenue.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives simultaneously.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working in or with insurance carriers, brokers, or related financial services.
  • Consulting experience, ideally working with insurance companies.

Why Join Samsara?

  • Make an impact: Your work will directly improve safety, efficiency, and sustainability in industries that power the global economy.
  • Work with the best: Join a high-performance, mission-driven team that values collaboration, innovation, and results.
  • Grow with us: We're scaling rapidly, which means new challenges, learning opportunities, and career advancement.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Senior Partner Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR

The Partner Marketing team extends Lovable’s reach by educating, engaging, and enabling partners globally to build market awareness and generate demand for their Lovable-powered solutions and services. We recruit prospective partners and support the onboarding and growth of existing ones as they build, launch, market, and scale their businesses through the Lovable Partner Ecosystem. We work closely with GTM partnerships, product partnerships, sales, and product marketing, and serve partner types from major technology and platform partners to the connectors, agencies, and independent experts who build with Lovable every day.

Why Lovable?

For decades, the ability to build software belonged to a tiny fraction of the population: the people with the credentials, the technical training, the access. Everyone else had to wait, or pay, or give up. Lovable is the counterargument: We exist for the people with ideas who were locked out of software creation until now.

Over 70 million projects have been built on the platform. Hundreds of thousands of people pay for it. The product handles real infrastructure, not only prototypes: authentication, databases, payments, and deployment. People run real businesses on Lovable, which means the stakes are real too.

The comms challenge: when anyone can build, the platform has to be safe for everyone who does, and they need to know it. That takes someone who can tell the story of how we think about topics like safety, security, and reliability before anyone asks, and who can be honest, precise, and fast when the questions come up anyway.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for an experienced, creative, results-oriented marketer to develop and execute partner marketing initiatives across our full partner ecosystem. Connectors and integration partners are the immediate priority: Lovable’s rapidly growing connector roster (spanning search, communications, CRM, and data) needs launches, positioning, and demand generation. You’ll also work with the Lovable Partner Program team to run co-marketing campaigns and programs at scale that drive customer acquisition and activation, helping partners grow their business with and through Lovable.

You’ll set and own Lovable’s marketing with, to, and through partners, and roll up your sleeves to execute across a high-volume, fast-moving roster.

  • Work with GTM Partnerships, Product Partnerships, Sales, and (Product) Marketing to build go-to-market initiatives across connector and integration partners, hyperscalers, and services partners.

  • Define priorities, investment model, scaling mechanisms, and success metrics across partner types, with connectors as the top priority given the roster’s size and growth rate.

  • Own and evolve the tiering framework that governs marketing investment per partner, and keep it workable as the partner count grows.

  • Administer and optimize market development funds (MDF), and build the joint GTM plans needed to fully activate committed co-marketing budgets.

  • Build and run an intake and prioritization system for inbound co-marketing requests from partners.

  • Drive adoption of scalable marketing and enablement programs across the partner base, and represent partner marketing’s needs in the broader GTM and marketing roadmap.

  • Collaborate with GTM teams (including marketing) to ensure partners are represented in initiatives across all regions.

Who you are

Meet the minimum requirements below to be considered. The preferred qualifications are a bonus.

  • 8-10+ years of relevant B2B marketing experience.

  • 3+ years managing partner marketing programs or teams.

  • Experience working with technology, platform, or services partners to build joint marketing plans and run programs that drive new customer acquisition and pipeline.

  • Experience running partner marketing across a large, growing roster (an ISV-style ecosystem with dozens to hundreds of partners).

  • Proven ability to influence partner marketing leadership and align on joint objectives and plans.

  • Experience shaping joint messaging and positioning with partners.

  • Demonstrated experience measuring and improving the ROI of marketing investment in an indirect, partner-led model, including administering MDF.

  • Deep understanding of the partner channel and funnel, sales cycle, and product lifecycle, and what each requires from partner marketing to drive revenue.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience at a dynamic, high-growth tech company.

  • Experience marketing developer tools, APIs, or platform and connector ecosystems.

  • Experience running co-marketing and MDF programs with hyperscalers (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure) or larger tech partners.

title: Senior Pricing Analyst
descriptionHtml:
👋🏻 Hello, we're Laka

You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey...

Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against.

Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month.

Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here.

What have we been up to since then...?

In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had:

🚀 Raised $10.4 million at series B!

🚀 Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK and NL, enabling a choice-based, remote-first way of working

🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places!

🚀 Captured the UK and NL enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering

🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳)

🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like

🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out!

Help us continue to change an outdated industry...

We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company.

🧮 Pricing at Laka

Pricing our Collective is what makes Laka unique, so this role sits at the heart of what we do.

Each month, members pay their share of the Collective's claims and a fee for Laka's services, up to their own cap. A stop loss from our insurers picks up anything above the total of all caps. Pricing it well means keeping the Collective healthy while balancing the interests of our members, Laka and our insurance partners.

We have a fledgling pricing stack that we are looking to advance with your help.

🤘🏼 The role

You'll own pricing across all five markets and both sides of our business. One side is cyclists who buy from us direct. The other is the partners who sell or bundle our cover, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and delivery fleets. It's a broad, hands-on role, working with our Pricing Analyst.

What you'll be getting up to:

  • Define and deliver pricing for our Collective in the UK and Europe: members' caps, rating factors and fees, based on claims frequency and severity by market and segment.
  • Price our partner business, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and fleets, and support our Commercial team on new deals and renewals.
  • Prepare rate reviews and pricing proposals for our insurance partners, and work with them on stop loss and capacity terms.
  • Develop our pricing stack, tools and processes with Engineering and Data.
  • Manage and develop our Pricing Analyst.

You'll be successful by:

  • Reviewing retail and partner pricing across all five markets in your first three months and agreeing priorities with us.
  • Taking the first cap and fee changes live, with proposals our insurers approve first time.
  • Taking our pricing stack to the next level within your first year.

Requirements

🚀 Sound like you?

  • 👉🏻 This role will be a great fit if you:
    • Have 6+ years' experience in insurance pricing, with rate changes you've designed and taken live.
    • Ideally have priced both direct-to-consumer and partner or B2B business: deep in one, credible in the other.
    • Build pricing models in code: GLMs and GBMs in Python, with SQL.
    • Are sharp and commercially minded, balancing growth, retention and profitability.
    • Can explain technical work simply to partners, insurers and our leadership team.
    • Have managed or mentored an analyst and are happy to stay hands-on.
    • Already use AI tools like Claude and Claude Code, or are keen to make them core to how you work.
  • Plus points:
    • Actuarial exams (IFoA, AAG, DAV or Institut des Actuaires): welcome, but not required. We care most about what you've priced.
    • Dutch, German or French.
    • An interest in cycling.

Benefits

🌟 Our perks

🏠 Remote-first way of working - you choose whether you work from home or our beautiful offices in London, Bristol and Amsterdam(we have no minimum expectation of how many days you come in, although we'd love to see your friendly face!)

📈 Share options - we want you to be rewarded for Laka's success - everyone in the business is granted share options when they join

💰 Performance driven scheme - if the company hits its targets, you'll get a cash bonus of 5% of your base salary annually

🌴 Annual leave - 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), with the option to roll over up to 5 days per year

💶 Pension scheme - Laka pays 3% of your base salary into your pension to help you save for the future

💊 Private medical insurance - we’ll give you individual private cover, with the option to add partners & dependants too (at a small cost)

🍽 Lunch on us - £15 every first Wednesday of the month to enjoy lunch on Laka - pop out locally with people in the office, or order-in at home, the choice is yours

💃 Company-wide events - we love getting everyone together as much as possible - expect regular events throughout the year, for team building, bonding, and general good old-fashioned fun!

🎳 Monthly socials - as if quarterly company events weren't enough, we also give each office a budget for a monthly social activity (think anything from low-key dinner & drinks through to adventure golf, paddleboarding, bowling, electric darts, trampoline parks and more!)

👚 Laka swag - we'll give you some lovely Laka kit to get you started, including a jumper & t-shirts so you can feel (& look) like part of the family

🚴 Laka credit - for all you cyclists, we'll give you £10 credit per month towards insuring your bike(s) with us - plus give you access to a bunch of cycling industry discounts

🧠 Mental health support - unlimited support via Spill, including one-to-one therapy sessions

🌈 Belonging at Laka

We're fast becoming a global community of people and we believe each person's unique qualities should be celebrated as they are a huge part of what makes Laka a great place to be. title: Senior Principal ASIC Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Astera Labs (NASDAQ: ALAB) provides rack-scale AI infrastructure through purpose-built connectivity solutions. By collaborating with hyperscalers and ecosystem partners, Astera Labs enables organizations to unlock the full potential of modern AI. Astera Labs’ Intelligent Connectivity Platform integrates CXL®, Ethernet, NVLink, PCIe®, and UALink™ semiconductor-based technologies with the company’s COSMOS software suite to unify diverse components into cohesive, flexible systems that deliver end-to-end scale-up, and scale-out connectivity. The company’s custom connectivity solutions business complements its standards-based portfolio, enabling customers to deploy tailored architectures to meet their unique infrastructure requirements. Discover more at www.asteralabs.com.

Senior Principal ASIC Design Engineer

Location: Germany (on-site)

Role Overview

Astera Labs is building purpose-built silicon for rack-scale AI infrastructure. As a Distinguished Engineer, you will be a senior technical leader driving ASIC design for next-generation Ethernet and Scale-Up (ESUN) connectivity products.

You will set technical direction across the full ASIC design flow, spanning high-speed Ethernet, UALink, UCIe, and PCIe Gen 6/7. You will solve complex scale-up networking challenges, mentor senior engineers, and turn ambitious product goals into robust, manufacturable silicon.

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Define and drive ASIC architecture for Ethernet/ESUN connectivity products across UALink, UCIe, PCIe Gen 6/7, and Ethernet.
  • Lead architecture and microarchitecture for high-performance Ethernet controllers, MACs, NIC datapaths, packet processing pipelines, and AI interconnect fabrics.
  • Define scalable, low-latency, high-bandwidth data movement, scheduling, buffering, congestion management, QoS, reliability, and flow control.
  • Architect hardware acceleration for NIC functions, RDMA, DMA, virtualization, and protocol offloads.
  • Lead tradeoff analysis across performance, power, area, latency, scalability, resiliency, and programmability.
  • Serve as a technical authority across digital, networking, and system domains.

ASIC Design & Execution

  • Lead RTL design and microarchitecture development for Ethernet controllers, MACs, NIC datapaths, protocol engines, and AI networking subsystems.
  • Design packet processing architectures, DMA engines, queue management, scheduling, buffering, and memory subsystem interfaces.
  • Develop hardware mechanisms for RDMA, zero-copy data movement, congestion control, transport reliability, and protocol acceleration.
  • Design scalable architectures supporting virtualization, multi-tenant isolation, traffic management, and quality of service.
  • Partner with firmware and software teams to define hardware/software interfaces for initialization, management, telemetry, performance monitoring, and diagnostics.
  • Drive execution from architecture through RTL, integration, verification, tapeout, and post-silicon bring-up.
  • Partner cross-functionally to meet performance, timing, power, area, manufacturability, and reliability targets.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • 12+ years of ASIC/SoC design experience, with a track record of delivering complex, high-speed networking or connectivity silicon from architecture through production.
  • Deep expertise in RTL design and microarchitecture for high-performance networking and connectivity ASICs.
  • Extensive experience designing Ethernet controllers, MACs, NIC architectures, packet processing engines, or network interface subsystems.
  • Strong understanding of RDMA architectures and transport protocols such as RoCE, InfiniBand concepts, or similar low-latency networking technologies.
  • Experience designing hardware for packet parsing, scheduling, buffering, DMA, queue management, flow control, congestion management, and transport acceleration.
  • Strong understanding of high-speed interconnects and protocols, including Ethernet, PCIe, and AI scale-up fabrics.
  • Hands-on experience across the complete ASIC development flow, including architecture, RTL design, integration, synthesis, timing closure, physical implementation, tapeout, and post-silicon validation.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership across multiple teams and product programs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Direct experience with UALink, UCIe, PCIe Gen 6/7, and/or advanced Ethernet architectures and protocols.
  • Experience designing Ethernet MACs, controllers, SmartNICs, DPUs, NICs, switch datapaths, or packet processing engines.
  • Experience developing Ethernet-based scale-up networking solutions for AI and HPC systems.
  • Experience leading architecture or design for multiple successful advanced-node ASIC tapeouts.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and mentorship skills.

title: Senior/Principal DFT Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and define the DFT architecture for a large AI accelerator SoC (scan, compression, MBIST, LBIST, boundary scan)

title: Senior Product Designer EMEA
descriptionHtml:
WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity.

Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures.

The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In.

We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Product Designer at WunderGraph, you are the connection between what our users will find most helpful and what our engineers build. Considering the users also happen to be other developers, this becomes an interesting challenge to think about the Developer Experience as the User Experience. You combine sharp user insight, craft, and pragmatism to deliver experiences that are elegant, usable, and built to scale.

This is a wide-reaching role, as design roles at a startup should be. One week you might be running user interviews to shape a new feature; the next, refining our design system or designing a marketing landing page. You ground your work in evidence rather than assumption, partner closely with product and engineering, and turn what you learn about users into a clear, informed UX strategy that guides where we go next.

TEAM INTEGRATION

  • Reports to the VP of Product; is part of the Product team

  • Aligns closely with the CEO (Product) and Head of Customer Success (customer experience and business impact)

  • Collaborate within the Product team with the Delivery Lead and the Design Engineer

  • Collaborates cross-functionally with engineering, marketing, product, and customer success

ROLE OBJECTIVES

You are successful if you:

  • Take ownership of the complete design lifecycle, bridging the gap between initial discovery and final delivery for web and product interfaces.

  • Cultivate an evidence-based UX strategy that leverages user research and data to steer the product's evolution.

  • Oversee the growth of a unified and extensible design system that spans both our product and marketing efforts.

  • Convert user insights and organizational objectives into pragmatic, human-centric solutions engineered for long-term scalability.

  • Advocate for excellence in accessibility, responsiveness, and performance as fundamental pillars of your craft.

  • Provide mentorship to the team, sharing expertise in research methodologies and design principles.

  • Refine the visual and functional identity of WunderGraph through meticulous and high-impact design work.

  • Impact high-level product strategy by demonstrating how user-focused decisions drive tangible business impact.

ROLE TASKS

The role focuses on, but is not limited to:

Product Design

  • Design and prototype user flows, interfaces, and interactions with scalability in mind.

  • Own design problems end to end. From initial concept through execution and iteration after launch.

  • Rapidly produce wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs, exploring multiple concepts and iterating quickly.

  • Define and evolve our design system and component library, keeping it consistent and maintainable.

  • Partner closely with engineers on feasibility, quality, and handoff, contributing to technical decisions (and coding where you're comfortable and it helps as a plus, not a requirement).

  • Introduce advanced prototyping, interaction design, and motion practices.

UX Research & Strategy

  • Plan and conduct user research across discovery and validation via user interviews, surveys, usability testing, and competitor analysis.

  • Turn ambiguous product questions into decision-grade research that maps to real product and design decisions.

  • Synthesize findings into clear insights, personas, journey maps, and opportunity areas that the team can act on.

  • Build and maintain a shared insight repository so learning is reusable, searchable, and available to everyone.

  • Translate research into an informed, evolving UX strategy that guides the roadmap and anchors design direction in real user needs.

  • Advocate for the user in prioritization and roadmap discussions, and define what "better" looks like through clear UX success metrics.

  • Run discovery workshops and share insights so research shows up where decisions are made like in design reviews, product planning, and standups embedding user knowledge from the get-go.

Web & Brand Experience

  • Own the design and evolution of WunderGraph's web presence.

  • Deliver assets that span product and marketing: landing pages, visuals, campaign graphics, and interactive components.

  • Shape and maintain a cohesive style guide, balancing design innovation with consistency.

  • Support brand storytelling with motion graphics and interactive elements.

ROLE REQUIREMENTS

  • Senior-level experience in Product Design or UX/UI Design, with a strong portfolio of shipped work.

  • Proven experience planning and running UX research (both generative and evaluative) and turning findings into strategy.

  • Proficiency in Figma, prototyping tools, and Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Strong background in UX and interaction design, accessibility, responsive design, and usability.

  • Experience contributing to or leading design systems and component libraries.

  • Comfortable using data and research to inform and defend design decisions.

  • Working knowledge of front-end technologies (HTML/CSS, JavaScript a plus) enough to collaborate closely with engineers.

  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and collaboration skills in English.

  • A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity and can lead initiatives independently in a fast-moving startup.

  • Comfortable working 100% remotely in a distributed team.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for team retreats and workshops.

Why WunderGraph?

  • Work from wherever you thrive—we’re fully remote and globally distributed. If you're in Miami, come work with us in person! We also provide co-working space options worldwide if needed.

  • Pick your preferred work hardware

  • We focus on getting stuff done, and on having fun whilst doing so: work hard, play hard!

  • You can make a real difference and find lots of opportunities to grow together with us

  • Discretionary PTO: take the time you need to recharge

  • Competitive compensation

  • Team retreats across the globe

Note: This is a full-time, fully remote position, but we're prioritising candidates from EMEA. We are looking for someone who is available to work during European (CET) business hours.

The Process

We respect your time and interest in WunderGraph. This is why we're aiming to make the process as fast as possible. Here's what you can expect:

  • 30 min intro call with Mariya from our People team

Our process also includes reference and background checks. We aim to respond or provide feedback in 2 or 3 days between each stage of the process. We're usually hiring through Deel as our Employer of Record, except for Germany or Florida where we're hiring directly.

WunderGraph Public Handbook and Resources

The Role

We are looking for someone who is curious about the domain: what the process is, where people struggle, what is worth solving and how and then solutionise what is worth building using technology. 

This is an opportunity to redefine the role of design for a world experiencing constant AI disruption. A world where human judgement, empathy, systems thinking, and creativity become the real differentiators, while AI accelerates the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). 

You will work closely with CXOs, product owners, engineers and data scientists to co-own the product vision and help them craft the path forward. Within the team, you will drive ambiguity towards real, valuable outcomes through design.

You will own and shape the product direction, challenge weak assumptions and stay close to implementation. You will leverage your collective experience as a design practitioner in this entire journey for driving impact on the client side. You will craft ‘new ways of working‘ from a design perspective with the influx of AI.

We are not looking for someone whose primary focus is making requirements turned into artefacts, make things look polished or pixel-perfect.

The Expectation

You're comfortable across the full design lifecycle, but you're exceptional at the parts that make it land: sharp problem framing, design that ships, and AI-accelerated craft.

Consulting with Delivery in mind: Challenging the ask and ideating intervention that matters, and seeing them through.

  • Turn ambiguous client asks into well-framed problems, prioritised opportunities and practical delivery plans.
  • Challenge assumptions, agreed scope and propose solutions constructively, using evidence and arguments to help clients choose the new scope 
  • Pitch, consult and negotiate design decisions for faster iterations and decisioning. 
  • Stay with the problem, be the custodian for the north-star  throughout delivery.
  • Constantly reframe design decisions as new constraints and evidence emerge.

Design that ships: Owning the work from framed problems to live product.

  • Own design across the lifecycle: discovery, concept, design, build, launch and iteration.
  • Create artefacts precise enough to build from, including flows, wireframes, prototypes.
  • Design for production reality: complex workflows, edge cases, data and system constraints.
  • Work inside the engineering cadence with technologists, data specialists and product owners, balancing user value, business impact, technical feasibility and delivery pace.
  • Measure what changed after launch and iterate using product analytics, user conversations and iterate.

AI-accelerated craft: Using AI to design better, and designing better AI native products

  • Use AI across research, synthesis, ideation and prototyping to compress design cycles.

The Experience

title: (Senior) Product Engineer – AI (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Worum es geht

MAIA ist eine KI-Plattform für Unternehmen. Mit MAIA durchsuchen Teams ihre internen Daten und verankern Agenten tief in ihren Prozessen. Wir begleiten Unternehmen dabei, KI nicht nur in einzelnen Abteilungen, sondern im ganzen Unternehmen einzusetzen.

Technisch heißt das: Wir bauen eine GenAI-Anwendung mit eigenen Agentensystemen, RAG-Pipelines und agentenbasierten Workflows, binden externe Systeme unserer Kunden an und analysieren ihre Daten. Wir nutzen die besten verfügbaren Modelle, betrieben in der EU, und machen sie verlässlich für anspruchsvolle Arbeit mit großen, komplexen Datenmengen.

Zahlreiche Industrieunternehmen arbeiten seit Jahren intensiv mit MAIA. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Finanzierungsrunde 2026 bringen wir MAIA jetzt in die Breite. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig.

Was du bei uns machst

Als Product Engineer verantwortest du Features von Anfang bis Ende: vom Gespräch mit Kunden über das Konzept bis zur Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung in Produktion.

Woran du arbeiten kannst:

  • Kunden und Markt verstehen. Du sprichst mit Nutzerinnen und Nutzern, begleitest Kundentermine und wertest Nutzungsdaten aus. So findest du heraus, wo MAIA im Arbeitsalltag am meisten helfen kann. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Produktmanagement und Customer Success zusammen.

  • Vom Problem zum Konzept. Du schreibst Konzepte, baust Prototypen, um Ideen schnell zu testen, und schneidest Features so, dass sie früh bei Nutzerinnen und Nutzern ankommen.

  • Umsetzen über den ganzen Stack. Du schreibst den Implementierungsplan, lässt Coding Agents umsetzen und verantwortest Architektur und Qualität, vom Datenmodell bis zur Oberfläche.

  • KI, die man versteht. Du gestaltest, wie Menschen mit MAIA arbeiten: Fragen stellen, Kontext mitgeben, Agenten mehrstufige Aufgaben erledigen lassen und Ergebnisse nachvollziehen.

  • Messen und weiterentwickeln. Nach dem Release prüfst du, ob ein Feature genutzt wird und hilft, und entwickelst es anhand von Feedback, Nutzungsdaten und Evals weiter.

Was wir suchen

  • Solides Software Engineering. Du hast Produkte gebaut und in Produktion betrieben, mit denen Menschen täglich arbeiten, über Backend und Frontend hinweg. Schwache Architektur erkennst du auch dann, wenn ein Coding Agent sie geschrieben hat.

  • Sehr gut in mindestens einer unserer Sprachen. TypeScript, Python oder Go, am besten eine der statisch typisierten. Alle drei musst du nicht mitbringen. In die anderen arbeitest du dich ein.

  • Produkterfahrung. Du hast mit Kundinnen und Kunden gesprochen, Anforderungen hinterfragt und Features von der ersten Idee bis zur täglichen Nutzung begleitet. Du hörst genau hin und erkennst, welches Problem hinter einem Wunsch steckt.

  • Gespür für gute Bedienung. Du merkst, wenn eine Oberfläche Menschen überfordert, und baust lieber eine einfache Lösung, die verstanden wird, als eine mächtige, die niemand findet.

  • Zu Hause im LLM-Ökosystem. Du hast Anwendungen mit LLMs gebaut, beruflich oder in komplexen eigenen Projekten, und kennst ihre Eigenheiten: Antworten schwanken, brauchen Zeit, und Agenten scheitern an unerwarteten Stellen. Du baust Produkte, die damit ehrlich umgehen.

  • Messen statt vermuten. Ob ein Feature wirkt, prüfst du mit Nutzungsdaten, Feedback und Evals. Du baust die einfachste Lösung, die das Problem löst.

  • Agentisch arbeiten. Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Alltag. Du schreibst Pläne, die andere prüfen und auf denen Coding Agents aufbauen können, prüfst die Ergebnisse kritisch und weißt, wo sie helfen und wo nicht.

  • Klar kommunizieren. Deine Konzepte versteht man beim ersten Lesen. Mit Kundinnen und Kunden redest du ebenso gern wie mit Engineers. Du sprichst sehr sicher Deutsch und ebenso Englisch.

Die Rolle umfasst keine Personalverantwortung. Ob du als Product Engineer oder Senior Product Engineer einsteigst, besprechen wir spätestens nach dem technischen Interview offen mit dir.

Arbeiten bei MAIA

Uns verbindet ein gemeinsames Ziel: ein richtig gutes Produkt zu bauen. Jede und jeder übernimmt Verantwortung für das eigene Thema. Wir haben Spaß an der Arbeit und sind stolz auf das, was unsere Kunden mit MAIA erreichen. Die Wege sind kurz, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Im Engineering-Team hinterfragen wir kritisch, wie wir entwickeln, und verbessern unsere Prozesse laufend, gerade in der agentischen Entwicklung.

Wir arbeiten gern zusammen in unserem Büro, zentral zwischen Innenstadt und Zoo, und kochen fast jeden Tag gemeinsam. An mindestens drei Tagen pro Woche sind wir vor Ort, an den übrigen arbeitest du, wo du möchtest. Wann dein Tag beginnt, legst du selbst fest.

  • Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen und Coding Agents

  • Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, die zu deiner beruflichen Entwicklung passen

  • Zugang zu einer Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft

Vergütung

Das Jahresbruttogehalt liegt bei 75.000 bis 95.000 €. Wo du in dieser Spanne liegst, hängt von deinem Level ab. Darüber sprechen wir spätestens nach dem technischen Interview. Dazu kommt eine virtuelle Beteiligung über unser VSOP.

Bewerbung und nächste Schritte

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte uns in ein paar eigenen Sätzen eine Frage: Warum willst du MAIA mitgestalten?

Wir arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI. Für diese Antwort zählt aber deine eigene Perspektive. Schreib sie deshalb bitte selbst, gern kurz und ohne Feinschliff.

Passt es, folgen ein 30-minütiges Kennenlernen, ein 90-minütiges technisches Interview, in dem es auch um Produktentscheidungen geht, und ein Abschlussgespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Nach jedem Schritt hörst du in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Werktagen von uns. Unser Ziel ist eine Entscheidung in rund drei Wochen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Senior Product Engineer (DevTools & AI reliability, remote)
descriptionHtml:
(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 32-40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3)

The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.

They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: end-to-end tests and synthetic monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel.

Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. You will build reliability for this kind of software.

Our stack is AI (Codex, Claude, use what you like best), Vue.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Golang, Postgres, ClickHouse and AWS. We ship to prod all day, every day. We practice Agile (not scrum) and take pride in good documentation and good looking products.

We’re a remote-first startup that keeps things simple—low on meetings, high on productivity, and always shipping. If you love building cool things, working async, actually listening to and working with customers, and keeping it lean, you’ll fit right in!

What you'll do

Build and ship with AI

You will actively use coding agents for full stack development, from exploring solutions and generating scaffolding to refactoring, test generation and debugging. At Checkly we push the limits of AI tools every day.

Talk to our users

You will talk directly to the developers, DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams who are on-call, debugging incidents, or wiring Checkly into production pipelines. You will understand their workflows, pain points, and feedback. You use those conversations to validate ideas, course-correct early, and iterate on what you build. Customer calls and the weekly support rotation are part of the job, not a distraction from it.

Find the right problems to solve

In a world where the cost of building software trends to zero, the hard part is picking what to build. You will focus on real developer pain: flaky tests and flaky checks, unclear failures, noisy alerts. You will favour pragmatic solutions that ship quickly, validate assumptions in production, and compound into long-term reliability improvements.

Own your work end to end

From shaping the initial idea, through implementation and rollout, to watching how it behaves in production. You will take part in on-call and help support customers when things don’t work as expected.

What you should have

  • You have shipped features with AI, not just experimented with them. You have taken work from zero to shipped with a comparable stack, made implementation decisions that held up, and put things in front of real users.

  • You have built and run production software. You know the realities of operating software that people depend on: edge cases, incidents, regressions, and the need for observability and follow-up. You are not surprised when things break. You help fix them.

  • You can hold a product conversation, not just a technical one. You can look at a customer problem and reason about whether the thing we are about to build actually solves it.

  • You work well without an office around you. You are autonomous and self-motivated in a remote setup, and you still enjoy getting to know your colleagues and helping other people get unstuck.

  • FULLY remote role, within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 time zones. You need to be able to travel to (other) European countries without having to wait for a visa appointment, for our annual kickoff, a team meetup or a conference.

What you will hate about us

We would rather tell you now than have you find out in month two.

  • We use AI for everything, and we mean everything. AI skepticism is not a thing here. If you have the slightest hesitation about working with AI every day, this is not the place for you, and that is completely fine.

  • We write more than we talk. We are async-first, so a lot of decisions happen in documents and threads, not meetings. If you do your best thinking out loud in a room full of people, you will miss it here.

  • We are lean, so you own the unglamorous parts too. There is no separate QA team, no ops layer to hand things off to, and you are on the support rotation and the on-call rotation like everyone else.

  • We ship constantly and change our minds. Priorities move as we learn from customers. If you need long, stable planning cycles, this will feel chaotic.

  • Customer signals come first, and most of the time they matter more than your instinct. We build what customers actually want, not the clever thing we dreamed up.

Benefits

  • Transparent salary because your salary shouldn't be dictated by how good a negotiator you are. (more info below)

  • Remote-first, flexible work hours, async-first (low meeting, high productivity) and transparent culture

  • Become part of a fast-growing, international, and remote team where your work matters, and your impact won't get lost in layers of bureaucracy.

  • Stock options

  • 27 days of paid vacation + your local public holidays

  • Paid sick leave & up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave

  • Co-working budget or home office setup

  • Annual company kickoffs

Find out more here.

What we pay

Fair, competitive, and transparent pay is very important for us. Therefore we work with a standardized salary calculator that includes several factors such as seniority level as well as location.

For this role, the range is

  • €88k - €105k for someone in a similar cost of market as UK, Germany etc, + stock options

  • €79k - €97k for someone in a similar cost of market as Spain, Poland, Ukraine etc, + stock options

Apply

If this sounds interesting, please apply! Studies by several different sources have shown that on average men will apply for a job if they meet 60% of the application requirements. Women, non-binary people and POC will seek to match a much higher percentage of requirements before applying. If you're not sure you're the right fit, apply anyway and let us know what you bring to the table. We'd love to hear from you!

We're all about being transparent and setting clear expectations. That's why we've put together our hiring playbook and open-sourced our employee handbook. There you'll find a sneak peek of who we are, how we work and what you can expect in our hiring process.

Compensation: €79K – €105K • Offers Equity • Multiple Ranges
