title: Staff Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Location: Chancery Lane, London (Office-based 4 days)

The Mission

At Fyxer, we believe the only sustainable competitive advantage for a startup is the quality and speed of execution.

We are looking for a Product Lead who operates like a Staff PM: someone who owns our most important product bets end-to-end, from ambiguous problem space to shipped outcome. You combine sharp product judgment with hands-on discovery skills, and you measure yourself on commercial impact, not output.

We're not looking for someone to write specs and manage a backlog. We want someone who helps us think better, decide better, and ship better. The goal isn't more process, it's higher quality decisions made faster.

You will work directly with our Head of Product, CTO, founders and senior engineers to shape what we build and why.

What you will own

You will not hand anything over. You will own the bet from first insight to shipped impact.

  • Own discovery through delivery for our most important product bets, from early ambiguity to validated direction to launched product

  • Work directly with engineers and founders from the start of any initiative as the accountable product owner, not a coordinator

  • Frame the problem, define the hypothesis, and choose the fastest route to signal: interviews, prototypes, fake doors, experiments, or just shipping and measuring

  • Translate messy qualitative and quantitative signals into clear product direction, then drive that direction through to execution

  • Set success metrics, make the call on when there's enough signal to build, and own the outcome either way

  • Embed structured learning loops into how we operate so insight compounds over time

  • Raise the bar of product thinking across the team: coach others, introduce lightweight frameworks, and get the whole company closer to customers

Who you are

You are a full-stack product thinker.

  • Outcome owner: You connect user behaviour to funnels, retention, and revenue. You think in bets and expected value, not feature lists, and you hold yourself accountable to results.

  • Discovery-strong: Genuinely fluent across qualitative research, behavioural insight, and experimentation. You generate strong signal quickly and pick the right method for the decision at hand, rather than outsourcing the thinking.

  • Engineering partner: You work shoulder to shoulder with engineers, translating insight into crisp problem framing and practical tradeoffs. Engineers want to work with you because you make the work clearer, not slower.

  • Decision oriented: You know when there's enough signal to move. You sharpen hypotheses, clarify thinking, and make confident calls under uncertainty. You'd rather ship and learn than perfect and wait.

  • Force multiplier: Your impact shows up in how the whole team operates. You build repeatable systems for discovery and decision-making that outlast any single project.

The Role

You will be the senior product voice on our most important initiatives, working directly with the Head of Product, CPGO, founders, and senior engineers. This is not a support function. You will be embedded in high impact work from day one, with real authority over what we build and why.

You will operate at speed. We care about generating signal quickly, making informed decisions, and shipping fast. You are comfortable working with imperfect information and tightening your thinking as you go.

You will move fluidly across the full product lifecycle. Some weeks you will be deep in user interviews or pressure testing a major bet, other weeks you will be in the detail with engineers getting something over the line.

You will have significant autonomy. We expect strong judgment, clear communication, and ownership of outcomes.

If there are specific tools you believe are critical to moving faster or generating better signal, we will support that. We want you to design the right setup, not work around constraints.

Why Fyxer?

We are intentional about our team. We believe a small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organization.

  • Autonomy: We hire people who want ownership and then we actually give it to them.

  • Velocity: You will be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company.

  • Scale: We are on track to hit $100M in revenue by the end of 2026. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth rocket ship at the foundational stage.

title: Staff Release Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: Bristol or London, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: Staff Engineer TL2

Team: Release Engineering

Salary: £97,600 - £125,000 + discretionary bonus

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Software Engineering manager

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you'll do

As a Staff Release Engineer, you will set the technical strategy and global architecture for Kaluza’s continuous integration, delivery, and automated release ecosystems. You will empower our entire engineering organization to deploy high-quality software safely, frequently, and with minimal friction.

  • Architect Release Ecosystems: Lead the high-level design and long-term roadmap definition for building, scaling, and governing the systems and practices that reliably move software from source to production through centralized developer tooling across all Kaluza engineering domains. 

  • Drive Engineering Productivity & SRE Practices: Strategize and embed automated deployment & release mechanisms, testing frameworks, Site Reliability Engineering principles and AI tooling  to drastically reduce toil and accelerate software delivery speed and safety across the organization. 

  • Establish Global Standards & Metrics: Lead the definition, continuous improvement and enforcement of company-wide DevOps practices, standards, and frameworks such as DORA for compliance and auditability but also to measure and target improvements that elevate engineering productivity.

  • Orchestrate Complex Infrastructure Tooling: Own the strategy for deployment platforms and infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Terraform, AWS, Kubernetes, ArgoCD), ensuring multi-tenant SaaS environments are secure, scalable, and efficient.

  • Mentor & Upskill: Provide technical ownership, guidance, and mentorship to engineers across Kaluza, fostering deep expertise in automated delivery, developer experience, and modern release engineering practices including AI enablement.

  • Hands-off & Hands-on Technical Leadership: Drive platform-wide release architecture through audits and strategic design, while retaining the capability to build high-impact proofs-of-concept for mission-critical release infrastructure.


What you'll bring

Ideally you'll have:

  • Strategic CI/CD & Release Architect: Deep experience architecting, scaling, and maintaining enterprise-grade CI/CD frameworks, release pipelines, and internal developer platforms in cloud-native environments.

  • DevOps & DORA Expert: Comprehensive mastery of DevOps practices, software development lifecycle (SDLC) automation, and practical application of DORA metrics to drive measurable engineering productivity.

  • Technical Mentor & Leader: A proven track record of upskilling senior engineering talent, driving technical strategy, and establishing consensus across multi-disciplinary engineering domains.

  • Infrastructure & Automation Mastery: Extensive hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), container orchestration (Kubernetes, ArgoCD), and workflow automation (GitHub Actions). Experience of GitHub Enterprise administration and GitHubAsCode experience would be a bonus.

  • Developer-Centric & Data-Driven: Strong customer obsession—viewing developers as your primary customers—paired with data-driven decision-making to optimize developer experience and eliminate toil.

What will set you apart:

  • LLM Integration Experience: Hands-on experience integrating large language models into production applications or developer workflows, whether via APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock) or open-source models, with a solid understanding of prompt engineering, context management, and evaluation.

  • AI Tooling Advocacy: A track record of introducing AI-assisted developer tooling and workflows (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude, or similar) into a team and upskilling colleagues, not just using it personally.

  • Enterprise Release Strategy & Domain Exposure: Experience designing, building, and governance-proofing release architectures specifically for enterprise clients or highly regulated global platforms, ideally with direct domain exposure to energy technology, smart device orchestration, billing SaaS platforms, or high-throughput IoT platforms.


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.


Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app


Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

title: Staff Technical Programme Manager, Systems Software
descriptionHtml:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Role:

System Software builds the software that runs IonQ's quantum computers: the runtime, orchestration, quantum tools, controllers and transport software that sit between the Quantum Operating System and the hardware. It is where a next-generation system either comes together or doesn't.

We're hiring a Staff Technical Programme Manager to lead delivery across this stack. You'll report to the Group Program Manager, Software in our Programme Management Office and be matrixed to the VP, Software for day-to-day work.

You'll work across five engineering teams (runtime, orchestration, quantum tools, controllers and transport) and the interfaces between them and their cross-functional stakeholders, serving several next-generation system programmes at once, with hardware being co-developed alongside the software and teams in both Oxford and the US. Those programmes draw on the same engineers, so the central problem of this role is making sure that capacity is spent by decision, not by default.

We run a centralised PMO model. This role will not own engineering headcount or define product but it will make the programme around those things run. It carries real ownership of delivery: the plan, the trade-offs put in front of decision-makers, and the honesty of the status. In this role you will interface with everyone from technical software engineers to a wide range of the most senior stakeholders. You will also coordinate with your fellow programme managers, across Science, Infrastructure and broader Software teams, making sure all plans are shared and coordinated, rather than operating in silos.

Turning a research-grade quantum system into a dependable product is a problem nobody has finished solving, and the delivery standard you'll work within is being built now. If writing the first version of the plan sounds like the interesting part, we should talk.

Responsibilities:

In this role you will own the end-to-end delivery of the Systems Software roadmap across several concurrent programmes including managing dependencies between hardware, science and systems integration teams. You will partner closely with engineering leadership, the engineering teams run the day to day planning and boards, you will provide the direction that creates incremental milestones that ship.

You will identify risks and blockers early and work with the teams to resolve them. You will also run intake and triage, so requests reach the right team with the right priority and engineers can stay focused on planned work.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Make contention visible: when two programmes need the same team in the same quarter, bring it to the right decision-maker with the options and a recommendation before it becomes a slip.

  • Keep the systems of record honest. Requirements, plans, schedules and Jira drift apart; you'll close the gap and automate the checking.

  • Make invisible work visible: on-call load, sustaining work and technical debt tracked as rigorously as feature delivery.

  • Surface risks early, before you have a full solution or complete alignment. We'd rather hear it messy and on time.

  • Run intake and triage so requests reach the right team, with priority set by the people who own it, and engineers stay on planned work.

  • Work hand in hand with the Quantum Systems Infrastructure and Science TPMs in Oxford and the Software TPMs in the US: shared processes where teams meet, and no duplicated ceremonies, boards or reports.

  • Write concise, plain-English status on progress, risks and decisions for programme directors, engineering leaders and senior leadership.

  • Help shape how IonQ runs software delivery across sites, working with the Group Program Manager, Software on the shared delivery standard.

Requirements:

You will have significant experience running technical programmes across several software teams, ideally in systems, embedded, compiler or platform software. You can discuss scope and trade-offs directly with engineering leads, read and reason about code, and re-plan when a timeline is no longer realistic. You will have a track record of leading teams through genuine ambiguity, writing the first version of the plan when there isn't one, not just executing a defined one.

You can break broad problems down into specific, assignable actions, and you have designed a team's operating cadence before. No quantum background is needed. Experience of software that works closely with hardware, for example in labs, robotics, aerospace or scientific instruments, would be beneficial.

You’d be a great fit with:

  • A habit of turning diffuse problems into specific, minimal, assignable asks.

  • Technical fluency to engage engineering leads directly on scope and trade-offs, and comfort reading and reasoning about code.

  • Willingness to re-baseline against reality rather than defend dates that have stopped being true, and the judgement to tell a target that motivates from one that just generates fiction.

  • Experience with software that works closely with hardware: labs, robotics, aerospace, scientific instruments or similar.

  • A chase-without-nagging, escalate-without-drama style, and a clear sense of the difference between a risk and a noise.

  • AI as a core part of how you work, for example agent-driven tracking, reconciliation or reporting.

  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication with both technical and senior stakeholders.

Additional desirable skills include capacity and staffing modelling, designing operating cadences and experience leading work across sites and time zones. Experience working with programmes and systems such as Jira, Confluence and GitHub, with a preference for lightweight processes, is also helpful.

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. 

At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.
 
We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

Vous souhaitez découvrir concrètement comment se développent les projets de stockage par batteries et contribuer à la transition énergétique ? Au sein de l’équipe Novar en France, vous serez accompagné·e par les équipes de développement et les supports techniques. Vous participerez, à votre niveau, à l’identification de sites et à la préparation des premières analyses et démarches d’autorisation pour des projets de stockage. Vos missions

· Identification de sites pour des projets de stockage par batteries. Pour cela, un travail d’analyse et de suivi des évolutions techniques et réglementaires devra être réalisé.

· Analyses et prédimensionnement du projet de stockage sur la base des informations collectées (caractéristiques du réseau électrique à proximité ; règles d’urbanismes ; enjeux liés à l’occupation du sol, aux accès, au voisinage et aux zonages environnementaux).

· Préparer des supports de synthèse (recherches documentaires, cartographie et tableaux de suivi) et apprendre à faire ressortir les principaux points à approfondir.

· Accompagner les Chef.fe.s de projet en Développement et les Développeurs Nouveaux Projets dans leurs missions et se familiariser avec les démarches de sécurisation foncière, de développement de projets et de permitting sous leurs supervisions.

Votre profil

· Bac +5 type Master ou Ingénieur généraliste ou énergie .

· Un intérêt marqué pour les énergies renouvelables, les systèmes électriques et la transition énergétique.

· À l’aise avec la recherche, l’analyse et la synthèse d’informations, ainsi qu’avec la rédaction de documents clairs.

· Rigueur, autonomie, curiosité et esprit d’équipe.

· Bonne maîtrise des outils bureautiques ; la connaissance des outils SIG ou de la réglementation en urbanisme et en environnement constitue un plus.

· Bon niveau de français ; la connaissance de l’anglais est appréciée dans notre environnement international.

Ce que NOVAR vous offre

Chez Novar, nous ne vous proposons pas seulement un emploi – nous vous invitons à rejoindre une véritable aventure. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement entrepreneurial et innovant, où l’énergie est au cœur de tout – au sens propre comme au sens figuré. Aux côtés de professionnels passionnés, vous contribuerez concrètement à la mise en œuvre de systèmes énergétiques durables.

Et qu’est-ce que cela vous apporte?

💰 Une gratification de stage de 900 € par mois, dans le respect de la réglementation en vigueur.

🚆 Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport en commun.
📚 Des opportunités de développement et de croissance au sein de notre scale-up international.

À propos de Novar – Nous façonnons l’avenir énergétique de l’Europe

Chez Novar, nous croyons que l’avenir de l’énergie est vert – et nous le concrétisons. Depuis notre création en 2014 aux Pays-Bas, nous sommes devenus un acteur majeur du développement et de l’exploitation de grandes installations d’énergies renouvelables. Avec plus de 200 collaborateurs engagés et 800 MWc de capacité installée, nous faisons avancer la transition énergétique à pleine vitesse.

Ce qui a commencé par des centrales solaires au sol est devenu une entreprise énergétique complète. Aujourd’hui, nous développons et fournissons de l’énergie solaire, du stockage par batteries, du solaire thermique, de l’hydrogène, des réseaux intelligents et bien plus encore. Nous couvrons toute la chaîne de valeur – du développement et de la construction à la gestion de l’énergie et à l’innovation.

Depuis 2024 nous étendons nos activités au-delà de notre marché d’origine, avec une présence en Suède, en Allemagne et en France. Notre objectif est ambitieux : développer 7 gigawatts de systèmes énergétiques verts d’ici 2035. Chez Novar, vous rejoindrez une équipe internationale en pleine croissance, animée par la volonté de faire la différence. Nous ne construisons pas seulement des projets énergétiques – nous façonnons les systèmes énergétiques de demain.

Créée en 1843, IMT Mines Alès compte à ce jour 1400 élèves (dont 250 étrangers) et 380 personnels. L’école dispose de 3 centres de recherche et d’enseignement de haut niveau scientifique et technologique, qui œuvrent dans les domaines des matériaux et du génie civil (C2MA), de l’environnement et des risques (CREER), de l’intelligence artificielle et du génie industriel et numérique (CERIS). Elle dispose de 12 plateformes technologiques et compte 1600 entreprises partenaires. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.imt-mines-ales.fr

Contexte :

Le stage à pourvoir s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet européen Best-Crop impliquant 18 partenaires à l’échelle européenne : https://www.bestcrop.eu/ dont le but est de contribuer à développer l’économie circulaire en offrant de nouvelles variétés d’orge à rendement amélioré (article de perspective – projet Best-Crop). ). L’un des volets du projet consiste à fournir des pailles d’orge de composition et/ou structure optimisées pour différentes applications, dont, entre autres, le secteur de la construction (fabrication de panneaux de particules et de biocomposites).

Dans le cadre de ce projet, l’équipe PCH a pour tâche d’étudier l’influence de la sélection et du fractionnement des pailles issues de différentes variétés d’orge, ainsi que d’étudier la microstructure et le comportement mécanique de panneaux biosourcés élaborés par pressage à chaud.

Objectifs :

Le stage consiste à mettre en œuvre des panneaux de pailles, d’optimiser le procédé de fabrication, et d’évaluer la variabilité des comportements mécaniques et d’isolation observés en regard de la composition et de la morphologie des pailles pour développer des panneaux performants. Le travail contribuera également à compléter la large base de données sur les panneaux à renforts lignocellulosiques développés au laboratoire.

Vous trouverez davantage d’informations sur le stage ici : https://partage.imt.fr/index.php/s/nRzezN9XJz7gYLS


Compétences et connaissances :

  • Élève de formation BAC+5 (Master 2) en science et génie des matériaux polymères et composites

  • Connaissances dans le domaine des biocomposites à fibres végétales

  • Production scientifique (rédaction de publications, de posters, présentations orales ...)

Conditions :

Le stage est prévu pour une durée de 6 mois à partir de février 2027

Date limite de candidature : 20/11/2026

Un entretien d’environ 45 minutes (possible en visioconférence) pour discuter de votre parcours, de votre motivation, de vos compétences et de votre projet professionnel.

Vous devrez transmettre un dossier comprenant :

  1. CV détaillé

  2. Lettre de motivation expliquant votre intérêt pour le sujet et vos compétences

  3. Relevés de notes M1 et M2 (ou équivalent)

title: Stage: Technische bedrijfskunde/Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Over Nedlin

Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen.

De stageopdrachten

Bij de afdeling Engineering/Technische Bedrijfskunde hebben we twee uitdagende stageopdrachten openstaan. Je gaat aan de slag met één van onze nieuwe geautomatiseerde processen en onderzoekt hoe we deze verder kunnen optimaliseren. Daarbij combineer je techniek, data en procesverbetering en krijg je de kans om jouw verbeteringen ook daadwerkelijk in de praktijk te implementeren.

Mogelijke werkzaamheden en stageopdrachten zijn:

  • Je onderzoekt en optimaliseert het nieuwe geautomatiseerde badgoedvouwproces van Nedlin Hospitality. Met behulp van procesdata en de DMAIC-methodiek breng je prestaties en knelpunten in kaart, voer je verbeteringen door en borg je deze voor een hogere productiviteit, kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid.

  • Je onderzoekt het nieuwe geautomatiseerde sorteerproces voor vuil linnengoed bij Nedlin Healthcare. Je analyseert de prestaties en efficiëntie van de installatie, brengt knelpunten en verbetermogelijkheden in kaart en werkt passende optimalisaties uit. Vervolgens help je deze verbeteringen te implementeren en evalueer je het resultaat.

  • Je onderzoekt hoe Nedlin een digitale kennisbank kan opzetten om de Technische Dienst beter te ondersteunen. Je verzamelt en structureert bestaande technische kennis, zoals handleidingen, onderhoudsinstructies en logboeken, en richt de kennisbank zo in dat deze geschikt is voor zowel de werkvoorbereider als een toekomstige Copilot-agent. Vervolgens implementeer en test je de kennisbank in de praktijk.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Stagevergoeding:

    • € 400,- bruto per maand voor hbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

  • Een leerzame stage binnen één van de modernste en duurzaamste wasserijen van Europa;

  • Ruimte en begeleiding om te werken aan jouw (afstudeer)opdracht;

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding en korte lijnen;

  • Een familiaire en positieve sfeer: samen feestdagen vieren, een jaarlijkse familiedag en leuke uitjes;

  • Kans op een (bij)baan bij Nedlin na afronding van je stage, bij wederzijdse match.


Wie ben jij?

  • Je volgt een hbo-opleiding, bij voorkeur Technische Bedrijfskunde

  • Je werkt zelfstandig, nauwkeurig en proactief.

  • Je communiceert gemakkelijk met verschillende collega’s.

  • Je bent 32 tot 40 uur per week beschikbaar voor een meewerk- of afstudeerstage.

  • Je kunt zelfstandig naar onze locatie in Elsloo komen.

Pak het moment

Wil jij tijdens je stage niet alleen werken aan een interessante opdracht, maar vooral ook leren, ervaring opdoen en jezelf ontwikkelen? Bij Nedlin krijg je de ruimte om jouw kennis vanuit je opleiding toe te passen in de praktijk, mee te kijken binnen onze organisatie en samen te werken met ervaren collega’s. Maak van jouw stage een waardevolle stap richting je toekomst. Solliciteer eenvoudig via de solliciteerknop. Heb je eerst nog vragen over de stage of de opdracht? title: Stagiaire Talent & Operations (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Apprendre, évoluer et accompagner le développement des talents. Contribuer à un impact positif.

  • Vous souhaitez acquérir une expérience concrète en gestion des talents et en Opérations au sein d’une entreprise internationale portée par une mission ?
  • Vous aspirez à évoluer dans un environnement dynamique, où la curiosité, l’apprentissage et l’esprit d’équipe occupent une place centrale ?

Le poste

Au cours de ce stage, vous découvrirez le fonctionnement opérationnel d’un cabinet de conseil : gestion des ressources, processus Talent, gestion de la performance et coordination de projets transverses. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Operations et Talent France, et développerez de solides compétences analytiques, organisationnelles et relationnelles, notamment en gestion des parties prenantes.

Vos missions

Talent management

  • Contribuer au déroulement du processus annuel d’évaluation de la performance : suivi des échéances, communication, collecte des feedbacks en lien avec les managers.
  • Participer à des projets RH transverses : formation, diversité et inclusion, autres projets transverses.
  • Apporter un soutien sur des sujets RH ponctuels, selon les besoins.

Excellence operationnelle

Staffing

  • Appuyer la coordination du staffing des consultants et des stagiaires.
  • Maintenir la planification de la charge de travail et les données de staffing.
  • Veiller à l’adéquation des demandes de staffing avec le pricing des projets.

Reporting

  • Maintenir la qualité des données dans les outils opérationnels (Napta, NetSuite).
  • Contribuer au reporting mensuel et aux tableaux de bord opérationnels.
  • Suivre l’exactitude des données projet et la complétion des feuilles de temps.

Coordination d’équipe

  • Préparer les réunions hebdomadaires de coordination de la branche France.
  • Participer à l’organisation des meetings internes mensuels des différentes populations de consultants (Juniors, Project Managers, Line Managers, etc.).
  • Contribuer à l’organisation et à la coordination du séminaire annuel.

Pourquoi rejoindre Quantis

Quantis, société du groupe BCG, est un cabinet de conseil de référence en développement durable, qui accompagne les organisations face à des enjeux environnementaux complexes. Depuis vingt ans, notre équipe d’experts collabore avec des organisations du monde entier afin d’intégrer le développement durable dans la stratégie, la prise de décision et l’action. Nous guidons les entreprises de l’ambition à l’action en associant les avancées scientifiques les plus récentes à une vision stratégique, pour les aider à appréhender la complexité, à progresser sur leurs priorités de durabilité et à créer une valeur durable.

Unis par un engagement commun en faveur de progrès concrets, nos plus de 250 professionnels incarnent une culture collaborative singulière, que nous appelons le Quantis Spirit. Nous sommes innovants. Nous sommes orientés vers l’impact. Nous sommes guidés par la science. Nous sommes Quantis.

Pour en savoir plus, découvrez Quantis et notre mission.

Votre profil

Vous réussirez dans cette mission si :

  • Vous souhaitez contribuer à l’action d’une entreprise engagée en faveur du développement durable ;
  • Vous faites preuve d’organisation, d’initiative et de rigueur ;
  • Vous appréciez l’analyse de données et l’amélioration des processus ;
  • Vous savez construire des relations de confiance et communiquer efficacement ;
  • Vous maîtrisez la suite Microsoft Office (en particulier Excel et PowerPoint) et portez un intérêt aux outils fondés sur l’intelligence artificielle ;
  • Vous maîtrisez couramment le français et justifiez d’un bon niveau professionnel en anglais.

Informations complémentaires

  • Lieu : Paris 2e (75002), organisation hybride alliant présence au bureau et télétravail
  • Conditions requises : être inscrit(e) dans une université, une école de commerce ou une école d’ingénieurs, et disposer d’une convention de stage valide. Une priorité sera accordée aux candidat(e)s recherchant un stage de fin d’études.
  • Date de démarrage : janvier 2027
  • Durée : 6 mois

Unlocking the Potential of All Quantisians

At Quantis, Unlocking Potential means empowering our employees to thrive, enabling them to drive our mission and manifesto forward—creating meaningful impact for people and the planet.

We aim to achieve this by nurturing a culture rooted in collective action, and shared purpose, where diversity is cherished, inclusion is lived, mental wellbeing is supported, and opportunities are open to all.

This extends to our clients, their clients, and their entire value chain as sustainable thinking and collective representation are integral components of our purpose to transform the way that businesses operate.

This is how we commit to our people, live our manifesto, and shape a sustainable future - together.

title: Strategic Account Director
descriptionHtml:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Role Summary

Location: London

Hybrid

Full-Time

The Strategic Account Director is a new-business, quota-carrying hunter responsible for landing the largest, most complex enterprise logos in the market. You own the full pursuit — from target identification and outbound generation through multi-threaded, committee-driven sales cycles to signed, revenue-producing contracts. Your prospects run cross-border volume at scale, they are today served by incumbent banks or specialist fintechs, and displacing that incumbent is the job.

This is a role for someone who is energized by the chase: building conviction where none exists, getting into the CFO's and Treasurer's office cold, orchestrating a pursuit team through a long and technical evaluation, and closing seven-figure relationships. You set the bar for how strategic new business gets won at Payoneer.

This is a strategic role. It is deliberately seated centrally under Global Sales so the strategic-accounts motion can be built, proven, and standardized before ownership is distributed to the regions. You will work hand in hand with regional heads of sales for in-market coordination and, over time, help shape how this function scales across the field.

What You'll Do 

  • Hunt and land net-new strategic accounts. Own a new-business quota. Identify, prioritize, and pursue the highest-value target accounts in your territory (typically $500K+/month cross-border volume, up to $10M+/month strategic targets) and convert them into signed, funded customers.
  • Generate your own pipeline. Build top-of-funnel through disciplined, research-led outbound — direct executive outreach, referrals, partner and ecosystem channels, and events. Do not wait for leads; create them.
  • Break into the buying committee cold. Get in front of and build conviction with CFOs, Treasurers, Finance Operations, and Compliance/Risk leaders at target accounts. Multi-thread deliberately so a deal never rests on a single contact.
  • Displace the incumbent. Position Payoneer's speed, global coverage, economics, and platform breadth to unseat incumbent banks and specialist competitors. Run competitive displacement plays and build the business case that moves an entrenched buyer.
  • Own complex, long-cycle deals end to end. Drive multi-stakeholder, technical, compliance-sensitive evaluations from first meeting to close. Own the mutual close plan, procurement, legal, and commercial negotiation.
  • Sell the platform. Lead with value, not features. Land the entry wedge and architect the deal to open cross-border payments plus high-value services (Capital, Treasury/FX, Embedded/Platform Payments, Workforce/EOR, and emerging rails) — maximizing initial contract value and expansion potential.
  • Qualify with discipline. Apply Payoneer's Sandler-based methodology — Up-Front Contracts, Pain Funnel, budget and decision qualification — to every pursuit so you invest team resources only in winnable, real deals.
  • Orchestrate the pursuit team. Direct Solutions/Pre-Sales, Product Specialists, Compliance, and RevOps as a coordinated deal team through the sales cycle, and quarterback executive sponsorship where needed.
  • Forecast honestly and close on time. Own a credible, hygienic pipeline and forecast in CRM. Drive deals to close dates and call your number straight.
  • Set up the win for the long term. Land with a clean handoff to Customer Success and a clear expansion thesis, so every logo you close becomes a growth account.

Who You Are 

  • 8+ years in enterprise B2B sales with a strong bias toward new business / new logo acquisition — not primarily account management or renewals.
  • Consistent, demonstrable record of hitting or exceeding a new-business quota on complex, high-value deals.
  • Proven ability to self-generate pipeline through outbound and to break into cold enterprise accounts at the executive level.
  • Experience closing long-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals with meaningful (six- to seven-figure) contract value.
  • Demonstrated success selling into and navigating executive buying committees — CFO, Treasury, Finance, Compliance/Risk.
  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills, including running procurement, legal, and margin-protective deal structuring to close.
  • Fluency operating in a matrix environment and orchestrating a cross-functional pursuit team.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred

  • Background in payments, fintech, banking, treasury, FX, or cross-border commerce.
  • Track record of competitive displacement against incumbent banks or specialist fintechs.
  • Experience selling a multi-product platform and structuring land-and-expand entry deals.
  • Familiarity with a structured sales methodology (Payoneer uses Sandler).
  • Exposure to compliance-sensitive, regulated sales environments (KYC/AML-aware selling).
  • Strong CRM discipline and data-driven pipeline management (e.g., Salesforce).

#LI-FD1

The Payoneer Ways of Working 

Act as our customer’s partner on the inside
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further. 

Do it. Own it.
Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do. 

Continuously improve
Always striving for a higher standard than our last. 

Build each other up 
Helping each other grow, as professionals and people. 

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

descriptionHtml:
Diabolocom is the leading European sovereign cloud contact center (CCaaS) and customer experience management (CX) platform. It helps organizations transform customer experience by augmenting agents' capabilities through AI-human collaboration, automating routine customer interactions, and delivering personalized experiences at scale. Built on proprietary AI, private cloud, and native telecom infrastructure, the platform automates workflows, improves data quality, and empowers customer service and sales teams across every channel.

About the role

We are looking for a Strategic Accounts Product Representative to strengthen the relationship between our Product organisation and our largest enterprise customers, as well as support major commercial opportunities across our products.

In this role, you will act as the primary Product interface for selected strategic accounts, helping customers understand our Product capabilities, direction and commitments while ensuring their needs are clearly understood and effectively translated into actionable Product insights.

You will work closely with Account Managers, Sales, Product Owners, Engineering and Delivery teams to connect customer expectations with our Product strategy, identify opportunities shared across multiple customers, and provide clear visibility on Product scope, dependencies and roadmap maturity.

This is a highly transversal, customer-facing role at the intersection of Product, business and technology. You will engage with stakeholders ranging from operational teams to senior executives, build a deep understanding of their business challenges, and help our Product organisation make better-informed decisions.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Building trusted Product relationships with strategic customers: Act as their main Product point of contact, in close coordination with Account and Project managers, clearly communicate product capabilities, strategic direction, constraints and trade-offs to stakeholders at every level.

  • Turning customer needs into Product insights: Qualify requests based on customer impact, business value, urgency, recurrence and strategic relevance. Identify common challenges across accounts and work with Product Owners and the Head of Product to surface broader Product opportunities.

  • Ensuring clear and reliable Product commitments: Maintain a consolidated view of Product commitments for strategic accounts, including scope, ownership, dependencies, status and confidence level. Ensure that customer-facing communications reflect internally validated product and delivery plans.

  • Bridging customers and internal teams: Coordinate Product Owners and relevant internal stakeholders to answer complex customer questions, clarify functional scope and address cross-product dependencies. Ensure changes to scope, timing or assumptions are communicated proactively.

  • Leading customer discovery and understanding business needs: Participate in or lead Product discovery workshops with strategic customers to understand their workflows, business challenges and expected outcomes. Challenge solution-driven requests where necessary to identify the underlying business problem.

  • Contributing to major commercial opportunities: Coordinate the Product contribution to strategic tenders, RFPs and major sales opportunities, ensuring that Product information, capabilities, limitations and proposed commitments are accurate and aligned internally.

  • Sharing customer and market intelligence: Develop an understanding of customers' industries, business models and relevant regulatory constraints. Bring these insights back to Product and help Sales, Customer Operations and other teams communicate Product decisions consistently.

    • What we're looking for

    We are looking for someone who combines strong customer-facing skills with a solid understanding of Product and technology. You can navigate complex enterprise environments, understand business challenges, communicate with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and bring structure to discussions involving multiple teams and competing priorities.

  • Significant experience in a customer-facing B2B technology environment, ideally within a SaaS company, enterprise software vendor or fast-growing technology business.

  • Experience working at the intersection of Product, customers and business, for example in Product Management, Enterprise Product Management, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management or a similar role.

  • The ability to understand complex customer environments, engage with senior stakeholders and build trusted relationships across operational, technical and executive levels.

  • A strong understanding of Product development processes, including discovery, requirements qualification, roadmap management, prioritisation and delivery dependencies.

  • The ability to translate customer requests and use cases into structured business needs, identify recurring patterns and distinguish customer-specific requirements from scalable Product opportunities.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical capabilities, Product direction and trade-offs clearly to different audiences.

  • Strong organisational skills and a structured approach to managing multiple strategic accounts, requests, stakeholders and commitments simultaneously.

  • The ability to influence and coordinate cross-functional teams without direct hierarchical authority.

  • A pragmatic, analytical and customer-oriented mindset, combined with the confidence to manage expectations and communicate when a requested feature, scope or timeline cannot be guaranteed.

  • Excellent written and spoken French and English.

    • Experience with Contact Center solutions, customer experience technology, conversational AI, CRM integrations or enterprise telecommunications would be a strong advantage.

    What you'll enjoy at Diabolocom

You will work closely with our Head of Insurance, Account Executives, Solution Engineering, Product and Engineering.

What You'll Do

  • Identify and prioritize target accounts across DACH insurers (primary insurers, reinsurers, MGAs, insurance groups) based on a clear thesis: where the business case for AI-driven decisioning is strongest and where we can win

  • Build account strategies for your portfolio: map the organization, its strategic agenda and transformation programs, the buying committee and the path to an executive sponsor, and spot expansion opportunities from day one

  • Grow and retain accounts once they are live: steer the overall relationship, open new business lines and country organizations, and make sure clients see lasting value

  • Lead relationships at every level, from claims and underwriting heads to CIOs, COOs and board members, and move them from first conversation to a defined business case and a strategic commitment to Taktile

  • Design and moderate executive workshops and steering meetings with insurance leadership teams, turning open-ended ambitions ("we need to become AI-native") into concrete, prioritized use cases

  • Shape and land account-level commitments (business case, commercial framework, executive sign-off), working hand in hand with the Account Executives who close individual deals, Solution Engineering and our Head of Insurance

  • Work closely with Product and Engineering to tailor our platform to each client's needs and turn client requirements into concrete solutions

  • Build and work our ecosystem in DACH: strategy and technology consultancies, system integrators and core system vendors who shape insurers' technology decisions

  • Represent Taktile at industry conferences, roundtables and client events, and help design formats of our own that bring insurance executives together

  • Bring market insight back into Taktile: what insurers need, how competitors and incumbents position, and what that means for our product, messaging and pricing

  • Help build the playbook for Taktile's insurance business in DACH as we scale the team

About You

  • 6+ years of total work experience, including 4–6 years at McKinsey, BCG, Bain or a comparable strategy or operations consultancy, ideally leading client teams as Engagement Manager, Project Leader or equivalent

  • Project experience with insurance clients; you don't need to be an insurance specialist, and adjacent work in operations, technical advisory or digital/AI transformation counts

  • A commercial track record: ideally you have sold or expanded projects as an Engagement Manager. Software sales experience is not required

  • Outgoing and client-facing: you enjoy being in front of clients and leading the conversation, rather than working in the background

  • You are comfortable in front of C-level executives: you can structure a difficult discussion, moderate a room of senior stakeholders and hold your own when challenged

  • Strong problem-structuring and business case skills; you can quantify the value of a use case and explain it to a CFO

  • Technical understanding: you can discuss how our platform works with engineers and translate it for business leaders

  • You take ownership of outcomes, not just recommendations, and you are motivated by building revenue and long-term client relationships. High ownership, but a team player, not a lone wolf

  • Fluent in German and English, written and spoken

  • Based in Munich or Berlin (Frankfurt or London possible) and happy to travel frequently across Germany, Austria and Switzerland. This is not a remote role: you will regularly work on-site with clients, for example in workshops

Ideal Qualifications (but not required)

  • Experience beyond consulting, for example in an industry or in-house role

  • Existing network among senior decision-makers at DACH insurers, insurance consultancies or core system vendors

  • Experience in an enterprise software, insurtech or AI company, for example in a commercial, strategy or business development role

  • Hands-on familiarity with how insurers run claims, underwriting or pricing, and with the regulatory context (BaFin, Solvency II, EU AI Act)

  • Experience speaking at industry events or publishing on insurance and AI topics

What We Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

  • Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early-stage company.

  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package, with a predominantly fixed salary and a performance-based bonus.

  • Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.

  • Use the equipment of your choice including meaningful home office set-up.

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

About Us

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com.

About Your Employment. Taktile operates through regional entities worldwide. Depending on the location of this role, your employment or engagement will be with Taktile LLC (US), Taktile GmbH (Germany), Taktile Ltd (UK), or Taktile SRL (Romania). The applicable entity will be confirmed during the offer process.

Your Privacy. Taktile (“we” or “us”) is the controller of the personal data you provide during this application process. We collect and process your name, contact details, resume/CV, work history, education, and any other information you submit or that we obtain from publicly available sources or references.

How we use your data: We process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy, communicate with you about the recruitment process, comply with legal obligations (such as right-to-work verification), and, with your consent, to consider you for future opportunities.

Legal basis (EU/UK applicants): We rely on (i) pre-contractual steps at your request (GDPR/UK GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)), (ii) legal obligations (Art. 6(1)(c)), and (iii) our legitimate interest in evaluating candidates (Art. 6(1)(f)).

Retention: If your application is unsuccessful, we retain your data for 12 months after the recruitment process concludes, unless you consent to longer retention. Successful candidates’ data becomes part of their employment records.

Your rights: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the processing of your personal data, to data portability, and to withdraw consent.

Automated decision-making: We use automated tools to assist in screening applications. No hiring decision is made solely by automated means without human review.

International transfers: Your data may be transferred to and processed in the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, or Romania. Where required, transfers are protected by Standard Contractual Clauses or other approved mechanisms.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood Taktile’s Applicant Privacy Policy. To exercise your rights or ask questions, contact Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Strategy & Operations Director
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Strategy & Operations Lead of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Generalist background in consulting, investment banking, start-ups, private equity or venture capital.

  • Experience building or scaling a business, ideally in financial services or fintech.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn regulation quickly and work credibly with regulators.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with boards, regulators, partners and teams.

  • Comfortable working across product, operations, finance and compliance.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a senior manager.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania.

  • Experience with MiFID II, brokerage, wealth management or fund distribution.

  • Experience building or running a regulated financial business in the EU.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

  • People who see regulation as someone else’s problem.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

title: Studio Director
descriptionHtml:
About Ogilvy  

Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports & entertainment, PR & social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy was named Network of the Year at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and ranks as the #1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. For more information, visit Ogilvy.com, and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

Studio Director



Department: WPP / Ogilvy
Location: London / National
Contract type: Permanent
Full Time/Part time: Full Time
Reporting into: WPP Lead 

The Role
As a Studio Director within the Studio Network—a dynamic WPP-operated brand amplification powerhouse—you will be at the helm of creating and scaling distinctive, platform-native content across Europe. Your core mission is to seamlessly run one of our studios, acting as the trusted partner and strategic advisor for brand marketers. You will lead a talented core team, orchestrate creative delivery, and continuously elevate the quality of our output, ensuring our studio remains the go-to destination for every brand brief.

At Ogilvy, we are guided by David Ogilvy’s core values: Do the Right Thing, Do the Best Work of Our Lives, and Do It Together. If these principles resonate with you, we’d love for you to join us in shaping what’s next.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead with Impact: Direct the studio’s daily operations under the clients leadership, ensuring every brief meets agreed standards and service levels are consistently achieved.
  • Build Lasting Partnerships: Become the trusted face of the studio to brand marketers across your markets. You'll join their planning sessions, showcase results, and proactively remove any roadblocks.
  • Optimize and Orchestrate: Smartly match capacity to demand, balancing your core team, flexible resources, and the wider network bench to handle workflow peaks smoothly.
  • Elevate the Creative Standard: Act as the guardian of quality, overseeing decision gates, tracking compliance to our 100% KPI, and ensuring we hit high scores on the clients Creative Scale.
  • Global Collaboration: Seamlessly manage the daily workflow with our global delivery centres (India and South Africa), ensuring flawless quality control before assets reach client approvers.
  • Drive Continuous Improvement: Own the quarterly studio scorecard, pinpointing and driving at least one major operational improvement each quarter.
  • Champion Your Team: Foster a supportive environment focused on retention and growth. Lead onboarding, ongoing training, and certify the team on every new brand.


Key Skills

  • Proven leadership in running a high-volume, high-quality creative or content studio.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with a knack for building trust with senior brand marketers and navigating complex matrix structures.
  • Strong operational acumen, including capacity planning, resource management, and workflow optimization across global delivery centres.
  • A sharp eye for creative quality and platform-native content, with experience using data and performance metrics to measure and elevate output.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities, capable of turning scorecard data into actionable quarterly improvements.
  • A passion for people development, with a track record of building, retaining, and growing high-performing teams.

About You
You are a natural leader who thrives at the intersection of operational excellence and creative brilliance. You don't just manage processes; you inspire teams and build unshakeable trust with clients. You are commercially savvy, culturally fluent, and possess a proactive mindset that spots opportunities for improvement before they become issues. If you are ready to drive an engine that produces world-class content for one of the world's most iconic brand portfolios, and you love seeing your team grow alongside the work, you'll be right at home here.

Benefits & Culture
At Ogilvy, we are a friendly, collaborative, and eclectic team united by a shared commitment to doing the best work of our lives. Beyond client work, you’ll have the chance to shape our vibrant culture, join active social teams, and contribute to our industry-leading DEI initiatives.

Here is a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

  • Hybrid Working: We embrace a hybrid model that blends collaborative in-office time with the flexibility to work remotely.
  • Annual Leave: 25 days holiday, a paid volunteering day, plus the option to buy up to 5 additional days.
  • Pension: a generous matched scheme. Contribute 4% (Ogilvy pays 6%) up to a maximum contribution of 7% (Ogilvy pays 10.5%—totalling a powerful 17.5%).
  • Healthcare & Wellbeing: BUPA Private Medical Insurance, plus discounted BUPA dental cover or financial contribution towards your physical and mental wellness.
  • Employee Assistance: 24/7 access to remote GPs, mental health support, physio, nutrition consultations, and confidential counselling for you and your family.
  • Free 1-to-1 Coaching: Professional and personal growth coaching sessions annually.
  • Life Assurance & Income Protection: Financial peace of mind for you and your loved ones.

Ogilvy champions innovation and the thoughtful application of AI. We encourage you to use AI tools to enhance your application and achieve the best possible results. During interviews, we may explore how you leverage AI, showcasing your judgment and ability to integrate these technologies effectively.

Please ensure your application authentically reflects your own skills, experience, and unique contributions.

At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self-expression. 

We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality. 

Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve.  This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.

Ogilvy is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

title: Support Operations Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Job title: Support Operations Analyst

Reporting to: Support Lead

Location: Remote (UK based)

Are you curious, analytical, and eager to grow in the world of SaaS and AI?

Aveni is an award-winning technology company. We use advanced AI to enable scalable efficiency for financial services companies, combining world-leading Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Model (LLM) expertise with deep financial services domain experience to drive enterprise-wide productivity. Aveni harnesses the power of voice to drive unprecedented efficiency and oversight. We’re using the latest in AI to automate and innovate, empowering businesses to achieve exceptional productivity and compliance outcomes.

We’re looking for a Support Operations Analyst to help us scale how customer support works through AI, automation, knowledge and strong operational processes. A core part of the role will be owning and improving our AI support experience: increasing the proportion of customer requests resolved through AI and self-service, continuously improving the content and workflows that power it, and using conversation data to identify new opportunities for automation. You’ll stay close to customers by providing second-line support when needed, while also improving our knowledge, incident and problem management practices.

About the Role

As a Support Operations Analyst, your primary focus will be making Support more scalable, proactive and effective. You’ll take day-to-day ownership of optimising our AI support agent, Intercom Fin, using performance data and conversation reviews to improve involvement, resolution and deflection. You’ll author and test AI content, tune workflows and routing, identify knowledge and automation gaps, and implement improvements that allow more customers to get the right answer without needing a human response. Alongside this, you’ll own key parts of our customer-facing knowledge and Support operations, help ensure we’re ready for product launches, coordinate customer-impacting incidents and recurring product issues, and provide second-line customer support where human investigation is required.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Second-line Customer Support – Provide hands-on support for customer requests that require human investigation or cannot be resolved through AI or self-service. Troubleshoot issues, communicate clearly with customers and use these conversations to identify opportunities to improve Fin, documentation or product experience.

  • Incident & Problem Management – Act as a Support point of contact during customer-impacting incidents: triage and escalate high-priority issues, coordinate with Engineering, maintain clear stakeholder and customer communications, and contribute recommendations that improve the process. For lower-impact bugs and recurring problems, work with Product and Engineering to maintain visibility and help ensure a healthy level of customer-impacting issues is picked up through sprint planning.

  • Technical Investigation – Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues, gather the right evidence and work confidently with Product and Engineering when deeper investigation is required.

  • Product Knowledge – Develop a strong understanding of Aveni’s products to support users effectively and confidently.

  • Launch & Cross-functional Collaboration – Work with Product, Marketing, Training & Enablement and Engineering to ensure Help Centre and Intercom content is accurate, and that customer documentation and Support readiness are in place for new features and product launches.

  • AI Support Optimisation – Take day-to-day ownership of optimising our AI customer support experience. At Aveni we use Intercom Fin, but experience with Zendesk AI or similar platforms is equally relevant. Author, test and continuously improve the content and instructions that power Fin; tune workflows, routing and hand-off paths; review customer conversations to identify new deflection and automation opportunities; and implement improvements that allow more requests to be resolved before reaching the Support team. Own regular reporting on AI involvement, resolution and deflection rates, using the data to identify trends, prioritise experiments and demonstrate the impact of changes.

  • Knowledge Management – Maintain and improve Help Centre content, FAQs and internal Support guidance, ensuring AI and human agents have accurate, useful knowledge to work from. Identify documentation gaps through conversation reviews, support trends and AI performance, and work with Product, Marketing and Training & Enablement to close them.

What We’re Looking For

  • A strong interest in technology, SaaS, and AI.

  • Solid problem-solving skills with a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.

  • Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in simple terms.

  • Experience in a customer-facing or technical support role, ideally within B2B SaaS, with confidence owning customer issues from first contact through to resolution or escalation.

  • Hands-on experience optimising AI customer support platforms such as Intercom Fin, Zendesk AI or similar. We’re looking for evidence that you have actively improved how an AI agent performs — for example by authoring and testing content, tuning workflows or routing, reviewing conversations for deflection opportunities, and using involvement, resolution or deflection reporting to drive measurable improvements. Direct Fin experience isn't essential; the track record matters more than the platform.

  • Experience maintaining customer-facing knowledge bases or Help Centres and turning support trends into clear, useful documentation.

  • A collaborative team player who is comfortable working both remotely and independently.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in a B2B SaaS or fintech environment, particularly supporting complex or regulated customers.

  • Experience designing or running experiments to improve AI agents, automation or self-service journeys in a customer support environment.

  • Experience using support and AI metrics such as SLA, CSAT, involvement, resolution and escalation trends to identify and prioritise improvements.

  • Experience with incident and problem management practices, including escalation, stakeholder communication, root cause analysis and continuous improvement.

  • Experience working with Product and Engineering during high-priority incidents and managing lower-impact bugs through a backlog or sprint-based development process.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • A collaborative and innovative work environment with career growth opportunities

  • 34 days holiday plus your birthday off (inclusive of bank holidays)

  • Share options – we believe in shared success

  • Skills development – continuous learning is at our core, expect the development to be front and centre of everything you do

  • Remote and flexible working – remote, co-working spaces, or a mix of both

  • Life insurance, income protection and private health care

  • Freebies and discounts at a range of retailers

  • Emotional wellbeing (Employee assistance programme provides access to 24/7 employee counselling and emotional support)

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Pension scheme (employer contribution matched up to 5%)

Join Us in Making a Difference

At Aveni, we believe that diversity drives innovation. We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities we serve and creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best work. If you're passionate about leveraging technology to drive positive change and want to be part of a team that's shaping the future of financial services, we'd love to hear from you. We know that some people are likely to only apply where they meet 100% of requirements, but we’d like to hear from you anyway.

Apply now to join us on our mission to transform the financial services industry through AI.
