title: Syndikus-Steuerberater/in (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Einleitung

Wir suchen neue Kolleg:innen! Migrando ist ein Legal-Tech-Unternehmen aus Cottbus. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Weg zur Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht und einem starken Team aus über 60 Kolleg:innen begleiten wir tausende Mandant:innen erfolgreich auf dem Weg zum deutschen Pass. Alle unsere Stellen sind Festanstellungen bei uns vor Ort in Cottbus.

Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich selbst einen Eindruck auf unserer Karriereseite. Denn wir können hier schreiben, was wir wollen, am Ende bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung.

Wir bieten Dir

Bei uns bist du keine Nummer in einer Großkanzlei, sondern die steuerliche Instanz für eine ganze Unternehmensgruppe. Du arbeitest strategisch, hast direkten Einfluss auf Entscheidungen und bekommst ein Umfeld, das dir dafür den Rücken freihält.

  • Keine operative Fristlast
    Bei uns arbeitest du strategisch, inhaltlich und qualitativ hochwertig, ohne die ständige Fristendichte und den Dauerstress einer klassischen Kanzlei.
  • Gestaltungsfreiheit & direkter Impact
    Du bist Sparringspartner:in auf Augenhöhe für die Geschäftsführung. Deine Expertise findet Gehör, deine Konzepte werden umgesetzt.
  • Attraktives Festgehalt
    Wir schätzen deine Verantwortung und Erfahrung. Deshalb erwartet dich ein faires Bruttogehalt zwischen 5.000 und 8.000 Euro im Monat, je nach Qualifikation.
  • Strukturierte, digitale Prozesse
    Kein Papierkrieg, keine Zettelwirtschaft. Wir arbeiten konsequent mit durchdachten digitalen Workflows und moderner Technik.
  • Kurze Wege und kleine Teams
    Du arbeitest in überschaubaren Teams, in denen man sich kennt. Du musst dich nicht durch Hierarchien hangeln, um gehört zu werden, sondern sprichst direkt mit Kolleg:innen, Teamleads oder der Geschäftsführung. Entscheidungen fallen schnell.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit
    Mit deiner Arbeit hältst du ein Unternehmen auf Kurs, das Menschen dabei unterstützt, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen.
  • Ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz
    Rückenfreundlicher Stuhl, höhenverstellbarer Tisch, zwei große Monitore, ein hochwertiges Headset, ein leistungsstarker Laptop und eine ruhige Umgebung.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit und flexible Teilzeit
    Keine Kernzeiten, keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster. Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell: Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.
  • Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung
    Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Nach deiner Einarbeitung ist gelegentliches Homeoffice aber kein Problem, auch spontan.
  • Spontan frei, wenn das Leben dazwischenkommt
    Kranke Kinder, Elternabend, kurzfristiger Arzttermin oder einfach mal eine Auszeit: Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.
  • Altbau-Büro im Herzen von Cottbus
    Unser modernes Altbau-Büro verbindet Charakter mit bester Ausstattung. Mit guter ÖPNV-Anbindung und Mitarbeiterparkplätzen in der Nähe kommst du entspannt an. Im Haus gibt es einen kostenlosen Fitnessraum, und auch dein Hund ist bei uns ausdrücklich willkommen.
  • Team-Events und Feel-Good-Angebote
    Sommerfest am See, Weihnachtsfeier, Halloween-Sause, gemeinsame Lunches oder Afterwork-Dinner: Wir feiern gern. Erscheinen ist keine Pflicht, und früher gehen ist auch kein Problem. Zwischendurch sorgt unsere Feel-Good-Managerin für kleine Auszeiten, von der kurzen Schultermassage bis zu Momenten zum Durchatmen.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

Als Syndikus-Steuerberater (w/m/d) bist du die zentrale steuerliche Ansprechperson für die gesamte Migrando-Gruppe. Du berätst die Geschäftsführung, entwickelst Konzepte und sorgst dafür, dass wir steuerlich sauber und zukunftsfähig aufgestellt sind.

  • Umfassende steuerliche Betreuung der Gruppe
    Du betreust die Migrando GmbH, die Rechtsanwaltskanzlei, die verbundenen Holdings sowie die privaten Steuern der Gesellschafter vollumfänglich.
  • Beratung der Geschäftsführung
    Als strategische:r Berater:in bewertest du die steuerlichen und wirtschaftlichen Auswirkungen geplanter Entscheidungen und gibst klare, fundierte Empfehlungen.
  • Entwicklung steuerlicher Konzepte
    Du erarbeitest Optimierungsstrategien, begleitest Umstrukturierungen und Holding-Aufbauten und stellst sicher, dass wir wirtschaftlich und rechtlich optimal aufgestellt sind.
  • Koordination mit externen Steuerberater:innen
    Du bist die Schnittstelle zu unseren externen Kanzleien, steuerst die Zusammenarbeit und sorgst für Transparenz.
  • Prozessgestaltung & Tax-Compliance
    Du baust interne steuerliche Prozesse auf und optimierst sie, damit Abläufe effizient, korrekt und zukunftsfähig bleiben.

Dein Profil

title: Talent Partner, GTM
descriptionHtml:
Talent Partner, GTM

Location: London, onsite 4 days a week.
Duration: 12-month fixed term contract

Retire The ERP.

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers: automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.

We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Keyshot. People don’t just use Light, they enjoy it.

We’re an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you’re excited to modernise how the world runs money, one workflow at a time, you’re in the right place.

Backed by world-class investors and advised by industry titans, we’re building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes.

Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

The Role

We plan to double the team in 2027. Most companies that grow this fast dilute the talent density that made them good. We won’t.

You’ll hire across GTM: the teams that win our customers and tell the world about Light. One week that might be an enterprise account executive, the next a product marketer or a demand generation lead. You’ll lead Marketing hiring and work alongside our Sales Talent Partner on Sales. It will be fast and at times messy, and you’ll be the person who brings structure to it.

This isn’t a role for someone who wants to sit and screen all day. We want a guardian of the bar: someone who steps back, looks at the whole hiring problem and fixes what’s actually in the way. AI and good process handle the volume. You bring the judgement, and relationships with great people long before we need them.

What You’ll Do

  • Own Marketing hiring end to end, from individual contributors to leadership

  • Work on Sales searches alongside our Sales Talent Partner, including account executives, SDRs and partner sellers

  • Partner with Marketing and Sales leaders from the start: shape the role, challenge the brief, and build the scorecards and calibration that keep the bar high

  • Work out why a search is stalling, whether it’s the brief, comp, location, assessment or the market, and fix it. Sometimes the answer isn’t an external hire at all.

  • Map the markets for the GTM profiles we hire most often and build talent pools, so the pipeline exists before roles open

  • Hire internationally, with visa sponsorship and relocation support, as our GTM team expands into new markets

What Success Looks Like In Your First 6 Months

  • Marketing and Sales leaders bring you in early because you make their hiring decisions better

  • Hiring managers know what they’re getting and when, because you’ve told them, with data

  • We have mapped markets and warm talent pools for our most common Marketing and Sales profiles

  • Hires are closing at pace, and every one makes the team stronger

  • At least one AI workflow you’ve built is part of how the whole team works

How Our Talent Team Works

  • We protect talent density. Every hire should raise the average. We’d rather hold a role open a little longer than fill it with the wrong person.

  • We source proactively. Most of our best hires won’t apply, so we don’t wait for a role to open. We map the market, build relationships early and have a pipeline ready when the need arrives.

  • We use data. We know where candidates come from, where they drop out and what predicts a good hire. We use that to challenge hiring managers with evidence.

  • We build with AI. We don’t mean writing job ads with ChatGPT. We mean sourcing workflows, research agents and automations that change how much a recruiter can get done.

What You’ll Get From Us

Most Talent teams are bolting AI onto the way they’ve always worked. We’re building ours AI-first, from the ground up.

  • A team built AI-first. AI does the searching, research and admin, so you can spend your time on judgement, relationships and closing. You’ll help design how that works, rather than having it handed to you.

  • The tools and the time to build. You’ll have Claude, Codex, Lovable, Noon and Ashby from day one, plus a regular team build session to test new workflows. When something works, it becomes how the whole team operates.

  • A strategic role. You’ll help shape GTM hiring plans and market-entry decisions, bringing leadership evidence on where talent sits and what it costs.

  • Real ownership. Marketing hiring is yours to build from the ground up.

What You’ll Bring

  • 4+ years in Talent Acquisition, mostly in-house or in embedded or RPO-style roles, hiring GTM teams, including Marketing, in high-growth B2B SaaS or fintech

  • You switch gears fast. You can move from an enterprise sales search to a product marketing hire in the same afternoon, picking up the language, the market and what good looks like in each.

  • Deep knowledge of the London and European GTM talent market. Without opening LinkedIn, you could tell us which companies build the best Marketing and Sales teams, how they structure comp and OTE, and who’s likely to move.

  • You’re a guardian of the bar. You hold it under pressure, including telling a hiring manager “not this one” when the deadline is tight.

  • You step back before you dive in. When a search isn’t working, your first instinct is to work out why, before you screen more CVs.

  • You work at pace and bring structure to chaos. When priorities shift and reqs pile up, you set a clear plan and keep everyone moving.

  • A track record of proactive sourcing: hires you found and engaged before the role opened, rather than hires that applied

  • Hands-on experience building with AI to improve recruiting, with examples you can walk us through

Bonus Points

  • Hiring GTM teams for new markets

  • Building a Marketing team’s hiring from scratch

  • Experience with Claude, Codex, Lovable, Noon or similar tools

The Good Stuff

🏢 In-office culture, high talent density.
💸 Competitive salary.
🏝 25 days annual leave plus public holidays.
🚀 Shape how Light hires as we double the team.
🥳 Off-sites twice a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence!

Equal Opportunities

Light is an equal opportunities employer. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, just let us know.

title: Teamleider Electromagnetic Warfare (m/v/x)
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij die ambitieuze Teamleider / R&D engineer die graag helpt om civiele en militaire vliegtuigen veilig, duurzaam en competitief te laten vliegen? Wil jij jezelf verder ontwikkelen en word je enthousiast van techniek, innovatie en duurzaamheid? Wij zijn op zoek naar een teamleider voor de afdeling.

Wat ga je doen?

In een wereld waarin lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen steeds complexer worden, is het belangrijk om innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen om de veiligheid en efficiëntie te garanderen. Binnen NLR werken we aan de ontwikkeling van geavanceerde aerospace systemen. We maken hierbij gebruik van software modelering en simulatie om het gedrag van complexe systemen te begrijpen en te optimaliseren.

Onze expertise in hardware testen en operationele ondersteuning (OPS) zorgt ervoor dat onze oplossingen niet alleen theoretisch solide zijn, maar ook praktisch toepasbaar en robuust.

De belangstelling voor Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) neemt toe, met de noodzaak om onze lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen te beschermen tegen elektromagnetische bedreigingen. We zoeken hierom een teamleider binnen onze nieuwe afdeling Aerospace Systems Electronic Warfare (ASEW)

Als teamleider EW zal je leiding geven aan een team van professionals met expertise in het ontwerp, de ontwikkeling en het testen van aerospace systemen met focus op Electronic Warfare.

Binnen onze nieuwe afdeling Aerospace Systems Electromagnetic Warfare zoeken wij een ervaren en gedreven Teamleider om ons team te leiden en te inspireren. De afdeling is gericht op het ontwikkelen van innovatieve oplossingen voor Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) en heeft als doel om de Nederlandse en internationale lucht- en ruimtevaartindustrie te ondersteunen.

Als Teamleider binnen onze afdeling ASEW ben je verantwoordelijk voor het leiden en ontwikkelen van een team van specialisten op het gebied van EW. Je werkt nauw samen met de Afdelingsmanager en andere teams binnen NLR om onze doelen te bereiken.

In afstemming met de Afdelingsmanager ASEW zal je één van de twee Electromagnetic Warfare kennisgebied overzien, namelijk Electronic Warfare Modelling and Simulation of Electronic Warfare Analyses.

In de rol van teamleider blijf je actief en inhoudelijk betrokken bij het uitvoeren van projecten en krijg je de coördinatie over een team van technische collega’s en het verder ontwikkelen en uitbouwen van de faciliteiten waarvoor ASEW verantwoordelijk is. Je bent dus zowel een teamleider als een R&D Engineer.

Als teamleider …

Als teamleider bied jij het team alles wat nodig is om de werkzaamheden van jouw team succesvol te laten verlopen. Je bent de directe leidinggevende van betreffende collega’s en draagt ook de HR-verantwoordelijkheid. Je coacht, stuurt, geeft én vraagt feedback en je pakt de leiding wanneer nodig.

Je stelt hen op deze wijze in staat om optimaal aan de projecten te werken en faciliteer jij hen waar nodig. Je zorgt voor het versterken van de kennispositie van het werkgebied en de realisatie van de werkzaamheden/opdrachten voor interne en externe stakeholders.

Je hebt een open en enthousiasmerende stijl van leidinggeven. Je collega’s voelen zich vrij en gesteund en kunnen zichzelf goed ontwikkelen. Er wordt een goede teamspirit ervaren. Je zorgt voor een goede aansluiting van het werkgebied bij de rest van ASEW en voor het zoeken van synergie met andere afdelingen binnen flight test en certificatie. Je versterkt de samenwerkingsrelaties gericht op het verder volwassen laten worden van het team.

Als R&D Engineer…

Als R&D engineer EW werk je mee aan het veiliger, duurzamer en competitiever maken van de militaire en civiele luchtvaart. Je werkt aan vliegtuigen, helikopters en onbemande vliegende systemen.

Je ondersteunt onze binnen- en buitenlandse opdrachtgevers bij het bereiken van hun doelen. Je voert testen uit, genereerd modellen en analyseert resultaten.

In de rol van R&D engineer, trek of draag je inhoudelijk bij aan projectvoorstellen voor bijvoorbeeld betaalde projecten in opdracht van een (externe) stakeholder. Dit kunnen ook onderzoeksvoorstellen zijn voor bijvoorbeeld defensie onderzoeks-calls.

Verantwoordelijkheden

  • Leiden en ontwikkelen van een team van specialisten op het gebied van EW;

  • Samenwerken met de Afdelingsmanager ASEW en andere teams binnen NLR om onze doelen te bereiken;

  • Overzien van een kennisgebied (Electronic Warfare Modelling and Simulation of Electronic Warfare Analyses) waarmee je samen met de Afdelingsmanager tot strategische doelen van het team komt;

  • Inspireren en motiveren van teamleden om hun beste werk te leveren;

  • Coördineren van projecten en activiteiten om de doelen van de afdeling te bereiken.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Een afgeronde WO master in een relevante discipline (bijv. lucht- en ruimtevaarttechniek, elektrotechniek, informatica);

  • Tenminste 3 jaar ervaring in een leidinggevende functie, bij voorkeur in de lucht- en ruimtevaartindustrie;

  • Aantoonbare kennis en ervaring op het gebied van EW;

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als het Engels (tenminste op C1 niveau);

  • Sterke leiderschaps- en coachingsvaardigheden;

  • In staat om een team te inspireren en te motiveren om hun beste werk te leveren.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten.

Naast dit alles bieden wij jou:

  • De kans om bij te dragen aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante vraagstukken;

  • Voldoende vakantie- en ATV-dagen (in totaal 45 bij fulltime dienstverband) voor een goede werk-privébalans;

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • Een tegemoetkoming in jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en cursussen die passen bij jouw ambities.

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Electromagnetic Warfare is een nieuwe afdeling binnen Aerospace systems en is voort gekomen uit de afdeling Defence Operations. Je zult de leidinggevende zijn van een team enthousiaste en gedreven professionals. Hierbij zul je nauw samenwerken met andere NLR afdelingen, in het bijzonder de afdeling waaruit ASEW voortgekomen is. De werkzaamheden zijn direct gerelateerd aan Defensie, weerbaarheid en de verdediging van Nederland en de Nederlandse krijgsmacht.

Je werkt vanuit onze locatie in Amsterdam en zult veel contact met collega's en partners binnen en buiten NLR.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties.

Bij ons werken meer dan 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. NLR staat voor een inclusieve en diverse organisatie waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt.

Wil jij meer weten?


Bel of mail dan met Frank Bax (recruiter) via 0615676915 of .

Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal.

Solliciteren?

Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button.

De teamleider is een parttime functie.

Een assessment maakt deel uit van de procedure.

Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD.

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld!

title: Teamleitung Naturnaher Wasserbau / Gewässerentwicklung (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Hier machst du dein Ding. Und wenn es passt, wird es auch deins.

Du planst Renaturierungen, Hochwasserschutz, Gewässerentwicklung. Fachlich macht dir so schnell keiner was vor. Was oft fehlt, ist der Raum dafür: Über dein Projekt entscheidet am Ende jemand, der nie am Gewässer stand, dein Budget verantwortest du nur auf dem Papier, und mit dem Kunden spricht jemand anderes.

Selbst wirksam werden. Bei Stowasserplan führst du dein eigenes Team, steuerst deinen Bereich wirtschaftlich und sprichst selbst mit deinen Auftraggebern. Du entscheidest, wie ihr arbeitet, und siehst direkt, was deine Entscheidungen bewirken. Nicht weil wir die besseren Ingenieure wären, sondern weil wir kurze Wege haben.

Schrittweise einsteigen. Wir suchen keine Führungskraft auf Zeit. Wer sich bei uns gut anstellt, unternehmerisch denkt und Verantwortung übernehmen will, kann sich nach einer Einarbeitungs- und Bewährungsphase am Unternehmen beteiligen und diese Beteiligung Schritt für Schritt ausbauen. So profitierst du direkt von dem Wert, den du mit deinem Team schaffst. Bei uns führt ein Weg von der Teamleitung zur Mitgesellschafterin oder zum Mitgesellschafter.

Wer wir sind

Stowasserplan plant seit 2009 naturnahen Wasserbau: Renaturierung von Fließgewässern, nachhaltiger Hochwasserschutz, Starkregen- und Erosionsvorsorge, Revitalisierung von Auen. Ingenieurbiologische Bauweisen sind unsere Kernkompetenz, nicht ein Zusatz im Leistungsverzeichnis.

Wie das aussieht, wenn es gelingt: Am renaturierten Pleißenbach spielen heute Kinder am Wasser. Am Hoyerswerdaer Schwarzwasser ist der Eisvogel zurück. Von der Machbarkeitsstudie über die Objektplanung nach HOAI bis zur Umweltbaubegleitung machen wir das komplett selbst.

Mit unserem Schwesterunternehmen Stowasserservice entwickeln wir aus unserer Praxiserfahrung Software, mit der andere Büros und Verwaltungen arbeiten: PROGEMIS für das Gewässermanagement, SOFIE für die Ingenieurbiologie. KI nutzen wir zunehmend als Werkzeug in unseren Planungsabläufen. Die fachliche Verantwortung bleibt beim Menschen.

Was du übernimmst

  • Ein Team von fünf bis acht Leuten: Projektverantwortliche, Projektmitarbeitende, Praktikanten. Du führst sie, planst Kapazitäten, führst die Mitarbeitergespräche und arbeitest neue Leute ein.
  • Die wirtschaftliche Steuerung deines Bereichs: Budgets, Termine, Qualität, Nachträge. Nach der Einarbeitung entscheidest du im vereinbarten Rahmen ohne Rücksprache.
  • Die Kundenbeziehung. Du sprichst selbst mit den Gewässerverantwortlichen in Städten und Verbänden, schreibst Angebote, verhandelst und holst Folgeaufträge.
  • Der Teil, für den uns heute die Zeit fehlt: KI-gestütztes Arbeiten in Prozesse einbauen, die halten. Projektstandards, Vorlagen, Qualitätssicherung, Wer das kann, prägt hier die nächsten Jahre.

Was du mitbringst

  • Führungserfahrung. Du hast mehrere Jahre eigenständig Projekte in Flussbau, Ingenieurbau, Wasserwirtschaft oder Regenwassermanagement geleitet und dabei Verantwortung für Menschen übernommen. Du weißt, wie man Aufgaben verteilt, Menschen entwickelt, Konflikte klärt und Entscheidungen auch dann trägt, wenn sie unbequem sind.
  • Du führst gern. Es macht dir Spaß, wenn dein Team besser wird, nicht nur, wenn dein Projekt gut läuft. Gespräche mit deinen Leuten siehst du als Teil deiner Arbeit, nicht als Unterbrechung. Begeisterte Kunden sind dein Maßstab.
  • Ein Studium im Bereich Bauingenieurwesen / Wasserbau, Landschaftsarchitektur, Umwelt- oder Landschaftsplanung oder etwas Vergleichbares.
  • HOAI sitzt, Baustelle ist dir vertraut, und im Vergaberecht (VgV, UVgO, VOB/A) kennst du dich sicher aus, als Bieter wie bei der Vorbereitung von Bauvergaben.
  • Praktische KI-Erfahrung. Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge bereits im Arbeitsalltag, etwa für Recherche, Texte, Auswertungen oder Angebote, kennst ihre Grenzen und hast Lust, das mit deinem Team weiterzuentwickeln.

Naturnahen Wasserbau und Ingenieurbiologie musst du nicht mitbringen. Das ist unser Kernwissen, und wir bringen es dir bei. Dafür nehmen wir uns Zeit und planen es ein.

Was du bekommst

  • Entscheidungen, die du triffst, statt Entscheidungen, die du vorbereitest.
  • 60.000 bis 70.000 Euro, je nach Erfahrung.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, an ein bis zwei Tagen pro Woche im Homeoffice zu arbeiten.
  • Fortbildung, die wir bezahlen und für die du Arbeitszeit bekommst.
  • Ein Büro, das wächst. Wir gehen in die DACH-Region. Das schafft Aufgaben, die es heute noch nicht gibt.
  • Eine unternehmerische Perspektive: Wenn die Zusammenarbeit trägt, kannst du dich schrittweise am Unternehmen beteiligen.

Warum es diese Stelle gibt

Wir wachsen. Dafür bauen wir unseren Führungskreis aus und besetzen eine weitere Teamleitung in Vollzeit.

Du kommst nicht in ein fertiges Team, sondern in eines, das gerade neu sortiert und erweitert wird. Wer darin die Chance sieht, ist hier richtig.

descriptionHtml:
• Role Title: Tech Lead
    Department: Engineering

    Role Summary
    As a Tech Lead at CreateFuture, you will use your technical and leadership skills to lead
    and support diverse client projects. Depending on the engagement, this includes
    hands-on coding, software architecture, solution design or delivery leadership and project
    management, ensuring a high standard of delivery in everything we do.
    We focus on high-value, high-impact client outcomes, and we’re not afraid to challenge
    the status quo. You should be curious, pragmatic, and operate well in ambiguous
    environments.
    As a technology consultancy, it’s important for us to not only deliver reliable, scalable
    solutions but to be looking at future trends and other high-impact developments. Your
    curiosity for technology and its application to business opportunities is highly valued
    within the company. We are disrupting consultancy through the use of Artificial
    Intelligence and radical thinking in our approach. We're doing something different, and
    that’s realising significant benefits for our clients. We want you to share that same
    ambition.
    You will also manage a team of technical direct reports, who are themselves working on
    client projects, for whom you will provide actionable feedback, technical guidance and
    mentoring, fostering a continuous improvement, growth and consultancy mindset.
    You will work with clients at every level to understand their problems, set expectations,
    and maximise business value, representing CreateFuture as an engagement lead.
    Role Requirements
    ● Proven, hands-on technical leader delivering complex software.
    ● Demonstrate thought-leadership; supporting our clients and colleagues to
    understand, through modern technology and process, what is possible for their
    business/craft.
    ● Line-manage a team of engineers while maintaining personal delivery
    contributions.
    ● Commercial experience in at least one: Java, .NET, Python, or TypeScript (backend
    or frontend).

    ● Commercial experience with at least one major cloud (Amazon Web Services,
    Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform) and modern infrastructure practices
    (containers, continuous integration/continuous delivery, infrastructure as code).

    management; escalates early with clear options and impacts.
    ● Communicate designs and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical
    stakeholders.
    ● Skilled in difficult conversations and actionable feedback; sets clear standards and
    holds people accountable.
    Desirable:

    improvement.
    ● Experience in change transformation projects that involved significant Artificial
    Intelligence adoption.
    ● Breadth across multiple languages or disciplines (e.g., Rust, test automation,
    DevOps/platform engineering).
    ● Experience across multiple clouds and cloud-native services.
    ● Contribute to recruitment and pre-sales in a consultancy context.
    ● Represent CreateFuture in the external tech community.
    Role Responsibilities
    Technical leadership:
    ● Communicate designs, trade‐offs, and constraints in the context of client goals.
    ● Lead architecture, solution design, and documentation; make pragmatic
    technology choices.

    testing, and maintainability.
    ● Troubleshoot complex issues; drive root‐cause fixes and follow‐up actions.
    Delivery leadership:
    ● Own technical outcomes: scope, estimate, plan, and track to agreed goals.
    ● Highlight risks, issues, and dependencies; escalate early with clear options,
    impacts, and recommendations.
    ● Ensure actionable backlogs and realistic plans; communicate timelines and team
    shape needs.
    People leadership (enable, unblock, hold to account):

    ● Guide direct reports to set themselves clear personal goals, and hold them
    accountable for realising them.
    ● Proactively remove impediments across technical, process, and organisational
    boundaries.
    ● Hold colleagues accountable for commitments and standards; address
    performance issues promptly.
    ● Provide targeted guidance and feedback; recognise achievements.
    ● Line‐manage direct reports; run core rituals (team meetings, 1:1s, objectives,
    reviews).
    ● Contribute to hiring.
    Client leadership:
    ● Build trusted relationships at all levels; translate business needs into technical
    plans.
    ● Manage expectations and scope; articulate value and trade‐offs; identify follow‐on
    opportunities.
    ● Represent CreateFuture as the engagement lead.
    Optional/community:
    ● Contribute to delivery practices and standards
    ● Contribute to pre‐sales.

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.

We look forward to your application!

title: Tech Lead
descriptionHtml:
MyEdSpace is an education technology platform that connects the best teachers on the planet with the students who need them the most - wherever they are, whatever their means.

Backed by $15m in Series A funding from some of the leading investors in the space, we're ready to scale - and we want you to help us build and scale MyEdSpace as part of a collaborative and ambitious team.

We're on a mission to make a world-class education accessible to all.

We believe that every child deserves access to quality education, regardless of geography or socioeconomic background, to achieve their dreams and build a brighter future.

If you’re motivated by solving meaningful problems and creating real impact through your work on a societal level and make a real impact on the world - we’d love to hear from you!

Job Title: Tech Lead

Experience: 8+ years commercial experience as a Software Engineer

Location: Remote / Flexible (UK timezone overlap required)

Compensation: Competitive + bonus upside

Your Impact at MyEdSpace

We’re looking for a Tech Lead who cares deeply about building great products and well-structured systems — whether your strengths lie in backend, frontend, or across the stack. You’ll guide technical decisions, help navigate trade-offs, and support engineers in delivering high-quality work.

The role spans three key areas of responsibility:

  • Technical leadership — coding, pair programming, peer reviews, and driving software and architecture design.

  • People management — running 1:1s, supporting career progression, and ensuring a strong feedback loop.

  • Product collaboration — working closely with product and design to shape scope, prioritise effectively, and align on outcomes.

We're building both the system and the team that will take us to the next stage — and you'll have real influence on how we scale, structure, and evolve our technology.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead and mentor a globally distributed team of engineers, fostering a high-performance, inclusive, and collaborative culture.

  • Set the bar for technical excellence, promoting best practices across architecture, CI/CD, testing, and code quality.

  • Drive a DevOps mindset — engineers own what they build, from design to deployment and beyond.

  • Architect and deliver scalable, maintainable systems and features with measurable impact on learners.

  • Collaborate with AI specialists to integrate adaptive, personalized learning into our platform.

  • Partner cross-functionally with product, design, and data to shape roadmap, scope work, and align on outcomes.

  • Continuously improve how we build software — from delivery speed and reliability to team workflows and technical decision-making.

What We’re Looking For

  • Senior engineering experience in product-led, fast-paced environments — ideally with time spent leading teams or large projects.

  • Strong software architecture skills — API-first, modular design, async comms, scaling patterns.

  • You work AI-first: LLMs and agentic tools are part of your daily workflow, not an experiment.

  • Experience across the stack — deep backend expertise and comfort navigating modern frontend frameworks (React.js preferred).

  • Fluency in Agile and Lean methodologies, you think in terms of shipping value in small increments, not running ceremonies.

  • Comfortable working in Docker-based, cloud-native environments (we use AWS).

  • A track record of shipping user-facing products that are performant, elegant, and thoughtfully engineered.

  • Excellent communication skills and collaborative mindset — you're comfortable working across disciplines and time zones.

Perks & Benefits

  • Flexible working hours

  • Competitive compensation with significant upside

  • Access to the latest AI tools & productivity software

  • Global, mission-driven team with a strong sense of purpose

Our Hiring Process

We aim to keep the process efficient, transparent, and focused on mutual fit:

  1. CV Screening

    We review your experience, technical foundation, and alignment with the role.

  2. Introductory Call with Hiring Manager

    A 60 minute conversation to discuss your background, what you're looking for, and how we work.

  3. Coding Exercise

    A take-home designed to assess practical skills — architecture, clean code, testing, and problem-solving.

  4. Technical Interview

    A deep dive into your engineering approach — we’ll explore past projects, technical decisions, and systems thinking.

  5. Culture & Collaboration Interview

    A final conversation to assess team fit, communication style, and alignment with our values and ways of working with the Product Manager of the squad

✨ Our values

PUT INTEGRITY FIRST Honesty matters. Tell the truth, and be straight-up. Be transparent and do the right thing. This builds respect and reliability for our students, families and team members.

KNOW YOUR COORDINATES Understand where you are and where you want to get to. Know your strengths and acknowledge your gaps. Think from first principles. Question things, and never pretend to know what you don't.

RAISE THE BAR Own it and get it done. Do better. Iterate quickly and seek feedback. Deliver real value. Be excellent and lift others up. Share learnings and help your teammates improve.

LOVE TO BE WRONG Push boundaries. Be outside your comfort zone. Naturally you'll get some things wrong and that's okay. Embrace feedback. Learn from it and get closer to excellence.

WIN TOGETHER To achieve our mission, we have to work together. We all have a role to play, so help each other get there. We’re stronger as a team so inspire, support and respect each other.

🙋 Why you’ll love working here

We’re a team on a mission to transform education for the better. Joining MES means you’ll be part of something ambitious, fast-moving, and full of purpose. Here’s what you can expect:

  • The chance to make a real impact: your work directly shapes the future of education.

  • A fast-paced and high-growth environment where ideas move quickly and careers accelerate.

  • A collaborative, supportive culture: we’re head quartered in the UK, but we’re a global team with colleagues in 15+ countries, bringing a rich mix of perspectives and energy.

We are committed to building a diverse team and strongly encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and help us build a better product for students around the world.

title: Tech Talent Partner
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

Why this role is different

The AI startups and scaleups we work with have roles they can’t fill. Not because they haven’t tried, but because they have world-class hiring bars, and it’s genuinely tough.

As a Talent Partner, you own those client relationships end to end. You take a role brief properly, you push back when it doesn’t add up, and you become the person a founder, internal talent partner or hiring manager calls before they’ve even decided to hire. You also own delivery, making sure every client has an amazing experience using Dex, from brief through to signed offer.

We’re an AI-first company, and our talent team is pushing the boundaries of what AI can do in recruitment. You won’t just be using AI tools, you’ll be part of the team working out what great hiring looks like when AI is built into every step.

You’ll also shape the product. You’ll work directly with our product and engineering teams, who are building tools specifically for you. When something isn’t working, whether it’s a match that shouldn’t have reached you or a workflow that slows you down, you raise it with the people who can fix it, and you see it change. Talent Partners are brought in early on anything that touches their workflow, so you help decide what gets built, not just use it.

What you’ll do

  • Own a portfolio of client relationships end to end: brief, delivery, feedback, and everything after

  • Take role briefs and kick-offs that actually hold up. Scope the role, interrogate the requirements, and tell a client when the role is really two roles, or shouldn’t be hired at all

  • Run the process on the client side: keep feedback fast, keep interviews moving, and keep momentum from breaking

  • Use funnel data to diagnose stalling roles and walk clients through where they’re losing people and why

  • Negotiate and close offers so that neither side feels managed

  • Grow accounts from one search into the whole hiring plan

You’ll probably have

  • 2+ years in tech or engineering recruitment, either in-house at a startup or scaleup or at a specialist tech agency

  • Hired for roles like backend, infra, ML/AI engineers, researchers or founding engineers, and the ability to hold a credible conversation with a CTO about what a role really needs

  • Strong command of funnel metrics: you know what good conversion looks like at each stage and what to do when it isn’t happening

  • Commercial sharpness and the confidence to push back on senior people early, rather than having the expensive conversation late

  • Curiosity about AI tooling. You’ll be a daily power user of a product that’s being built around you

Why join now

You’ll be building relationships with some of the best AI startups and scaleups on the planet, helping them hire the roles they care most about. You’ll have experienced talent leaders around you day to day, and a product team building tools for you specifically. This is a team that deeply understands how difficult and how important hiring is.

We’re open on backgrounds. If you have the raw ingredients and have excelled where you are now, we want to hear from you, even if you don’t tick every box.

What we offer

  • Above market base salary plus uncapped commission; we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition

  • Significant equity - we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

  • Full private healthcare & dental - because life happens and we want to support you

  • Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

  • Gym membership & wellness benefits

  • Claude tokens - lots and lots of Claude tokens

  • Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

  • MacBook Pro + team kit

  • "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support

The process

Our hiring process is designed to be transparent and respectful of your time. Here's what you can expect:

  • Talent Screen: Becca (Head of Talent) 30m

  • Hiring Manager Interview: Richard, who heads up Talent Operations at Dex (30-45m)

  • Short Take Home Exercise

  • Task Review (60m)

  • In person interview

    • Culture Fit & Values (45m)

    • Final Interview with Paddy, CEO and Founder at Dex (30m)

title: Technical Instructional Designer (AI Programmes)
descriptionHtml:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

The opportunity

AI can draft a lesson in seconds. It can't tell you whether that lesson will actually land with a nervous career-switcher three weeks into an AI apprenticeship — or whether the concept it just explained is subtly, but fundamentally, flawed.

That's where you come in.

You'll be the human judgement layer sitting on top of our AI-assisted content pipeline — part subject-matter expert, part instructional designer. You'll decide what AI got right, fix what it didn't, and build the parts no AI can: the high-touch, high-stakes, deeply human moments in a learner's journey that make the difference between content that's technically correct and content that actually changes someone's career.

You'll have experience building content in generative and/or agentic AI — not just someone who's read about it, but someone who can explain it, question it, and know when the AI-generated explanation of tricky subjects is actually going to help a learner or quietly confuse them.

 

What you'll actually do

  • Design outcomes, not just content. Apply end-to-end backward design to build AI programmes and content where success is measured by what learners can do on the job — not just what they can pass a test on. You'll own the hardest part: turning a job-aligned outcome into content that actually gets learners there.

  • Chase real-world impact, relentlessly. When a piece of learning isn't landing — when an AI practitioner cohort isn't showing the outcomes it should — you won't wait to be told. You'll spot it, own it, and scope the revisions that bring it up to the standard it needs to hit.

  • Build what AI can't. Design the custom, high-touch programmes and creative assets — branching narratives, bespoke multimedia, high-stakes onboarding moments — that need real human empathy, creativity, and nuance. If AI could have built it, it's not your job; if only a person could, it is.

  • Put AI to work, deliberately. Use AI tools and prompt engineering to accelerate your own content development and uncover learning design approaches nobody's tried yet. This isn't about using AI because it's there — it's about knowing exactly where it earns its place.

  • Advise up, not just build. Work directly with Programme Designers and senior stakeholders on the quality and pedagogical effectiveness of the content you design. Your feedback doesn't stay in the room — it shapes how our rules, principles and frameworks evolve.

  • Prototype for the long game. Lead new learning formats and modalities that don't exist yet — and know how to balance shipping fast against building something sustainable enough to reuse.

     

What you'll bring

  • Real command of end-to-end ADDIE and backward design — you've built measurable, job-aligned outcomes and the assessments that prove learners hit them, not just theoretical frameworks on a CV.

  • A habit of treating "good enough" as a starting point, not a finish line — you notice when learning isn't driving real outcomes, and you take the initiative to fix it.

  • Genuine fluency with AI-powered tools and prompt engineering, used to accelerate content development and find genuinely new applications in learning design.

  • The ability to take a genuinely complex generative and/or agentic AI concept and design a learning experience around it that actually works — for a range of different learner personas

  • The confidence and track record to influence peers and senior stakeholders toward a specific, measurable curriculum improvement — not just raise a concern and move on.

  • Resilience when things don't go to plan — you can point to a time a project hit a real obstacle (a blocker, a shifting SME, a launch that missed the mark) and describe exactly what you did about it, and what you learned.

What gets you in the door

You'll need at least one of these:

  • Hands-on experience producing technical content for generative and/or agentic AI.

  • 2+ years designing instructional content in a commercial environment or for commercial clients.

  • Plus one of:

    • A Data or Computer Science degree (or close cousin of one)

    • Completion of a technical apprenticeship in Data or AI

    • 2+ years working as a practitioner in Data or AI

 

If you're a strong technical practitioner who's never formally studied instructional design, or a seasoned learning designer who's spent the last year deep in AI tools — either path can get you here. We're looking for the judgment, not a checklist.

 

What we'll actually explore together

We're upfront about what our process looks for, because we'd rather you come prepared to talk about the real thing than guess what we want to hear. Across the conversations, we'll dig into:

  • Advanced curriculum & applied design — how you turn an end-to-end backward-design process into measurable, job-aligned outcomes, and how you build creative assets that genuinely need a human touch.

  • Impact & excellence — what you do when a piece of learning isn't hitting its real-world mark, and how you weigh speed against building something built to last.

  • AI integration & innovation — where and how you've put AI tools and prompt engineering to work, and what that's actually unlocked.

  • Influence & stakeholder management — how you've moved a curriculum forward through a genuine disagreement or feedback conversation, not just delivered a good pitch.

  • Coachability & resilience — how you've handled a launch that didn't land, or a project blocker outside your control, and what you changed as a result.

Benefits

title: Technical Product Manager (Data Integrations)
descriptionHtml:
Orcrist is building a next generation data intelligence platform using cutting-edge technologies. We're handling petabyte-scale data with sub-second queries. Our product is a Kubernetes‑based platform delivered as B2B SaaS or as a self‑hosted on‑prem solution, including air‑gapped deployments. We enable customers across defense, law enforcement, and enterprise to turn mission-critical data into actionable intelligence.

Role

Every investigation starts with data. As PM for the Integration team, you make sure analysts in law enforcement and defense have the data they need, when they need it. You own the roadmap for integrating data from commercial vendors, open feeds, social media and messaging platforms, as well as the admin interfaces used to manage these integrations. Your work ensures data arrives current, traceable to its source and ready to use.

This is a largely technical PM role with significant ownership over a platform and admin experience that are still taking shape. You decide what gets built and in what order, working closely with engineers and other product teams to turn provider APIs and data models into scalable integrations and features that support analysts’ investigations. You’ll read API documentation, map provider data to OIP’s data model and write clear, actionable specs that engineers can build from.

What you'll do

  • Own the provider roadmap. We add a source when it answers a question analysts can’t answer today, so you start from the analyst’s problem, not from a provider’s name. You talk regularly with analysts, admins and solutions engineers in law enforcement and defense, and with the upstream teams whose features bring integration requests. You decide which providers come next and what “done” means for each.
  • Write the technical specs. Cover authentication, pagination, rate limits and quotas, incremental sync, deduplication, field mapping, and how failures surface. Every object must carry its provider, fetch time and source URL from the moment it is fetched. Our platform runs as SaaS and on-prem, so you also decide how each source behaves in each distribution.
  • Own the connectors as a product. That covers the contract between connectors and the platform, versioning, and how quickly a new provider goes from evaluation to production. Every connector should make the next one cheaper. Where another team can reach a public source on its own, you give it a safe way to do so instead of putting it in our queue.
  • Own the admin interfaces. That means creating a connection, managing credentials, scheduling, health and status, logs, quota usage and permissions. A source we can’t monitor isn’t delivered, so every live connection needs a health check and clear failure states.
  • Work with partnerships and legal. You collaborate with the Director of OSINT and the Data Acquisition Manager to evaluate vendors, raise licensing and terms-of-service questions before we build, and turn the legal framework (storage, retention, redistribution) into product requirements. You also give the people negotiating contracts technical findings and cost per call.
  • Manage the teams around you. Upstream, you work with the teams building user-facing features, such as graphs and maps, who bring integration requests from their intelligence domain. You help them find the analyst question behind each request and decide whether a shared connector can serve several of them. Downstream, you work with the foundation teams for ontology, machine learning and processing, so incoming data arrives in a shape they can use. You forecast the load of every high-volume source before it goes live.
  • Shape person-focused investigation tools. You own how analysts go from a first lead about a person to a reviewed set of linked online identities. That includes how results are presented and reviewed, and how to avoid paying for the same lookup twice.
  • Measure the integration layer. Track sync success rate, data freshness, time to onboard a provider, active connections, and time to resolve a failed connection.

About you

  • 5+ years as a Product Manager in B2B SaaS, with experience owning a technically complex area end-to-end, such as an integration platform, an API product, or data pipelines.
  • You are comfortable in API documentation. You can discuss OAuth versus API keys, polling versus webhooks, pagination and rate limits with engineers as an equal, and you can try an endpoint yourself in Postman or curl.
  • You have designed admin or configuration interfaces for technical users: connection setup, status and error states, audit trails.
  • You write specs and acceptance criteria that are specific enough to build and test against.
  • You are data-fluent and define quality metrics for reliability and coverage, not just feature delivery.
  • You are comfortable with the legal side of third-party data: licensing, terms of service, GDPR, and provenance requirements.
  • You work well across teams, since integrations touch engineering, partnerships, customer success, and every product that consumes the data.
  • Eligible to work in Germany and willing to travel to Berlin and across DACH for workshops and customer visits.

Nice-to-haves

  • You have built or managed a connector framework, integration marketplace, or iPaaS product.
  • Familiarity with OSINT as a practitioner or product builder, and a sense of where existing collection tools fall short.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, on-prem, or air-gapped deployment constraints and what they mean for integration architecture.
  • Familiarity with entity resolution or link analysis, and how ingested data feeds them.
  • German language (B1+) 
  • Experience working directly with law enforcement or defense users in Germany or the DACH region.

What we offer

  • Real ownership, real impact: Own a critical layer of the platform that every customer relies on. Much of the integration platform and its admin experience is still taking shape, so you identify the problems, set priorities, decide what gets built, and see it through.
  • Remote-first, Germany-wide: Work from wherever you do your best work, with regular team gatherings in Berlin and other off-site locations.
  • Flexibility by default: Flexible working hours help you make work fit your life.
  • Your setup, your way: Get a personal home-office equipment budget to create a workspace that works for you.
  • 30 days of vacation: Take the time you need to recharge and come back with fresh energy.
  • Keep growing: We invest in your personal and professional development.
  • Get rewarded for impact: Performance bonuses are tied to agreed objectives and key results.
  • A warm welcome: Every new team member gets a welcome goodie bag.
  • Good people, good times: From summer and Christmas parties to regular team gatherings, we make time to celebrate together.
  • A mission that matters: Work on challenges with tangible impact on public safety and national security.

descriptionHtml:

Join us as a Technical Program Manager in our new Project Management Office (PMO), reporting to the PMO Lead. You will own day-to-day program management for one to two development programs, keeping schedules, responsibilities and risks visible across development and production departments. Working in a highly technical, fast-moving environment, you will build the habits and practice of program discipline that the whole company will adopt as the PMO scales.

    • Manage the day-to-day execution of the assigned programs including handoffs across departments.

    • Lead the program-management activities for your assigned programs: schedule build, baselining, gate reviews, etc.

  • Manage uncertainty and risk

    • Identify risks and bottlenecks early

    • Plan for potential failure modes and contingencies

    • Escalate risks and blockers to the relevant stakeholders promptly.

  • Support growth and development of the team

    • Mentor junior program managers in program execution and collaborative leadership.

    • Support the PMO Lead in rolling out common language, product lifecycle, team rhythms for programs.

  • Approach

    • Learn quickly in a highly technical, low-maturity field, without needing a deep technical background in quantum computing on day one.

title: Technical Recruiter, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
The R&D team at Chainalysis is inspired by solving the hardest challenges and building products that establish trust in cryptocurrencies. We're a global organization that thrives on challenging work and doing it alongside exceptionally talented teammates. Our industry evolves rapidly, and our mission is to build a flexible, AI-driven platform that automates entity resolution, optimizes data labeling pipelines, and creates predictive models that identify illicit patterns before they escalate.

Our data and solutions have been used to solve some of the world's most high-profile criminal cases and grow consumer access to cryptocurrency safely. Now, by pairing the industry's most trusted blockchain data with agents that reason, investigate, and act, we help our customers scale their workflows as the cryptocurrency economy becomes increasingly mainstream.

Talent Acquisition at Chainalysis is a small, close-knit team that partners with leaders across the business to hire the people who will carry our mission forward. We share sourcing wins, market learnings, and process improvements openly, and we hold ourselves to a high bar for both results and candidate experience.

We are hiring a Technical Recruiter to own and drive hiring for Engineering & Product roles in our EMEA locations. This is a high-volume, outbound-heavy role: you'll spend a meaningful portion of your time building pipeline through direct sourcing, identifying and engaging top engineering talent across AI, Crypto, and Fintech. You'll manage a full requisition load, move fast, and close strong candidates in a competitive market, with Software Engineering roles among your key hires. You'll work closely with hiring managers across our R&D teams as a talent partner who understands the business and delivers results.

In this role, you'll:

  • Build pipeline through proactive outbound sourcing, mapping the AI, crypto, and fintech landscape to find where strong Software Engineers work today

  • Develop creative sourcing strategies that go beyond LinkedIn InMails, including referral generation, community engagement, and direct outreach campaigns

  • Own the full recruiting lifecycle for R&D roles, from intake and sourcing through offer negotiation and close, across a high-volume requisition load

  • Deliver a thoughtful, personalised, and transparent candidate experience at every step while moving candidates through the process efficiently

  • Partner with R&D leaders to calibrate expectations, share market insights on talent availability and compensation, and flag risks early so hiring plans stay on schedule

  • Use data on pipeline health, conversion rates, and channel effectiveness to guide decisions, and champion diversity and inclusion in every search

We're looking for candidates who have:

  • 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience with a strong track record of hiring technical talent, such as Software Engineers, Data Scientists, Researchers, and Product Managers

  • Demonstrated outbound sourcing ability: you build your own pipeline through direct outreach and do not rely on inbound applications to fill roles

  • High AI proficiency, using it for building pipeline proactively, workflows, processes, and documentation

  • Proven experience recruiting technical talent within the SaaS, AI, Blockchain, and Cybersecurity sectors, with a focus on candidates who have worked in fast-paced companies building technically complex products

  • Consistently utilised data to inform decision making and advise hiring managers through the hiring process

  • Strong organisational skills, sharp attention to detail, and consistent follow-through on every candidate and requisition

  • The ability to build credibility with hiring managers quickly, communicate market realities clearly, and guide decisions with data, in a collaborative, low-ego way

You might also have:

  • Experience recruiting for Blockchain companies with a focus on Engineering roles

  • A background at a high-growth scale up technology company

  • A track record of hiring for technical roles in Denmark, Israel, UK, and the USA

Tools we use:

  • Ashby ATS

  • Sourcing tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, Nova AI, GitHub)

  • Coderpad

  • Google suite, Slack, Chain AI

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

title: Telecom security trainer
descriptionHtml:
About P1 Security

Founded in 2011, P1 Security is on a mission to secure critical and sovereign mobile networks by providing services and technologies to identify, detect, and recover from critical threats and vulnerabilities.

We address telecom security challenges across 5G, cloud-based infrastructure, OpenRAN, network slicing, edge computing (MEC), and legacy telecom systems (2/3/4G), including Diameter, SS7, SIGTRAN, GTP, and related attack surfaces.

Our team includes telecom operators, security professionals, and researchers who regularly share cutting-edge work at international security conferences and GSMA working groups. P1 Labs, our R&D branch, also shares open-source initiatives with the telecom security community (GitHub).

Job Description

Freelance Telecom Security Trainer — Worldwide Onsite Missions

We are seeking an experienced Freelance Telecom Security Trainer to deliver high-impact, onsite technical training for mobile network operators (MNOs), regulators, and enterprise clients worldwide.

Working on a per-mission basis, you will adapt and present established course content and practical lab materials from P1 Security’s training platform. You will help engineering and security operations center (SOC) teams understand telecom protocol vulnerabilities, assess their impact, and apply effective detection and defense strategies.

This role combines deep telecom security expertise with strong classroom facilitation skills and a practical, hands-on approach to learning.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver multi-day onsite technical workshops worldwide, adapting your approach to participants’ technical backgrounds and learning objectives.

  • Prepare for each mission by reviewing the course scope, audience prerequisites, learning objectives, and practical lab requirements with the P1 Security team.

  • Adapt existing online curriculum, presentations, exercises, and lab materials for engaging live classroom delivery.

  • Explain signaling flows, trust boundaries, protocol vulnerabilities, attack scenarios, and defensive controls clearly and accurately.

  • Facilitate hands-on exercises in authorized, controlled lab environments and help participants troubleshoot technical issues.

  • Answer participant questions on telecom security, including detection, mitigation, and operational defense strategies.

  • Check participants’ understanding through practical exercises, discussion, and knowledge checks.

  • Coordinate classroom and lab readiness with P1 Security and the client before delivery.

  • Gather participant feedback and share recommendations to improve course content and delivery.

  • Respect client confidentiality, intellectual property, and agreed rules of engagement throughout each mission.

Required qualifications

  • Deep telecom security expertise in one or more of the following domains:

  • SS7 / SIGTRAN: MAP/CAP signaling, common abuse scenarios, and signaling security controls. Related course: TS-201 — 2G, 3G and SS7 Mobile Network Security.

  • LTE / Diameter: S6a, Gx, and Gy interfaces, protocol vulnerabilities, and defensive measures. Related course: TS-401 — LTE Security and Insecurity.

  • GTP-C: Versions 1 and 2, control-plane procedures, security risks, and mitigation strategies. Related training tracks: TS-201 — 2G/3G and TS-401 — LTE / EPC, depending on the mission scope.

  • IMS / SIP: Signaling fundamentals, protocol weaknesses, and protection mechanisms. Related course: TS-250 — IMS Security.

  • 5G: Service-based architecture (SBA), HTTP/2 and JSON-based APIs, and interconnect security involving N32 and the Security Edge Protection Proxy (SEPP). Related course: TS-501 — 5G Telecom Security hands-on course.

  • You do not need to cover every domain to apply. Specialists in one or several domains are welcome. Missions will be matched to your demonstrated expertise; please indicate the courses and topics you are confident teaching independently.

  • Proven experience delivering technical training, workshops, or hands-on instruction to engineering or SOC teams.

  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts, manage classroom discussion, and adapt to mixed levels of experience.

  • Practical experience analyzing telecom signaling traces and using packet-analysis tools such as Wireshark.

  • Confidence working with Linux-based lab environments and troubleshooting connectivity or exercise issues.

  • Professional preparation, reliable delivery, and clear communication with clients and the P1 Security team.

  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally for short-term onsite engagements: typically around five days per mission including travel, with some engagements requiring up to two weeks onsite.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in telecom security consulting, penetration testing, incident response, signaling monitoring, or mobile core network operations.

  • Familiarity with 3GPP security specifications and relevant GSMA signaling security guidance.

  • Experience with signaling firewalls, roaming and interconnect security, or telecom threat detection.

  • Experience adapting digital learning content into instructor-led courses and practical exercises.

  • Familiarity with virtualized or containerized lab environments and scripting for lab preparation.

  • Experience teaching international audiences or working across different cultural and organizational contexts.

Language requirements

  • Fluent professional English, with the ability to deliver technical instruction and facilitate discussions.

  • Additional languages are a plus, including French.

Engagement details

  • Contract type: Freelance, on a per-mission basis.

  • Delivery location: Onsite at client locations worldwide.

  • Mission duration: Typically around five days including travel; some engagements may require up to two weeks onsite.

  • Headquarters: Paris, France.

  • Training materials: Established curriculum and lab materials from P1 Security’s training platform, adapted for each classroom engagement.

  • Commercial arrangements: Scope, preparation time, delivery dates, fees, and travel and accommodation arrangements to be agreed for each mission.

Hiring process

  • First contact call (10-20min)

  • Direct manager call (30min)

  • Capability assessment exercice (depending on position)

  • C-level & Director call (30 min)

Contact

If you are a motivated and experienced professional who is passionate about cybersecurity and driving innovation, we would love to hear from you! Join P1 Security and be part of a fascinating mission to protect critical infrastructure and work alongside industry experts in the cybersecurity field.

To apply, please send your CV or professional profile and a short introduction highlighting your telecom security expertise and training experience. Include the protocols and courses you can teach, examples of previous workshops or audiences, your availability, your location and travel flexibility, and your indicative daily rate. Please do not include confidential client information.

Website - www.P1sec.com

Linkedin - https://www.linkedin.com/company/p1security/?originalSubdomain=fr

What you will do

Testing and verifying new features is an important part of the job, as our product continues to evolve.   • Error Reproduction and Reporting: Create detailed error reproductions and document them clearly. Provide precise information to help resolve issues and record all error-related details in the internal system. 
  • Verification: Verify that developer fixes successfully resolve reported issues. 
  • Knowledge Base Management: Maintain and expand the internal Knowledge Base with documentation of new product functionality. 

 
 You will be great for this position if you have 

  • High level of self-motivation and independent work structuring. 
  • Curiosity and critical thinking. 
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies. 
  • Fluency in written and spoken English. 
  • (Plus) Experience with Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint and Excel. 

 
 Our Values 

As part of our team, you will embody and help shape the following principles that define us: 

  • Forward Thinking: We embrace change and challenge the status quo. 
  • Ownership: We take pride in our work and learn from our mistakes. 
  • Customer First: We prioritize delivering lasting value. 
  • Unified Team: We foster collaboration, respect, and integrity. 
  • Strive for Excellence: We set ambitious goals and pursue quality. 

 
 Why is thinkcell the right place for you? 

We empower over 1.3 million users across 35,000 companies, including top consulting firms and major global enterprises. With offices in Berlin, Munich, Denver, Boston, London, Tokyo, and Dubai, we’re a diverse team of over 220 people, committed to innovation and excellence. 

thinkcell is more than a job – it's a chance to be part of an innovative, inclusive team that values collaboration and growth. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply. Together, we can shape the future of productivity software. 

We can’t wait to see what you’ll bring to the team!

title: UI/UX Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join SE3 Labs as a UI/UX Software Engineer

Design and build intuitive, high-performance interfaces for autonomous systems, turning complex operational capabilities into software that people can use confidently in the real world.

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our future, help us build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team’s research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field

About the Role

As a UI/UX Software Engineer at SE3 Labs, you’ll take ownership of how our software looks, feels and performs. Your core challenge is to build one coherent interface system that works across many contexts: different devices, screen sizes, plugins and product features, from large command displays to small field devices with limited computing power. You’ll combine UX/UI design with hands-on front-end development, working closely with our software team. From integrating 3D visualisations to building interfaces for military personnel in the field, you’ll help shape a product from the ground up and see the direct impact of your work.

What You’ll Work On

  • Coherent UI System & Front-End Architecture: Design and build a modular, well-structured front-end and a consistent design language that spans our whole product range. Make it easy to add new plugins and features, and to run on different systems and devices, without losing consistency or maintainability.

  • UX/UI Design & Implementation: Work with the team to understand user needs, design and wireframe interfaces, and turn them into working software. Own both the user experience and the code that brings it to life.

  • Multi-Device & Performance: Build interfaces that adapt across small screens, tablets and large displays, and stay responsive on resource-constrained hardware. Identify bottlenecks, optimise rendering and deliver a smooth experience without relying on high-end devices.

  • 3D Visualisation Integration: Integrate 3D visualisations into the user interface so that they work smoothly alongside other features, including on devices with limited computing resources.

  • Plugin & Feature Interfaces: Build reusable UI components for different plugins and product features, so that third parties and internal teams can extend the platform in a consistent way.

  • Usability for Operational Environments: Help design interfaces for military personnel working in demanding conditions. Consider intuitive workflows, clear information hierarchy and established conventions such as NATO symbology. Learn from real user feedback and improve continuously.

  • Collaboration & Product Evolution: Work closely with the software team to understand customer needs and translate them into design and engineering decisions. Help shape how the interface evolves as the product grows, and look for ways to simplify workflows and make new capabilities easier to understand.

Your Profile

  • You enjoy building a coherent system rather than a single screen: one design language and one component structure that works across many plugins, systems and devices.

  • You bring hands-on experience designing and implementing user interfaces for software products, with a focus on intuitive, usable experiences across different devices and screen sizes.

  • You have built structured, responsive and maintainable front-end applications, not just static designs or isolated prototypes, and you know how to organise code into reusable components and modular structures.

  • You can move between UX/UI design and software development, turning wireframes and requirements into working interfaces and making informed decisions about both usability and implementation.

  • You care about performance as well as appearance, and you work methodically to improve the experience across different hardware.

  • You work well with engineers and other stakeholders, explore different approaches and turn ideas into practical solutions.

  • You take initiative, enjoy open-ended problems and want to help build and shape a product rather than maintain an established interface.

  • You’re interested in software for real-world use, where clarity, reliability and ease of use matter as much as visual design.

  • You’re happy to work on-site with the team in Munich.

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • 3D Visualisation: Experience integrating interactive 3D visualisations into software interfaces, particularly using Unreal Engine or similar technologies.

  • Performance on Constrained Hardware: Experience optimising front-end applications for low-compute devices, limited resources or demanding real-time requirements.

  • Complex Operational Interfaces: Experience designing interfaces for complex systems where users need to interpret spatial information, symbols or multiple sources of information quickly.

  • Gaming or Real-Time Visualisation: Experience in 3D gaming, motorsport, simulation or other fields where responsive interfaces and real-time visual feedback are important.

  • Building from Scratch: Experience establishing a front-end architecture, reusable component system or coherent design language for a new product or platform.

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Participate in SE3’s growth through our employee participation programme

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you

  • AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (30 minutes): An initial conversation to discuss your experience, motivation and interest in SE3 Labs, alongside an introduction to the role and our working environment.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (45 minutes): Discuss your experience, approach to software development and UX/UI design, and how you would contribute to the team.

  3. Technical Deep Dive (90 minutes): Explore your technical capabilities in more detail, including front-end architecture, interface design and implementation, responsive development and problem-solving.

  4. Team Lunch or Dinner: Meet members of the team, get a feel for how we work together and learn more about life at SE3 Labs.
