title: UX Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
We are hiring a UX Designer who loves turning real user problems into clear, safe and well-tested designs, and who wants to shape how healthcare professionals work with AI every day.

Our Mission
Attendi has already built a strong user base through speech-to-text integrations with electronic health record (EHR) vendors, used by over 300 care organisations in elderly and disability care. With the Attendi App (web and mobile), we are building a one-stop solution for AI-driven administration in healthcare: structured documentation, conversation summaries, voice-driven workflows and AI assistance, anytime, anywhere.

Design is central to this vision. Our users are care professionals working with clients, not behind a desk. Every flow we build needs to be simple, fast and safe to use. And because the Attendi App is being certified as a medical device (MDR), we don’t just design what feels intuitive, we prove that users understand and use it as intended.

This isn’t about making it as easy as possible to order a pizza. It’s about how a care professional can receive AI-generated advice safely, and make sure they check what matters before they rely on it.

Your Role
As a UX Designer at Attendi, you will:

  • Translate user research into user flows, wireframes and high-fidelity designs for the Attendi App.

  • Work closely with our UX researcher, who uncovers user needs in the field, and turn those insights into the right solution.

  • Visit care organisations to test your designs with healthcare professionals: does this solution fit the problem we observed?

  • Design for safety in an AI product: identify where users could misuse or over-trust AI output, and design features that mitigate that risk.

  • Run usability studies as part of our MDR certification, through simulations, observation or A/B tests, and document what you tested and learned.

  • Work in two lanes: fast shipping of new features, and careful, well-documented work on our medical device track.

  • Work closely with the product owner, developers and our compliance team to get designs into production.

  • Help mature our design system in Figma.


You might be a good fit if you hit most or all of the following:

  • 2-4 years of experience as a UX or product designer in a product team, working in sprints.

  • Experience with B2B SaaS products.

  • You start with questions, not solutions: who is the user, what is their context, what problem are we really solving?

  • You balance a startup pace with taking a step back to research and test before going to production.

  • Strong Figma skills.

  • Native Dutch speaker. You’ll talk with healthcare professionals a lot, in their own language.

  • A portfolio that shows your thinking: the user, the problem, how you approached it and how you measured whether it worked.

title: Venture Partner
descriptionHtml:
We are hiring a Venture Partner to bring new opportunities into Pairs, and to grow the network of investors who see them first.

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the opportunities that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

THE ROLE
This role works across both sides of Pairs. You bring in companies worth our diligence, and you grow the network of investors who back them directly.

This role is for people who bring in deals on their own. You already have an active network of founders who are raising, and investors who write direct cheques. Here you open new relationships on both sides every month, using the same approach that built your existing ones.

We are not raising a fund. Our investors invest directly in companies, so the work is about family offices, high-net-worth individuals and angels, not fund LPs.

Our platform handles the pipeline, research and follow-up. Your time goes to founder and investor conversations, and to judging which opportunities deserve the network's attention.

You will work directly with the two co-founders and our investor team. The organisation is flat, so you will see first-hand how we screen opportunities, what we decline and why.

Your current title matters less than the quality of your relationships. We are looking for someone who has built those relationships personally and can explain exactly how.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • New opportunities. Companies raising Series A and later, brought to Pairs with the context our team needs to assess them.

  • Network growth. New relationships every month with family offices, high-net-worth individuals and angel investors who are new to Pairs.

  • Investor matching. A clear understanding of what each investor looks for, so the opportunities you share are relevant.

  • Your relationships. The founders and investors you bring, kept current and qualified. They remain yours.

YOU ARE A FIT IF YOU

  • Have an active network of founders you can bring to the table yourself, and direct investor relationships you built personally.

  • Have brought at least one company or investor into a private round, and can walk us through how it happened.

  • Understand what makes a company worth an investor's time: stage, traction, round structure, and the reasons investors pass.

  • Treat discretion as second nature. Please do not include any investor or company names in your application.

  • Use AI tools daily, with clear judgement about where they improve your work and where they would compromise its quality.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • A fully remote, asynchronous role

  • Direct access to the co-founders and our investor team

  • Close collaboration with our internal team

  • Live mandates from your first week, and access to the opportunities that clear our diligence

  • Insight into our internal processes, including how we screen deal flow

  • A base salary plus commission

Compensation: $120K – $180K

Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

About the role

We're looking for a Visual Designer to own how Omnea shows up in the physical world and across marketing campaigns. You'll lead design for events, print and traditional media, and presentations, and support Marketing with graphic design for campaigns, content and paid ads.

Omnea now runs roughly one event every three days, across London, New York and beyond. You'll bring it in-house, raise the quality bar and build the foundations (templates, asset libraries, print specs) so every event doesn't start from scratch.

You'll work alongside our Founding Visual Designer, who owns digital (website, animations, product assets), building on a brand direction that's already set. Together you'll keep the brand consistent everywhere, from a product launch page to a booth at an industry summit, and help it evolve as we grow, pushing it into new formats, spaces and campaigns.

This is a hands-on role with a lot of ownership. You'll take briefs from Marketing and Events, shape them, push back where needed, and see them through to production.

What you'll do

Events

  • Design event assets end to end: booths, roll-ups, signage, badges, invites, menus, stage visuals and merchandise.

  • Partner with the Events team on our own events (like our Annual Summit in New York), industry conferences and customer dinners.

  • Build and maintain an event asset library and templates, including a self-serve starter kit so colleagues running smaller events stay on brand without a designer.

Print and traditional media

  • Design print collateral and out-of-home or traditional media placements.

  • Prepare print-ready files and work with printers and suppliers on production, quality and deadlines.

Marketing and campaign design

  • Create graphic design for campaigns, paid ads, social and content, working closely with Marketing and Product Marketing.

  • Support product launches with campaign assets, in partnership with the digital Visual Designer.

  • Help Marketing self-serve by growing our brand asset bank and templates.

Presentations

  • Design high-impact decks for events, keynotes, webinars, sales and leadership.

  • Maintain and evolve our slide templates so teams can build on-brand decks themselves.

  • Turn rough content into clear, well-structured presentations.

Brand

  • Apply and extend our new brand system across print and physical formats.

  • Raise the quality bar on customer-facing content, including guidelines for photography and filming at events.

What success looks like

  • First 30 days: you know the brand system inside out, you've shipped your first event assets, and you've mapped what currently goes to contractors.

  • First 90 days: events and print run through you, not contractors. There's a working event template library and a print spec/supplier list the team trusts.

  • First 6 months: colleagues self-serve the basics (starter kit, slide templates), and you spend your time on the moments that matter most.

Who you'll work with

  • Events: our Events team in London and New York.

  • Marketing and Product Marketing: a growing PMM team plus content, customer advocacy and growth.

  • Design: our Founding Visual Designer and the Design Director.

  • Leadership: occasional high-visibility requests (keynotes, board and leadership decks).

What we're looking for

  • Around 5 years in graphic or visual design, ideally in a B2B or in-house brand team. If you're close to that and your work speaks for itself, apply anyway.

  • A portfolio with real, produced events, print and campaign work, not only screens.

  • Strong typography, layout and colour, and confidence working within a brand system while pushing it forward.

  • Experience preparing print-ready files and working with printers and suppliers.

  • Comfortable juggling several briefs at once, pushing back on scope and keeping stakeholders in the loop.

  • Confident in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop).

  • Strong presentation design in Google Slides and Figma Slides.

Nice to have

  • Basic motion design for event screens and social.

  • Experience art directing photography or video.

How we hire

  1. Portfolio review by our design team.

  2. Intro call with Talent Team (about 30 mins).

  3. Design deep-dive: walk us through 2 to 3 produced projects.

  4. Meet the team: Marketing and Events stakeholders.

We keep it quick and tell you where you stand at each stage.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

title: VP Product & Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Tout ce que nos clients voient et utilisent, c’est vous qui le concevez. Nous créons le poste de VP Product & Engineering pour faire de notre puissance GPU une gamme de services d’IA que les développeurs prennent en main en quelques minutes : inférence managée, déploiement de modèles, notebooks, API.

Qui sommes nous ?

Arkane Cloud est un Cloud Service Provider lyonnais, conçu pour l’IA et hébergé en Europe, avec des datacenters à Paris et à Lyon.

Notre propre infrastructure GPU permet à des startups, des chercheurs et des entreprises de déployer leurs modèles en quelques minutes, dans le respect du RGPD et jusqu’à 70 % moins cher qu’avec un hyperscaler.

Notre ambition : bâtir un acteur européen de référence de l’infrastructure IA.

Pourquoi ce poste ?

Arkane Cloud passe de 10 à 50 personnes d’ici fin 2027, et sa direction s’organise autour de deux rôles complémentaires, tous deux rattachés au CEO. Le VP Infrastructure fait tourner nos datacenters, nos serveurs GPU, le réseau et le stockage. Le VP Product & Engineering construit tout ce que nos clients voient et utilisent.

Vous dirigez deux pôles :


• Product : l’expérience de nos clients, de la console à l’onboarding, avec la documentation et l’analytics produit.
• Engineering : la plateforme elle-même : API publique, SDK et CLI, comptes et droits, facturation à l’usage, services d’IA managés.

Vos missions

• Bâtir nos services IA

• Porter la vision et la roadmap de la plateforme

• Structurer et faire grandir les pôles Product et Engineering.

• Solidifier les fondations

• Co-construire avec le VP Infrastructure les API de provisioning, les nouvelles offres GPU et leur pricing (avec le CSO), la gestion des incidents et la communication client.

Vos 6 premiers mois

• 1er mois : rencontre des clients et des équipes, état des lieux de la console, de l’API, des services d’inférence et de la facturation.

• 3 mois : roadmap produit et IA à 12 mois validée avec le CEO, organisation des pôles Product et Engineering posée, interfaces avec l’Infrastructure formalisées.

• 6 mois : un premier service IA managé lancé ou refondu, indicateurs produit suivis chaque mois, recrutements clés réalisés.

Votre expérience

• 10 ans ou plus en engineering avec une dimension produit, dont au moins 3 ans à la tête de pôles produit et techniques.

• Au moins une solution IA construite et mise en production à l’échelle : plateforme d’inférence, MLOps, API de modèles ou produit cloud pour développeurs.

Vos expertises

Indispensables :

• IA et inférence : moteurs de serving (vLLM, SGLang ou équivalent), déploiement et optimisation de modèles en production.

• Kubernetes : vous savez concevoir des services qui y tournent et dialoguer d’égal à égal avec l’équipe Infrastructure.

• Facturation à l’usage et IAM : mesure de la consommation, billing, authentification, gestion des droits.

• Management de pôles en croissance, anglais professionnel courant.

Un vrai plus :

  • Expérience chez un cloud provider, un neocloud GPU ou une plateforme MLOps ;

  • Connaissance des marketplaces de modèles.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

• Du poids dans les décisions, vous serez rattaché au CEO, vous définissez la stratégie produit avec le VP Infrastructure.
• Une équipe à bâtir. Deux pôles, Product et Engineering, à structurer pendant le passage de 10 à 50 personnes.
• Un produit qui porte votre signature : console, API, facturation, services d’IA managés : tout ce que nos clients utilisent, c’est vous qui le concevez.
• Un cloud IA européen à construire. Un cloud GPU souverain, pour des clients qui veulent garder la maîtrise de leurs modèles et de leurs données.

Package et avantages

• 90 – 110 k€ brut annuel, BSPCE

• Deux jours de présentiel (mercredi/jeudi) pour les profils de la région lyonnaise ou deux jours toutes les deux semaines pour les profils en dehors de la région lyonnaise.

• Mutuelle à 100 %, tickets restaurant, RTT (Convention Syntec)

Arkane Cloud s’engage pour la diversité : nous étudions toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, d’âge, d’origine ou de handicap.

Compensation: €90K – €110K

title: wo-stage onderzoek milieukosten m.b.v. bestaande afval- en emissiestatistieken
descriptionHtml:
wo-afstudeerstage/praktijkstage, vanaf februari 2027

Ben jij die nieuwsgierige onderzoeker die energie krijgt van data, duurzaamheid en nieuwe inzichten?
Wil jij een inhoudelijke bijdrage leveren aan de statistieken van het CBS?

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Het kabinet wil dat Nederland in 2050 volledig circulair is. Om te kunnen volgen of we die doelstelling halen, is betrouwbare informatie nodig over onder andere afval en emissies naar water. Het CBS verzamelt en publiceert deze gegevens voor bedrijven. Daarbij maken we vooral gebruik van gegevens uit het elektronisch Milieujaarverslag (e-MJV), aangevuld met enquêtes.

Naast de hoeveelheid afval en wateremissies brengen we ook de milieukosten van bedrijven in kaart, bijvoorbeeld de kosten voor afvalverwerking en voor het lozen van afvalwater. Hiervoor wordt nu een aparte enquête gebruikt. Maar is dat eigenlijk wel nodig?

Tijdens je stage onderzoek je of we de milieukosten voor afval en wateremissies kunnen berekenen met gegevens die al beschikbaar zijn. Je combineert bijvoorbeeld gegevens over de hoeveelheid afval en geloosd water met bestaande indicatoren, zoals gemiddelde kosten per ton afval en sectorspecifieke kosten per kubieke meter geloosd water.

Je gaat onder andere:

  • bestaande data en indicatoren analyseren en beoordelen op bruikbaarheid;

  • onderzoeken welke methode het meest geschikt is om de milieukosten te schatten;

  • een berekening of model ontwikkelen waarmee de kosten kunnen worden afgeleid;

  • de uitkomsten vergelijken met de beschikbare gegevens uit de huidige enquête;

  • onderzoeken hoe betrouwbaar en bruikbaar de schattingen zijn;

  • je bevindingen vertalen naar een concreet advies voor het CBS.

Met jouw onderzoek willen we bepalen of we meer uit bestaande data kunnen halen en minder hoeven uit te vragen bij bedrijven. Als blijkt dat de milieukosten betrouwbaar kunnen worden berekend, kunnen de uitkomsten bovendien worden gebruikt om de bestaande afval- en waterstatistieken te controleren.

In het meest gunstige scenario kan de aparte enquête naar milieukosten gedeeltelijk of helemaal vervallen. Dat betekent minder administratieve lasten voor bedrijven, efficiënter gebruik van beschikbare data en mogelijk betrouwbaardere statistieken.

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag

We verwelkomen je binnen de sector Leefomgeving bij team Milieu. Met 20 gedreven professionals werken we aan milieu gerelateerde statistieken en doen we onderzoek naar actuele thema’s zoals klimaat(verandering) en circulaire economie. We werken nauw samen met andere teams binnen het CBS.

We werken hard aan het continu verbeteren van onze statistieken en de cijfers beschikbaar te stellen voor het publiek. Voorbeelden van recente publicaties uit ons team zijn:

  • Bedrijven investeerden in 2024 minder in milieu | CBS

  • Bijna 2 procent meer bedrijfs- en industrieafval in 2021 | CBS

  • Milieukosten en -investeringen van bedrijven | CBS

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een wo-opleiding milieukunde, economie, technische bestuurskunde, data science of een aanverwante opleiding.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met het onderwerp circulaire economie.

  • Je bent analytisch sterk en kunt complexe vraagstukken gestructureerd onderzoeken en vertalen naar heldere inzichten.

  • Je kunt goed programmeren in R.

  • Je bent sociaal en communicatief vaardig en kunt je ideeën en bevindingen helder overbrengen aan verschillende gesprekspartners.

Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • jouw competenties in kwantitatieve data-analyse versterkt door gebruik te maken van milieustatistieken en economische databronnen;

  • jouw onderzoeksvaardigheden aanscherpt op het gebied van de circulaire economie en levenscyclusanalyse;

  • jouw programmeervaardigheden in R verder ontwikkelt;

  • ervaring opdoet met het interpreteren van verschillende datasets om betrouwbare profielen op te stellen.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken.

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.
Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking.

title: Working Student - LLM Inference Performance
descriptionHtml:
About Tensordyne

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

About the Role

How fast should an LLM building block run on our hardware? How fast does it actually run, and what would make it faster?

As a Working Student, LLM Inference Performance, you'll help answer these questions by working directly with our hardware and software engineering teams.

You'll write and optimize low-level kernels, benchmark performance on real silicon, and develop profiling tools that help engineers understand and improve LLM inference performance.

You'll gain hands-on experience with our Rust programming stack and Python SDK, use AI coding agents as part of your development workflow, and collaborate closely with engineers working on compilers, runtimes, and kernel optimization.

This is an opportunity to apply your academic knowledge to real-world AI hardware challenges while taking ownership of meaningful technical projects.

What You'll Do

  • Understand our hardware: Learn how Tensordyne silicon processes data, manages memory, and synchronizes operations, and how key LLM components such as attention, MLP, and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing map onto the architecture..

  • Develop and optimize kernels: Implement, test, and tune low-level kernels to improve the performance of LLM inference workloads..

  • Analyze performance: Build analytical and roofline performance models, compare predictions against simulator and real-silicon measurements, and investigate performance bottlenecks..

  • Build benchmarking and profiling tools: Develop benchmark harnesses, profiling scripts, and trace visualizations that make performance easier to measure, understand, and improve..

  • Work with AI coding agents: Explore workflows where AI agents assist with kernel development, optimization, and benchmarking, and identify the tools and context they need to work effectively..

  • Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with compiler, runtime, and kernel engineers to translate performance insights into practical improvements..

Example project: Develop a benchmarking and profiling harness for an LLM building block, such as decode attention, at two abstraction levels. Compare measured performance against theoretical estimates and make the tooling accessible to AI coding agents.

What We're Looking For

  • Currently enrolled in a Master's degree program in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field..

  • Strong programming skills in Python and at least one of C, C++, or Rust..

  • Understanding of computer architecture, memory systems, bandwidth, and parallel computing through academic coursework or personal projects..

  • Interest in low-level programming, hardware performance, and optimization..

  • Practical experience using AI coding agents in development workflows, with the ability to evaluate and improve their output..

  • An experimental mindset, with the ability to form hypotheses, analyze measurements, and communicate technical findings clearly..

  • Curiosity, initiative, and enthusiasm for learning new technologies..

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:

  • GPU or AI accelerator programming..

  • Embedded systems or bare-metal programming..

  • Performance profiling, benchmarking, or optimization..

  • LLM inference fundamentals and architectures..

Why Join Tensordyne?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI technology: Contribute to the development of next-generation AI inference hardware and software..

  • Gain hands-on experience: Apply your university knowledge to real silicon and challenging engineering problems..

  • Own meaningful projects: Build tools and solutions that directly support our engineering teams..

  • Learn from experienced engineers: Work alongside specialists in hardware architecture, compilers, runtimes, and performance optimization..

  • Explore AI-assisted development: Gain practical experience building with AI coding agents and shaping how they interact with advanced hardware systems..

  • Make a lasting impact: Help develop performance tools and workflows that will support both current and future generations of Tensordyne technology..

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values

  • Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.

title: Quality & Data Intern (m/f/d) – Mandatory Internship / Prácticas
descriptionHtml:
About JawBuddy

JawBuddy helps people with jaw pain, teeth grinding and TMJ problems through a guided exercise app. Our app measures jaw movement through the phone camera using computer vision and AR, so users see their progress in real numbers.

We are a small, funded health-tech team with paying customers in Germany. Next up: a B2B platform release in early 2027.

How this internship works

We offer this role in exactly two ways:

  • Mandatory internship at an EU university: you are enrolled at a university in the EU and your study regulations require an internship. You send us a document from your university that confirms this. Start as soon as possible.

  • Prácticas at a Spanish university: you are enrolled at a university in Spain, and the internship runs through your university's internship agreement (prácticas extracurriculares with a convenio), full-time or alongside your studies. Start from December 2026.

We can't offer working-student contracts, voluntary internships or freelance work.

The role

You make sure our app and our numbers can be trusted, and you use AI to do it at a scale one person couldn't before. AI handles the repetitive checks; you handle what needs human judgment, like testing our camera features in the real world. You work directly with our CTO and founding engineer.

  • About 60 % app and computer vision quality: real-world testing, releases, accessibility, performance

  • About 25 % data quality: making sure analytics data is complete and correct

  • About 15 % automation with AI: building automated tests and checks, and reviewing what they find

What you'll do

Test our computer vision in the real world

  • Test camera-based jaw tracking across devices, lighting, faces, glasses and beards

  • Find the conditions where measurements break, and help the team fix them

Own app quality

  • Own the release checklist for every iOS and Android build

  • Test accessibility, German texts, performance, slow networks and offline use

  • Write clear bug reports in Linear, with steps to reproduce and evidence

  • Keep test evidence documented, as our product requires

Keep our data trustworthy

  • Review the daily data-quality checks across Amplitude, AppsFlyer, RevenueCat and BigQuery, and investigate what they flag

  • Find out why two tools disagree, and get it fixed

  • Keep our tracking plan in sync with what the app actually sends

Automate with AI

  • Use AI tools to write automated tests (Maestro), generate test cases and run checks

  • Review what AI produces: you are the person who decides whether it is right

What you bring

  • Enrolled at an EU university with a mandatory internship in your study regulations, or at a Spanish university that signs a convenio for prácticas

  • Available 20 to 40 hours a week, remote, as your university allows

  • Fluent in English (the app is in German; the team works in English)

  • Solid SQL

  • A structured, curious way of testing: you find the edge cases others miss

  • You already use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or similar) in your daily work

Nice to have

  • Test automation (Maestro, Detox, Appium)

  • Accessibility (WCAG, VoiceOver, TalkBack)

  • Product analytics (Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4) or attribution (AppsFlyer)

  • dbt or Dataform, Git, Python

  • Interest in computer vision, health tech or medical device quality

What we offer

  • Compensation: €300 per month

  • Real ownership: you own the release checklist, and when you say a build isn't ready, we listen

  • Work with AI from day one: you learn how to run quality at scale with AI, a skill few people have yet

  • Rare experience: computer vision, health data and quality in a health product, all in one role

  • Mentorship: a weekly 1:1 with our CTO

  • Hours that fit your studies: 20 to 40 hours a week, as your university requires

How we hire

  1. Send your CV and your university document (internship requirement, or confirmation that your university can sign a convenio).

  2. A 30-minute call with our team.

  3. A short trial task: we send you a test build of the app, and you spend about 2 hours finding and reporting what's wrong. Use any AI tools you like.

  4. A final conversation, and an offer within a week.

Details

  • Type: mandatory internship (EU university) or prácticas (Spanish university)

  • Hours: 20–40 per week, depending on your university

  • Location: remote within the EU

  • Compensation: €300 per month

  • Start: as soon as possible; prácticas in Spain from December 2026
